title: Campaign Specialist
description:
**About Amenify**

Amenify was founded in 2017 in San Francisco and has raised $25M to date. Amenify is the leading AI-powered resident commerce platform in the US that helps property managers and residents with services they love. Through a proprietary network of local providers, enterprise integrations, and personalized concierge tools, Amenify powers services like local retail, dining, grocery, home services, maintenance, and more. Through its API integrations powering resident engagement, Amenify is available in 15 million homes in the USA. We encourage high-performers from all backgrounds to reach out, provided they share our core values listed here: https://www.amenify.com/about-us.

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a Campaign Specialist to plan, execute, and manage marketing campaigns across various digital platforms. The candidate will be responsible for driving campaign performance, generating leads, improving engagement, and ensuring campaigns meet business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other platforms.
* Monitor campaign performance, budgets, leads, and conversions.
* Generate quality leads and improve lead conversion rates.
* Optimize campaigns to achieve better ROI and reduce cost per lead (CPL).
* Conduct audience research, keyword research, and competitor analysis.
* Create and test different ad copies, creatives, and campaign strategies.
* Track campaign performance using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics tools.
* Prepare regular performance reports and share campaign insights.
* Coordinate with the design and content teams for ad creatives and marketing content.
* Identify new opportunities to improve campaign reach, engagement, and conversions.
* Manage advertising budgets and ensure effective utilization.

**Key Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 years of Experience in performance marketing and paid advertising.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.
* Understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, ROAS, and other performance metrics.
* Experience in lead generation and campaign optimization.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and budgets.
* Good communication and reporting skills.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Strong pronunciation and speech clarity
* Customer-first approach
* Detail-oriented and disciplined

**Why should you join us?**

* Above-industry salary + performance bonus + monthly bonus
* Team lunches and outings
* High-growth trajectory with rapid learning
* Best referral bonus in the market
* Massive ownership of work & projects
* Direct 1:1 time with founders
* Work with an ambitious, collaborative, transparent team

**Meet our Founders:**

* Danish Chopra
* Everett Lynn

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**

#ARM Worldwide is a digital advertising and marketing communications enterprise founded in 2013, specializing in integrated strategies across earned, paid, and owned media. The company combines creativity, technology, and analytics to deliver comprehensive digital transformation solutions for clients. A team of strategy experts and creative professionals leads KPI-driven, innovative campaigns that create impactful and trending conversations for partner brands. #ARM Worldwide maintains key partnerships with leading platforms such as Google, Leadsquared, and Microsoft Advertising. With a team of 220+ professionals across Gurugram and Mumbai, the company operates as a global thinker and delivery leader.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Performance Marketer role based in Gurugram. The individual in this role will support the planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital channels. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with media planning, audience targeting, budget allocation, and campaign trafficking; monitoring performance metrics; and preparing regular reports with insights and recommendations. The role also involves conducting market and competitor research, collaborating with account managers and creative teams to align messaging with campaign objectives, and ensuring campaigns meet defined KPIs. The Peformance Marketer is expected to stay updated on new media trends, platform features, and best practices to enhance campaign effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Media Buying and Planning to support effective paid campaign strategy and execution.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and present campaign insights clearly.
* 3-7 years of experience with Google, Meta, and Linkedin Ads
* Candidates should possess familiarity with New Media platforms and digital ecosystems to manage campaigns across diverse channels.
* Candidates should possess Research skills to analyze markets, audiences, competitors, and campaign performance data.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong analytical thinking, eagerness to learn, and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

description:

**About Relier Media**

Founded in 2014, Relier Media is a digital-first creative and media agency with studios in Mumbai, Dubai, and now Delhi NCR. We specialize in building and scaling global brands through a mix of creative storytelling, digital campaigns, performance media, and influencer activations.

**Our client portfolio includes:**

* **H&M**

  – High-impact influencer-led sustainability and fashion campaigns.
* **Audi**

  – Brand and advertising campaigns.
* **India's first molecular haircare brand**

  – A category-defining biotech beauty company promising salon-level hair repair in minutes.

At Relier, you'll work on campaigns that shape industries, build consumer brands, and drive measurable business growth.

**Know more:**
www.reliermedia.com

**The Role: Senior Media Planner**

We're looking for an experienced, strategic, and highly analytical Senior Media Planner who has extensive hands-on experience in planning, setting up, executing, managing, and scaling digital advertising campaigns.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role that goes beyond creating media plans. We are looking for someone who understands the complete campaign lifecycle, from campaign strategy and account setup to execution, optimisation, analytics, and scaling.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and other digital advertising platforms, with a proven ability to improve campaign performance, increase Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and drive sustainable growth.

A key focus of this role will be
**scaling a D2C brand**

by building effective performance marketing strategies, optimising customer acquisition costs, improving conversions, and maximising overall marketing efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities****1. Media Strategy & Campaign Planning**

* Develop comprehensive media strategies and campaign plans aligned with business objectives, marketing goals, target audiences, and budgets.
* Identify the right platforms, channels, audience segments, and campaign formats to maximise reach, engagement, and conversions.
* Plan and execute full-funnel marketing strategies covering awareness, consideration, acquisition, and retention.
* Develop performance-driven media strategies for D2C and e-commerce brands.

**2. End-to-End Campaign Setup & Execution**

* Independently set up, launch, manage, and execute advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Have complete working knowledge of campaign structures, ad sets, targeting, placements, bidding strategies, pixels, conversion events, and tracking.
* Manage campaign budgets, audience segmentation, retargeting, and creative testing.
* Ensure accurate campaign tracking, implementation of pixels, conversion APIs, UTM parameters, and other measurement tools.
* Monitor campaign delivery and troubleshoot performance or tracking-related issues.

**3. Performance Marketing & ROAS Optimisation**

* Continuously monitor and optimise campaigns to improve ROAS, reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and increase conversion rates.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency.
* Conduct A/B testing across creatives, ad copies, audiences, landing pages, and campaign structures.
* Optimise campaigns based on CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, CAC, conversion rates, and ROAS.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and implement data-backed corrective strategies.
* Develop strategies to scale winning campaigns while maintaining profitability.

**4. D2C Brand Growth & Scaling**

* Have a complete understanding of how to scale a D2C brand through performance marketing.
* Develop and execute customer acquisition and retention strategies to drive sustainable business growth.
* Understand the D2C business funnel, including website traffic, product discovery, add-to-cart, checkout, and purchase conversions.
* Work towards improving website conversion rates, average order value (AOV), customer lifetime value (LTV), and repeat purchase rates.
* Understand D2C unit economics and the relationship between advertising spends, revenue, margins, and profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across digital channels and build scalable media strategies.

**5. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting**

* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads reporting.
* Analyse website traffic, user behaviour, conversion funnels, and customer acquisition data.
* Track and evaluate campaign performance through dashboards and analytical reports.
* Prepare regular performance reports, media plans, and actionable business insights.
* Translate campaign data into clear recommendations for improving performance and business outcomes.

**6. Budget Management & Media Optimisation**

* Plan, allocate, and manage advertising budgets across multiple platforms.
* Ensure efficient utilisation of media spends while achieving campaign objectives.
* Forecast campaign performance and provide recommendations on budget allocation.
* Monitor spending, revenue contribution, and overall campaign profitability.

**7. Research & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, and market studies to identify media opportunities and emerging trends.
* Work closely with creative, content, influencer marketing, and e-commerce teams to develop effective advertising campaigns.
* Provide creative teams with performance insights and recommendations for ad creatives.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth campaign execution.

**What We're Looking For**

* **5–8 years of relevant experience**

  in media planning, performance marketing, digital marketing, or media buying, preferably in an agency or D2C environment.
* Proven experience in independently setting up, executing, managing, and scaling digital advertising campaigns.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Complete working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, pixels, and campaign attribution.
* Demonstrated ability to improve ROAS, optimise CAC, increase conversions, and scale advertising campaigns.
* Strong understanding of D2C business models, e-commerce funnels, customer acquisition, and retention strategies.
* Experience in media planning, budget allocation, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and campaign optimisation.
* Strong understanding of performance metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, AOV, LTV, reach, and impressions.
* Ability to interpret complex campaign data and translate insights into actionable growth strategies.
* Experience managing substantial advertising budgets and multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why Join Relier?**

* **Build and Scale Brands:**

  Work on scaling ambitious consumer brands, including India's first molecular haircare brand.
* **Ownership & Impact:**

  Take ownership of media strategy, campaign execution, and performance outcomes.
* **Cross-category Exposure:**

  Work across fashion, FMCG, technology, entertainment, and beauty.
* **Creative & Performance-led Environment:**

  Collaborate with creative and growth teams to build campaigns that deliver measurable impact.
* **Growth Opportunities:**

  Be part of a fast-growing agency where your strategies directly influence business performance.

**Interested?**

If you have the experience, analytical mindset, and expertise to build and scale high-performing digital campaigns, we'd love to hear from you.

naveen@reliermedia.com

title: Founder's Office
description:
About AdsFlo

AdsFlo (adsflo.ai) is a Meta Ads analytics and launcher platform built by performance marketers, for performance marketers. It started as the internal tool behind Outwrk Media, a Gurugram-based D2C growth agency that manages about ₹40 crore of monthly ad spend across 50+ brands.

Today AdsFlo helps brands and agencies launch ads in bulk, tag and analyse every creative with AI, and see what is actually driving ROAS. Google Ads launching and Shopify data are next. We have paying customers, a product that works, and now need someone to take it to market.

**Role:**
Founder's Office, Growth (Sales, Marketing and Customer Success)

**Location:**
Gurugram, in office

**Experience:**
1 to 3 years

**Reports to:**
Founders

The role

You will be the first growth hire at AdsFlo and own the full customer journey: getting brands to hear about us, closing them, and keeping them happy enough to stay and refer others.

This is not a coordinator role. You will work directly with the founders, sit in on product decisions, and be the voice of the customer inside the team. If you have run Meta campaigns yourself, you already understand our buyer better than most salespeople ever will. That is the edge we are hiring for.

What you'll ownSales

* Build and run the pipeline: D2C brands, agencies and in-house growth teams spending on Meta
* Run discovery calls and product demos, handle objections, and close deals end to end
* Own outbound on LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp, plus warm intros from the Outwrk network
* Track every lead in a CRM and report weekly on pipeline, conversion and revenue
* Shape pricing, plans and the agency (B2B) offering based on what you hear from buyers

Marketing

* Plan and run AdsFlo's own paid campaigns on Meta and Google, and own the CAC and trial-to-paid numbers
* Run the founder and brand LinkedIn presence: posts, carousels, product walkthroughs, customer stories
* Create content that performance marketers actually want: teardowns, benchmarks, creative insights from the platform
* Own the website funnel (landing pages, signup flow, onboarding emails) with the product team
* Set up webinars, community sessions and partnerships with agencies and D2C founder circles

Customer support and success

* Onboard new customers: ad account connection, first launch, first insight within the first week
* Be the first line of support on chat, email and WhatsApp, and resolve or route issues fast
* Turn support tickets and feedback into clear, prioritised inputs for the tech team
* Track activation, usage and churn; run renewals and upgrades
* Build the help docs, FAQs and video guides so customers can self-serve

Who we're looking forMust have

* At least 1 year of hands-on performance marketing, ideally Meta Ads for D2C brands, at an agency or in-house
* You know ROAS, CPM, CTR, CPC, CVR and AOV cold, and can explain why a campaign is working or not
* Strong spoken and written English and Hindi; you can hold a room on a demo call and write a sharp cold email
* Analytical by default: comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, pulling numbers and turning them into a story
* High ownership: you finish what you start without being chased

Good to have

* Any B2B or SaaS sales exposure, even informal (freelance clients, agency pitches)
* Experience with Google Ads, Shopify, or quick commerce ads
* A LinkedIn presence or content you have created and grown
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Notion, Canva or basic automation

You'll love this if

* You want to see how a SaaS company is built from the inside, not just one function of it
* You would rather own a number than a task list
* You see the founder's office as a fast track to leading growth, and you want that responsibility early

This is not for you if

* You need a fixed playbook and a large team before you can start
* You dislike talking to customers or picking up the phone

Your first 90 days

By

What success looks like

Day 30

Know the product inside out, speak to every active customer, set up the CRM and support process

Day 60

Run demos and close your first deals independently; AdsFlo's own Meta campaigns and LinkedIn calendar are live

Day 90

Own a monthly revenue and activation target, with a repeatable sales and onboarding playbook in place

What we offer

* Direct access to the founders and every growth decision
* Exposure to 50+ D2C brands through the Outwrk portfolio
* Fast-track path to leading AdsFlo's growth team as it scales
* CTC: ₹8 to 10 lakh per annum

You will be responsible for end-to-end campaign delivery, risk mitigation, and driving client retention.

Key Responsibilities

• Sales Collaboration & Client Meetings: Partner closely with the Sales team to attend client meetings, pitch presentations, and discovery calls. Deeply understand brand requirements, identify core marketing pain points, and provide expert strategic consultation on-site.

• Strategy & Proposal Pitching: Translate vague or complex client briefs into actionable influencer marketing proposals. Build and present compelling PPT pitches with clear commercial logic to convince clients of optimal execution paths.

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Senior Brand Marketing Manager | Cüraa

Backed by 3one4 Capital, Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital (₹40 crore Series A, led by 3one4 Capital)

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 4–8 years in brand marketing at D2C / consumer startups

Type: Full-time

Focus: Brand building, launches, content and creators, D2C growth

Category: Kitchen and home appliances

THE ROLE IN SHORT

Own the Cüraa brand. You will shape how India sees Cüraa, launch every new product with a clear story, and make every rupee of performance spend work harder. This is a hands-on role in a lean D2C team: you set the direction and you also get it done, working closely with the founders, product and design, performance marketing, marketplaces and customer experience.

We are looking for someone who has built a brand from scratch, not someone who has only managed a big one.

Half a million homes. Now make 40 million remember the name.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. The brand: positioning, value proposition, tone of voice and visual identity for Cüraa and any new brands we launch. Build the brand book and the distinctive assets that make people recognise us before they see the logo.

2. The consumer: talk to customers, read every review, run quick surveys and home visits in real Indian kitchens, and track competitors on Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. Turn what you learn into messaging, claims and input for our product roadmap.

3. The launches: go-to-market for every new product: naming, claims, packaging story, listing content and A+ pages, launch creatives and plans across our website, marketplaces, quick commerce and offline. Every launch gets one clear reason to buy.

4. The content and campaigns: creator and influencer programs, social, video, PR and community, plus festive and sale-season campaigns (Big Billion Days, Prime Day, Diwali). Test fast, keep what works, kill what does not.

5. The numbers: brand and growth metrics that matter for D2C: share of search, organic traffic, ratings and reviews, repeat purchase, content engagement, and how brand work lowers CAC and lifts conversion. Work hand in hand with the performance team on creative and budget.

6. The team and the standard: lead a small team (content, social, design) and freelancers or agencies with sharp briefs. Keep the brand consistent across the website, marketplace stores, packaging, social and customer service.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 4–8 years in brand marketing, mostly at D2C or consumer startups

• You have built a brand, sub-brand or category from scratch, and can show what you did and what it achieved

• Hands-on launches: products taken from zero to market on D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce

• Strong content instincts: creators, social, video, packaging and listing pages that sell

• You understand how brand and performance marketing work together, and speak the language of CAC, ROAS and conversion

• Comfortable with lean budgets: you get big results from small spends

• Data-driven: you use reviews, social listening, search trends and simple dashboards to decide what to do next

• Strong taste in creative, copy and design, and the ability to brief and guide a small team or freelancers

• Ownership: you work like a founder and do whatever it takes to ship

BONUS POINTS

• Home, kitchen or consumer durables experience

• Took a D2C brand from early stage to scale

• Built a community or creator-led brand

• Amazon and Flipkart brand store and A+ content expertise

• Offline retail or quick commerce launches

SELF-CHECK: ANSWER HONESTLY

• I have built a brand or product line from scratch, and can show the before and after.

• I have launched products on D2C and marketplaces, and know how they performed.

• I have run creator or content programs that moved sales, not just likes.

• I have done a lot with a small budget.

• I have worked closely with performance marketing and made each other better.

• I am happy to write the brief, review the creative and fix the listing myself.

Mostly yes? Apply. Not really? This is not the role, and that is fine.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeAH5eftzB9Ak1TdfEjuUda3-bmq40euLEWTU0rfXn-1E4TOA/viewform

Share your resume and a short portfolio or case-study deck: the brands, launches and campaigns you worked on, your exact role, the idea behind the work, how you executed it, and the results. Include at least one brand or product you built from scratch.

ABOUT CÜRAA

Cüraa started from scratch: a small team, a blank sheet, and one habit we never dropped. Pick a real kitchen problem, solve it properly, and ship it at a price India will pay. A few of the problems we have solved so far:

• The bullet mixer grinder with a steel jar: bullet-style speed and size, with a jar made for everyday Indian grinding.

• The most durable frother: the product everyone underestimates, built to last.

• Manual and electric choppers that set a new bar for the whole category.

• The knob-based induction: India's inductions came covered in buttons. Ours is simple: turn it, cook.

One kitchen problem at a time, Cüraa has reached half a million households. We have raised a ₹40 crore Series A led by 3one4 Capital, with Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital. Our goal is 30–40 million households in the next five years, roughly 10% of India's homes. Most of those homes have never heard of Cüraa, and they already have a brand in mind for every mixer, chopper and induction. We need a brand that is remembered, chosen and recommended. That is your job.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• A sharper, more recognisable Cüraa brand that stands apart from the big players

• Share of search, organic traffic and ratings rising month on month

• Every launch lands with a clear story and hits its launch targets

• Brand and content that lower CAC and lift conversion for the performance team

• Consistent messaging across the website, marketplaces, packaging and social

• Customer insight that shapes what we launch next

**operating efficiency**

Inc42 Courses has already worked with 400+ D2C founders across eight cohorts. The next phase is about scale — more programs, more learners, better unit economics, and a repeatable operating system that doesn't depend on heroics.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can think like a product owner, execute like a program manager, and read a funnel like a growth marketer.

**Inc42**
**is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events, Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. We also track over 10,000+ startups and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and Events for startup & business leaders across India.

* Inc42 stories reach over
  **50 Mn+**
  people monthly
* Published more than
  **55,000**
  stories
* Successfully conducted
  **150+**
  events
* Launched
  **100+**
  research reports
* Receives
  **500+**

  brands

**Program**

**Format**

**Built For**

**D2CX**

12-week hands-on hybrid accelerator

Early-stage D2C founders scaling from INR 1 Cr to 10 Cr

**D2CX Foundations**

6-week self-paced + live program

First-time founders launching a D2C brand profitably

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
**About Us:**

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the GBL are Ach Adhvaryu – Professor of Economics, Director of 21st Century India Center, School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego, Anant Ahuja – Director of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd. (India’s largest Ready Made Garment firm), and Anant Nyshadham – Associate Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan.

**About the role**

Projects at GBL are centred on building the business case for worker wellbeing. Examples include studying the migration experience and mental health of workers and how these are affected by pairing them with experienced workers from their region (through a novel ‘buddy system’), unlocking women’s economic participation, and understanding how an effective grievance redressal system affects workers’ job outcomes. We are also building a portfolio of projects at the intersection of climate action and worker wellbeing, including the clean energy transition through a human lens and extreme heat stress.

To further our mission of advancing good jobs at the intersection of worker wellbeing and business resilience, the Partnerships Associate will service existing project needs, identify new project opportunities across industries and geographies, build key stakeholder relationships with private-sector firms and ecosystem partners, and support GBL’s external engagement strategy, including through delivering events.

*We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to historically underrepresented and marginalized communities. If comfortable, please share your social location in your application. This information will be limited to the hiring team and will not have any detrimental impact on your candidature.*

***Location: Delhi/Bangalore***

***Compensation: 6.5-8 LPA***

***Type of Engagement: Full Time***

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Partnership pipeline and outreach**

* Run a process-driven outreach pipeline: identify prospects (private sector, CSR, and industry bodies), sequence outreach, and maintain CRM hygiene (records, logs, and status).
* Support GBL’s partnerships strategy by following a systematic approach to partner outreach and relationship management.
* Conduct background research on organisations GBL could partner with, for projects, new opportunities, and otherwise, across industries and geographies.
* Ensure regular documentation of partnerships and opportunities in the form of records and logs.

**Relationship management**

* Service ongoing partnerships with private-sector firms, manufacturers, implementation agencies, NGOs, consultants, and other partners.
* Develop strong relationships with new and existing partners.
* Support other GBL teams in servicing project-specific partnerships.

**Events and external engagement**

* Support relevant teams in curating events for GBL, including participant and attendee outreach, event flow, roundtable or panel curation, vendor coordination, and other event-related logistics.
* Support relevant teams in vetting ecosystem events suited to GBL’s participation.
* Represent GBL at forums, conferences, and gatherings, and use them to share GBL’s work and identify new partnership opportunities.

**Research, insights, and communication materials**

* Coordinate and prepare policy memos, concept notes, proposals, presentations, and other targeted communication materials for meetings and internal or external stakeholder engagements.
* Proactively monitor policy and business developments that concern GBL’s focus areas, especially in the sustainability space, and share regular updates with the team.
* Build domain depth in evaluation, sustainability/ESG, and social ventures, and translate learning into practical recommendations for the pipeline.

**Who are you?**

**Required skills and experience**

* A bachelor’s degree in economics, environmental science, political science, international relations, sociology, history, English, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 1–2 years of work experience in the social sector, preferably within sustainability, gender, or livelihoods.
* Advanced writing, communication, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated administrative and coordination skills.
* Ability to network and build meaningful connections.
* An interest in GBL’s mission and thematic areas of work.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with, or openness towards, CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* An understanding of how economic research works, or experience doing economic research.

*We understand that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. So please avoid the confidence gap, if this role excites you, and go ahead and apply. You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.*

**Additional Requirements: (If Any)**

* Strong problem-solving and organisational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise and work under pressure to tight deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and proactively.
* Comfort with a dynamic environment with competing priorities, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and a ‘can-do’ attitude.
* Openness to giving and receiving constructive feedback.
* Empathy and sensitivity towards the wellbeing and growth of fellow coworkers.
* Strong perseverance in high-pressure situations.

**Recent projects and blog posts:**

To acclimatize yourself with some of our work, you can explore our website where you’ll find project insights, podcasts and reports. You can also read our blog posts on Medium, and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter (X), and Instagram to learn more about our work.

**Deadline to Apply:**
*On rolling basis*

**The process:**

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role! We deeply value your time and effort.

Our interview process for this role includes the following steps:

1. Introductory Conversation
2. Assignment
3. First Round of Interview
4. Second Round of Interview

*Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.*

*The hiring team will review your application after each round and share a timely update on your application status and keep you updated on your progression through the following stages.*

**Our commitment to diversity:**

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**Background Verification:**

Employment with GBL is contingent upon satisfactory background verification. GBL reserves the right to withdraw the offer in the event of any adverse or unsatisfactory findings.

title: Senior Copywriter – Culture & Brand
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

We're looking for a culture-obsessed, AI-savvy creative who lives on the internet, writes exceptionally well, and thinks in ideas.
  
  
Someone who doesn't just write copy for campaigns but comes up with the campaigns themselves. Who can spot a cultural moment, turn it into a disruptive idea, use AI to bring it to life, and create content people actually want to watch and share.
  
  
At Atlys, you'll help build a distinctive travel brand through sharp writing, original ideas, social content, creators and collaborations. You'll have the freedom to experiment, ownership to make things happen, and plenty of startup chaos to navigate.
  
  
**The Job**

* Think big ideas: Develop disruptive campaigns, social concepts, content IPs and culturally relevant brand moments.
* Write brilliantly: Create sharp, distinctive copy for social, films, ads, websites and campaigns.
* Live on the internet: Spot trends, understand online culture and find unexpected ways for Atlys to participate in conversations.
* Make things with AI: Use AI tools, prompting, image and video generation to explore ideas, prototype concepts and create content.
* Direct social content: Independently conceptualise, script and direct reels and short-form videos.
* Build cultural relevance: Develop creative ideas with influencers, creators, brand partnerships and collaborations.
* Collaborate on craft: Work closely with art and design teams to turn ideas into exceptional creative output.
* Get things done: Own projects end-to-end, manage stakeholders and thrive in a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* 3–5 years of experience in copywriting, creative strategy, advertising or social content.
* Excellent writing skills, a distinct point of view and the ability to think on your feet.
* An internet-native understanding of culture, creators, trends and what makes content shareable.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools and strong prompting skills.
* The ability to take an idea from a rough thought to a finished piece of content independently.
* Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Startup DNA: resourceful, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and obsessed with making great work.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations**

Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring
  
  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With
  
  
The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: L1 SOC Analyst Security Monitor AND  Triage
description:
Department: Internet Security Operations Center (ISOC)

Position Type: Full-Time (Shift-Based / 24x7 Operations)

Night shift is must. don't apply if not ok for night shift

salary - 4- 4.5 LPA

Location - New Delhi

Position Overview

We are seeking an entry-to-mid level L1 SOC Analyst to join our Cyber Security

Operations team. As the first line of defense, you will monitor our centralized security

ecosystem, identifying and validating incoming security alerts before they can impact

production environments.

You will monitor internal network traffic alerts generated by NDR, track edge firewall

events aggregated via FortiAnalyzer, and handle real-time monitoring streams inside

FortiSIEM. Utilizing FortiSOAR operational playbooks, you will validate user behavior

anomalies flagged by FortiUEBA and follow clear, pre-defined guidelines to handle basic

threat mitigation across remote FortiGate firewalls managed through FortiManager.

Core Responsibilities

• 24/7 Security Monitoring: Continuously monitor real-time security alert queues

within FortiSIEM and FortiSOAR dashboards to identify potential indicators of

compromise (IOCs).

• Initial Alert Triage & Filtering: Review incoming alerts to separate true security

events from benign network behavior or known false positives based on

established playbooks.

• First-Level Inspection (NDR & Perimeter): Review initial traffic alert details

from internal NDR ISNG/AED probes (e.g., unusual internal bandwidth spikes)

and compare them with boundary logs inside FortiAnalyzer to build a basic

timeline of the event.

• Identity Tracking: Monitor high-risk user alerts flagged by FortiUEBA, gathering

contextual information regarding the user's location, device, and typical behavior

patterns.

• Basic Guided Containment: Execute standard operating procedures (SOPs)

within FortiSOAR to run pre-approved, "one-click" automated playbooks that

block malicious external IPs safely across FortiManager policy boundaries.

• Incident Logging & Escalation: Document all initial findings accurately within

the ticketing system. Ensure clear, complete handoffs of validated, high-severity

threats to L2 or L3 analysts for deep-dive investigation.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

• Foundational Cybersecurity Knowledge: Strong understanding of security

principles, common attack vectors (phishing, brute-force, basic malware), and the

TCP/IP stack (ports, protocols, IP routing).

• SIEM Familiarity: Basic understanding or academic experience operating within

a SIEM interface (experience with FortiSIEM or similar platforms is a significant

advantage).

• Log Navigation: Ability to read and understand standardized event logs (e.g.,

firewall deny logs, Windows event codes).

• Detail-Oriented & Process-Driven: Exceptional ability to follow step-by-step

technical playbooks and documented escalation paths precisely without skipping

steps.

• Certifications (Preferred):

o CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA CySA+.

o Fortinet Certified Associate (FCA) or Fortinet Certified Professional (FCP)

in Security Operations.

Experience & Education

• Education: BE/Btech Degree or Certificate in Cyber Security, Information

Technology, or a related technical field. Completed bootcamps or equivalent self-

study tracks are highly valued.

• Experience: 0–2 years of experience working inside a technical helpdesk,

network operations center (NOC), or junior security monitoring role.

Experience and skills

title: Technical Account Manager - OpenShift
description:
**About The Job**
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance along with hands-on technical support to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.
  
  
**Note:**
This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Proactively identify and address potential technical risks within customer environments.
* Develop and support the implementation of solutions for complex technical challenges.
* Provide hands-on support to the assigned customer
* Collaborate with engineering and product management teams on customer escalations.
* Conduct regular technical reviews with customers to ensure optimal performance.
* Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in assigned Red Hat products.
* Serve as a technical mentor for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and internal training materials.
* Conduct regular account reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You Will Bring**

* 6+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
* Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Dockers cluster management
* Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
* Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
* Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
* Comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

* Investigate billing queries and short payments; coordinate with sales and operations to resolve them.

* Support preparation of customer balance confirmations for audit.

* 5-8 years of experience in AP, AR or general accounting.
* Good understanding of basic accounting principles: debits and credits, accruals and reconciliations.
* Hands-on experience with Bill.com, QuickBooks, Zoho Books & Salesforce.

description:

**Qualification & Experience**

**Educational Background**

* Master’s degree or higher in Public Policy, Management, Economics, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Education, or a related field from a recognized university.

**Work Experience and Expertise**

* Ability to independently manage assigned workstreams and coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Government and Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to engage and coordinate effectively with government officials, implementation partners and diverse stakeholders.
* Programme Management: Ability to plan, coordinate, and track multiple workstreams while managing priorities and timelines.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyse programme information and data, identify implementation gaps and develop practical recommendations.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations, briefs and official communication.
* Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose operational challenges and work collaboratively to develop practical solutions.
* Teamwork: Proven ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams and contribute to shared programme objectives.
* Ownership and Execution: Strong sense of accountability, attention to detail and ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities.

**Our Commitments**

* We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
* We are committed to diversity in our workforce and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
* You will work with sector experts and understand how people-centred policies can be created and effectively implemented.
* With us, you will master framing narratives and counterpoints and pace storytelling for internal and external stakeholders.
* We offer a space for you to grow, think innovatively, and shed unconscious biases while learning more about diverse cultures.

title: Travel & Administration Executive
description:
At Wellversed, we are committed to fostering growth, innovation, and operational excellence. We are looking for a highly motivated, detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support leadership and core teams by managing travel, calendars, vendors, documentation, and day-to-day administrative operations with precision and ownership.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Administrative Operations: Handle routine administrative requests, correspondence, data entry, document circulation, printing, scanning, filing, and coordination with internal teams. Track tasks, deadlines, and pending issues, escalating delays when required.
2. Travel, Visa & Hospitality: Coordinate travel bookings, accommodation, transport, itineraries, visa documentation, appointments, and visitor arrangements. Track expenses, cancellations, and reimbursements, ensuring all bookings have prior approval and comply with company policies.
3. Vendor Sourcing & Procurement: Identify vendors and service providers, obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, and coordinate purchase requisitions, purchase orders, work orders, invoices, deliveries, and payment follow-ups. Maintain vendor records and ensure approvals and budget limits are followed.
4. Meetings & Site Visits: Schedule meetings, appointments, and site visits; confirm availability, venues, visitor access, attendance, materials, and transport. Maintain records and follow up on assigned action items.
5. Workplace & Office Administration: Coordinate workspace, meeting rooms, visitor access, internet, facilities, housekeeping, security, and IT requirements. Monitor stationery, consumables, stock registers, and replenishment; report maintenance issues and support office setup, relocation, and onboarding logistics.
6. Local Outreach & Ground Operations: Research and contact local vendors, agencies, businesses, and service providers. Coordinate local purchases, deliveries, transport, site visits, and other ground activities; verify service completion and resolve or escalate execution issues.
7. Documentation, Data & Reporting: Maintain accurate administrative records, vendor databases, contact lists, invoices, quotations, travel and reimbursement documents, and operational trackers. Update dashboards and prepare status reports on completed tasks, pending actions, expenses, and issues while protecting confidential information.
8. Stakeholder Follow-ups: Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to track commitments, approvals, deliveries, and documentation. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly, escalate delays promptly, and close tasks only after confirming completion and updating records.
9. Process Improvement: Follow SOPs, checklists, and approval workflows. Maintain process documentation, identify recurring inefficiencies or documentation gaps, and suggest practical improvements to strengthen accountability and operational efficiency.

**Skills Required:**

1. Strong organisational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
2. Effective communication, coordination, and follow-up abilities.
3. Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, including spreadsheets, email, documents, and calendars.
4. Attention to detail in documentation, bookings, and financial records.
5. Basic knowledge of administration, procurement, vendor management, and travel coordination. ● Cost-conscious decision-making and the ability to work independently within approval processes.
6. Professionalism, confidentiality, accountability, and a proactive, service-oriented approach.

**Qualifications & Experience**

1. Graduate in any discipline; a degree in Business Administration, Travel Diploma, IATA Certification, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.
2. Minimum 1 year of experience in administration, operations, office coordination, procurement, travel coordination, or a related role.
3. Hands-on experience in vendor coordination, cross-functional communication, and maintaining operational trackers is an advantage.
4. Proficiency in spreadsheets, email, documentation, and digital record management is essential.

**About Wellversed**

Wellversed owns and operates a portfolio of nutrition brands to empower people to attain their most optimal state of wellness. Our brands like Wellcore, YouWeFit, Zero Sugar, Dynamite, Okami and Osmo - enable people to unlock their performance potential and live healthier lives. The brands are made available to our customers through an omni-channel approach including our own eCommerce portal (
www.wellversed.in
).

title: D2C Growth Associate
description:

Barosi is a D2C food brand bringing traditional Indian food and authentic flavours to modern households. We are looking for a proactive and analytical D2C Executive to help manage and grow our direct-to-consumer business.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The candidate will manage day-to-day Shopify operations, coordinate with the performance marketing team, track business performance, and identify opportunities to improve the D2C funnel and drive online sales.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Shopify & Website Management
* Manage Shopify operations, including product listings, pricing, inventory visibility, collections, discount codes, and offers.
* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, banners, product launches, and campaign-related changes.
* Ensure accurate product information, pricing, and promotional details across the website.
* Identify website issues affecting customer experience and conversions, and coordinate technical fixes with developers or external partners.
* D2C Growth & Funnel Optimisation
* Develop strategies to improve the customer journey, from website visits and product discovery to add-to-cart, checkout, and purchase.
* Analyse funnel drop-offs and identify opportunities to improve conversion rate, average order value (AOV), repeat purchases, and revenue.
* Plan product bundles, cross-selling, upselling, and promotional strategies to drive growth.
* Support customer retention initiatives and improve the overall shopping experience.
* Performance Marketing Coordination
* Work closely with the media buying team to align campaigns, offers, creatives, landing pages, and business objectives.
* Ensure campaigns go live with the correct products, pricing, discount codes, and landing pages.
* Track campaign and website performance to identify opportunities for improving conversions and sales.
* Share customer behaviour and website insights to support campaign optimisation.
* Data Analysis & Business Reporting
* Track key metrics, including revenue, website sessions, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, add-to-cart rate, checkout abandonment, and repeat purchase rate.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyse sales trends, product performance, customer behaviour, and campaign results.
* Identify gaps against targets and recommend data-backed actions to improve performance and profitability.
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Coordinate with performance marketing, creative, design, customer support, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure smooth execution.
* Manage timelines for campaigns, product launches, website updates, and promotional activities.
* Coordinate on inventory availability, order-related issues, cancellations, returns, and customer feedback.
* Ensure clear communication and timely completion of deliverables across teams.
* Retention & WhatsApp Marketing
* Use Interakt or other WhatsApp marketing tools to plan and execute retention campaigns, promotional broadcasts, and offer communications.
* Coordinate customer communication for product launches, festive campaigns, special offers, and repeat purchase initiatives.
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve customer retention.

**Requirements**

* Hands-on knowledge of Shopify and its day-to-day functionalities.
* Understanding of D2C business models, e-commerce operations, and online sales funnels.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, and performance marketing metrics.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritise effectively, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and growth-oriented mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with a D2C brand, preferably in FMCG, food, beauty, or lifestyle.
* Familiarity with Shopify analytics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), CRM, email marketing, and WhatsApp marketing tools.
* Understanding of e-commerce profitability, contribution margins, discounts, returns, and cancellations.

**Ideal Candidate**
Someone who understands how a D2C business operates, is comfortable working with numbers, and can turn strategies into execution. The candidate should be able to manage Shopify independently, coordinate across teams, and proactively identify opportunities to grow Barosi’s online business.

title: On-Premises Deployment Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an On-Premises Implementation Engineer with hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. You will install, configure, upgrade and hand over our product on customer-owned servers, including restricted and air-gapped environments, within agreed timelines. This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will assess client infrastructure readiness, deploy the product using Docker and Docker Compose, integrate it with the client’s network, security and identity controls, and support the environment after go-live until it is stable and formally handed over.

**What you will do**

* Review customer infrastructure against product prerequisites: server sizing, OS version, storage, ports, DNS, certificates and firewall rules
* Prepare checklists, deployment plans and implementation schedules for customer IT teams
* Validate server readiness before deployment, including patch level, disk layout, time sync and proxy connectivity
* Install, configure and harden Linux servers (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux)
* Manage users, sudo access, SSH keys, permissions, systemd services, cron jobs and log rotation
* Configure LVM, filesystems, NFS shares and storage for application data and backups
* Configure networking, firewalld/iptables and SELinux/AppArmor in line with customer security standards
* Install Docker Engine and Docker Compose on customer servers, including offline installation
* Deploy, configure and upgrade the product stack using Compose files, environment files and scripts
* Set up local image registries and move images into air-gapped environments using docker save/load or registry mirroring
* Configure Docker networking, volumes, restart policies, resource limits and log drivers
* Troubleshoot container start-up failures, image pull issues, port conflicts, storage and permission errors and inter-service connectivity
* Configure reverse proxies and load balancers (Nginx, HAProxy, Apache) and install SSL/TLS certificates from customer CAs
* Integrate the product with customer databases, SMTP, LDAP/Active Directory and SSO providers such as Keycloak
* Set up and verify PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis when hosted alongside the product
* Plan and run upgrades and patch releases with documented rollback steps and minimal downtime
* Configure backup and restore for application data, databases and Docker volumes, and test restores periodically
* Provide L2 support for deployed environments, including root cause analysis and resolution within SLAs
* Escalate and close product defects with internal development and product teams
* Write installation guides, as-built documents, runbooks and handover notes for each customer
* Run handover and knowledge-transfer sessions for customer IT and operations teams
* Keep an accurate record of each customer’s deployed version, configuration and change history

**What you bring**

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and Docker-based deployment, ideally in product implementation or customer-facing roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent practical experience
* Linux (must have): strong command line skills on RHEL, Rocky or Ubuntu, including dnf/yum, apt, systemd, permissions, LVM, networking, firewalld/iptables, SELinux and log analysis
* Docker (must have): Docker Engine and Compose in production, image management, volumes, networks, private registries, offline image transfer and container troubleshooting
* Web and proxy services: Nginx, HAProxy or Apache, plus SSL/TLS installation and troubleshooting
* Scripting: Bash for installation and operational automation. Python is an advantage
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls, proxies and basic troubleshooting (curl, telnet/nc, tcpdump, ss/netstat)
* Databases: working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or Redis, including install, connectivity, backup and restore
* Support: ticket-based support, root cause analysis and SLA-driven resolution

**Good to have**

* RHCSA, RHCE or LFCS; Docker Certified Associate
* Experience deploying into air-gapped or highly restricted customer networks
* Ansible for repeatable server preparation and deployment
* Monitoring exposure: Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix or Loki
* Keycloak, LDAP/Active Directory or SSO configuration
* Familiarity with CIS Benchmarks for Linux and Docker

**How you work**

* Clear, professional communication with customer IT teams, including non-technical stakeholders
* Structured troubleshooting under time pressure during go-live windows
* Ownership of each implementation from readiness through handover
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and support deployments outside business hours when required

Lutron’s Gurgaon team is seeking a technically driven professional to join our SAP support and delivery function. In this role, you will leverage your deep SAP expertise to solve complex business challenges, drive system stability, and deliver high-quality solutions that support critical business operations.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with a team of skilled Computer Science and IT professionals, contributing to strategic initiatives, optimizing enterprise processes, and enhancing the efficiency of our global operations and overall customer experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with global SAP on Basis and/or BTP, providing technical support
* ABAP, CPI and IDOC technical support
* Monitor and review IDOC Error messages (Inbound and outbound).
* Work with the technical team and/or functional team to determine the root cause and then resolve the errors
* Create Fiori tiles/reports based on business needs
* Lead and provide directions to the team on the day-to-day deliveries of the team, manage stakeholder expectations.
* Responsible for quality of the deliverables, identify and generate team metrics
* Coach and mentor the team members and plan their career development
* Collaborate with team members, across locations, with other teams to resolve errors and with and management through the organization, using strong written and verbal communication skills
* Gain knowledge of other IT functions to be able to understand the integration with the SAP environment
* Plan the training and onboarding for new team members, and for current team members on new Areas / Modules
* Interface with internal stakeholders throughout all project phases, including understanding business requirements
* Identify and lead improvements to procedures as a part of continuous improvement
* Drive SAP issues to resolution, including incorporating lessons learned

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3-year degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with a 60% and above, or a 4-year degree in engineering/technology
* 6–9-year experience in the relevant field
* Experience in SAP Basis (Business Application Software Integrated Solution) knowledge and experience and/or Experience in SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform)
* ABAP knowledge and experience
* Experience as a SAP S/4 developer
* IDOC knowledge and experience
* Fiori and CPI Experience
* EDI knowledge is a plus
* Exposure to leading teams with training and guiding junior team members
* Formal team leadership and supervision experience would be a plus
* Knowledge and experience of software development processes and best practices (Agile or Scrum)
* A proactive attitude to platform enhancements and desire to implement best practice solutions
* Strong problem-solving and strong written and communication skills
* Strong service mind-set
* Strong attention to details

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to EDI integrations and related standards.
* Experience working in cross-functional or global team environments.
* Familiarity with SAP integration landscapes beyond core modules.
* Experience contributing to process improvements or governance practices.

Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent. Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at www.lutron.com.
  
  
*Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.*

title: Network TAC Expert
