title: AI Functional Analyst
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent
  
  
Application Deadline: 02 November 2026
  
  
**Job Description**
**Title**
AI Functional Analyst
  
  
**Department**
General Counsel Shared Services
  
  
**Location**
India
  
  
**Reports To**
AI Systems Manager - GC Systems Functional Admin
  
  
**Level**
Grade 4
  
  
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together and supporting each other all over the world. So, join our General Counsel Shared Services team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
General Counsel (GC) is a trusted advisor to all parts of Fidelity International Limited (“FIL”), providing high-value independent advisory and assurance expertise through our specialist teams. GC comprises of Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, and Public Policy & Strategic Relationship Management. GC Shared Services function (GCSS) is a global centre of expertise currently in Dalian and India, providing operational support and services to the General Counsel function. The GCSS Functional Administration team provides first-line business support and functional administration for GC-owned systems, while helping colleagues adopt and use AI-enabled solutions effectively and responsibly.
  
  
**About Your Role**
Join the GCSS Functional Administration team in a techno-functional role supporting the effective system operations, adoption, continuous improvement and post deployment monitoring of Artificial Intelligence (AI) based IT systems including No-Code, Low-Code and Pro-Code solutions. You will provide first-line user support, business administration, provision access and licences, maintain functional configurations and knowledge content, and coordinate with AI Product Owners, Business Process Owners, technology teams and other stakeholders. You will also enable users for AI adoption through onboarding, training and communities of practice; track adoption and feedback; support UAT and release readiness; and undertake first-level triage and escalation of operational or AI output-related issues. The role requires a practical understanding of Generative AI, strong stakeholder management and the ability to translate user needs into clear actions across BAU support, enablement, governance support and change delivery.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide functional administration and first-line support for AI platforms, ensuring a high-quality user experience.
* Manage user access, provisioning and deprovisioning, and support effective licence allocation and utilisation.
* Develop and maintain knowledge content, user guidance and support documentation.
* Deliver onboarding, training and enablement activities to drive adoption and responsible use of AI solutions.
* Monitor platform usage, adoption and feedback, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders and technology teams to support operational delivery and platform enhancements.
* Support testing, release activities and change implementation for new features and capabilities.
* Perform initial triage of platform issues and coordinate escalation, remediation and follow-up where required.
* Maintain appropriate records, reporting and governance documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance user experience, efficiency and business value.

**Skillsets Required**
About 7+ years of experience in IT systems support, AI enablement, business analysis, change management or a related area, with the following capabilities:
  
  

* Practical knowledge of Generative AI and AI solution concepts, with the ability to explain them clearly to users and stakeholders.
* Experience in first-line support, access management and licence optimisation for enterprise technology platforms.
* Experience delivering user onboarding, training, adoption initiatives, communications and knowledge content.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business, product, technology and governance teams in a global environment.
* Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, change implementation, issue triage and escalation.
* Awareness of responsible AI, AI governance, information security, risk and control considerations in a regulated environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel and Power BI, with the ability to turn usage and feedback data into practical insights.
* Experience with prompt engineering, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, service-management tools would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting Legal, Risk, Compliance or another regulated business function would be advantageous.

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work and finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.
  
  
For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

description:
*Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.*
*Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.*
*Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.*
*This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.*
Job posting end date:
  
  
**Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC**
**Introduction**
We are looking for a Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC to join our Network Service Delivery team in Information Technology. In this role, you will ensure reliable, secure, cost-effective and business-aligned network services across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be the regional link between business stakeholders, Country IT teams, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, project teams and external service providers, and you will make sure regional needs – including offices, manufacturing plants and service locations – are well represented in our global network operating model.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram, India, and includes regional travel as required.
  
  
**Team you will belong to**
You will join our Network Service Delivery community, working closely with the Network Service Delivery Team Lead and regional service delivery managers to keep ways of working and service delivery practices consistent across regions. We collaborate with Country IT teams, global network service owners, Information Security, Procurement, Finance and external service providers. Our work spans APAC time zones and includes participation in agreed major-incident escalation and planned maintenance arrangements.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Oversee the delivery and performance of network services across APAC sites, including local and wireless networks, software-defined WAN (SD-WAN), internet connectivity and secure remote access, aligning resilience with global site criticality standards.
* Manage service performance against agreed service-level and operational-level agreements, working with internal teams and service providers to maintain availability, capacity and readiness.
* Act as the regional escalation point for critical network incidents, coordinating restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and govern network changes and resilience testing.
* Serve as the regional focal point for network demand, ensuring business and site requirements are documented, prioritized and progressed with Country IT, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, Operational Technology (OT) and project teams, in line with global standards and approved designs, including IT/OT network segmentation where applicable.
* Represent APAC priorities in global network service, governance and roadmap discussions, and drive regional improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate service provider relationships, monitor supplier performance and escalations, and partner with Procurement, Global Service Owners and Country IT Managers on service requirements, renewals, budgets, costs and cost optimization.
* Coordinate network needs for new site setups, expansions, relocations, closures and integrations of acquired businesses, and communicate service performance, risks, outages and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ensure new or changed network services move into operations with accurate service records, monitoring and documentation, and drive improvements in monitoring, reporting, automation and operational analytics.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8–10 years of experience in enterprise network services, infrastructure operations or IT service management, including service delivery, vendor management or regional coordination across multiple countries.
* Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including local and wireless networks, SD-WAN, internet connectivity, routing, VPNs, IT/OT network segmentation, high-availability architectures and network security fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience managing service-level agreements, major incidents, problem resolution, service transitions and supplier performance.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and commercial skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher, or other relevant networking, infrastructure or IT service management certifications (nice to have).
* Experience managing network services in a global, multi-vendor environment, ideally in manufacturing, industrial, mining or other operationally critical multi-site settings, and experience within APAC (nice to have).
* Familiarity with enterprise SD-WAN, switching, wireless and network monitoring platforms such as Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN, HPE Aruba or SolarWinds, or equivalent (nice to have).

**What’s In It For You**
At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You’ll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.
  
  
We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:
  
  
  

* Purpose-led work: Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.
* Wellbeing: Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.
* Rewards: Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
* Growth: Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.
* Culture: A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.

**Get in touch**
Want to rise above the possible with us? Click “Apply now” to submit your application.
  
  
We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.
  
  
Hiring Manager: Shiji Nambiar

title: Manager, Training Knowledge Systems
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
Knowledge Systems Manager
  
  
We're looking for a technically capable Knowledge Systems Manager to build, administer and evolve our knowledge management ecosystem on Zendesk. This is a hands-on role: you'll build tools and apps directly on the platform, work alongside engineers on integrations and UX, and take ownership of authentication and API-level troubleshooting, while also maintaining the knowledge base and the documentation that keeps it useful. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering and Support to make self-service, search and AI-assisted knowledge experiences genuinely work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Zendesk Platform Development
  
  

* Design, build and maintain custom applications on Zendesk App Builder (e.g. dashboards, content management tooling, publishing workflows).
* Own configuration of Zendesk Guide: themes, article templates, content presentation and publishing workflows.
* Work directly with developers/engineers on Zendesk UX and UI translating requirements into technical specs and reviewing implementation.
* Support and extend AI and automation features within Zendesk.

APIs, Authentication & Integrations
  
  

* Build and maintain integrations between Zendesk and other enterprise systems (e.g. Zendesk API with Microsoft Teams, for querying the knowledge base directly from Teams).
* Work confidently with APIs: authentication, requests, troubleshooting failures end-to-end.
* Understand and troubleshoot OAuth, SSO and SAML authentication patterns, including recurring cross-brand/cross-tenant auth issues.
* Partner with platform administrators and developers on new integrations and system enhancements.

Knowledge Base Management & Content
  
  

* Maintain the day-to-day health of the knowledge base, applying the information architecture, taxonomy and content standards set by the Knowledge Director.
* Create and maintain user-facing documentation for product features, workflows and releases.
* Support knowledge strategy and self-service initiatives set by the Knowledge Systems Director; surface opportunities and risks from day-to-day platform work.

AI-Powered Knowledge Management
  
  

* Use AI tools to accelerate content creation, maintenance and knowledge discovery, within the agent/pipeline architecture set by the wider team.
* Optimise knowledge content for AI retrieval and generative AI / agent experiences.

Analytics & Insights
  
  

* Analyse knowledge base usage, search behaviour and content performance to find gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Produce regular reporting to feed into the wider knowledge strategy and roadmap.

**Essential**
Required Skills & Experience
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk Guide/App Builder or a comparable platform, including custom app development and day-to-day configuration.
* Working knowledge of APIs and authentication concepts (OAuth, SSO, SAML) with the ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently.
* Experience delivering integrations between a knowledge/support platform and other enterprise systems.
* Experience creating technical documentation and user-facing guidance.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers on technical requirements, UX/UI, and implementation.
* Experience using AI tools for content or workflow purposes.
* Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills.
* Ability to analyse data and turn it into concrete improvement recommendations.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Zendesk Administration & App Builder
* API integration & troubleshooting
* OAuth / SSO / SAML
* HTML, CSS, JSON (low-code development)
* Taxonomy & metadata management
* Workflow automation
* AI prompt engineering
* Analytics & reporting

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with generative AI implementations and RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) concepts.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)
  
  

* Shipped at least one new Zendesk App Builder tool or integration that measurably improves a workflow (e.g. content ops, publishing, cross-system querying).
* Reduced reliance on engineering support for common Zendesk configuration, integration and auth issues.
* Improved knowledge base search success and content discoverability.
* Established measurable knowledge governance processes, with content quality and freshness improved across the KB.
* Delivered actionable insights through knowledge analytics and reporting.
* Supported AI initiatives that make effective use of organisational knowledge.

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

title: Oracle Financial Consultant
description:
**Experience Required:**
6+ Years

*(Relevant experience in Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on production support experience)*

**Job Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai / Gurgaon / Noida / Mumbai / Pune / Ahmedabad (Hybrid)

**Work Shift:**
US Region Shift (
**5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST**
)

**Job Summary**

As an Oracle Fusion Finance Support Consultant, you will be a critical part of our application management services (AMS) delivery team, ensuring continuous, high-performance daily operations for our live US/North American clients. Your primary focus will be analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex functional incidents and user issues across live production environments. You will specialize in day-to-day transaction processing across Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), while providing reliable secondary operational support for General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expense Management, Advanced Collections (AC), and Risk Management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Incident & Ticket Management:**
  Own, track, and resolve Level 2 (L2) and Level 3 (L3) functional tickets in compliance with strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) regarding response and resolution times.
* **Production Firefighting & RCA:**
  Troubleshoot complex system anomalies—such as stuck invoice approval workflows, unposted transaction events, interface data mismatches, and reporting errors—and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to deliver permanent fixes.
* **Month-End Close Support:**
  Provide high-touch, dedicated support to client finance teams during high-pressure monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles, diagnosing and resolving closing exceptions swiftly to maintain financial schedule continuity.
* **Quarterly Patch Testing (Regression Testing):**
  Analyze Oracle's mandatory quarterly readiness documents, define regression testing test scripts, map impacted configurations, and run system validation checks to ensure business functionality does not break when new patches are applied to production.
* **Oracle Service Request (SR) Lifecycle Management:**
  Log, manage, and escalate Service Requests with Oracle Support (MOS). Collaborate closely with Oracle engineers, provide environmental diagnostic data, test proposed bug fixes, and apply data fixes safely.
* **System Maintenance & Configuration Tweaks:**
  Execute minor configuration modifications as business requirements change, such as adjusting existing approval rules, modifying custom cross-validation parameters, setting up new banks/payment files, or assigning security roles.
* **Report Adjustments & Diagnostics:**
  Troubleshoot, run, and update custom Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) layouts, BI Publisher reports, and standard financial dashboards to assist business users with reconciliations.
* **Business User Training & Documentation:**
  Author detailed knowledge-base articles, maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for financial processing teams, and conduct formal refreshers or onboarding sessions for client end-users.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* **Soft Skills & Operational Drive:**
  High level of resilience, sharp logical problem-solving abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills to interface confidently with remote US corporate finance teams during their core operating hours.

title: Digital Growth & AI Specialist Executive
description:
**AI Video Production | SEO, AEO & GEO | AI Website Development**
About Sumvaik

Sumvaik Consulting Group is a creative, digital and consulting agency working with brands across industries.

As AI transforms the way businesses create content, build digital experiences and grow online, we're expanding our capabilities to deliver smarter, faster and more impactful solutions.

We're looking for a

who can turn emerging AI technologies into real, client-ready outcomes.

This isn't a conventional digital marketing or creative role. We're looking for someone who can create, build, optimise and execute.

* Edit and refine outputs to achieve professional, brand-consistent production quality.

* Research opportunities for improving brand visibility across Google AI experiences, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

* Handle website layouts, functionality, testing and deployment.
* Ensure website performance, mobile responsiveness, user experience and SEO readiness.
* Collaborate with designers and developers when projects require advanced technical implementation.

**4. AI Innovation & Workflow Optimisation**

* Continuously research and experiment with emerging AI tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve production workflows and digital delivery.
* Build repeatable, efficient processes using AI and automation.
* Help the team adopt useful new technologies across client projects.

What We're Looking For

* Demonstrated experience producing high-quality content using generative AI.
* Practical knowledge of SEO implementation and an understanding of AEO and GEO.
* Hands-on experience building websites or landing pages with AI-assisted tools.
* Strong creative judgement, technical curiosity and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to learn emerging tools independently.

* Strong ownership, attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines.

* Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar editing software.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript or AI-assisted coding.
* Experience with Make, n8n, Zapier, APIs or workflow automation.
* Experience in a creative, digital marketing or consulting agency.

Why Join Sumvaik?

* Work on diverse brands and projects across industries.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies and apply them to real-world business challenges.
* Collaborate with creative, marketing and development teams.
* Help shape the next generation of AI-powered services at Sumvaik.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and portfolio.

* **Please share:**
* Examples of AI-generated videos you have produced.
* SEO projects you have worked on, including measurable outcomes where available.
* Links to websites or landing pages you have created using AI tools.

**We value what you can build and deliver more than the number of AI tools listed on your resume.**

title: Media Intern
description:
**Department:**
Media

**Experience:**
Fresher

**Internship Duration:**
3 Months

**Work Mode:**
Remote

**Role Type:**
Internship

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and enthusiastic Meta Ads Intern to join our Media team. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of digital marketing and a strong interest in learning paid advertising across Meta platforms, including Facebook and Instagram.

The intern will assist the team in setting up, monitoring, and optimizing branding and awareness campaigns through Meta Ads Manager. This role offers hands-on exposure to campaign execution, performance tracking, reporting, audience targeting, and campaign optimization while working remotely with the media team

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in setting up and managing branding and awareness campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.
* Support campaign creation at the campaign, ad set, and ad levels under team guidance.
* Monitor campaign delivery and performance on a regular basis.
* Track key campaign metrics such as reach, impressions, frequency, CPM, video views, engagement, and budget utilization.
* Help ensure campaigns are launched accurately as per approved media plans, creatives, budgets, and timelines.
* Assist in preparing daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance reports using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Support the team in analyzing campaign performance and identifying areas for improvement.
* Assist with campaign quality checks (QA), including audience targeting, placements, budgets, schedules, creatives, and tracking parameters.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect creatives, campaign requirements, and other necessary assets.
* Help identify campaign delivery issues and communicate them to the relevant team members.
* Maintain campaign trackers, reporting sheets, and documentation.
* Stay updated on Meta advertising features, ad formats, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.
* Learn campaign optimization techniques and support the team in implementing recommendations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of digital marketing and social media advertising.
* Familiarity with Facebook and Instagram as advertising platforms.
* Basic knowledge of Meta Ads Manager is preferred but not mandatory.
* Understanding of advertising objectives such as Awareness, Reach, Engagement, Video Views, Traffic, and Messaging is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of campaign metrics such as Reach, Impressions, Frequency, CPM, Video Views, and Engagement Rate.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks independently while working remotely and meet deadlines.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be proactive, curious, analytical, and eager to build a career in digital media and performance marketing. They should have a keen interest in Facebook and Instagram advertising, a willingness to learn new tools and techniques, and the ability to collaborate effectively with the team in a remote working environment.

Freshers and candidates with relevant digital marketing coursework or certifications are encouraged to apply.

**What You Will Learn**

* Hands-on exposure to Meta Ads Manager.
* Fundamentals of campaign planning, setup, and execution.
* Understanding of branding and awareness campaign objectives.
* Campaign monitoring, budget pacing, and performance tracking.
* Reporting and analysis using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Audience targeting, ad placements, and campaign QA.
* Practical exposure to campaign optimization and digital media operations.

Josh Talks believes that every person irrespective of the background they come from has the potential in them to do well in life. Josh Talks, while serving as an elder brother figure, is working to help young India unlock their true potential.

Being an elder brother figure, firstly, Josh Talks inspires the youth by providing them access to relatable role-models through stories. These stories feature individuals who come from backgrounds similar to the majority of us in India, who have faced similar life struggles yet, against all odds, managed to achieve great success in life. As of January 2024, 5 cr Indians watch a Josh Talk every month. Across all Youtube channels, The Josh Talks Family has over 25mn subscribers. The largest individual channel is Josh Talks Hindi that has over 10mn subscribers.

Another duty that Josh, as an elder brother, undertakes is teaching English to young Indians. Spoken English has become critical to anyone doing well in the workplace. Josh teaches English through its Josh Talks English Speaking app, available on the android play store. Our Indian brothers and sisters can learn to speak in English from 6 other languages including Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Punjabi. Josh Talks priced the course at a meager Rs. 499 so that every Indian from any part of the country can afford to speak fluently and confident in English, what Josh considers a basic human right. Over 4L students have completed the Josh Talks Spoken English course.

This however, is just the beginning. Over the coming decades Josh Talks intends to continue building more products that will help advance its objective of helping each Indian unlock their potential.

There is a common trait visible in anyone of the Josh team members who have done incredibly well over the last 10 years and it is that they are
*relentless*
.

If you have an itch inside you to serve your nation, you feel a sense of duty towards your fellow countrymen, and you have a deep seated desire to make your society and the country better, and you want to do all this while building a prosperous career, then Josh Talks is right organization for you to join. To find more information about our work, visit joshtalks.com

**Position Summary**

We're looking for a Content Curator for our Josh Talks team to drive the Content Curation and Strategy of YouTube channels. As Content Curator, you'll craft data-driven content strategies, curate high-impact talks, and guide speakers to captivate audiences across platforms. You are expected to create engaging narratives, do audience-centric analysis, and collaborate across teams. You will work with people across content, marketing, and production teams to shape the future of Josh Talks as a Content Curator.

**Key Responsibilities: Josh Talks Content Curator**

As a Content Curator, you'll wear multiple hats, including:

* Curate strategic content for YouTube channels, leveraging storytelling to resonate with the target audience.
* Research, source, and onboard speakers for high-impact talks, aligning their stories with Indian audience aspirations.
* Write engaging scripts for YouTube Josh Talks, considering audience interests and YouTube algorithm optimization.
* Direct and guide speakers to deliver impactful story-telling style presentations that resonate with intended audiences.
* Collaborate with production and post-production teams to ensure video quality and adherence to brand guidelines.
* Provide ongoing training to speakers in voice modulation, body language, and on-camera performance.
* Analyze user engagement metrics and suggest changes accordingly in content style.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive content strategy and a content calendar for the Josh Talks across YouTube and other platforms to increase key metrics such as viewership & engagement. (subscribers, likes, comments, AVD, APV, etc)
* Support the YouTube growth team in planning and developing content style and layout.
* Stay updated on digital trends and infotainment culture, identifying online personalities and emerging cultural conversations in the YouTube world.
* Conduct research on Josh Talks and inspirational content to gain a deeper understanding of the brand and its mission.

**Competencies and Skills Required:**

**Content Strategy & Production:**

* Strong research skills, for unearthing stories through online and offline mediums.
* Ability to develop the strategy wrt the projection of content trends and audience consumption.
* Proven ability to craft compelling narratives and translate them into engaging digital content (e.g., scripts, videos, thumbnails, marketing materials).
* Experience in curating and analyzing diverse content formats (long-form & short-form) for maximum impact.
* Experience in scriptwriting, ensuring all key elements are captured for maximum audience relatability.
* Deep understanding of Josh Talks' target audience: Demonstrates strong empathy for the aspirations, challenges, and preferred content formats of Josh Talks viewers, ensuring all content aligns seamlessly and resonates with viewers.

**Creative & Analytical Mindset:**

* Highly creative with a knack to understand audience insights and performance to drive data oriented story telling.
* Structured thinker with the ability to dissect complex problems into easy-to-understand language and an understanding of audience retention.

**Communication & Networking:**

* Exceptional communication skills in English as well as Hindi, both written and verbal. Ability to tailor communication to diverse audiences (film directors, artists, civil servants, sensitive topics).
* Strong public speaking and storytelling skills, capable of captivating audiences.

**Additional Preferences:**

* Fluency in Hindi and English
* Familiarity with Tier 2 & Tier 3 city and rural psychology.
* Experience in media, radio jockeying, creative writing, copywriting, theater, or performing arts (a plus).
* "Getting shit done" attitude and willingness to travel for work.
* Seeking a highly intuitive, problem solver, self motivated and highly curious individual.

National Media Award 2019: President of India

The Josh core team is composed of people who are ambitious and intend to create something that is bigger than themselves. Things that will last forever and will go on to impact and change the world. We have big dreams that are backed by our relentless pursuit to achieve them.

* Track pipeline performance, lead progression, and conversion metrics, including prospect-to-lead, MQL-to-SQL, and lead-to-opportunity conversions.
* Create, update, and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor sales performance, pipeline effectiveness, campaign engagement, and data hygiene, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.

title: Head of Communications
description:
**1. POSITION VACANT:**

Head of Communications | Confidential Organisation | Gurugram, Haryana

**2. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW**

A well-established not-for-profit organisation works to strengthen learning outcomes in government schools by partnering with State Education Departments, teachers and communities. The organisation has evolved towards a systems-strengthening model that brings education improvements to scale through government partnerships.

The organisation’s teacher-centric, consultative approach supports improvements across the school education continuum, from foundational learning and school readiness to secondary education through capacity building, locally relevant learning resources, assessment and institutional strengthening. Working within public education systems, it emphasises practical, sustainable solutions that are co-designed with teachers and government stakeholders.

The organisation values mutual respect, integrity, transparency, excellence, collaboration and trust, and seeks to foster an inclusive work environment.

**3. JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Head of Communications will provide strategic and operational leadership to the organisation’s communications function, strengthening the organisation’s identity, visibility, thought leadership and stakeholder engagement. Reporting to the CEO, the incumbent will turn complex programme work, evidence and outcomes into accurate, memorable and accessible narratives, while ensuring high standards of creative and editorial execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**(A) Strategy, Brand and Creative Storytelling**

(1) Develop and lead the implementation of the organisation’s communications strategy, ensuring alignment with organisational priorities, programme objectives and resource mobilisation goals.

(2) Translate strategic priorities into annual communication plans, key messages, content priorities and outreach initiatives, with clear deliverables and timelines. Establish and maintain consistent messaging, positioning, branding and storytelling across all platforms, media, publications and communication materials.

(3) Oversee the development of high-quality communication materials, including organisational profiles, brochures, reports, presentations, visual storytelling videos, publications and digital content. Safeguard brand integrity by establishing and maintaining brand guidelines, editorial standards and quality assurance processes.

**(B) Impact Communications and Thought Leadership**

(1) Work closely with Programme and MEL teams to identify, validate and communicate programme results, learning outcomes, evaluation findings and stories of change.

(2) Oversee the development of knowledge products, including case studies, white papers, policy briefs, research-based articles and publications that showcase the organisation’s experience, insights and contributions to the education sector. Identify and pursue opportunities to position the organisation and its leadership as credible voices in education.

(3) Establish processes for identifying, documenting and communicating human-interest stories that illustrate the experiences of children, teachers, parents, schools and other stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, dignity and appropriate consent. Oversee field-based documentation and a repository of impact stories and other communication assets; enforce clear consent guidelines, including written parental/guardian sign-off where children are subjects.

**(C) Donor and Stakeholder Communications**

(1) Work closely with the Resource Mobilisation team to develop donor proposals, presentations, impact reports, newsletters and other fundraising materials that articulate the organisation’s value proposition, achievements and potential for scale.

(2) Translate programme information, evidence and organisational priorities into clear, persuasive narratives tailored to different donor and stakeholder audiences. Ensure consistency between programme evidence, organisational messaging and donor-facing narratives, maintaining accuracy and credibility across all external communications.

(3)Communications supports fundraising initiatives;

**(D) Publications, Digital Outreach and Internal Communication**

(1) Lead the organisation’s content strategy, defining content priorities, formats, editorial calendars and publication plans in line with organisational and stakeholder needs. Oversee audience-specific communication materials, including impact reports, case studies, programme publications, teaching and learning collaterals, textbooks and other knowledge products.

(2) Lead the organisation’s digital communications strategy, overseeing its website, social media channels and other relevant platforms. Ensure digital platforms are regularly updated; use digital analytics and audience insights to improve engagement, and identify and manage digital and social media risks.

(3) Lead initiatives to strengthen internal communications, promote organisational alignment and facilitate information sharing across teams and locations. Establish effective processes for gathering programme information, evidence, updates and stories from Programme, MEL and other teams.

**(E) Team, Agency and Function Management**

(1) Lead and manage the communications function, ensuring effective planning, prioritisation, coordination and delivery across all workstreams. Build and manage internal resources, consultants and external partners as applicable; set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.

(2) Define briefs, deliverables and quality expectations for external partners, and monitor performance, timelines and costs. Establish effective systems and processes for content planning, approvals, production, publication, documentation and performance monitoring; manage the communications budget and ensure effective utilisation of funds.

(3) Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Maintain the highest standards of personal and professional integrity and model the organisation’s values of openness, innovation, teamwork and performance; ensure adherence to organisational policies and procedures.

**4. EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES**

**Qualifications and Experience:**

(1) Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, Social Sciences, or any relevant discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification will be an advantage. Strong demonstrated capability may be considered over academic qualifications.

(2) Approximately 14 -15 years of relevant communications experience, including around three years leading a team and a substantial communications portfolio; flexibility for outstanding candidates.

(3) Applications welcomed from corporate communications, agency, brand management and people with active social media fluency. Prior NGO employment or specialist Communication for Development (C4D) credentials are not a prerequisite.

**Skills and Attributes:**

(1) Outstanding English writing, editing and storytelling, with an ability to develop original ideas and communicate complex information engagingly to different audiences.

(2) Strong strategic judgement, brand stewardship to actively build the organisation’s brand and hands-on capacity to deliver high-quality content, campaigns, publications and digital communication.

(3) Ability to interpret and accurately communicate programme evidence and outcomes; excellent judgement on ethics, permissions and sensitive representations involving children.

(4) Confident stakeholder management, collaboration with technical teams, and oversight of creative partners, schedules, budgets and production quality.

(5) Creative, resourceful, audience-aware and results-oriented; able to combine conceptual thinking with disciplined execution and uphold integrity and collaboration.

(6) Multilingual content or Indian regional contexts would be advantageous, but not a prerequisite.

(7) Strong working proficiency in English is a prerequisite; proficiency in Hindi/other Indian languages is an advantage.

**6. LOCATION AND WORK SCHEDULE**

Office-based Monday to Thursday; work from home on Friday. Saturday and Sunday are normally weekly holidays, although occasional weekend work may be required.

title: Content Strategist (B2B SaaS)
description:
**Title: Content Strategist (B2B SaaS)**

**Location:**
[On-site, Janakpuri, New Delhi] ·

**About Infrasity**

Infrasity is an engineering-led developer marketing and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency. We help DevTool and B2B SaaS companies get discovered by developers on Google, in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), on GitHub, and in communities like Reddit.

Our clients build in infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AI/LLM tooling, security, and APIs. Their audience is engineers, who can tell real technical content from marketing fluff instantly. That's the bar we hold ourselves to.

**The role**

You'll own content strategy and editorial quality for a portfolio of client accounts. You'll plan what gets created and why, write the highest-priority pieces yourself, edit and QA the rest, and prove impact through rankings and AI citations. You'll work closely with our SEO/GEO, Reddit, influencer, and GitHub teams, and directly with client founders and marketing leads in the US and Europe.

**What you'll do**

* Own content roadmaps for 4–6 client accounts, including keyword and AI-prompt research, competitor gap analysis, and topic prioritisation across SEO, GEO/AEO, GitHub, and community channels.
* Write high-priority pieces yourself, and edit and QA work from writers. Formats include:
* blogs, pillar pages, and landing pages
* comparison ("X vs Y") and alternatives pages
* product docs, READMEs, and case studies
* video and creator scripts
* Structure every piece for both search and AI citation, using answer-first sections, FAQs, schema, clear entities, and strong internal linking.
* Get hands-on with client products: read the docs, run the quickstart, and test the code, so the content holds up with engineers.
* Use AI tools to research and draft faster, then fact-check, add technical depth, and cut the filler.
* Repurpose each piece into Reddit posts, creator briefs, and GitHub repo content, working with the respective teams.
* Track performance in GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Infrasity's GEO Dashboard. Metrics include rankings, organic traffic, AI citation rate, and share of voice. Report monthly with clear next actions.
* Manage async communication and review calls with overseas clients, and ship to the agreed cadence on time.
* Support the sales team with content audits and proposal sections for prospects.
* Contribute to Infrasity's own content, including our blog, newsletter, and research assets.

**What we're looking for**

* 1–2 years of experience in content marketing, content writing, or SEO, with a portfolio of published work. Internships count.
* Comfort with technical material. You can read API docs, use Git/GitHub and a terminal at a basic level, and write in Markdown. A CS or engineering background, or experience writing for developers, is a strong plus.
* Clear, concise writing and strong editorial judgment. You can tell substance from filler, including in AI-generated drafts.
* Working knowledge of Ahrefs, GSC, and GA4, and the ability to turn data into a plan.
* Curiosity about GEO/AEO, meaning how AI assistants decide what to cite. We'll train you, and we expect you to own it within your first 30 days.
* The organisation to run multiple accounts in parallel, and the confidence to handle calls with overseas founders and marketing leads.
* Availability for some evening overlap with US/EU time zones.

**What success looks like**

* **1 week days:**
  You're onboarded on our GEO workflow and tools, you own roadmaps for 2 accounts, and your first pieces have shipped.
* **30 days:**
  You're running 4–6 accounts on cadence with minimal revision rounds.
* **45 days:**
  You can show measurable movement in rankings or AI citations on at least one account.

**Why Infrasity**

* You'll work on real DevTool and AI companies, not generic SaaS.
* You'll get hands-on experience with GEO, the fastest-moving area in marketing right now, using our proprietary tooling.
* You'll have high ownership early, work directly with the founding team, and have a clear growth path into content strategy leadership.

title: SOC Analyst L2
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their Security Infrastructures and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, this role is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA) and focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity.
  
  
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* BE/BTech in Electronics/EC/EE/CS/IT Engineering or MCA
* At least one security certification such as CCNA Security, CCSA, CEH, CompTIA, GCIH/GCIA

**Required Experience:**

* At least one SIEM solution certifications with one or more SIEM/ Security solutions (i.e., RSA NetWitness, Splunk ES, Elastic ELK, HP ArcSight, IBM QRadar Log Rhythm).
* Minimum overall 5 years of experience in handling security related products & services in a reputed organization out of which 3 years’ experience should be in SIEM solution.
* Person should have adequate knowledge of security devices like firewalls, IPS, Web Application Firewall, DDOS, EDR, Incident response, SOAR and other security devices
* Administration of SIEM environment (e.g.: deployment of solution, user management, managing the licenses, upgrades and patch deployment, addition or deletion of log sources, configuration management, change management, report management, manage backup and recovery, etc.)
* Construction of SIEM content required to produce Content Outputs (e.g., filters, active lists, correlation rules, reports, report templates, queries, trends, variables)
* Integration of customized threat intelligence content feeds provided by the Threat Intelligence & Analytics service
* Identifies possible sensor improvements to prevent incidents
* Collects/updates threat intelligence feeds from various sources
* Creates situational awareness briefings
* Co-ordinates with the different departments for incident analysis, containment and remediation
* Liaise with Security monitoring team to discover repeatable process that lead to new content development
* Provides engineering analysis and architectural design of technical solutions
* Knowledge of networking protocols and technologies and network security
* Sound analytical and troubleshooting skills

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.
* Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
* Routinely identifies common incidents and opportunities for avoidance as well as general opportunities for incident reduction.
* Investigates first line incidents assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
* Schedules maintenance activity windows for patching and configuration changes.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.
* Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.
* Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests.
* Updates existing knowledge articles or create new ones.
* Identifies opportunities for work optimization including opportunities for automation of work, request fulfilment, incident resolution, and other general process improvement opportunities.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation ( EAII Advisors )
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
You will be part of our Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation team supporting the successful design and rollout of monitoring initiatives for the India Safe Water programme. The programme is implementing In-Line Chlorination (ILC) technology in partnership with the Government of India's Jal Jeevan Mission, targeting communities served by Single Village Scheme water systems; ILC delivers safe, chlorinated water at the source and has demonstrated strong potential for cost-effectiveness and scale. The programme is currently operational in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, with the goal of reaching 17.5 million people across multiple Indian states with safe drinking water.
  
  
As the programme portfolio expands, you will contribute to exploring and implementing innovative, technology-enabled ways of operating at scale. The MLE team plays a central role in generating evidence, ensuring data quality, and informing programme decisions; this role requires significant experience in evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, and applied data analytics.
  
  
The Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation will be based in New Delhi and reports to the Senior Manager - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Monitoring Framework and Systems
  
  

* Support the MLE team in developing programme Theory of Change, Results Framework, Logframe, indicators and measurement protocols aligned with programme objectives
* Develop and institutionalise monitoring tools, reporting formats, data quality protocols and SOPs
* Establish systems for routine tracking of programme outputs, outcomes and key performance indicators
* Work closely with programme teams to ensure that monitoring systems generate actionable insights rather than only reporting numbers
* Support the design and implementation of the MLE framework for the India Safe Water programme

Evaluation Design and Assessment
  
  

* Work with MLE team to Develop evaluation designs appropriate to programme objectives, including experimental/quasi-experimental approaches where feasible
* Work with the MLE team to develop sampling strategies, sample size calculations, survey designs, questionnaires and data collection protocols
* Define appropriate evaluation indicators and outcome measures related to safe water access, water quality, behaviour change, service delivery and programme performance

Data Management, Analysis and Interpretation
  
  

* Analysis of large and complex programme datasets using appropriate statistical and econometric methods
* Conduct descriptive, inferential and multivariate analysis, as appropriate
* Identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies in programme data and translate these into actionable programme insights
* Develop approaches for data triangulation across survey and monitoring datasets
* Establish standards for data cleaning, validation, documentation and reproducible analysis

Data Visualisation and Dashboarding
  
  

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and data visualisation systems to track programme performance
* Translate complex datasets into intuitive visualisations that can be used by field teams for decision-making
* Design dashboards covering key programme indicators, performance, implementation progress, outcome indicators and emerging risks

Data Quality and Field Monitoring
  
  

* Work with the MLE team to Establish and implement a robust Data Quality Assurance (DQA) framework
* Develop protocols for data verification, back-checks, audits and validation of field-collected data
* Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring data to identify inconsistencies, reporting gaps and potential data quality issues
* Work with field and implementation teams to strengthen data collection processes and address data quality gaps
* Ensure that data collection tools and processes are aligned with evaluation and analytical requirements

Programme Learning and Decision Support
  
  

* Develop regular analytical reports and management briefs highlighting programme performance, challenges, emerging trends and recommended actions
* Institutionalise learning loops between monitoring, evaluation and programme implementation

Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Work closely with programme, operations, technical and field teams to integrate M&E into programme implementation
* Manage relationships with external agencies, survey firms, evaluators and technology/data partners

**Requirements**

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in MLE, evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, or applied data analytics
* Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related field
* Experience in WASH, safe water, public health, or rural development is desirable
* Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies and research design
* Demonstrated experience in designing impact and outcome evaluations
* Knowledge of sampling techniques, sample size determination, and survey methodology
* Advanced skills in data analysis and statistical modelling
* Strong hands-on experience in data quality assurance, high-frequency checks, data validation, data cleaning, and data management
* Excellent data visualisation and dashboarding skills
* Proficiency in Stata, SPSS, Power BI, and CAPI scripting. Experience with multiple analytical and data management tools is an advantage
* Ability to independently interpret quantitative findings and effectively communicate insights and implications to non-technical stakeholders
* Strong report writing, documentation, and presentation skills
* Fluency in written and spoken English and Hindi

**Position Location**
: This role will be based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide. Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Optional enrolment in the National Pension System (NPS) through our partner, HDFC Pension
* Optional Flexible Basket Plan, offering components such as meal allowance, fuel, top-up health and term insurance, and telecommunications & internet - all forming part of the employee's CTC
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.

title: Associate-Senior Associate - AIF
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Origination, due diligence, development, and implementation of commercially viable distressed private equity investment opportunities in the real estate and allied sectors for the achievement of returns targeted by the investors in the fund.

**Key Accountabilities:**

1.
**Deal Evaluation**

* Prepare market reports to identify demand and supply drivers of the deal
* Plan the product type to optimize unit sizes and price for the market
* Develop financial models to test the financial feasibility of the deal under different scenarios
* Identify and prepare key deal considerations that impact financial feasibility
* Prepare the investment committee note for the approval of the deal by the investment committee

**2. Due Diligence**

* Coordinate with due diligence vendors to mitigate information gaps
* Control the due diligence process by continuously seeking updates from vendors and managing timelines
* Identify key issues during the due diligence process and working with management to propose mitigating measures

**3. Deal Documentation and Investment**

* Coordinate with the tax advisor, legal vendor, and internal legal team to deliver the draft deal documents within agreed timelines
* Propose alterations to the deal documents by working with the management and development partner
* Manage and control the execution of the deal documents by coordinating with internal support teams, external vendors, management, and development partner
* Plan and control the investment into the deal within agreed timelines by coordinating with management and internal support teams

**4. SPV Financial Monitoring**

* Establish standards for improving the quality of financial reporting by external accountants and proposing ways to improve the presentation of financials
* Prepare quarterly summary financials of SPVs based on historical financial statements and benchmark them against targets
* Prepare revised forecasts of future periods in financial models to estimate revised returns and funding requirements
* Compare revised investment returns with initial investment returns to assess reasons for variation and highlighting them to the management and development partner (project monitoring committee) for taking up control measures

**5. SPV Funding**

* Plan funding requirements of SPVs by evaluating shortfalls in finances and coordinating with external accountant and development partner
* Process infusions in SPVs in timely manner to ensure invoices are paid on time
* Work with management and external vendors to raise debt for SPVs by assessing the impact of debt terms on the business plan, closing information requirements of lenders, and coordinating with internal legal team and external legal advisor for due diligence and review and finalization of transaction documents

**6. SPV Sales and Operations Management**

* Coordinate with development partner and external advisors to prepare the project for sales by ensuring adequate approvals from government, facilitating the closure of sales related documentation, and working with sales advisors for the preparation of sales collaterals
* Monitor the sales launch date, monthly sales, and sales price by comparing it with the business plan and highlighting deviations to management
* Manage the onboarding of housing finance providers by closing their information requirements and facilitating them in their due diligence
* Coordinate with development partner to identify issues related to site infrastructure and resolving them by working with the seller of the land

**7. Investor Reporting**

* Prepare quarterly investor reports by identifying key developments in projects and providing revised investment returns
* Resolve investor queries pertaining to projects and facilitating them in their monitoring and controlling activities

**8. Business Development and Process Flow Management**

* Establish and manage partnerships with developers and market intermediaries to improve the deal flow and capability of the fund to invest across multiple asset classes
* Develop standard operating procedures and reporting standards for all internal support functions and external vendors for smooth flow of operations

**Educational Qualifications**

a) Qualifications

* Minimum Qualification required: Master’s in Finance/ Master’s Business Administration/ CA/CFA
* Stream of Study – Finance
* Qualifications preferred: Postgraduate/Master’s Business Administration/ CA/ CFA

b) Work Experience

1. Minimum 4/9 years of experience
2. Industry experience: Real estate and Infrastructure related experience
3. Functional experience: Private equity, Investment banking, Management consulting
4. Proficiency in MS excel and MS word
5. Report writing
6. Experience with stakeholder management

title: Senior Manager- Child & Social Protection, EVAC
description: 1. POSITION VACANT: Senior Manager, Child & Social Protection, EVAC, India | Location: New Delhi2. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW:The Children’s Investment Fund Foundation (CIFF) is an independent philanthropic organisation with offices in Addis Ababa, Beijing, London, Nairobi, and New Delhi. CIFF works with a wide range of partners to tackle some of the most complex challenges facing children, so that every child has the chance to survive and thrive. CIFF has been working in India since 2008, supporting government priorities to improve outcomes for children. Through its Born Healthy Mission, CIFF supports maternal, newborn and child health, improved nutrition, the prevention of low birthweight, and efforts to reduce mortality from severe acute malnutrition. Through the End Violence Against Children (EVAC) Mission, CIFF works to reduce children's vulnerability to violence, exploitation and harmful practices, while enabling children to access better education, health and future opportunities. Complementing this, the Women's Economic Empowerments (WEE) Mission advances girls' and women's economic agency by strengthening pathways to skills development, workforce participation and sustainable livelihoods. CIFF's climate work sits within the Clean Growth Mission, supporting India's transition to clean energy and a climate-safe future that delivers healthier air, greater energy security and sustainable livelihoods for current and future generations. Across these missions, CIFF combines catalytic capital, alongside rigorous use of data and evidence, to maximise impact and strengthen the effectiveness of philanthropy and public systems. Building and harnessing diversity of perspective and experience within CIFF is critical to achieving its bold goals. CIFF strives to deliver a work environment which is diverse, equitable and inclusive, respecting and embracing individual differences and needs, and enabling all members of the CIFF family to be at their best. For more information, please visit www.ciff.org. 3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:The role is accountable for the strategic leadership, investment proposition and portfolio management of Child Protection and Social Protection investments under CIFF’s Ending Violence Against Children (EVAC) Mission in India. It will develop strategy, innovate delivery models, refine execution strategy and cultivate partnerships with Government and the wider ecosystem to deliver the Mission’s priorities and accelerate India’s demographic dividends.Main Purpose of the Role:(1) India is one of the most critical countries in the world as CIFF seeks human advancement, and shifting the needle on most global indicators can only happen if there is progress in India. India is among the biggest countries for CIFF, and the entirety of CIFF’s portfolio is active here: child health and development, ending violence against children, adolescence, child protection, women’s economic empowerment and climate change;(2) Built on in-country and global workstreams, CIFF’s newly approved Ending Violence Against Children (EVAC) Mission affirms and widens in scope the foundation’s decades-long commitment to protect millions of children from violence over the next decade. The Mission pools together multiple programmes to end manifestations such as child marriage, child labour, child trafficking and child sexual assault through a comprehensive approach built on access to secondary education, access to social protection and access to child protection;(3) In India, the EVAC Mission is at the cusp of rapidly scaling Kawach, its signature Child Protection intervention delivered through government Child Protection systems across multiple states. The Mission is also building its portfolio to help households develop resilience, particularly to economic shocks, through investments such as the Migrants Resilience Collaborative and others;(4) The post-holder will lead strategy, the investment proposition and portfolio management of the Child Protection (CP) and Social Protection (SP) investments of the EVAC Mission in India, including developing strategy, innovating delivery models, refining execution strategy and cultivating partnerships with Government and the ecosystem.Reports to: Director- Child Protection & Social Resilience-IndiaCIFF operates a matrix structure, so reporting lines can vary between specific aspects of the role.Key Responsibilities:(A) Strategy and Planning:(1) Lead the Mission’s strategic functions for India (and across CIFF as applicable), including strategy planning using evidence-informed prioritisation, strategy review based on actionable insights, programme and grant structure design, strategic communication and strategic partnerships;(2) Proactively assess the context and ecosystem to modulate the strategy of the relevant Mission components, ensuring a robust pathway to Mission objectives through CIFF investment and ecosystem initiatives informed by CIFF;(3) Develop and execute an innovation track, especially on promising forward-looking ideas in Child Protection and Social Protection;(4) Identify synergies and actively strengthen integration of CP and SP programmes with other EVAC programmes as a paramount goal, working closely with the EVAC and Programme Excellence teams;(5) Identify and enable opportunities for improving processes, procedures and programme management approaches within (and beyond) the team to support increased organisational efficiency and effectiveness.(B) Programme Delivery and Performance:(1) Lead and manage a portfolio of complex and multi-layered programmes (approximately USD 25 million or more), implemented across multiple states with significant national government engagement and involving four or more key execution partners, including large inter-sectional investments under the EVAC India portfolio, with end-to-end accountability for planning, design and delivery of short- to medium-term results;(2) In close collaboration with the Director, EVAC and the Programme Excellence team, build and lead a CIFF-investable pipeline, covering design of programmes, identification of appropriate grantees and commissioning of programmes for implementation;(3) Lead the internal communication and socialisation of the pipeline with CIFF leadership for participatory decision-making and successful conversion from ideation to approval;(4) Innovate and execute active portfolio management techniques, in collaboration with the Programme Excellence team, that are customised to the CP and SP portfolio contexts and built on multi-sectoral and multi-source insights, to ensure continuous improvement towards Mission and programme goals, especially on opportunities, risks and momentum;(5) Conduct regular evidence-informed reviews of the progress and performance of CP and SP programmes, identifying challenges early and working with governments and partners to develop effective course-correction measures and solutions, and co-lead with the Programme Excellence team the monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) systems and deliverables for programmes;(6) Apply agreed due diligence and risk management protocols appropriately throughout the development and delivery of CP and SP proposals and programmes, to ensure the interests and reputation of the Foundation are protected;(7) Proactively engage senior leaders and peers to raise the profile of CP and SP portfolios and give an early sense of ongoing work and its impact, evolving contexts including challenges and opportunities, and exploratory course corrections;(8) Work closely with members of the Finance and Legal teams to develop grant agreements, forecast and process grant payments, and enable effective grant management and reporting within the organisation;(9) Lead the preparation of synthesised, high-quality deliverables, including insight reports, Board papers, portfolio investment updates, presentations and briefs, ensuring they are produced to an exceptional standard and within rapid turnaround timelines;(10) Prepare and present high-quality analysis and research, as required, to support the sector in determining longer-term strategic priorities, and set and implement sustainable operational plans.(C) Sector Knowledge and Profile-Building:(1) Keep abreast of national and international developments in the priority areas of the CP (Child Protection) and SP (Social Protection) portfolios, establishing practice as a sector expert, and act as a knowledgeable resource on CIFF’s programmes and priority areas;(3) As required, work with the Communications team on the development of thought leadership, communication and advocacy materials, to support CIFF’s ambitions to scale up, mainstream and leverage additional support for its initiatives.(D) Stakeholder and Partner Management:(1) In suitability and credentials for collaborating on CIFF initiatives;(2) Apply CIFF’s agreed account management and customer relationship management (CRM) disciplines and approaches in all dealings with programme partners and stakeholders, to ensure productive and professional relationships are maintained in a coordinated and strategic manner;(3) In collaboration with the Portfolio Lead and India leadership, develop strategic partnerships with international and Indian donors and governments to support adoption, replication, co-funding or scaling-up of CIFF programmes;(4) With a variety of central and state levels, to ensure effective programme implementation and sustainability of outcomes.(E) Membership and Leadership of the Team:(1) Provide coaching and mentoring support to identified encourages continuous improvement and learning;(5) Contribute to corporate initiatives, as required by the Executive Director and Directors.4. EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:Skills & Experience:(1) Advanced understanding of, and expertise in, relevant disciplines;(2) Demonstrable experience in analysis and due diligence, and in policy, planning and programme delivery, including field experience, all within the development sector;(3) Demonstrated experience in government social development programme systems, such as governance and data, planning and financing, and delivery; experience in behaviour change / mental models is preferred;(4) Demonstrated experience in the private sector, particularly in informing CxO / CxO-1 decision-making, is preferred;(5) Detailed understanding of using cost-benefit and ROI methodologies and metrics to inform strategy and business planning;(6) Knowledge of the evidence bases pertaining to programme design and implementation, and a belief in the importance of evidence-based decision-making;(7) Strong working knowledge of impact measurement and programme monitoring and evaluation;(8) An innovative thinker with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset;(9) Ability to analyse an organisation’s strength of management, vision and adaptive capacity, and to recruit, guide, influence and/or advise management teams to implement programmes effectively;(10) Experience working within government systems and/or experience influencing the policies of government agencies, private sector organisations or donor organisations;(11) Effectively champions and promotes causes: credible and professional, always presenting the Foundation’s programmes in a compelling way to engage the
