title: Senior 2D Artist
description:
**Job Description –**
2D Artist – Visual Design, UI/UX & Concept Development

**Threye Interactive Pvt Ltd**

**Who are we:**

Threye Interactive (www.threye.com) is a multi-award winning and Google accelerated gaming/simulation Development Company doing venture works in the field of virtual and augmented reality and deeply engaged with the aerospace and defence sector. .

**About the Role**

We are seeking a versatile and creatively driven
**2D Artist**
with
**5+ years of professional experience**
spanning graphic design, UI/UX, concept development, visual storytelling, and motion design.

You are a seasoned creative generalist with an uncompromising eye for visual fundamentals—including typography, color theory, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy. You thrive in the space between ideation and execution, moving fluidly from rough sketches and concept exploration to polished, production-ready assets.

If you possess a background in game design, a passion for visual experimentation, and hands-on experience with open-source AI image-generation workflows like Stable Diffusion and ComfyUI, we want to hear from you. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams of designers, artists, and developers to bring compelling visual concepts to life.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Visual & Graphic Design:**
  Craft compelling layouts, compositions, branding assets, and marketing materials for diverse digital and print mediums.
* **Concept Development & Ideation:**
  Drive early-stage creative exploration through mood boards, reference gathering, quick sketches, and conceptual design.
* **UI/UX & Interface Design:**
  Design intuitive, visually striking user interfaces, including screens, layouts, HUDs, menus, icons, and interactive elements.
* **Motion Graphics & Animation:**
  Produce engaging motion design elements, dynamic transitions, and short-form animated content to elevate visual communication.
* **Image Making & Retouching:**
  Execute high-end photo selection, digital retouching, compositing, and image manipulation using professional non-Adobe software.
* **AI-Assisted Workflows:**
  Integrate open-source generative AI tools (e.g., Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI) into your daily pipeline for rapid ideation, texture generation, and visual exploration.
* **Cross-Platform Adaptation:**
  Optimize and adapt visual assets across various platforms, resolutions, and technical constraints.
* **Collaboration & Delivery:**
  Partner with product, engineering, and creative teams to interpret briefs, pitch design directions, iterate on feedback, and hit production milestones.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  4–5+ years of professional experience working as a 2D Artist, Visual Designer, UI/UX Designer, or Concept Artist within creative studios, games, or digital media.
* **Software Proficiency:**
  Strong command of alternative and open-source creative tooling (e.g.,
  **Krita, Affinity Studio, Figma**
  , Inkscape, GIMP, or other independent raster and vector design suites).
  *Note: Our pipeline operates independently of the Adobe Creative Cloud suite.*
* **Design Fundamentals:**
  Mastery of typography, font pairing, color theory, grid systems, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* **Artistic Foundation:**
  Demonstrated strength in sketching, illustration, and turning abstract briefs into concrete visual concepts.
* **Game Design Background:**
  A foundational understanding of game design principles, interactive media, HUD/UI layout, and real-time environment aesthetics.
* **Interface Design:**
  Working knowledge of digital interface layout and user experience best practices.
* **Adaptability:**
  Proven ability to context-switch across multiple creative disciplines under tight deadlines.
* **AI Tooling:**
  Hands-on experience experimenting with open-source generative AI frameworks (Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI).
* **Portfolio:**
  A robust portfolio showcasing multidisciplinary versatility, strong foundational design sensibilities, and creative problem-solving.

**Good-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* **Ad Agency Experience:**
  Previous experience working within a fast-paced advertising agency or creative marketing studio.
* Working knowledge of print production requirements (color spaces, pre-press, bleed, resolution).
* Basic video editing and multimedia production skills.
* Familiarity with 3D packages (e.g., Blender) for reference building, layout planning, or lighting exploration.
* Deepened exposure to game art pipelines, interactive media, or real-time engines.

**What We Value**

* **Versatility:**
  A true creative all-rounder who enjoys wearing multiple hats.
* **Curiosity & Experimentation:**
  Eagerness to explore emerging creative tech and push the boundaries of traditional workflows.
* **Craftsmanship:**
  High visual standards and meticulous attention to detail.
* **End-to-End Ownership:**
  The ability to shepherd a project from a loose napkin sketch to a polished final deliverable.
* **Communication:**
  Clear articulation of design choices and receptiveness to constructive feedback.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description:
**W.O.G. Technologies Limited**

Job Description

**Senior Process Engineer - Proposals and Bid Engineering**

**Department**

Process and Proposal (P&P) Engineering

**Reports to**

Head - Process and Proposal Engineering

**Location**

Gurugram (Corporate HO), on-site, with travel to project and client sites as required

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Process Engineer is a senior individual contributor in the Process and Proposal Department, owning end-to-end process engineering for incoming RFQs, tenders, and pre-bid technical engagements across W.O.G.'s domestic and international pipeline. The role sits at the front end of the project lifecycle, converting client tender documents, raw water and wastewater characteristics, and discharge or reuse norms into technically compliant, commercially competitive, and bid-winning process solutions.

This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Business Development, Engineering, and Senior Leadership.

**What This Role Is, and What It Is Not**

**This is a proposal and bid engineering role. The core of the job is solutioning and costing winning technical proposals against live tenders, not running plants.**

**This role IS for candidates whose recent and primary work is:**

* Proposal / bid / tender / estimation engineering with an EPC, OEM, or system-integrator company.
* Front-end process design and technology selection for ETP / STP / WTP / ZLD / SWRO / MEE / MBR / UASB bids.

**This role is NOT suitable for, and applications will not be progressed from, candidates whose primary experience is:**

* Plant operations and maintenance (O&M), plant or process in-charge, or shift operations roles.
* Commissioning-only or site-execution-only profiles with no proposal ownership.
* Laboratory, water-chemistry, or quality-control roles.
* Academic, R&D, or product-development roles without a tendering track record.

*Candidates from the above backgrounds who wish to move into proposals should not apply against this senior role; relevant junior openings, where available, will be advertised separately.*

**Must-Have Screening Criteria (all required)**

An application must satisfy every point below to be shortlisted. These are non-negotiable and will be checked at CV stage.

1. Engineering degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical, or Process Engineering.
2. Minimum 10 years in water and wastewater process engineering, of which at least 4 to 5 years in a dedicated Proposal / Bid / Tendering / Estimation function with an EPC, OEM, or system integrator.
3. Current or most recent job title clearly reflects proposals, bid, tender, estimation, or front-end process design (not O&M / plant in-charge / operations).
4. Demonstrable ownership of submitted techno-commercial proposals across ETP / STP / WTP / ZLD / SWRO / MEE (candidate should be able to walk through specific bids at interview).
5. Hands-on process and hydraulic sizing, mass and energy balance, and costing in Excel.
6. Working knowledge of at least one membrane design tool: WAVE, IMSDesign, ROSA, Toraywater, or Winflows.
7. Exposure to both industrial and municipal water / wastewater projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

A. Proposal Engineering and Bid Support (primary focus, about 60 percent)

* Lead the technical solutioning of incoming RFQs / RFPs / tenders for ETP, STP, WTP, SWRO desalination, ZLD, MEE/MVR, reuse and recycle, leachate, spent caustic, and resource-recovery projects.
* Study tender documents, scope of work, raw water and effluent characteristics, and treated-water or discharge norms (CPCB, MoEFCC, USEPA, WHO, local regulators), and convert client requirements into an optimized treatment scheme.
* Develop technology selection studies comparing biological (MBBR, MBR, SBR, IFAS, UASB, AnMBR), membrane (UF/NF/RO/EDI), thermal (MEE, MVR, ATFD), and advanced oxidation options on CAPEX, OPEX, footprint, energy, recovery, and sludge generation.
* Prepare Process Basic Engineering Packages for bids: Process Design Basis, block flow and process flow diagrams, mass and energy balance, hydraulic flow diagrams, process descriptions and control philosophy, tentative P&IDs and layout inputs, equipment list with key sizing parameters, and utility consumption summary.
* Carry out equipment and hydraulic sizing across pumps, blowers, clarifiers, DAFs, screens, MBBR/MBR tanks, UASB/EGSB reactors, RO/UF skids, evaporators, crystallisers, ATFDs, sludge handling units, dosing systems, DM/SAC/WAC, EDI, and disinfection systems.
* Generate process calculations: aeration and oxygen demand, sludge generation, RO recovery and flux modelling, evaporation duty, hydraulic gradelines, retention times, and biogas potential.
* Prepare techno-commercial offers with Sales, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, I&C, and Costing teams; build optioned costing scenarios where required.
* Float vendor RFQs for major equipment packages, technically evaluate offers, and recommend selections to the bid lead.
* Prepare clause-by-clause technical compliance statements, deviation lists, and bid clarifications.
* Drive bid submission timelines and own the technical quality of every proposal that leaves the department.
* Participate in pre-bid, technical clarification, and negotiation meetings with clients, consultants (for example DCPL, EIL, MECON, PDIL, Tata Consulting, Jacobs), and PMC firms, and represent W.O.G. on technical questions.

**B. Engineering Documentation and Design Reviews (about 20 percent)**

* For awarded projects, support handover to Detailed Engineering: author or review Process Design Basis, PFDs, P&IDs, equipment data sheets, control philosophy, and line lists.
* Participate in and document HAZOP, SIL, HAZID, design reviews, and constructability reviews.
* Approve vendor technical submissions and GADs for process equipment.
* Ensure process deliverables comply with applicable codes and standards: CPHEEO, MoEFCC, CPCB, IS/BIS, ASME, API, ISO 14001, and client-specific specifications.

**C. Cross-Functional and Client-Facing Support (about 15 percent)**

* Provide technical inputs to Business Development for enquiry qualification, market mapping, and target-account strategy.
* Deliver technical presentations to clients, EPC contractors, government bodies, and consultants.
* Support trade fairs and seminars (for example IFAT India, WaterEx, Aquatech, Chemtech) with technical representation and white papers.
* Provide commissioning and process troubleshooting support to I&C and O&M teams when escalated.
* Conduct plant audits for prospective O&M opportunities and develop revamp or upgrade proposals.

D. Knowledge Management and Innovation (about 5 percent)

* Build and maintain the department's proposal library: reference designs, sizing templates, cost benchmarks, vendor records, and lessons learned.
* Stay current on emerging technologies relevant to W.O.G.: AnMBR, electro-coagulation, electrodialysis, granular sludge, MABR, PFAS destruction, digital twins, and AI-based water quality prediction.
* Contribute to thought leadership through case studies and technical articles.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

* B.E./B.Tech in Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical, or Process Engineering - mandatory.
* M.Tech in Chemical, Environmental, or Water Engineering - preferred.
* Diploma holders considered only with significantly higher experience and a demonstrated proposal-engineering track record.

Experience

* Minimum 10 years of water and wastewater process engineering, of which at least 4 to 5 years in a Proposal / Bid / Tendering function with an EPC, OEM, or system integrator.
* Hands-on exposure to both industrial and municipal water / wastewater projects.
* A strong record of submitted proposals across ETP/STP/WTP/ZLD/SWRO/MEE, with order-conversion or win-rate evidence - preferred, and will be probed at interview.
* Experience with international tenders (Middle East, SE Asia, Africa) - preferred.
* Prior experience in two or more of W.O.G.'s focus sectors (chemicals and fertilizers, pharma, oil and gas, refinery, power, food and beverage, textile, automotive, dairy, distillery, pulp and paper, mining, data centres) - preferred.
* Exposure to BOOT/BOO, HAM, EPC, and turnkey contracting models - preferred.

**Seniority note:**
*this specification is pitched at a senior, lead-grade individual contributor. If the approved band and CTC are for a mid-level engineer, retitle to "Process Engineer - Proposals" and reset the experience bar to 6 to 8 years total with 2 to 3 years in proposals, so that title, years, and pay stay aligned.*

Technical Knowledge

* Command of unit operations and treatment technologies: screening, equalisation, primary treatment (DAF/CPI/TPI), biological (ASP, MBBR, MBR, SBR, IFAS, UASB, EGSB, AnMBR), tertiary polishing, membranes (UF/NF/RO/EDI), thermal concentration (MEE, MVR, ATFD), AOPs, ion exchange, and sludge handling.
* Understanding of discharge norms, reuse standards, ZLD targets, and PFAS or micropollutant considerations.
* Familiarity with HAZOP, SIL, LOPA, and HAZID methodologies.
* Working knowledge of hydraulic profile design and equipment de-rating for tropical, coastal, or extreme conditions.

Software and Tools

**Must-have:**

You will be reporting to the Manager, Indirect Tax and working onsite in Noida, India.

title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Description**
Position at LeadVenture India
  
  
**Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Build Our Foundation**
**Location: Gurgaon, India (Hybrid)**
Are you an engineer who loves building the rock-solid foundation that everything else runs on? Do you enjoy the challenge of weaving different technologies—Windows, Linux, on-prem, and cloud—into a single, powerful platform?
  
  
If you want to architect and own the core infrastructure of a global company, this role is for you.
  
  
**Here is more of what you’ll get to do:**
Our company is growing incredibly fast and is a leader in multiple areas. Your mission is to help design, build, and manage the core infrastructure that powers it all.
  
  
This isn’t just about keeping the lights on. It’s about creating a scalable, secure, and efficient foundation for future growth.
  
  

* You will help architect and deploy the infrastructure for our new projects, ensuring they meet the highest standards for performance and uptime.
* You will master a hybrid world, expertly managing both Microsoft (Active Directory, IIS, SQL, Clustering) and Linux environments (Ubuntu, Apache, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch).
* You will own our resilience, implementing and managing complex backup, storage (SAN/NAS), and disaster recovery solutions.
* You will bridge the gap to the cloud, using your experience with public cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
* You will be the expert, acting as an escalation point for critical issues and mentoring junior engineers.

**You’ll thrive in this role if you have:**

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a mixed mode (onsite, remote or hybrid) environment, including consistent use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, and proactive communication practices while maintaining a professional on-camera presence.

**Virtualization and SAN storage**

* Strong hands-on experience with one of Hyper-V, VMware/ESXi, or Nutanix, with working knowledge of a second.
* Experience with VM provisioning, host maintenance, high availability, and troubleshooting.
* Basic experience working remotely with SAN storage, preferably Pure Storage or HPE Nimble.

**Windows, Linux, and application infrastructure**

* Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux, preferably Ubuntu, with stronger expertise in one.
* Comfortable with patching, upgrades, permissions, services, and performance troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of IIS and NGINX/Apache, plus a basic understanding of HAProxy, reverse proxying, backend health checks, and load balancing.
* Exposure to Windows Failover Clustering and SQL Server Always On Availability Groups is preferred.

**Active Directory and related services**

* Good understanding of domains, domain controllers, DNS, Group Policy, authentication, and replication, with practical experience troubleshooting domain joins and login issues.
* Familiarity with Windows/Linux domain integration.

**Exposure to public cloud**

* Foundational experience supporting AWS (preferred) or Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, access controls, and monitoring.

**Configuration management and scripting**

* Working experience with Puppet or Ansible, including maintaining existing configurations and troubleshooting failures.
* Ability to understand, maintain, and adapt scripts using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

**Operational ownership and collaboration**

* Structured troubleshooting, proactive stakeholder updates, timely ticket records, clear documentation, and willingness to share knowledge and support junior engineers.
* Ability to collaborate across global teams and participate in on-call support and planned maintenance.

**AI-assisted operations**

* Practical use of Claude, ChatGPT, or similar approved tools for troubleshooting, analysis, scripting, and documentation.
* Able to refine prompts, validate recommendations, and protect sensitive information while improving efficiency and accelerating delivery.

**Nice-to-have skills**
**Monitoring and centralized logging**

* Experience using Zabbix and the ELK stack for monitoring, alert investigation, log analysis, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

**Backup, disaster recovery, and SOC 2**

* Experience with enterprise backups, preferably Veeam, including failure investigation and restores.
* Understanding of RPO/RTO, business continuity, recovery testing, and SOC 2 controls and evidence.

**Networking, firewalls, and load balancing**

* Broader experience with TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, NAT, firewall rules, and load-balancer configuration.
* Ability to investigate connectivity issues and coordinate changes with networking/security teams.

**CI/CD**

* Exposure to Jenkins, Octopus Deploy, or similar tools, including pipelines and deployment troubleshooting.

**Kubernetes**

* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and Rancher, including workloads, services, ingress, and troubleshooting.

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Familiarity with Terraform or similar tools, including version-controlled configurations, state management, and drift detection.

Does this position sound like something you would enjoy and be successful at, but you’re not sure you have the exact qualifications to be considered? While our job descriptions are an outline for the type of candidate we’re looking for, it is not a checklist. We encourage you to apply!
  
  
**Who we are:**
LeadVenture is the market-leading SaaS provider of digital retailing, eCommerce, digital marketing and eCatalog solutions for dealerships across 12 industry verticals including powersports, marine, RV, pre-owned auto, agriculture and more. title: Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst (Qualys)
description:
**Role Description**
Role at a glance ROLE INFORMATION DETAIL Job title Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst Team/function Technology Services Group (TSG) — Cyber Operations/Vulnerability Management Level Senior Analyst Employment type Contract (Contractor) Location Gurgaon, India Work arrangement Hybrid. Minimum two days per week onsite at the Gurgaon office, subject to prevailing workplace policy. About the role seeking an experienced Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst to join our Cyber Operations team within the Technology Services Group on a contract basis. This is a hands-on engagement in which you will operate and drive the day-to-day maturity of our vulnerability and exposure management program across a large, diverse global environment spanning servers, endpoints, network devices, containers, and multi-cloud workloads. You will run the core tooling stack hands-on — Qualys (VMDR) for host and application scanning, Wiz for cloud and container posture, and Tanium for endpoint visibility and remediation — and lead a Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) program that turns findings from these tools into a single, risk-prioritized view of real exposure. Working closely with IT, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams, you will set remediation standards, drive accountability, guide junior analysts, and brief leadership on exposure and risk trends. This role is a fixed-term contract; extension or conversion is subject to business need and performance. The role is based at our Gurgaon office in India and is hybrid, with a minimum of two days each week worked onsite. 1 Location and work arrangement
  
  

* The role is based in Gurgaon, India. Candidates must be based in Gurgaon or within a daily commute of the office.
* The contractor is required to work from the Gurgaon office a minimum of two days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely.
* Specific onsite days will be confirmed with the hiring manager to fit team and operational needs.
* The contractor must follow prevailing workplace and attendance policy at all times. If that policy changes, including any change to the required number of office days or to the firm's hybrid working model, the contractor is expected to comply with the revised policy. Key responsibilities
* Own and continuously mature the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle across the enterprise — asset discovery, scanning, detection, validation, prioritization, remediation governance, rescanning, and closure verification.
* Operate and administer the core exposure tooling stack hands-on — Qualys (VMDR) for host and application scanning, Wiz for cloud and container posture, and Tanium for endpoint visibility and remediation — including deployment, configuration, tuning, integration, and scanner/agent/sensor health.
* Lead the Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) program — running the scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization cycles, and correlating findings across host, cloud, and endpoint sources into a single de-duplicated, risk-ranked view of exposure.
* Prioritize vulnerabilities using CVSS combined with exploitability signals (EPSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities), threat intelligence, and asset/business criticality — focusing remediation on what is actually exploitable and material.
* Set and enforce remediation SLAs and drive accountability with IT, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams — translating findings into clear, actionable work and escalating aged or high-risk exposures.
* Partner with threat intelligence to correlate external threat activity with internal findings, translate emerging threats into targeted validation and remediation, and surface material risks for escalation.
* Define exception and risk-acceptance standards, review and adjudicate requests, and maintain defensible documentation to support audits, compliance, and leadership reporting.
* Build and automate dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting on exposure, scan coverage, vulnerability aging, and SLA adherence — using native tool reporting, Excel (including pivot tables), and query/BI tooling.
* Mentor junior analysts, set standards for triage, documentation, and reporting quality, and act as the escalation point for complex or contested findings. 2
* Advise on secure configuration, hardening, and overall program maturity, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to senior stakeholders. Required qualifications
* Experience: 5–7 years of hands-on experience in vulnerability management, exposure management, or closely related security operations, including time in a senior or lead capacity.
* Lifecycle and governance: Deep understanding of the vulnerability management lifecycle, risk based remediation, and SLA governance across large, complex environments.
* Tooling (hands-on): Direct, hands-on experience operating and administering Qualys (VMDR), Wiz, and Tanium — including deployment, configuration, tuning, integration, and reporting. Hands-on depth with all three is required.
* CTEM: Demonstrated experience running or materially contributing to a Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) program across its scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization phases.
* Risk prioritization: Proficiency in CVSS analysis combined with exploitability signals (EPSS, CISA KEV) and threat-intelligence-driven, risk-based prioritization.
* Data and reporting: Strong data and reporting skills — Excel (including pivot tables), native tool reporting, and ideally query or BI tooling — to produce both technical and executive-level metrics.
* Environment breadth: Proven experience securing large, diverse environments spanning Windows, Linux, network devices, endpoints, containers, and multi-cloud workloads.
* Threat awareness: Strong working knowledge of threat intelligence sources and the ability to correlate external threat data with internal findings to drive prioritization.
* Communication and leadership: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence remediation owners, brief senior leadership, and mentor junior analysts. Preferred/nice-to-have
* Cloud and container security: Working knowledge of cloud security posture (CSPM/CNAPP) and container/Kubernetes security concepts, ideally via Wiz or an equivalent platform.
* Benchmarking: Working knowledge of CIS Benchmarks and secure configuration/hardening standards.
* Automation: Exposure to scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, tool APIs, Power Query) to integrate tooling and streamline reporting or remediation workflows.
* Integrations: Experience integrating vulnerability/exposure tooling with ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) to automate remediation workflows. 3 Certifications One or more relevant certifications preferred (or willingness to obtain):
* Qualys VMDR Certification
* Wiz Certified (or equivalent cloud security/CNAPP certification)
* GIAC (e.g., GEVA/GCED) or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* CISSP, or Tanium/CompTIA Security+ (or progress toward these

**Skills**
Vulnerability Management, Wiz, Tanium, Qualys

Registration of new known solutions and updating of existing known solutions based on answers/solutions developed within own line organization or received from elsewhere.
  
  
Providing suggestions in developing Operation & Maintenance instructions.
  
  
Isolate product faults and raise them to Product Design. Support design unit to reproduce the fault and evaluate the final fix provided.
  
  
May need to work in shifts and Emergency Support rota.
  
  
To lead and execute the implementation of new software releases on test labs.
  
  
Writing documents for fault analysis/RCA along with required preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Strong analytical skills.
  
  
24×7 availability as per support guidelines.
  
  
**The skills you bring :**
Relevant experience of 2-8 years .
  
  
Deep knowledge of Linux (SUSE/SLES, Red Hat/RHEL or Ubuntu) including extensive hands-on administration and troubleshooting (systemd, journald, networking, storage, performance).
  
  
Virtualization technologies (KVM/QEMU, libvirt).
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash/Shell).
  
  
OpenStack knowledge and hands-on experience, OpenStack distribution (core services: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Heat).
  
  
Understanding of NFV/NFVI architecture and ETSI MANO concepts; VNF/CNF onboarding and VIM integration (e.g. with orchestrators such as EVNFM).
  
  
High-availability clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing and virtual IP management (HAProxy, keepalived/VRRP).
  
  
Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting (control plane, kubelet, scheduling, RBAC, workloads) with hands-on operational experience.
  
  
Container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and image/registry handling.
  
  
Cluster lifecycle management on bare metal using Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3, and cluster lifecycle tooling (e.g. ccdadm).
  
  
etcd operation, backup/restore and recovery fundamentals.
  
  
Kubernetes networking (Calico/CNI, Multus, kube-proxy) and policy enforcement (e.g. Kyverno).
  
  
Solid IP networking fundamentals (L2/L3, routing, VLANs, static routes, MTU, TLS/PKI troubleshooting).
  
  
Virtual machine and container internetworking concepts.
  
  
Open vSwitch (OVS) and OVS-DPDK.
  
  
SR-IOV functionality and DPDK-based high-performance networking.
  
  
Host network configuration tooling (NetworkManager/nmstate).
  
  
CEE: software-defined and cloud storage – OpenStack Cinder, Ceph, Nexenta, Dell Powerflex.
  
  
ECCD: Ceph and NetApp (CNIS deployments); ScaleIO/PowerFlex and Nexenta (NFVI-based deployments).
  
  
General block/object/file storage concepts.
  
  
Configuration management and automation (Ansible).
  
  
Orchestration templating (Heat/TOSCA).
  
  
Monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana; log aggregation such as Fluentd/Fluent Bit).

**Experience: 6–9 years**

We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.

* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 6+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.

* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

title: Junior Communications Manager
description:
**PLEASE NOTE:**
We are only considering candidates who are currently based in
**New Delhi or Mumbai, India**
.

**✈️ About Smart Freight Centre**

Think about the package that just arrived at your doorstep, the products on store shelves, or goods being shipped across oceans. Logistics powers the global economy and drives a significant share of global emissions. That’s where Smart Freight Centre (SFC) comes in. SFC works with businesses, governments, and global freight leaders to accelerate the transition to zero-emission logistics by 2050 or sooner. Our member network represents €15+ trillion in market capitalization and more than 10 million employees, making SFC one of the most influential platforms shaping the future of freight and transport.

We don’t just advocate sustainability. We standardize it, measure it, and scale it.

And in India – one of the world’s fastest-growing freight markets the opportunity is transformational.

**⏰ Employment Type:**
Fixed-term

**⚓ Location:**
New Delhi, India

**⌛ Starting date:**
ASAP

**⌛ Contract duration:**
The position is initially offered on a one-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension or transition to a permanent contract following review and mutual agreement between both parties.

**✈️ About SFC India**

SFC India is building a platform to support the decarbonization of India’s freight ecosystem across road, rail, maritime and aviation. We convene government ministries, regulators, industry leaders, research institutions, and global climate actors to accelerate the transition toward greener freight systems. Our ambition is to build a credible and scalable Green Freight platform for India, delivering impact at national scale.

**⭐ Why This Role is Unique**

You will work at the intersection of communications, climate action and the freight sector, helping translate SFC India’s work into clear and engaging stories for different audiences. The role offers exposure to both India and global communications, with opportunities to work across content, digital communications, design and campaigns.

**✏️ About the Position**

As Junior Communications Manager, you will work with the Communications Manager, India, to deliver SFC India’s communications across content, digital platforms, visual communications and campaigns.

You will develop content, create visual assets, coordinate digital publishing, and deliver communications for events and key initiatives. You will also work with internal teams and the global communications team to gather information and coordinate communications activities.

The role offers the opportunity to take ownership of assigned projects while developing experience across corporate communications in the climate and sustainability space.

**⭐ What You Will Drive**

* Support theIndia Communications team in implementing SFC India’s communications strategy, campaigns and communications calendar
* Coordinate with internal teams to gather information and develop clear, engaging communication materials
* Develop communications materials including LinkedIn posts, newsletters, website content, announcements, presentations, one-pagers, blogs, casestudiesand other content
* Manage SFC India’s LinkedIn channel, including content planning, scheduling,publishingand basic performance monitoring.
* Manage regular updates and content for the SFC India website, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure information isaccurate,timelyand up to date.
* Create simple,professionaland on-brand communication materials using Canva, photoshopor similar design tools, including social media creatives,videos,presentations, event banners, one-pagersand infographics
* Ensure communications materials are aligned with SFC’s brand guidelines, messaging and tone of voice.
* Coordinate communications for events, webinars,workshopsand stakeholder engagements, including invitations, eventmaterialsand post-event amplification.
* Research relevant industry news, trends and conversations across freight,logistics, transport,climateand sustainability toidentifycontent and communications opportunities
* Maintain communications trackers,social mediacalendars,and campaign documentation
* Coordinate with the SFC global communications team and internal stakeholders to align messaging and deliver communications outputs on time.

**⭐ We are looking for someone who has:**

Experience & Background

We welcome candidates with 2-3 years of experience in communications, corporate communications, content, digital communications, marketing communications or a related field

**Education**

Degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, Media Studies or a related discipline

**⭐ Skills and Capabilities**

* Strong writing, editing and story telling skills
* Good understanding of corporate communications, digital communications and social media
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn and content creation
* Basic to intermediate design skills using Canva, Adobe or similar tools
* Strong organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Ability to simplify technical,policyor sustainability-related information
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach
* Experience in climate, sustainability,logistics,transportor infrastructure is an added advantage

**Who You Are**

You are a hands-on communicator who combines strong writing and content skills with an eye for design and a willingness to take ownership of projects.

**You:**

* Are an excellent writer, and storyteller
* Have a good eye for design and visual communication
* Can manage multiple communications outputs across content, digital, internalcommunicationsand events
* Are organized, proactive and detail-oriented
* Can work independently while taking direction from the India Communications Manager
* Work well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and geographies
* Are motivated by contributing to climate and sustainability impact

**What You’ll Gain**

* Hands-on experience producing communications for one of the world’s most active freight decarbonization platforms
* Practical, portfolio-building skills across content strategy, design and digital channel management
* Exposure to how a mission-driven organization communicates across government, industry and global stakeholders
* A strong foundation for a career in sustainability, climate or corporate communications

**Career Development Opportunities**

This role offers a strong foundation for building a career in sustainability and corporate communications.
**You will have the opportunity to:**

* Deepen your expertise in digital communications, content strategy and brand storytelling
* Gain exposure to communications across climate, policy and industry engagement.
* Progress from content execution toward campaign planning and stakeholder communications
* Build experience that can support progression into broader communications roles.

**Organizational Culture & Work Environment**

At SFC, we combine global impact with entrepreneurial execution. We value:

* Cross-sector collaboration
* Systems thinking and curiosity
* Practical solutions to complex challenges
* Diverse and global perspectives

**Why This Role Matters**

You will be working on one of the most important sustainability transitions globally, the decarbonization of freight.

Through SFC India’s work, you will contribute to communications that help bring greater visibility to solutions, partnerships and initiatives supporting the transition to greener freight.

**Why us?**

❤️Join a culture of collaboration, innovation, and sustainability.

**What you will get:**

At Smart Freight Centre, we believe in collaboration, creativity, and sustainability. We value everyone’s ideas and create a welcoming space where you can grow and make an impact.

* Take time for yourself:Enjoy 27 days of holiday and 10 public holidays to relax, recharge, and do what matters most to you.
* Grow with us: We provide learning opportunities; you can keep building your skills and knowledge
* Care for your mind: Full access to OpenUp means you can connect with psychologists, join mindfulness classes, and explore courses to support your mental health.
* Good times guaranteed: Whether it’s a creative workshop, a fun challenge, or some drinks and bites, join our team-building activities and enjoy time with your colleagues.

title: Communications Associate - Content and Editing
description:
Communications Associate - Content and Editing, CPI India
  
  
New Delhi, Delhi
  
  
**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a communications associate who will primarily be responsible for supporting content development and editing across our India programs. You will possess the ability to translate economics, finance, and policy analysis into clear, concise, and accessible insights for investors and policymakers. You will align CPI content with the most recent trends in climate finance and policy, in ways that directly speak to our target audiences and ensures that CPI expertise provides actionable guidance to decision makers at the highest levels.
  
  
The ideal communications associate will have a strong interest in sustainable business, investment, finance, and economics, and dedication to CPI’s mission and impact.
  
  
You will report to the India Communications lead, and will closely collaborate with program teams in India, as well as the global communications team. You will also work with external stakeholders including partner NGOs and the media.
  
  
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**
Includes the following and other duties as assigned:
  
  

* Develop and carry out integrated, external communications plans that are aligned with directly influencing the intended audience and have measurable KPIs
* Guide content development from concept to publication—including storyboards, key messaging, structure, and editing—of CPI research products, presentations, op-eds, social media campaigns, and other written content.
* Ensure adherence to CPI’s in-house style guide, brand, and citation standards.
* Maintain and evolve a repository of talking points that summarizes CPI India’s body of work and addresses current issues in climate finance and policy.
* Support internal communications that builds cohesion and reinforces CPI’s positive and inspiring culture.
* Help with content taxonomy, keywords, and tagging to ensure web content is optimized for search indexing and discovery.
* Occasionally lead or help with media relations, including identifying outlets and placing stories in top-tier business, financial, and energy sector media.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Post Graduate degree in Mass Communications/ Public Relations/ Marketing, and demonstrable (minimum of 4 years) post-qualification experience in the field, or a Graduate degree with minimum 6 years of experience
* Experience with handling content development, written content editing, media outreach and public relations. Financial and business press experience will be beneficial.
* Experience with content editing, copywriting, and ensuring consistency with brand and style guidelines.
* Experience with social media and online content campaign development, execution, and analysis, as well as experience with relevant tools, including Wordpress, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Mailchimp, Hootsuite, or equivalents.
* Editorial calendar and project management, handling input from a variety of internal stakeholders, ensuring all deliverables are executed on time and internal stakeholders are kept up to date on task status.

Competencies & Personal Attributes
  
  

* Ability to turn economic and finance analysis into engaging and accessible insights for investors, policymakers, and other stakeholders.
* Impeccable English writing and editing skills, including a proven ability to turn technical content drafted by researchers and analysts into compelling copy in a variety of formats, from long research reports to short policy briefs, blogs, social media campaigns, and op-eds.
* Expertise in message crafting, content restructuring, and copyediting (fluency in AP Style is not a requirement but will be highly beneficial).
* Proven record of excellent writing and editing demonstrated in a professional portfolio.
* Independent worker and strategic thinker, who learns quickly and can successfully navigate unchartered territory.
* Polished, diplomatic interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships in a cross-cultural, global working environment that inspires, motivates, and influences highly-discerning team members.
* Outstanding organizational, project management, and prioritization skills, capable of managing deliverables and influencing people across locations to overcome barriers, meet deadlines, and achieve project goals.
* Ability to work flexibly and with a solutions-oriented approach, under pressure, and on tight deadlines.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel are heavily used on a daily basis).

Location and Compensation
  
  
CPI is hiring for one permanent, full-time communications associate position based in Delhi/NCR.
  
  
CPI offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. Compensation will be dependent on experience.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
Visit this link to apply. With your application, attach two documents:
  
  

* CV no longer than 2 pages
* a compelling cover letter no longer than 1 page, setting out how you meet the requirements of the role and your motivations for wanting to work at CPI.

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and open until filled. Apply early.
  
  
Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.
  
  
CPI Commitment
  
  
CPI’s mission is to create economic opportunity while protecting our environment. This worldview—grounding opportunity in something more fundamental that we all share and must protect—permeates our organization, and forms the foundation of our approach to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).
  
  
CPI’s approach to DEI mirrors our mission: within a culture that values transparency and dialogue, we strive to improve equity within our organization as well as in the communities in which we work. Internally and externally, we seek to remove inequitable barriers regardless of their origin, whether it be class, race, religion, nationality, region, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation, or physical ability. We are proactive in identifying and removing biases in our processes, seeking fairness in hiring, working conditions, and professional development.
  
  
If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

Combine strategic leadership with hands‑on campaign management, creative development and structured testing. Partner with App, Product, Technology, Analytics, Brand, Creative and CRM teams to improve the journey from discovery and download through activation, first booking and repeat use.

Growth strategy and leadership

* Own the app acquisition strategy, budgets and forecasts across organic and paid sources; set targets for installs, first bookings, tickets, net revenue and contribution after marketing costs.
* Build a prioritized growth and testing roadmap with clear hypotheses, owners, milestones and success measures. Translate performance gaps into specific actions and investment decisions.
* Lead internal specialists, agencies and external partners; manage delivery, performance and team development.
* Present results and recommendations to leadership, distinguishing platform‑reported performance from evidence of incremental growth.

App store optimization and organic growth

* Own ASO strategy and execution across the Apple App Store and Google Play, improving discoverability, store conversion and organic downloads.
* Conduct keyword, competitor and customer research; optimize app names, subtitles, descriptions and keyword fields as appropriate for each store and market.
* Own briefs and testing for app icons, screenshots, preview videos and store messaging; coordinate production, localization and publishing with Creative and App teams.
* Monitor search visibility, keyword rankings, store visitors, conversion and organic installs by brand, platform and market; diagnose changes and prioritize improvements.
* Grow organic downloads through coordinated website‑to‑app journeys, SEO, email, CRM and brand initiatives. Work with channel owners on app promotion and deep links.
* Coordinate review and rating improvement initiatives with Product and Customer Service, and feed customer feedback into app experience priorities.

Success measures

Growth in qualified installs, first bookings, tickets and net revenue; improved store and booking conversion; stronger acquisition economics; and consistent delivery of ASO, creative and campaign tests.

Paid app acquisition and creative testing

Own Google App campaigns and Apple Ads. Meta campaigns remain with a separate Paid Social owner; coordinate on app growth objectives, creative insights and measurement.

* Own strategy and hands‑on execution of Google App campaigns and Apple Ads, including setup, campaign structure, budgets, bids, targeting and keyword optimization where applicable.
* Scale qualified downloads and first bookings using campaign and cohort performance; manage spend pacing and allocate investment across brands, platforms and markets.
* Develop creative briefs covering audiences, customer insights, value propositions, messaging, formats and asset requirements. Manage copy, image and video production and refreshes.
* Run structured tests across creative concepts, assets, campaign settings and relevant app store destinations; define success criteria, document results and scale effective approaches.
* Optimize acquisition economics using cost per install, install‑to‑booking conversion, cost per first booking, net revenue, return on ad spend and payback.
* Evaluate and test additional acquisition channels, including paid social beyond Meta, such as TikTok and Reddit, and programmatic mobile advertising. Prioritize tests by audience fit, first‑booking economics and payback.

Conversion and measurement

* Partner with App and Product teams to improve onboarding, registration and booking conversion; identify funnel friction and agree on prioritized tests and fixes.
* Work with Analytics and Technology to validate attribution, event tracking and deep links across iOS and Android. Reconcile reporting discrepancies and account for privacy‑related measurement limitations.
* Build reporting across organic and paid acquisition, activation, first bookings and repeat value. Use cohorts and appropriate incrementality tests to guide growth decisions.
* Coordinate with CRM on activation, repeat engagement and customer quality.

Qualifications

* 10+ years in app growth, mobile acquisition, performance marketing or related roles, with meaningful leadership and budget ownership.
* Demonstrated success growing organic downloads through ASO and improving app store conversion across iOS and Android.
* Hands‑on experience managing Google App campaigns and Apple Ads, with evidence of improving booking or purchase outcomes beyond install volume.
* Experience with keyword research, store optimization, localization and testing tools; additional paid social or programmatic app acquisition experience preferred.
* Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs, managing asset production and running structured creative tests.
* Strong analytical and commercial skills, including forecasting, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and acquisition economics; working knowledge of mobile measurement platforms, attribution, event tracking and deep linking.
* Ability to lead teams and agencies and deliver across Product, Technology, Creative and CRM. Online travel, marketplace or other transactional app experience preferred.

title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
**Senior Content Manager / Content Strategist**

**About Seleqt**

Seleqt by Wishlink is a creator-led fashion eCommerce platform. Seleqt brings your instagram fashion discovery into one place: trend curations handpicked and styled by creators, so people can shop with confidence. We're early, moving fast, and building the brand from the ground up.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager / Content Strategist to own Seleqt's content engine end to end - strategy, calendar, brand voice, and execution across social,paid, influencer, and product surfaces. You'll test and turn our positioning into content that builds reach, resonance, and demand.

You'll be the person with the eagle-eye view of every piece of brand content that goes out.

This is a hands-on senior role: you'll set the strategy AND make it happen, working closely with the brand manager, the community manager, merchandising, the paid-collab/influencer team, design, and performance marketing.

**What You'll Own**

* **Content strategy & calendar:**
  own the end-to-end content plan across brand, social, trend, and sales buckets phased, briefed, and shipped on time.
* **Brand voice & messaging:**
  define and guard how Seleqt sounds; run message-testing across channels to find what actually resonates with our consumer.
* **Execution across channels:**
  social (organic), influencer/creator content, product copy, and from brief to live.
* **Creator content direction:**
  brief and steer outsourced creator content with the paid-collab team; ensure it's on-brand, on-time, and usable for performance.
* **Cross-functional delivery:**
  work with design on assets, with performance on ad creative that converts, and with community on voice and engagement.
* **Performance content ownership:**
  track reach, resonance (saves/shares/engagement), and content-driven PDP visits; report and iterate weekly.
* **Content Metrics:**
  Monthly content analysis including both tof channel metrics ( primary ) and product level user journeys from those channesl / content.

**What You'll Be Measured On**

* **Standardising brand voice and content strategy**
* **Content planning & calendar adherence**
  – plan and ship volume on time.
* **Message resonance**
  – winning message × channel identified and scaled.
* **Creative quality**
  – first-pass approval rate, brand consistency, and creator-content usability in paid.
* **Content driving acquisition**
  - Content-driven website visits & engagement quality.
* **Content marketing x Creative SOPs**
  - work closely with creative to automate the content engine

**What We're Looking For**

* **4 - 5 years**
  in content, brand, or social - ideally in D2C, fashion, or ecommerce
* **A strategist with operator mindset**
  - you can build, present the channel wise content plan and take it to execution with relevant team
* **Strong grip on the Fashion & creator/influencer ecosystem**
  and how creator content drives both brand and performance.
* **Fluency in the language our audience actually speaks**
  - Gen-Z / Hinglish, authentic not manufactured; sharp instinct for fashion & trends.
* **Data-comfortable**
  – you read reach, engagement, and funnel metrics and let them shape content.
* **Ownership mindset**
  – you run things end to end, hit deadlines, and raise the bar on quality without hand-holding.
* **Bonus:**
  you have scaled content strategy grounds up

**Why Join**

* **Build a fashion marketplace from the ground up**
  - your content shapes how India discovers and shops fashion trends.
* **High ownership, high velocity**
  - a lean, senior-heavy team where your work ships and matters.
* **Work at the intersection of creators, fashion, and commerce**
  - the most exciting space in Indian consumer right now.

*To apply: share your portfolio and a few pieces of content you're proud of - especially anything you took from idea to live.*

description:

Creative Data Strategist (Associate Managing Consultant(-2

Serving as a partner to regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide, this role translates complex information into actionable opportunities, shapes strategic recommendations, and enhances the impact and effectiveness of creative work.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strategic thinking and storytelling, transforming complex data into clear narratives that inspire action and strengthen strategic and creative decision-making.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Creative Data Strategist, you will support regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide through data-driven analysis, audience intelligence, and market insights across a broad range of client engagements.

Proficiency in data visualization and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.

* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and consulting skills.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

title: Director, UX Design
description:
**About This Role**
As Director of UX, you will lead and develop a team of UX professionals while remaining actively engaged in the work. This is a player-coach role that combines people leadership, UX strategy, hands-on design contribution, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
You will help shape UX strategy and execution across Gartner’s products and digital platforms, working directly with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, and business stakeholders to solve complex customer problems. You will contribute to discovery, research, journey mapping, ideation, prototyping, design reviews, and validation while setting a high standard for the team’s work.
  
  
You will also help advance Gartner’s AI capabilities by building an AI-focused UX culture, encouraging responsible experimentation, creating AI prototypes, and training the team to use emerging AI tools and methods effectively. Success in this role requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic leadership, hands-on design work, coaching, and delivery.
  
  
**What You will do:**

* Define and execute the UX strategy across Gartner’s products, digital platforms, and key initiatives, from discovery through delivery and optimization.
* Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of UX professionals supporting multiple products and customer experiences.
* Serve as a player-coach, providing hands-on leadership across research, discovery, ideation, prototyping, design, testing, and design reviews.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, Marketing, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs into clear, useful, and feasible experiences.
* Set expectations for UX quality, process, accessibility, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making.
* Advance an AI-focused, human-centered UX culture by guiding AI-enabled experiences, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, and design experiments.
* Promote responsible AI design principles, including transparency, trust, accessibility, privacy, human oversight, and inclusion.
* Build team capability and foster continuous learning through coaching, mentorship, design critiques, training, Design Thinking, user research, and experimentation.

**What you’ll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in UX, product design, interaction design, design research, information architecture, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience managing and developing UX or Product Design professionals, ideally in a player-coach leadership role.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX leadership and delivery, including discovery, research, interaction design, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
* Experience defining UX strategy and leading execution across multiple products or initiatives, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, business objectives, and strategic priorities.
* Experience using AI tools or AI-enabled workflows for UX research, ideation, prototyping, experimentation, or product development.
* Experience designing accessible and inclusive experiences and leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong communication, storytelling, collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills, along with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning, teaching, and applying emerging technologies responsibly.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
