title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship
description:
**Title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship**

**Type: Paid**

**No of Interns: 8**

**Location: Delhi**

**Internship Duration- 11 weeks**

**Work Mode: Hybrid,**

Breakthrough’s work on gender justice extends beyond programme implementation to shaping narratives, influencing institutions, and building long-term alliances across sectors.

Many individuals who will influence institutions in the future; across universities, corporates, consulting firms, media organisations, and public policy spaces; are currently students or early professionals. Engaging with them early in their careers provides an opportunity to deepen their understanding of gender justice and build relationships that extend beyond the organisation itself.

Breakthrough currently engages young people through internships and volunteer programmes. While valuable, these engagements are often informal and task-oriented. A structured internship programme provides an opportunity to create a more intentional platform for talent engagement, learning, and strategic contribution. The proposed internship is therefore designed not primarily as a recruitment pipeline, but as a way to build an extended network of individuals who remain connected to Breakthrough and act as champions of its mission across institutions and sectors.

The internship is designed around
**defined project assignments**
that interns work on during the core phase of the programme. These projects will be drawn from areas that are strategically useful to Breakthrough but may not always receive dedicated internal capacity.The aim is to ensure that interns contribute meaningfully to the organisation while also gaining exposure to different aspects of social change work.

These projects can broadly fall across the following seven categories/ departments:

**1. Corporate and Institutional Engagement(Dept. - Resource Mobilisation)**

Interns can support Breakthrough’s engagement with corporates, philanthropic actors, and institutions by conducting strategic analysis and developing engagement materials.

Illustrative projects may include:

* **Corporate engagement strategy development**
* Mapping companies aligned with Breakthrough’s mission and identifying collaboration opportunities.
* **CSR landscape analysis**
* Analysing corporate CSR priorities related to gender justice, youth engagement, or social norms change.
* **Corporate partnership pitch documents**
* Developing pitch decks and partnership proposals for engaging potential corporate partners.
* **Employee engagement models**
* Designing frameworks for corporate employee engagement initiatives, including volunteering, pro-bono work, or digital campaigns.
* **Institutional partnership mapping**
* Identifying potential collaborations with universities, foundations, think tanks, and networks.

These projects help expand Breakthrough’s ecosystem of institutional partners.

**2. Narrative, Media, and Campaign Strategy (Dept.-Media & Communications)**

Narrative change is a central pillar of Breakthrough’s work. Interns with storytelling, communication, or creative backgrounds can contribute to this area.

Illustrative projects include:

* **Narrative analysis & research**

Analysing how gender-related issues are represented across digital media and public discourse, alongside conducting research-driven tasks to develop first drafts of documents on assigned gender topics.

* **Campaign strategy & media engagement**

Supporting the development of campaign narratives and audience strategies, while mapping and engaging with journalists, media platforms, and digital communities aligned with gender justice conversations.

* **Content creation & storytelling**

Conceptualising and producing content—particularly short-form social media content—through ideation, planning, and execution of shoots (in-office or field-based), in-app editing, and platform management. This also includes exploring diverse storytelling formats such as multimedia narratives, podcasts, and short-form videos.

* **Design support**

Assisting with design tasks as assigned by the graphic design team, in accordance with provided technical requirements.

These projects help strengthen Breakthrough’s influence in shaping public narratives.

**3. Research and Evaluation Support (Dept.-Research & Evaluation)**

Some interns may contribute to research and evaluation initiatives, supporting different stages of the research lifecycle.

Possible projects include:

* **Literature Review**

Undertaking literature review for select research or evaluation studies, entailing deep-diving into secondary sources, contributing towards developing conceptual frameworks and approaches, and mapping socio-demographic and psychographic contexts for key population groups and sub-groups of interest

* **Data Collection and Analysis**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams in planning and executing the data collection process, and undertaking quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis

* **Dissemination of Findings**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams disseminating the findings of select studies. This would include drafting high-level summaries for key stakeholders and assisting in the design of communication materials articulating key findings for a diverse set of audiences.

These outputs help strengthen research quality, enable knowledge sharing, and support the effective design and replication of studies and evaluation processes across programmes.

**4. Tools, Frameworks, and Methodology Development (Dept.- Deep Transformation & Community Engagement)**

Some interns may focus on developing tools or frameworks.

Illustrative work may include:

* **Programme methodology documentation**
* Documenting frameworks used in Breakthrough programmes.
* **Reporting & decks**

Preparing reports, presentations, and strategic decks for internal and external stakeholders.

* **Toolkit development**
* Creating toolkits that can be used by partners, educators, or community organisations.
* **Programme case studies**
* Documenting impactful initiatives and lessons learned.
* **Workshop or training modules**
* Designing structured modules for youth engagement or awareness building.

These outputs help codify organisational knowledge and improve programme replication.

**5. Thought Leadership and Knowledge Products(Dept.-Positioning)**

Breakthrough produces valuable insights/positioning papers which showcases BT evidence as well as contributes to the sectoral work. Interns can support the initial phase of development of structured knowledge products.

Examples include:

* **Research briefs/Scoping Papers**
* Producing short analytical papers on emerging gender issues.
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Global comparisons**
* Analysing how gender justice campaigns operate in different countries.

These outputs help strengthen Breakthrough’s voice as a thought leader in the field.

**6. Organisational Strategy and Consulting Assignment (Dept.-Thematic)**

Some interns may work on projects that resemble short consulting assignments, supporting strategic planning and organisational decision-making.

Possible projects include:

* **Strategic landscape analysis**
* Identifying and mapping relevant policies, reforms, and programs, while building a database of organizations and government stakeholders in gender-transformative education, and identifying collaboration opportunities across aligned initiatives.
* **Programme expansion strategy**
* Analysing opportunities for expanding Breakthrough’s work into new areas or geographies.
* **Stakeholder mapping**
* Identifying networks, institutions, and influencers relevant to Breakthrough’s mission.
* **Strategic briefing documents**
* Preparing background notes and analyses to support leadership discussions, along with strategy updates informed by global trends and relevant international practices.

These assignments can provide valuable strategic inputs to the organisation.

**7. Gender Transformative Education System (Dept.-Strategic Partnerships and Scale Up)**

* **Develop a virtual platform for Learning**
* Documenting lessons learnt and creating a virtual platform for stakeholders to engage, discuss and take learnings
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Drafting pitch documents / power point presentation**

Developing pitch deck (brief visual proposition of an idea/s)

* **Developing a compendium of short stories of change**

Professionally documenting short impactful “stories of change” within teachers, Govt. officials, SMC members, parents etc to develop a compendium/ book

* **Developing concept note bank**

Identify and draft different ideas from within the program which has the potential for expansion and develop concept notes (4-6)

These projects can strengthen the organisation’s ability to use data for learning and decision-making.

***Skills, Competencies & Experience Required:***

* Final Year Graduate and Post Graduate students can apply

The Analyst is responsible for independently configuring, maintaining, and optimizing system setups to support business operations and client requirements. The Analyst serves as a subject matter expert within the setup and configuration function, ensuring the accurate, timely, and high-quality delivery of configuration services while continuously identifying opportunities to improve processes, quality, and operational efficiency.

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into accurate and efficient system configurations.

* Effective issue resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Positive stakeholder, client, and customer satisfaction outcomes.

Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation[NN1] [DS2] , education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter.

**Authorization to work in the Employing Country**

title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Role:**
Platform Engineer

**Function:**
Infrastructure / DevOps / Platform Engineering

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, active since 2006. The company reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu and Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.

With a team of 740, the company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcasting and digital innovation.

**Position Overview**

The company is building a media super-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro-drama, news, and commerce on a single platform. This foundational individual-contributor role owns infrastructure and DevOps end-to-end — from cloud and Kubernetes to CI/CD, observability, and security. The Platform Engineer sets the operational standards every engineering team builds and ships on, directly shaping the reliability and velocity of the entire platform.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own GCP infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, Terraform-managed environments, CDN, storage, IAM, secrets management, and networking end-to-end
* Design and maintain a scalable, secure cloud infrastructure foundation supporting all content and commerce verticals of the super-app
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable engineering teams to ship quickly and reliably at scale
* Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability practices across services to ensure platform reliability and fast incident response
* Enforce infrastructure-as-code standards using Terraform to keep environments consistent and reproducible across all stages
* Partner with Backend and Frontend Architects to ensure infrastructure aligns with and supports evolving application architecture
* Drive infrastructure cost optimization and scalability planning as the platform scales beyond its initial launch phase

**Must Have Criteria**

* 5–8 years of hands-on infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering experience
* Deep expertise with GCP (or equivalent major cloud provider), Kubernetes, and Terraform in production environments
* Proven track record building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines at scale
* Strong working knowledge of monitoring, observability, and incident response practices in cloud-native systems
* Hands-on experience with IAM, secrets management, and networking security in a cloud-native environment
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a high-impact individual contributor — leading through technical authority rather than headcount

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a media, content, or commerce super-app environment — particularly with CDN and content delivery at scale
* Prior 0→1 infrastructure experience at a high-growth startup
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect certification or equivalent cloud certification
* Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure cost optimization at scale

**What We Offer**

* Foundational ownership of infrastructure for a platform reaching 40M+ listeners — high visibility, high impact
* Direct collaboration with senior architects in a greenfield super-app build
* Full-time, individual-contributor role with the autonomy to set infrastructure standards organisation-wide
* Opportunity to shape the technical foundation of one of India's most recognised broadcast and digital media brands

title: Structure Draughtsman
description:
**Company Description**
Consulting Infra Engineers (CIE), founded in 2022, is a team of experienced engineering professionals focused on delivering innovative, efficient, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions with a strong emphasis on quality and timely delivery. The firm specializes in structural design for a wide range of civil engineering projects, including bridges, flyovers, underpasses, cross drainage structures, and various temporary and protection works. CIE provides detailed design services for reinforced concrete and prestressed concrete structures, as well as complex steel structures such as composite plate girders and specialized truss systems. The team leverages leading design software, including Sofistik, MIDAS Civil, STAAD, and Adsec Oasys, to ensure designs meet current industry standards. In addition to design, CIE offers proof-checking and technical support during construction, with a core focus on value engineering and sustainable, future-ready infrastructure development.

**Role Description**
The Structure Draughtsman will be responsible for preparing accurate structural drawings and detailed plans for bridges, flyovers, underpasses, and other civil engineering structures, based on inputs from design engineers. Day-to-day tasks include creating and revising general arrangement drawings, reinforcement details, bar bending schedules, and fabrication drawings, while ensuring compliance with relevant codes, standards, and project specifications. The role involves coordinating with engineers, reviewing design inputs, maintaining drawing records and documentation, and assisting in resolving drawing-related queries during design and construction phases. The Structure Draughtsman will also support value engineering efforts by clearly representing optimized design solutions and ensuring clarity and buildability in all drawings. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India.

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in structural drafting using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD) and ability to produce clear, detailed drawings.
* Solid understanding of civil and structural engineering fundamentals, including reinforced concrete and steel detailing, bar bending schedules, and standard detailing practices.
* Ability to interpret design calculations, technical specifications, and engineering sketches, and convert them into accurate, construction-ready drawings.
* Experience working with bridge and infrastructure projects, including familiarity with foundations, substructures, superstructures, and various structural systems.
* Knowledge of relevant national codes and standards commonly used for bridge and structural design and detailing.
* Careful attention to detail, strong quality focus, and ability to perform self-checks to minimize errors and rework.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with design engineers and project teams in an on-site environment.
* Diploma or certification in Civil Engineering, Structural Drafting, or a related discipline; prior experience as a structural or bridge draughtsman

title: Senior Strategy Consultant
description:
The Convergence Foundation has incubated a new project PRAGATI.

**About PRAGATI**

Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher-income economic activity.

PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:

* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.

PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands-on implementation. It identifies high-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.

PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro-processing, labour-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.

**Role Summary**

The Lead – Strategy & Institution Building will work closely with the CEO and play a central role in building PRAGATI as an institution. This is an opportunity to help shape an organisation from an early stage while working on some of the hardest questions in India's economic development.

The role spans strategy, execution, partnerships and organisational effectiveness. The individual will help determine where PRAGATI should focus, lead high-priority initiatives, build trusted external relationships and strengthen the systems and capabilities required for the organisation to scale.

The role offers unusual breadth—from strategy and policy to markets and businesses, and from senior government engagement to field execution. It requires someone who can move comfortably from understanding a complex economic problem to forming a point of view, aligning stakeholders and driving execution on the ground.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with the CEO to identify PRAGATI's highest-leverage opportunities, structure complex problems, develop clear hypotheses and make evidence-based choices on where the organisation should—and should not—invest its effort.
* Take selected priorities from research and design through stakeholder alignment, pilots and early execution. Convert ambiguity into clear actions, resolve bottlenecks and assess when an initiative should scale, adapt or stop.
* Develop trusted relationships with senior government officials, businesses, funders, experts and other ecosystem partners. Understand stakeholder incentives and build alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Build effective processes for planning, reviews, decision-making and accountability. Surface risks early, ensure decisions translate into action and help allocate people and resources towards the organisation's most important priorities.
* Work across PRAGATI's teams and partners, mentor colleagues, raise the quality of problem-solving and execution, and help create structures and ways of working that become stronger as the organisation scales.

**Qualifications and Skills**

We are looking for someone with approximately 8–10 years of high-quality professional experience, with evidence of increasing responsibility and ownership. The individual may come from consulting, strategy, investing, economic development, public policy, a high-growth operating environment or a similar problem-solving role. Prior experience in rural development or agriculture is useful but not essential.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

* Exceptional structured problem-solving and the ability to independently navigate complex, ambiguous situations.
* A track record of taking important initiatives from an unclear starting point to tangible outcomes.
* Strong economic and commercial judgment, with the ability to distinguish high-potential opportunities from activity unlikely to create meaningful impact.
* The ability to influence senior and diverse stakeholders and build alignment across organisational boundaries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complexity and make clear recommendations.
* Strong people judgment and an ability to make teams more effective through collaboration, coaching and candid feedback.
* High ownership, persistence and comfort taking responsibility beyond narrowly defined role boundaries.
* The judgment to balance ambition with practicality, move with urgency and change course when evidence suggests a different answer.
* A genuine commitment to improving economic opportunity through jobs, enterprise, productivity and functioning markets.
* An instinct to build for scale, considering economics, incentives, replicability and institutional sustainability from the outset.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer | CTC Upto 20-28LPA
description:
**Company Description**

Byteforge is a startup product development firm specializing in wearables, consumer electronics, and medical devices. The company works with clients to solve complex engineering challenges, developing innovative products from concept to mass production. Its founder has contributed to products including WHOOP 4, WHOOP MG, the Nuro self-driving car, and the Lumia earpiece. Byteforge offers engineers the opportunity to collaborate with world-class teams, work on cutting-edge technologies, and develop products that push the boundaries of design and engineering.

**Role Description**

The Senior Mechanical Engineer at Byteforge will lead the design and development of complex mechanical systems for wearables, consumer electronics, and medical devices. This is a client-facing role requiring 8–12 years of experience in mechanical engineering and product development. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing and validating mechanical hardware, developing detailed CAD models, building prototypes, and taking products from initial concept through manufacturing. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage technical requirements, and optimize designs for functionality, reliability, manufacturability, and performance. Additional responsibilities include supporting product testing, managing suppliers and contract manufacturers, implementing design improvements, and contributing to new product development initiatives. The role may involve up to 15% domestic and international travel.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree (B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, with 8–12 years of experience developing complex mechanical and integrated consumer products. M.Tech is a plus.

- Strong expertise in mechanical design, product engineering, and taking products from concept through prototyping, validation, and mass production.

- Proficiency in 3D/2D CAD software, GD&T, tolerance analysis, Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA). Experience with Onshape is an advantage.

- Hands-on experience with manufacturing processes including injection molding, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, ultrasonic welding, and overmolding.

- Experience with rapid prototyping techniques such as 3D printing (FDM, SLA, SLS, MJF), laser cutting, and related technologies.

- Strong understanding of materials including plastics, metals, adhesives, and glass, and their applications in mechanical product design.

- Knowledge of mechatronics, structural design, thermal engineering, precision mechanisms, or other relevant mechanical engineering disciplines.

- Experience working with overseas suppliers, contract manufacturers, and external vendors throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Familiarity with product testing, validation, reliability engineering, and new product introduction (NPI).

- Experience developing consumer electronics, wearables, or medical devices, particularly those integrating biomedical sensors such as ECG, PPG, or SpO₂, is an advantage.

- Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis (FEA), simulation, Design of Experiments (DOE), ingress protection, and high-volume manufacturing is desirable.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, project management, and client-facing skills, with the ability to independently lead complex engineering projects.

title: Senior Career Counsellor – Schools
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, student-focused Senior Career Counsellor to work with schools across India. You will guide students and parents on career pathways, stream and subject selection, higher education options, entrance exams and skill development. The ideal candidate is confident in school environments, communicates well and can build trusted relationships with students, parents, teachers and school leadership.

Location: Gurugram (on-site, with school visits and travel as required)

Employment type: Full-time

Salary: ₹60,000 – ₹80,000 per month, based on experience and profile

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct one-to-one and group career counselling sessions for students, mainly Classes 9–12

• Guide students on stream and subject selection, career pathways, higher education, entrance exams and skill-based options

• Conduct structured career assessments and explain the results in a clear, student-friendly way

• Run career awareness workshops, seminars, parent sessions and teacher engagement programmes in schools

• Develop personalised career roadmaps based on each student's interests, strengths, academic profile and aspirations

• Application platforms and profile building: UCAS (UK), Common App (USA), OUAC/OCAS/EPBC (Canada), Uni-Assist/APS (Germany), Studielink, UNEDasiss and NAWA, including profile building for Oxbridge, Russell Group, Ivy League, Go8 and U15

• Test and profile guidance: SAT, GRE, GMAT, UCAT, dMAT, IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, CUET, NEET, JEE, CLAT and LNAT, plus profile enrichment (research, internships, extracurriculars)

• Admission counselling: application processing, academic advising, scholarship counselling, visa counselling, essay/SOP, LOR and CV writing support

• Share information on Indian and international higher education pathways, where relevant

• Build and maintain strong relationships with school principals, counsellors, coordinators, teachers, students and parents

• Plan and manage school visits, counselling calendars, workshops and follow-ups

• Maintain accurate counselling records, student interactions, follow-ups and outcome reports

• Work with the business and academic team to improve counselling programmes, content and student engagement

• Stay updated on emerging careers, university programmes, entrance exams, scholarships and education trends in India

• Represent the organisation professionally at school meetings, education fairs, seminars and counselling events

Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Education, Counselling, Social Sciences, Human Resources or a related field

• 3–8 years of relevant experience in career counselling, school counselling or education counselling, including with a third-party vendor

• Experience working directly with schools, students, parents and educators is strongly preferred

• Excellent verbal and written English; Hindi or a regional language is an advantage

• Strong presentation and public-speaking skills, with confidence addressing groups of students and parents

• Empathetic, approachable and patient, able to build trust with teenagers and their parents

• Strong knowledge of the Indian education system, undergraduate pathways, entrance exams and career options, with an understanding of international admissions

• Comfortable travelling for school visits and education events

• Good organisational skills, follow-up discipline and proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace

What We Offer

• Competitive monthly compensation of ₹60,000 – ₹80,000, based on experience, qualifications and overall fit

• The chance to work directly with leading schools and diverse student communities across India

• Exposure to the fast-evolving career guidance and higher education ecosystem

• Professional growth in a growing education and career services organisation

• A role with real impact on students' academic and career decisions

How to Apply

Share your updated CV along with a short note on your school counselling and career guidance experience.

**Role Overview:**
Makes the robot walk, climb and recover on mud, rock, snow and stairs — designing and training the gait controller in simulation and transferring it to the real robot.

**Experience:**
3–8 years,

**Education:**
MTech/PhD with a thesis on legged locomotion. BTech/MTech/PhD in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics or Control Systems. Very few people in India have built legged robots, so a strong humanoid, exoskeleton or legged-research background also counts.

**Responsibilities**

* Build the simulation environment with randomised rough terrain.
* Develop gaits (walk, trot, stairs, crawl) using reinforcement learning, model predictive control (MPC), or both.
* Transfer controllers from simulation to the real robot (sim-to-real) and tune them in field tests.
* Write state estimation (body pose and velocity) from IMU and joint sensors.
* Specify actuator and leg requirements to choose the off-the-shelf supplier.

**Must have**

* C++ and Python.
* Rigid-body dynamics and control theory: MPC, whole-body control, or RL for locomotion (PPO).
* At least one physics simulator: Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, PyBullet, Gazebo or RaiSim.
* Has run a controller on real robot hardware, not only in simulation.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on with commercial quadrupeds (Unitree, ANYmal, Spot, Deep Robotics) or their SDKs.
* Open-source legged stacks: legged\_gym, OCS2, Pinocchio, Drake, Crocoddyl.
* Publications at ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS or Humanoids.
* Kalman filters / state estimation; terrain-aware foothold planning.
* PyTorch, GPU training, domain randomisation.

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Digital Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India's national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments, supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India's health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF's effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF's programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross-cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Background**
India's health system is in the middle of a decisive shift. Care delivery, disease programmes, financing, and supply chains are all moving onto digital rails, through national disease programme platforms, health management information systems, telemedicine services, and population-scale identity and records infrastructure. The question facing the sector is no longer whether to digitise, but whether digitisation actually changes what happens to a patient whether records follow people across facilities, whether frontline workers act on better information, and whether programme managers make different decisions because of what the data tells them.
  
  
The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is the clearest expression of this shift. Launched nationwide in September 2021 and managed by the National Health Authority (NHA), ABDM creates the interoperability required for health records to move seamlessly across platforms, anchored in the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) and supported by the Health Facility Registry (HFR), the Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR), and platforms such as the Unified Health Interface (UHI). WJCF has been a strategic and operational partner to the NHA on ABDM since 2021. Through the 100 Microsites Programme, WJCF delivered 30 Microsites across five states, supporting the registration of over 17,000 health facilities and over 18,500 healthcare professionals and the generation of more than 3 million ABHA-linked health records; it then led the Digital Health District Pilot in Bhopal. Both engagements have concluded, and the portfolio has since moved to the harder question of demonstrating value for programmatic outcomes, beginning with the national tuberculosis programme.
  
  
Artificial intelligence is the next frontier of this agenda, and arguably the one with the steepest trajectory. The Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India (SAHI) sets the national policy direction, and credible applications now span the structuring and validation of clinical records, clinical decision support at the point of care, screening and triage, programme targeting and prioritisation, and the analysis of claims and utilisation data at population scale. WJCF is supporting the NHA in establishing its Health Analytics and AI Unit (HAAU), a dedicated advanced analytics and AI capability built to leverage data generated as a by-product of running AB PM-JAY and ABDM to improve these programmes and, in turn, health outcomes. All such work must be delivered with privacy-by-design and strong health data governance, consistent with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.
  
  
WJCF brings deep experience in digital health, built through its partnership with the NHA and its work with state governments and district administrations. With AI opening new possibilities and ABDM adoption accelerating, the team needs to expand and strengthen to meet what is ahead. WJCF is therefore looking for a senior leader who can shape that direction, deciding where the team focuses next and building the partnerships that support it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
WJCF is looking to hire a Senior Manager/ Associate Director to lead its Digital Health portfolio in India. The position reports into the Director (Digital Health, Health Financing and New Initiatives) and is based in New Delhi, with regular travel to project states and districts. The level at which the role is offered will be determined by the successful candidate's experience.
  
  
This is a shaping role first and a delivery role second. The selected individual will define the direction of WJCF's digital health work for the coming years, choosing which problems are worth solving as India's digital health and AI agenda evolves, building the team's credibility in new areas, and converting that positioning into a funded pipeline of work. Business development sits at the centre of the role identifying opportunities, authoring concept notes and proposals, and building the partnerships that make ambitious work possible.
  
  
Alongside this, the individual will serve as WJCF's principal interface with the NHA and state counterparts, oversee the current portfolio of work including the programmatic outcomes agenda and support to the Health Analytics and AI Unit, and manage a multi-disciplinary team spread across national, state, and district locations. This role provides an excellent opportunity for a senior professional who would like to shape how digital health and artificial intelligence translate into better health outcomes in India.
  
  

* Strategy and positioning
* Set the strategic direction for WJCF's Digital Health portfolio, defining where the team should focus over the coming years and making deliberate choices about which problems are worth solving as the national digital health and AI agenda evolves.
* Build WJCF's position in emerging areas, particularly artificial intelligence in healthcare, translating the policy direction set by SAHI and the capabilities now reaching maturity into a concrete agenda of work that WJCF is credible to deliver.
* Design new programme concepts from first principles, grounded in a clear reading of where government priorities, donor appetite, and WJCF's comparative advantage intersect.
* Shape the team's institutional capability, defining the skills and roles the portfolio will need as its focus shifts, and leading recruitment and team design accordingly.
* Represent WJCF externally with government, donors, technology partners, academia, and the wider digital health ecosystem, positioning the organisation as a partner of choice on digital health and AI.
* Business development and partnerships
* Own growth for the portfolio map the donor landscape, identify and cultivate funding opportunities, and build and maintain a live pipeline against which the team plans.
* Lead the development of concept notes, expressions of interest, and full funding proposals, taking personal authorship of the strategic narrative and the case for WJCF.
* Build and manage relationships with existing and prospective donors, and structure partnerships with government, technology, academic, and implementation partners where these strengthen a proposition.
* Manage donor reporting, ensuring commitments are met and that reporting is accurate, timely, and well evidenced.
* Portfolio delivery and team leadership
* Serve as WJCF's senior interface with the National Health Authority, sustaining the relationship as a trusted advisory partnership and supporting the NHA in developing frameworks, roadmaps, and policy tools across priority areas.
* Oversee the portfolio's programmatic outcomes agenda, beginning with the national tuberculosis programme, including the design of ABDM-enabled workflows, state-level implementation across multiple geographies, and the measurement approach that links digital interventions to outcomes such as treatment adherence, referral completion, and continuity of care.
* Convert field evidence into national-level influence, producing analyses, assessments, and policy briefs that shape national design and sequencing, and extending the approach to further programme areas over time.
* Build and sustain relationships with State ABDM Offices, State National Health Mission leadership, district administrations, and programme officers, securing the institutional backing that drives sustained results.
* Support the establishment and scale-up of the Health Analytics and AI Unit at the NHA, including unit design, role definition, recruitment, onboarding, and integration of embedded team members, and support state-level replication of the model.
* Ensure that privacy-by-design and strong health data governance are embedded across the portfolio, consistent with the DPDP Act 2023.
* Manage, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary team of programme managers, analysts, programme officers, and field staff working across national, state, and district locations.
* Own portfolio-level work planning, budgeting, and performance management, and ensure delivery against agreed milestones.
* Perform other responsibilities as requested by WJCF leadership.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, public policy, management, engineering, economics, or a closely related field.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with exposure to digital health, health systems strengthening, or technology-enabled public programmes in India.
* A strong record in business development, including authorship of concept notes, expressions of interest, and funding proposals, and direct engagement with donors; experience building a pipeline rather than responding to individual opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to set direction for a team or portfolio, including defining new areas of work and building credibility in them from a standing start.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, multi-state or multi-site programmes end to end, with ownership of work plans, budgets, and delivery against milestones.
* Experience managing and developing teams, including field-based staff across multiple locations.
* Experience working directly with government counterparts at national and state level, and a track record of building credibility with senior officials.
* Working knowledge of digital health in India, including ABDM and its building blocks, and of how national disease programme and state health information systems operate.
* Demonstrated knowledge of, and active interest in, the application of artificial intelligence in healthcare, sufficient to identify credible use cases, engage technical teams on equal terms, and distinguish genuine utility from hype.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience working with the National Health Authority, State ABDM Offices, or National Health Mission structures.
* An existing network among health and development donors active in India.
* Familiarity with national disease programmes and their digital systems, particularly the national tuberculosis programme and Ni-kshay.
* Experience designing or delivering measurement and evidence-generation work that links digital interventions to health outcomes.
* Experience establishing new teams, units, or capabilities within or alongside government institutions.
* Familiarity with health data governance, the DPDP Act 2023, and SAHI.
* Experience in a management consulting or strategy advisory environment.
* Experience of private sector engagement in healthcare delivery.

**Skills & Traits**

* Entrepreneurial instinct the ability to spot an opportunity early, form a view on it, and build it into something fundable.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with senior government officials and donors, and to influence without formal authority.
* Excellent analytical (qualitative and quantitative) and communication (written and verbal) skills.
* Strong document and presentation craft, with the ability to produce decision-ready material and compelling proposal narratives for senior government and donor audiences.
* Ability to think strategically, handle ambiguity, and problem-solve in a fast-paced, limited-structure, multi-stakeholder environment.
* Ability to move fluidly between national policy discussions and district-level implementation detail.
* Genuine curiosity about artificial intelligence and emerging technology in health, and the judgement to assess where it adds real value.
* A focus on building institutional capability rather than creating personal dependence.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project states and districts.
* Impeccable integrity; humility and open-mindedness; a learning mentality; tenacity and resourcefulness.
* Fluency in English and Hindi.

**Last Date to Apply**
27th November, 2026

title: Endocrinologist- MD Doctor
description:
Who we are

Metaboliq from WTFGyms

* Cutting‑edge tech stack: workout tracking, nutrition planning, member analytics, and streaming workouts.
* 46+ AI gyms, 172+ certified trainers, and 40,000+ members nationwide.
* Affordable premium experiences with personalized coaching and measurable transformation results.
* Backed by visionary leadership and “Mission 2030” to scale fitness across India.

Endocrinologist / MD Physician — Clinical Network

Position: Endocrinologist / MD Physician (Consulting Physician)

Department: Clinical Network / Telemedicine

Hiring: 5–10 Doctors (Initial Cohort)

Engagement: Full- time/ Part-time / Consultation-based (Flexible scheduling)

Experience: 3+ years post-qualification preferred

Location: Delhi NCR (Remote / Digital Consultations)

About Metaboliq

Metaboliq delivers specialized, physician-led metabolic care and medical obesity management.

We provide doctors with diagnostic infrastructure, continuous monitoring platforms, and a

multidisciplinary support layer (dietitians, health coaches, care coordinators), allowing

physicians to deliver precise, high-touch metabolic care digitally.

Role Overview

We are looking for consulting Endocrinologists and MD Physicians with active practices in

metabolic health and obesity management to join our elite clinical care network. In this role, you

will conduct video teleconsultations for patients enrolled in Metaboliq’s metabolic and

weight-management programs.

You will retain complete, independent clinical discretion over diagnosis, patient evaluation,

laboratory interpretation, and medical prescriptions (including GLP-1 therapies where indicated),

supported by longitudinal lifestyle data and dedicated care teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Comprehensive Metabolic & Obesity Teleconsultations

● Conduct scheduled, structured video consultations with patients entering or progressing

through Metaboliq programs.

● Review detailed patient intake history, lifestyle context, comorbidities, concurrent

medications, and previous weight-loss attempts.

● Evaluate diagnostic blood panels (glycemic markers, insulin resistance, lipid profiles,

hepatic/renal function, hormonal screens) to identify root metabolic drivers.

2. Independent Clinical Treatment Decisions & Prescribing

● Determine patient eligibility for medical weight-loss pathways based on clinical

indications, BMI thresholds, metabolic comorbidities, and contraindications.

● Exercise full independent judgment when prescribing medical therapies—including

evidence-based anti-obesity medications (such as GLP-1 receptor agonists)—tailoring

initiation dosages, titration cadences, and supportive medications.

● Clearly explain treatment rationale, expected outcomes, and potential side effects

directly to the patient during consultation.

3. Longitudinal Monitoring & Clinical Reviews

● Conduct scheduled digital follow-up consultations to evaluate therapeutic response,

weight trajectories, glycemic control, and metabolic biomarker improvements.

● Monitor medication tolerability, proactively titrate dosages, and adjust or discontinue

treatment based on patient response and clinical criteria.

● Review continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) trends and body composition markers to

calibrate treatment plans.

4. Adverse Event Triage & Clinical Documentation

● Identify, manage, and document adverse reactions, tolerability challenges, or medical

red flags in accordance with established safety guidelines.

● Direct patient care escalations where physical intervention, in-person clinical

examinations, or emergency hospital evaluation is warranted.

● Maintain complete, accurate, and prompt electronic medical records (EMR) following

every consultation.

Key Requirements

Qualifications:

● Primary / Preferred: MBBS + MD (Internal Medicine) + DM / DNB in Endocrinology.

● Secondary / Considered: MBBS + MD (Internal Medicine) / Diabetology with

demonstrated, extensive clinical practice in obesity medicine and metabolic therapeutics.

● Valid, active medical license registered with the relevant State Medical Council or

National Medical Commission (NMC).

Clinical Experience & Skills:

● Minimum 3+ years of clinical experience post-MD/DM with active exposure to obesity

management, diabetes care, and metabolic syndrome.

● Direct hands-on experience initiating and monitoring modern GLP-1 receptor agonist

therapies and managing associated gastrointestinal or metabolic tolerability profiles.

● Comfort and proficiency in delivering high-quality, empathetic teleconsultations over

secure video platforms.

● Clear, reassuring bedside manner with the ability to communicate complex metabolic

concepts to patients simply and compassionately.

● Adherence to evidence-based medical guidelines and medical ethics.

We are looking for an experienced, results-driven SEO Executive to lead the execution of SEO initiatives, improve organic search visibility, increase qualified website traffic, and strengthen EaseToLearn's search engine performance. **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic rankings, website traffic, and search visibility.
* Conduct advanced keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and content gap assessments.
* Manage on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structures, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimisation.
* Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexing, canonicalisation, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, Core Web Vitals, and website architecture.
* Monitor organic search performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog.
* Develop and execute ethical off-page SEO and link-building strategies to improve domain authority and backlink quality.
* Collaborate with content writers to plan and optimise SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, category pages, and educational resources.
* Identify organic growth opportunities for high-intent keywords, competitive search terms, and relevant educational topics.
* Analyse changes in rankings, organic traffic, CTR, engagement, and conversions; recommend corrective actions based on data.
* Coordinate with developers to implement technical SEO recommendations and resolve website performance issues.
* Track search engine algorithm updates and implement appropriate improvements to maintain sustainable organic growth.
* Prepare regular SEO performance reports, maintain documentation, and communicate progress against agreed objectives.
* Support website migrations, new page launches, and large-scale content optimisation wherever required.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SEO and organic search optimisation.
* Strong practical knowledge of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and technical SEO.
* Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, backlink analysis, indexing, crawling, and website architecture.
* Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, structured data, schema markup, and basic HTML.
* Experience analysing organic traffic trends, ranking changes, CTR, and conversion performance.
* Ability to translate SEO data into actionable recommendations and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Experience in EdTech, education, e-commerce, or other content-driven websites will be preferred.

**Mandatory Application Requirement**

Candidates must submit an
**SEO portfolio or relevant work samples**

along with their application.

The portfolio should include, wherever available:

* Websites or pages for which the candidate has managed SEO.
* Examples of keyword research, content optimisation, and technical SEO audits.
* Case studies demonstrating organic traffic growth, keyword ranking improvements, indexing improvements, or increased conversions.
* Performance reports or screenshots showing results over a defined period.
* A clear description of the candidate's individual contribution to each project.

Candidates may share portfolio links, case studies, reports, or relevant screenshots. Confidential client information must not be disclosed.

Applications without relevant portfolio links or work samples may not be considered for shortlisting.

title: Head of Marketplaces
description:
**Head of Marketplaces**

Location: Delhi NCR | Work from office

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Reports to: Founder

Direct reports: Quick Commerce Operations Manager, Flipkart Account Manager

Compensation: Rs 9.6 to 18 LPA, fixed

**About TNT**

TNT (The Next Trend) is a manufacturer of home utility products: steel cloth-drying stands, step ladders, shoe racks and multi-tier organisers. We have manufactured in India for 15 years and sell 30+ SKUs through quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket), Amazon, Flipkart, modern trade (DMart) and a pan-India distributor network. We own our manufacturing, which gives this role direct control over cost, assortment and supply.

**About the role**

The Head of Marketplaces owns the online marketplace P&L across Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. You will personally manage the Amazon account on Vendor Central and lead the two managers who run quick commerce and Flipkart. This is a hands-on leadership position, not a supervisory one.

**Responsibilities**

**Amazon (personally managed)**

* Own the Vendor Central relationship: cost price and PO negotiations, terms, allowances and annual agreements.
* Maintain a complete, accurate catalogue, A+ content and advertising within agreed efficiency targets.
* Track the vendor scorecard, dispute chargebacks and recover approved but unpaid invoices.
* Deliver a written 1P versus 3P recommendation for the account within 90 days.

**Quick commerce and Flipkart (through the team)**

* Set the commercial plan for Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket and Flipkart: assortment, pricing, city-level priorities, fees, replenishment and advertising.
* Agree targets with both managers, review weekly and remove blockers.

**P&L and reporting**

* Own revenue and contribution margin by platform, after commission, storage and ageing fees, advertising, returns and freight.
* Maintain pricing discipline so that no platform undercuts another without approval.
* Submit a weekly one-page brief and a monthly P&L by platform, reconciled to actual payouts.

**Key performance indicators**

* Amazon revenue growth and contribution margin
* Catalogue health and PO fill rate
* Advertising efficiency (TACOS) by platform
* Accuracy and timeliness of the weekly brief and monthly P&L
* Delivery of the quick commerce and Flipkart targets agreed with the team

**Requirements**

* 5 to 8 years in marketplace or key account management on the brand side, with at least 2 years across more than one platform.
* Hands-on Amazon Vendor Central experience, including PO, cost price and chargeback processes. Mandatory.
* Ownership of a multi-platform P&L, not only a revenue or GMV target.
* Brand-side experience on at least one quick commerce platform.
* Experience managing a team.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; able to build your own trackers and reconciliations.
* Clear, concise written reporting.

**Preferred**

* Category experience in home, kitchen, hardware or furniture.
* Working knowledge of Flipkart Ads and quick commerce advertising tools.

**Compensation**

Rs 9.6 to 14 LPA fixed, with no variable component. Final offer based on experience and interview performance.

**To apply**

Apply through LinkedIn. Include one line on a marketplace account you have grown, with the number.

title: Consultant - Smart Cities
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are looking for a Smart Cities Consultant who can focus on details and see the big picture. You will be joining a team who is delivering digital transformation in cities, regions and developments, supporting Clients on major projects globally across multiple sectors. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team in a rapidly growing market, realize real change and contribute to revolutionary change on a city scale.
  
  
As a Smart Cities Consultant, you will be tasked with working across the Smart City project lifecycle, from the analysis of qualities of place, to the identification and design of smart services, to planning for and driving their implementation. A successful candidate will be able to evidence an excellent capability in applying advanced techniques such as user-centric design on real-life problems as well as presenting outputs in visual forms, infographics and/or dashboards. You will need to collaboratively engage with engineers, urban designers, city stakeholders and industry professionals to develop solutions and agree outputs
  
  
You will be responsible for building your personal brand and developing relationships internally and with clients to help us share knowledge and deliver best practice, you will also be called upon to help colleagues develop their digital awareness, sharing their own knowledge to help others.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Assess the qualities, needs, and opportunities of cities, regions, developments, and communities.
* Develop City/Infrastructure based digital strategies and identify services that can create value for stakeholders.
* Support the planning, design, and implementation of smart city services and digital infrastructure.
* Apply user centered design and advanced techniques to real world challenges.
* Present findings and recommendations through clear written outputs, visualisations, infographics, or dashboards.
* Collaborate with engineers, urban designers, planners, clients, city stakeholders, and industry professionals.
* Build client and internal relationships, share knowledge, and contribute to good practice and digital awareness.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Degree qualified
* Experience delivering strategies and projects for cities, regions, developments, and communities to help harness the potential of digital technologies.

description: Job Title: Research Associates (multiple positions), System 3Reports to: A Pre-Doctoral Fellow, with a System 3 Principal Investigator as overall mentorLocation: BengaluruExperience (in years): At least 1 year of paid, full-time work experienceNature of work: Full-time, fixed term of 12 months, with potential for renewalAbout Ashoka UniversityAshoka University is India’s premier interdisciplinary teaching and research university. An institution that has become a beacon of academic excellence in less than 10 years since its inception. At Ashoka, we encourage you to embrace the new, push the boundaries for continuous learning, and adapt to a world of constant change because we believe that each Ashokan is capable of becoming a thought leader.As part of our thriving and committed workforce, you will:Be Mission-Driven: Champion interdisciplinary learning, innovative pedagogy, and academic rigor to transform Indian higher education.Think Strategically: Collaborate with visionary minds to shape the future of higher education through strategic planning and a forward-thinking approach.Act Authentically: Embrace authenticity and integrity, fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where every voice is valued.Take Accountability: Own your work and drive positive change, as an empowering individual seeking to make a meaningful contribution.Build Collaboration: Experience the power of teamwork and diverse perspectives, working collectively towards our shared goals.Deliver Excellence: Strive for excellence in all aspects, upholding the highest standards of academic excellence, student support, and professional development opportunities.About the Centre for Social and Behaviour ChangeAt the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC), we bring together behavioural scientists, policy experts, and researchers to develop novel insights and catalyse action. We partner with governments, non-profits, and corporations to embed behavioural science in programme design, creating solutions that work in practice and at scale. Established by Ashoka University with Gates Foundation support, we make development more people-centric through real-world applications of behavioural science. In recent years, CSBC researchers have contributed 25 peer-reviewed articles to top journals, advancing the nation’s behavioural evidence base and catalysing collaborations with leading institutions such as the University of Chicago, Yale School of Management, the University of Michigan, the Collegio Carlo Alberto, and Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. For more information, please visit https://csbc.org.in/.About System 3System 3 is a new research lab under the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC). It will rest on two pillars.Basic science, from India: Most of what the world knows about how people think, trust and decide comes from a few narrow populations. India, with its range of languages, identities and institutions, is where those claims can be properly tested. We will run foundational, curiosity-driven research on cognition, judgement and behaviour, to learn which findings travel and which were only ever local. We take inspiration from the MIT Media Lab: open, accessible and joyful in the pursuit of credible science.AI and Behaviour: System 1 and System 2 describe the fast and slow thinking of the human mind, both shaped by the social and institutional worlds around us. System 3 will ask what happens to that mind in the age of AI. How do we learn, judge, trust and decide when intelligent machines are part of everyday life? What do we gain, and what do we quietly give away? This will be a major focus of our research agenda.The two pillars will reinforce each other. Understanding the human mind in all its diversity will let us study how AI changes it.We are a small team, early in our journey, based in Bengaluru. We are looking for people who like building something from scratch, who take ownership without waiting to be asked, and who are as comfortable rolling up their sleeves as thinking big. Role and ResponsibilitiesSystem 3 is hiring Research Associates to be the engine of the lab. The Associates will run studies, work with data and help bring the lab’s research to life, learning how rigorous behavioural science is done from the Pre-Doctoral Fellows they work with every day. The role suits someone who is curious about research and about how people think and decide, and who wants to learn by doing it in a small, ambitious team. Reporting to a Pre-Doctoral Fellow, the Associates will be part of the lab’s core team.What the Research Associates will do:1. Run studiesSet up experiment sessions, run them with participants and collect data carefully and accurately.Keep materials, schedules and records organised so that every study runs smoothly.2. Bring people into the labSupport the recruiting participants, scheduling sessions, and keeping participants coming back.Reach out to the wider public to invite them to take part in research.3. Work with dataClean, organise and analyse data under guidance, using AI tools where useful and checking what they produce.Document every step so that others can check the work and build on it.4. Support the scienceSearch for and summarise research papers.Help prepare study materials, figures and drafts for the Pre-Doc Fellows and Principal Investigators.5. Open the lab to the curiousHelp organise public lectures and discussions on behavioural and cognitive science.Welcome anyone who is curious, whether or not they have a science background.Qualifications and Skills RequiredQualificationsA bachelor’s degree in any discipline that shows quantitative ability or strong analytical reasoning, for example philosophy, a pure science, computer science, economics or engineering. Candidates without a quantitative background should be willing to learn basic statistics and programming, with support from the lab.At least 1 year of paid, full-time work experience in any field is required. Experience in research, AI or an applied behavioural science field is preferred.Technical SkillsRequiredData analysis in Python, R, Stata or Matlab, or the ability to pick it up quickly.Using agentic AI tools for research (coding, analysis, literature work), and protecting the team from hallucinations.DesirableAssociates work with different Principal Investigators and projects, so we do not expect any one person to have every skill below. Strong candidates will have the Required skills plus some of the Desirable skills for social sciences or cognitive sciences or AI.Any areaData collection through Qualtrics, SurveyCTO, oTree, z-Tree or similar.Familiarity with regression and basic statistics.Adapting tasks and measures across languages and populations (translation, back-translation).Economics and sociology projectsExperience with survey or field data, and regression analysis of it.Familiarity with running economic or social experiments.Psychology and cognitive science projectsProgramming behavioural experiments in PsychoPy, jsPsych or lab.js, including online studies (for example Pavlovia).Familiarity with cognitive tasks and measures (reaction time, accuracy, memory or attention tasks).Professional SkillsA structured, analytical thinker with a working understanding of causal reasoning, such as why correlation is not causation and why control groups matter.Curiosity about how people think and decide. Candidates who have not formally studied human behaviour should be very curious about it.Eagerness to learn, and openness to guidance and feedback from the Pre-Doc Fellows.Careful, organised and reliable, with attention to detail.Comfort with reaching out to people and encouraging them to take part in research, or a real willingness to learn how.A preference for flat teams, where a good idea counts for more than a title.Willingness to do whatever a research start-up needs, from running sessions to setting up a room for a public talk.Application Submission ProcessWe invite you to embark on this journey by submitting your application to the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change. To ensure your candidacy receives the attention it deserves, kindly follow the application submission process outlined below:Prepare Your Materials: Please put together the following.An updated CV: Showcase your professional accomplishments, skills, and experiences.A concise cover letter: In no more than one page, explain why you are applying and which of your skills you expect to rely on in your first month on the job.A professional referee: In your email mention the name and email address of a manager or colleague who can speak to your work (a professional, not an academic, reference). We will contact referees only after screening CVs, so please let them know we may be in touch.Submit Your Application: Email your materials to careersatcsbc@ashoka.edu.in, ensuring the subject line reads as follows: “RA_System 3_<Applicant Name>”. Make sure your surname is included in the titles of all attachments. This will help us efficiently process your application.Include Essential Details: Along with your materials, kindly provide the following information:Last compensation received: We value your expertise and acknowledge the importance of fair compensation.Expected salary: Share your aspirations for growth and remuneration.Notice period: Inform us of the time required to transition from your current role, if applicable.Pursuit of Excellence: At Ashoka University, we strive for excellence in all aspects of our operations. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted as part of our rigorous selection process.
