title: Growth Associate
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Growth Associate**
to help grow Atlys in the UAE.
  
  
You’ll research the market, figure out what’s working and what isn’t, and help shape and carry out our growth plans for the region. You’ll work closely with the Growth, Marketing and Product teams, and get hands-on with a wide range of problems from day one.
  
  
**The Job**

* Research the UAE market: study travellers, competitors and trends to understand how people in the UAE plan trips and apply for visas.
* Find out what works: track how our campaigns and channels are doing, and pull out clear insights on what to do more of and what to stop.
* Help shape the strategy: turn your research into ideas and plans for growing Atlys in the UAE, and present them to the team.
* Execute on the ground: help launch and run campaigns, partnerships and experiments, and keep things moving across teams.
* Report and follow up: keep simple, regular reports on UAE performance so the team always knows where we stand.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 1–2 years of experience at a high-growth startup, in growth, strategy, business or similar roles.
* Understand the UAE market, or are excited to get deep into it quickly.
* Are curious and research-minded, and enjoy digging into a market to understand what makes people tick.
* Are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets, and can turn data into clear takeaways.
* Are hands-on and reliable: you take ownership, follow through and get things done.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Managed Services Consultant - Sr
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot-to-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day-to-day support for post go-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Who You Are**

* Detail-oriented and hands-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer-facing, fast-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day-to-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: IAM Engineer
description:
Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you will design, build and operate identity services that secure access to Macquarie’s Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) platforms while supporting their reliability, security and continuous improvement. You will provide trusted advisory support on UAM governance, operating models, risk management and roadmaps, while contributing to assurance, audit and risk oversight activities. Working within an Agile team, you will collaborate with identity, platform and application teams across the full engineering lifecycle, from solution design and development through to production support.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 5+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), including User Access Management (UAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and access governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of access governance controls, including User Access Reviews (UAR), Access Profile Reviews (APR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Sound knowledge of end-to-end access lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, certification, and access control best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with technology, cyber security, risk, audit, and business teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and continuous improvement mindset, with experience working in Agile environments and leveraging automation and cloud-based technologies.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**

title: ICT Active Head
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – ICT ACTIVE HEAD
  
  
Company: Labotek Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
  
Department: IT / ICT / Infrastructure
  
Designation: ICT Active Head
  
Reporting To: Project Head / IT Head / Technical Head
  
Location: CCS
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
## 1. Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient ICT Active Head to lead and manage active IT infrastructure systems, including network switches, routers, servers, wireless networks, CCTV, Access Control Systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and related ICT infrastructure.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for technical planning, system configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, commissioning, team management, and project coordination. The role requires strong knowledge of networking, data centre infrastructure, system integration, and ICT operations, along with excellent reporting and documentation skills.
  
  
## 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
### A. ICT Active Infrastructure Management
  
- Lead the implementation, configuration, integration, and commissioning of active ICT infrastructure systems.
  
- Manage network switches, routers, servers, wireless access points, network controllers, and associated equipment.
  
- Oversee the installation, configuration, and integration of CCTV surveillance systems, Access Control Systems, and BMS interfaces, as applicable to project scope.
  
- Ensure proper connectivity and integration between active equipment and passive infrastructure, including racks, patch panels, Cat-6 cabling, and fibre-optic networks.
  
- Ensure systems operate efficiently and comply with approved technical specifications and project requirements.
  
  
### B. Network Planning & Configuration
  
- Plan and manage network architecture, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, and network segmentation as required.
  
- Configure and troubleshoot managed switches, routers, servers, and other active network devices.
  
- Coordinate network connectivity, fibre links, patching, and equipment integration with passive infrastructure teams.
  
- Monitor network performance, connectivity, availability, and system reliability.
  
- Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, configuration backups, and other technical documentation.
  
  
### C. CCTV, Access Control & BMS Integration
  
- Supervise the configuration, testing, and commissioning of CCTV cameras, Network Video Recorders (NVRs), Video Management Systems (VMS), and associated network components.
  
- Oversee the integration and operation of Access Control Systems, including controllers, readers, and management software.
  
- Coordinate the integration of BMS interfaces with relevant ICT and monitoring systems, where applicable.
  
- Troubleshoot communication, connectivity, configuration, and integration issues.
  
- Ensure system functionality is verified against approved drawings, specifications, and client requirements.
  
  
### D. Project Execution & Site Coordination
  
- Plan and monitor ICT active system installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning activities at the CCS site.
  
- Prepare project schedules, resource plans, deployment plans, and activity trackers.
  
- Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, technicians, vendors, consultants, and client representatives.
  
- Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
  
- Identify technical risks, material requirements, site constraints, and dependencies, and escalate issues to management.
  
- Ensure the availability of approved drawings, equipment, software licences, and other required resources.
  
  
### E. Testing, Commissioning & Quality Assurance
  
- Prepare and execute testing and commissioning plans for active ICT systems.
  
- Verify equipment configuration, connectivity, performance, and interoperability.
  
- Ensure compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, manufacturer recommendations, and applicable standards.
  
- Conduct site inspections and quality checks to identify and resolve installation or configuration deficiencies.
  
- Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system demonstrations, and client handovers.
  
- Ensure all observations and defects are documented, tracked, and closed within agreed timelines.
  
  
### F. Troubleshooting & Technical Support
  
- Lead the diagnosis and resolution of network outages, hardware failures, configuration issues, and system integration problems.
  
- Provide technical guidance to engineers and technicians during installation, testing, and maintenance.
  
- Coordinate with OEMs, system integrators, and vendors for technical support and warranty-related issues.
  
- Analyse recurring faults and implement corrective and preventive measures.
  
- Support preventive maintenance and operational continuity of deployed ICT systems.
  
  
### G. Team Leadership & Resource Management
  
- Lead, supervise, and mentor ICT engineers, network engineers, technicians, and other assigned team members.
  
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor daily work progress.
  
- Review manpower deployment, productivity, work quality, and adherence to project schedules.
  
- Conduct technical briefings and knowledge-sharing sessions for the team.
  
- Ensure team members follow site safety requirements and approved working procedures.
  
  
### H. Documentation & Management Reporting
  
- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
  
- Develop professional PowerPoint presentations, Excel trackers, dashboards, and technical reports for management and client reviews.
  
- Maintain network diagrams, equipment lists, configuration records, test reports, snag lists, and commissioning documentation.
  
- Prepare material requirement lists, technical compliance reports, and equipment status updates.
  
- Maintain as-built drawings, operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranty details, and handover records.
  
- Report project delays, technical challenges, resource gaps, and corrective action plans to management.
  
  
### I. Client, Vendor & Internal Coordination
  
- Act as the technical point of contact for ICT active systems at the assigned site.
  
- Coordinate with clients, consultants, OEMs, vendors, and internal project teams.
  
- Participate in technical meetings, progress reviews, inspections, and commissioning discussions.
  
- Ensure timely resolution of client observations and technical queries.
  
- Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure the timely availability of approved equipment and materials.
  
  
### J. Safety, Security & Compliance
  
- Ensure compliance with company policies, site safety procedures, and applicable technical standards.
  
- Follow secure network configuration practices, access control procedures, password management, and configuration backup protocols.
  
- Ensure appropriate protection of client data, system credentials, and confidential technical information.
  
- Maintain proper records of system changes, configuration updates, and maintenance activities.
  
  
## 3. Educational Qualifications
  
  
- B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Instrumentation Engineering.
  
- Relevant certifications in networking, cybersecurity, CCTV, or ICT infrastructure will be an added advantage.
  
  
## 4. Experience Required
  
  
- Minimum 8-15 years of relevant experience in ICT active infrastructure, network implementation, system integration, or infrastructure projects.
  
- Prior experience leading engineers and technicians at project sites is preferred.
  
- Hands-on experience with network switches, routers, servers, IP networking, CCTV, Access Control Systems, and BMS integration.
  
- Experience in data centres, government infrastructure projects, or large-scale ICT deployments will be preferred.
  
  
## 5. Technical Skills
  
  
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, and IP addressing.
  
- Practical experience with managed switches, routers, servers, and network troubleshooting.
  
- Understanding of fibre-optic and structured cabling infrastructure.
  
- Knowledge of CCTV, NVR/VMS, Access Control Systems, and BMS integration.
  
- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project reporting.
  
- Ability to read technical drawings, network diagrams, BOQs, and equipment specifications.
  
- Familiarity with network monitoring tools, configuration management, and testing procedures.
  
  
## 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Timely completion of ICT active installation and commissioning activities.
  
- Network and system availability, stability, and reliability.
  
- Successful completion of testing, integration, and client acceptance.
  
- Reduction in recurring technical faults and resolution time.
  
- Compliance with approved technical specifications and quality standards.
  
- Timely submission and accuracy of project reports and documentation.
  
- Effective utilisation and productivity of deployed manpower.
  
- Timely closure of site observations, snags, and client complaints.
  
- Compliance with safety, security, and project procedures.
  
  
## 7. Preferred Qualifications
  
  
- Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or relevant vendor-specific ICT certifications.
  
- Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and network security practices.
  
- Experience with data centre infrastructure and monitoring systems.
  
- Familiarity with AutoCAD, network design tools, and project management software.
  
- Experience with government, enterprise, or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  
  
## 8. Working Conditions
  
  
- The position is site-based at CCS and may require travel to other project locations as per business requirements.
  
- Flexibility to work beyond standard working hours during critical installations, testing, commissioning, or project deadlines.
  
- Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and work effectively under pressure.

title: FICO - Senior Consultant - L3
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA L3 FICO Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA L3 FICO Consultant to provide advanced functional support, incident resolution, enhancements, and continuous improvement for SAP Finance and Controlling processes. The consultant will serve as the escalation point for complex FICO issues, collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams, and ensure stable, compliant, and efficient SAP S/4HANA operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide Level 3 functional support for SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, recurring issues, and root causes within agreed SLAs.
* Configure and support SAP S/4HANA FICO processes, including:
* General Ledger Accounting (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Asset Accounting (AA)
* Bank Accounting and Cash Management
* Cost Center Accounting
* Profit Center Accounting
* Internal Orders
* Product Costing and CO-PA / Margin Analysis
* Tax configuration and statutory reporting support
* Support period-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations, financial reporting, allocations, settlements, depreciation runs, and foreign currency valuation.
* Investigate integration issues between FICO and other SAP modules, including MM, SD, PP, PM, PS, and Treasury, as applicable.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
* Gather business requirements, prepare functional specifications, and coordinate with ABAP, Basis, Security, and integration teams.
* Support change requests, minor enhancements, testing, transport management, and deployment activities.
* Prepare test scenarios, conduct unit testing, support SIT/UAT, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, financial compliance, and change-management processes.
* Maintain functional documentation, configuration documents, support knowledge articles, and process flows.
* Work closely with finance users, business process owners, and external vendors to improve system performance and usability.
* Participate in SAP S/4HANA upgrades, rollouts, migrations, and transformation initiatives when required.
* Mentor L1/L2 support resources and provide subject-matter expertise for FICO-related issues.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 5–8+ years of SAP FICO functional consulting experience, including significant experience in SAP S/4HANA.
* Strong hands-on configuration knowledge in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling.
* Experience providing L3 production support in a global or enterprise SAP environment.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, and controlling processes.
* Experience with:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA
* New Asset Accounting
* S/4HANA Finance data model
* Fiori applications for Finance
* Parallel ledgers, document splitting, and multi-currency scenarios
* Intercompany accounting and reconciliation
* Knowledge of integration points between FICO and MM, SD, PP, and other SAP modules.
* Ability to write clear functional specifications and work effectively with ABAP developers.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar incident/change-management tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize critical issues, and manage multiple support requests.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification.
* Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Treasury, Cash Management, or SAC financial reporting.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, embedded analytics, CDS views, and reporting tools.
* Experience in SAP ECC to S/4HANA conversion or greenfield implementation projects.
* Experience working in Agile, ITIL, or DevOps-based support environments.
* CPA, CA, CMA, ACCA, or other finance/accounting qualification is an advantage.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Advanced SAP FICO troubleshooting and configuration expertise
* Strong financial and accounting process knowledge
* Root cause analysis and issue-resolution capability
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Documentation and change-control discipline
* Customer-focused communication
* Ability to work under pressure during financial close cycles

title: Manager, Digital Supply Chain Implementation, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
At A&M GCC, Supply Chain and Manufacturing professionals assist our clients in analyzing manufacturing operations, supply chain and distribution channels, procurement, SG&A operations and Operating model effectiveness for potential value creation opportunities and to help drive them during our client’s ownership. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of current operations, identify performance improvement opportunities and quantify potential EBITDA improvement areas across plan, source, make and deliver functions
  
  
Our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team under Performance Improvement vertically is growing significantly and hence we are seeking techno-functional experts who can roll up the sleeves and deliver large, complex client engagements, working closely with leadership to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions
  
  
This role involves working closely with clients to identifytheir operations pain points and design & implement digital solutions across Supply chain planning, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics functions. Individuals should be able to translate business requirements into the right solution and map those with the vendor’sCOTS functionalities along with required customizations for end-to-end digital transformation programs (Design, Build/Configure, Test, Go Live and Hypercare)
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As Manager for Digital supply chain at A&M GCC PI team, you will contribute across the key areas below:
  
  
**Supply Chain Solutions Design & Implementation**

* Evaluate supply chain technologies, platforms, and solution providers and support the development of fit-for-purpose solution architectures and implementation roadmaps
* Define end-to-end digital supply chain strategy, roadmap and target operating model across ERP, planning, procurement, MES, WMS and TMS
* Define and validate data architecture, governance, cloud hosting and API/integration architecture across supply chain platforms
* Conduct “As-is” Assessment for gap analysis to design “To-be” state organization
* Translate business needs into functional & Technical specs and configure processes
* Create Design specifications for planning, procurement, production, Order management, Logistics, distribution
* Support end-to-end ERP implementation life cycle across supply chain modules (e.g., MM, PP, SD, WM, APO/IBP)
* Experience in integration with existing enterprise systems through APIs, middleware, cloud platforms, and cross-functional business process workflows
* Build RICEFW templates as per design specifications to support the solution
* Work with platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tulip, IRIS/MES, SAP EWM/TM etc.

**Testing & Deployment**

* Own the end-to-end implementation lifecycle from requirements through configuration, integration, testing, go-live and post-go-live stabilization
* Design and execute test scenarios: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, UAT
* Assist to validate configurations through business scenarios
* Support data migration, cut-over planning, go-live and hyper-care activities
* Collaborate with IT to troubleshoot and resolve issues post-deployment
* Project Management to track the issues through MS Project and JIRA

**Change Management & Training**

* Prepare SOPs, training materials, and user manuals; drive business-user adoption
* Support role – based user training sessions and drive functional adoption
* Conduct process workshops and knowledge-transfer sessions to build functional capabilities
* Highlight change impacts and ensure user readiness

**Continuous Improvement & Enhancements**

* Identify post-implementation improvements and process automation opportunities
* Support digital supply chain reporting needs (MPS, inventory, OTIF, cycle time etc.)
* Assist in system upgrades and rollouts across new plants or warehouses
* Evaluate emerging technologies like generative AI, Agentic AI and continuously enhance digital solutions through automation and process optimization

**Client Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead day-to-day project workstreams and contribute to overall project delivery
* Prepare executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations
* Facilitate client discussions, workshops, and stakeholder engagements

**Firm & Practice Contribution**

* Develop thought leadership, industry perspectives, benchmarks, and reusable tools / frameworks to strengthen the firm's Digital Supply Chain proposition
* Contribute to proposal development and business development activities
* Support internal knowledge development and training initiatives

**Qualifications**

* 6-11 years of experience in digital supply chain transformation, supply chain planning, logistics, operations excellence, or digital supply chain technology implementation programs
* Previous advisory and consulting experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist / niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing or a related field
* MBA / master’s degree in supply chain & Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or similar discipline
* Strong functional knowledge across the end-to-end supply chain, including demand & supply planning, manufacturing, procurement, production scheduling, inventory, logistics, distribution, and order fulfilment
* Strong knowledge of supply chain operating models, process re-engineering, business process mapping, and target-state design
* Experience supporting or leading implementation of supply chain planning, logistics, warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), procurement, or manufacturing execution solutions (MES)
* Familiarity with enterprise data models, cloud platform architectures, data migration lifecycle, API/integration frameworks, and business process integration across supply chain functions
* Hands-on experience with ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP IBP, SAP EWM/TM, Oracle SCM Cloud, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, Microsoft Dynamics, o9, WMS / TMS or similar solutions
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to drive adoption across business and technology teams
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills in dynamic, operationally complex environments
* Experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders during implementations
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and root-cause problem-solving skills
* Exposure to AI/ML-powered supply chain solutions, generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision intelligence platforms, would be a plus
* Tools knowledge on Alteryx, Power BI, python, Linear programming platforms, etc. would be a plus

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Field Operations & Partnerships Executive
description:
**ABOUT NINJAHELP**

NinjaHelp helps families in Delhi-NCR book trusted, verified help for their homes: elder care, nannies and cooks. We're building the technology behind household services: verified worker identity, smart matching, digital onboarding in six languages through our worker app Saathi, and simple monthly billing. Households deal with one trusted brand. Behind it, we work with a network of partner agencies who manage and support workers on the ground.

We're an early team led by operators from Paytm, MakeMyTrip, Flipkart and we're building fast.

**THE ROLE**

You'll be our person on the ground. You'll bring partner agencies onto the platform, keep them performing, and make sure every family gets a smooth start with their new help. You'll report to our Co-Founder & Chief Business Officer and work closely with the founders and the product team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Agency partnerships

• Find and meet household-service agencies across Gurugram, Delhi, Noida and Faridabad, pitch the NinjaHelp partner programme, and sign them up

• Onboard partners onto our partner portal: help them register their workers, build profiles and get comfortable with the tools

• Track partner performance against agreed service standards (response time, worker availability, replacements) and work with them to close gaps

• Build a reliable bench of partners who can grow with us

**Operations**

• Coordinate worker trials and start dates at households, and be the on-ground point of contact when something needs fixing

• Verify worker documents and run in-person checks where needed

• Keep our ops console up to date: every visit, worker status and partner conversation logged

• Bring workers onto Saathi through community channels: residential societies, worker clusters, NGOs and our Saathi Mitra referral network

• Share what you see in the field with the product team. Your feedback will shape what we build.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

• 1–4 years in field operations, partner or merchant onboarding, or B2B field sales, ideally at a consumer-tech or marketplace company (food delivery, quick commerce, mobility, home services)

• Fluent Hindi and good working English

• Comfortable travelling across Delhi-NCR most working days

• Organised and data-minded: at ease with Google Sheets and keeping records current on an app

• Graduate in any discipline

• Patience and empathy. You'll work with families, workers and small business owners, each with very different needs.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET**

• Fixed salary plus monthly performance incentives

• Travel allowance

• Direct work with the founders at an early-stage company

• Room to grow into a city or partnerships lead role as we expand to new cities

HOW TO APPLY

* Apply on LinkedIn with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will have a short phone call, an in-person conversation in Gurugram, and a short field exercise.

title: Senior Lead, Capacity Building
description:
**Position Overview:**

The Senior Lead, Capacity Building owns how Room to Read India builds the capability of its people and partners to improve children's literacy learning outcomes. The person in this role will lead all literacy training across the organization and with government and partner systems: analyzing training needs at every level, designing role-specific training and materials, including virtual modules and courses, building competency frameworks that track individual learning over time, and measuring training impact jointly with the Research, Monitoring and Evaluation (RM&E) team, with improvement in Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) as the central measure. The Senior Lead also owns the quality standards that all literacy training must meet. This position will be based at the Country Office in New Delhi, report directly to the Senior Director, Programs, Lead one Officer, work closely with the IDTS team, and require frequent travel to project locations and regular interaction with state teams, education officials, partners and training agencies.

**About Instructional Design and Technical Support Team (IDTS):**
The team enables RtR's state units to enhance program implementation by improving the adoption of structured pedagogy resources, teacher and team professional development, and evidence-informed assessment in instruction. The team is in charge of content creation amidst a lot of academic rigor and field experiences. This team supports other teams by providing technical inputs at various levels including internal and external stakeholders. It also leads Room to Read India's work on INCO, an AI-powered literacy coaching app, ensuring the technology stays anchored in sound pedagogy and real classroom practice.

**Responsibilities:**

**Training Needs Analysis Across Levels:**

* Conduct periodic training needs analysis across all levels of the organization.
* Draw on program data, field observations, coaching and monitoring records, assessment results and consultations with Program and RM&E teams to identify capability gaps.
* Translate needs into a prioritized, role-specific capacity-building plan aligned to program calendars, hiring phases and project goals.

**Ownership of Literacy Training and Quality Standards:**

* Lead the end-to-end literacy training architecture: induction, technical training on literacy pedagogy and program models, data-use training and mid-course correction training.
* Sequence and coordinate training delivered by IDTS, other internal teams, external agencies and consultants, and oversee logistics, facilitators and batches across locations with Admin, Finance and Program teams.
* Oversee training for government and partner systems (such as SCERT, DIET and partner organizations) where Room to Read supports capacity building.
* Define and uphold quality standards for the design, delivery and follow-up of literacy training, observing sessions, reviewing facilitator performance and gathering participant feedback.
* Document lessons from each training cycle, feed them into the next one, and share learning and recommendations with Program, Technical and Leadership teams.

**Training Materials and Virtual Courses:**

* Lead the design of training modules, facilitator guides, participant materials and job aids for literacy projects, including materials that help teams understand and use program data and run mid-course correction training when data shows implementation or learning gaps.
* Design and manage a library of virtual training modules and courses for each role and level, with defined learning outcomes, duration, mode, content sequence, practice tasks and assessments.
* Develop course content such as short videos, interactive lessons, case studies, classroom practice clips and quizzes, in Hindi, English and other languages the program needs.
* Run a learning management system or equivalent platform with enrollment, completion tracking, certification and links to competency and Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) results, and plan virtual and blended delivery, including live online sessions, peer learning and offline or mobile-friendly formats for low-connectivity locations.
* Ensure all materials are linked to children's learning outcomes and reviewed with technical experts before roll-out; build and mentor a pool of internal facilitators and master trainers.

**Competency Frameworks and Learning Tracking:**

* Create a competency framework for each training area and role, with defined learning outcomes and observable indicators.
* Design assessments, observation tools and rubrics so that each individual's understanding and practice can be measured and tracked over time.
* Set minimum competency thresholds for trainees to begin contributing to the project as per role expectations, and define follow-up support (refreshers, coaching, reassessment) for trainees who have not met them.
* Maintain learning records and a training dashboard that show progress by individual, role, cohort and project.

**Training Impact Analysis with RM&E:**

* Jointly with RM&E, design and carry out evaluations of training impact, with KAP improvement as the central measure.
* Co-develop KAP baseline, post-training and follow-up tools, and agree sampling, timing and analysis methods with RM&E.
* Link training participation and competency results to changes in field practice, program quality indicators and, where possible, children's learning outcomes.
* Co-author findings and recommendations with RM&E, and use them to revise training design, content and delivery for subsequent cohorts.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Management or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in education or development programs, including substantial responsibility for training needs analysis and for planning and managing training across multiple cohorts, roles and locations.
* Experience designing training materials and competency frameworks, with assessments or observation tools that track individual learning over time.
* Experience measuring training effectiveness, including KAP assessments, and working with an M&E or research team to use findings for improvement.
* Strong understanding of literacy instruction and how adults and teachers learn; ability to link training to children's learning outcomes.
* Experience using program and learning data to diagnose implementation gaps and design corrective or refresher training.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Willingness to travel frequently to project locations.

**Desirable:**

* Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in education, training, or learning and development.
* Experience in foundational literacy or large-scale government education programs, including work with systems such as SCERT and DIET.
* Experience with multilingual education, or with digital and AI-supported coaching and learning tools.
* Experience managing external training agencies, consultants or facilitators.

**Compensation:**

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include a thirteenth-month bonus, health insurance, and a retirement plan. The non-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing and transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries on literacy and gender equality in education.

Read is a child-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.

Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.

title: Billing Engineer
description:
Job Opening: Site Billing (Secondment)
  
Location: New Delhi
  
Position Type: Full-time (Deputed / Site Secondment)
  
Experience: 3 – 6 Years
  
Qualification: Diploma / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
  
Reporting to: Senior Project Manager / Quantity Audit Lead
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented Site Billing Engineer / Quantity Surveyor to be deputed on-site at a high-end luxury retail store project. The candidate will act as our primary on-site technical representative responsible for receiving, verifying, and recording store materials, performing precise physical site measurements of works executed by the General Contractor (GC) and trade vendors, certifying bills, and preparing final client submission reports.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Material Receipt, Stock Control & Asset Inwarding
  
\* Inward Verification: Receive, physically inspect, and verify all incoming interior materials, structural items, MEP fixtures, and high-spec fit-out supplies against delivery challans, POs, and approved samples.
  
\* Inventory & Asset Logging: Maintain meticulous on-site stock registers and digital inventory tracking. Ensure secure storage and proper handling of premium finish materials.
  
\* Discrepancy Reporting: Immediately report damaged goods, short supply, or specification mismatches to the project manager and supplier team.
  
  
2. Site Measurement & Quantity Verification
  
\* Joint Site Measurements: Take precise joint measurements at the site along with the General Contractor (GC), interior fit-out vendors, and MEP contractors.
  
\* CAD & Drawing Verification: Cross-check site execution against approved GFC (Good for Construction) architectural and interior drawings to verify actual quantities vs. BOQ allowances.
  
\* Abstract & Measurement Sheet Preparation: Draft accurate measurement sheets (MB), joint measurement records (JMR), and itemized quantity breakdowns.
  
  
3. Vendor Bill Certification & Client Submissions
  
\* Bill Verification & Audit: Audit and verify running account (RA) bills and final bills submitted by the GC, sub-contractors, and trade vendors.
  
\* Rate & Specification Compliance: Reconcile claimed line items against approved BOQ rates, change orders (VOs), and quality sign-offs.
  
\* Certification: Issue certified bill summaries with recommendations for payment or necessary retention/deductions.
  
\* Client Reporting: Compile and submit clean, certified measurement records, reconciled bill summaries, and material consumption reports for client sign-off.
  
Qualifications & Key Competencies
  
\* Education: Diploma or B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
  
  
\* Experience: 3 to 6 years of core experience in billing engineering, quantity surveying, and material control within commercial, retail, or hospitality interiors.
  
  
\* Technical Skills:
  
  
\* Proficiency in reading Architectural, Civil, and MEP GFC drawings.
  
\* Advanced command of MS Excel (for measurement sheet creation, reconciliation, and BOQ tracking) and basic AutoCAD.
  
\* Thorough understanding of interior finishing materials (joinery, veneer, marble, gypsum ceilings, track lighting, electrical fit-outs).
  
\* Soft Skills:
  
\* Strong negotiation and communication skills for joint site measurements with contractors.
  
\* High level of integrity, accuracy, and attention to detail required for high-value retail project audits.
  
Work Environment & Terms
  
\* This is a site-based secondment role requiring full-time presence at the project site during operational hours.
  
\* The engineer will interact daily with site contractors, and client design representatives on-site.

  **Delhi NCR or within practical travelling distance of New Delhi**

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
Experience3–5 years
  
  
Compensation₹8–12 LPA CTC
  
  
The role
  
  
At Trendwick, you lead testing for our trading tools and AI assistant, and make sure they work correctly before every release.
  
  
You plan the testing, automate it, and guide a small team of about three junior testers.
  
  
Open to any graduate or post-graduate with 3–5 years of software testing experience, including automation. No trading knowledge is needed; we teach you our products and the markets.
  
  
Skills for this role: Automation testing (Selenium or Playwright), Python or Java, API testing (Postman, REST Assured or PyTest), SQL, Performance testing (JMeter), CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Jira, Test planning and strategy, Mentoring.
  
  
At Trendwick, everyone also keeps company and client information private, never gives investment advice or promises profits, checks anything an AI tool gives before using it, joins the short daily team meeting, and keeps learning through the training we give.
  
  
How we hire: 1. Apply on this page. 2. A short testing task. 3. A friendly interview with our team. 4. HR discussion and offer. Tip: add your GitHub or project link in the Portfolio URL box.
  
  
Growth path: Associate Quality Analyst → Quality Analyst → Senior Quality Analyst → QA Lead.
  
  
Please note: we only build software. We do not handle anyone's money or give investment advice, and you will never be asked to trade or invest your own money.
  
  
Trendwick is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome everyone, whatever their gender, background or ability. Beware of fraud: we never ask for money for applications, training, joining or equipment. Report any such request to hr@trendwick.co or WhatsApp +971 58 307 6101.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Plan testing: plan the testing for every release and decide when it is ready to go live.
* Automate tests: build automated tests with Selenium or Playwright using Python or Java.
* Test APIs: automate API tests with Postman, REST Assured or PyTest.
* Check trading logic: make sure indicator values and EA trades are correct, including tricky cases like price gaps and fast markets during big news.
* Test the AI: check the AI chat assistant and AI agents for wrong answers, unsafe advice and misuse.
* Test speed: run speed and load tests with tools like JMeter.
* Check security: do basic security checks on login, licences and data.
* Guide your team: review your juniors' test cases and bug reports, and teach them.
* Lead bug meetings: discuss bugs with developers and Product Owners and agree what to fix first.
* Share reports: share simple quality reports with the team.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years in software testing, including at least 1 year of automation.
* Python or Java for automation, with Selenium or Playwright.
* API testing and SQL.
* Experience guiding junior testers is a plus.
* English and any Indian language.

**Benefits**

* Full training: learn our products, trading platforms and tools step by step.
* Mentoring: guide a small team of about three junior testers.
* Work on AI: test our new AI chat assistant and AI agents.
* Real products: build our TradingView, MetaTrader and cTrader tools from the start.
* Skills for the future: fintech, trading technology and AI experience stays valuable in any company.

Deeply integrate Observability into customer's Platform Engineering and CI/CD workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
* Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Observability concepts, APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management. Lead technical workshops and design sessions with customer architects, engineers, and leadership to define the implementation roadmap.

**Your Qualifications**
We believe that experience comes in many forms and are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you believe you have the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.
  
  

* Extensive Technical Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical consulting, solutions architecture, or senior engineering role, specifically focused on cloud and application performance technologies.

* Automation and DevOps Proficiency: Deep expertise in Automation, Scripting (e.g., Python), and CI/CD practices and tools. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly valued.
* Observability Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and practical experience with Observability concepts (The Three Pillars) and products (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, etc.) is extremely important. You can articulate the 'why' and 'how' of Observability to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Consultative Influence: Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive consensus on complex technical architectures.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. title: Analyst - Placements
description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Analyst – Placements will support the effective functioning of the Placements

Department through data management, placement analytics, reporting, and process

monitoring via ERP. The role will involve maintaining accurate placement records,

tracking student eligibility and placement progress, analysing placement outcomes,

and preparing management reports to support decision-making.

The position requires a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive professional who

can work closely with the placement team, students, and internal stakeholders to

ensure smooth and efficient execution of placement activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. Placement Data Management and Analytics

 Maintain and update the placement database, including student profiles,

academic details, CVs, placement status, interview progress, offers, and

joining details.

 Analyse placement data to track key performance indicators such as

placement percentage, average CTC, average fixed compensation, median

CTC, and the number of offers across salary brackets.

 Monitor placement progress against batch-wise targets and highlight gaps,

trends, and areas requiring intervention.

 Maintain accurate records of company-wise hiring, sector-wise placements,

role-wise offers, compensation packages, and recruiter engagement.

 Ensure data integrity, consistency, confidentiality, and timely updation of

placement records.

B. MIS and Management Reporting

Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic placement reports for the

placement leadership and institute management.

 Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and analytical reports using MS

Excel and other relevant tools.

 Prepare batch-wise and campus-wise placement summaries, recruiter

reports, and performance reports.

 Generate insights on placement trends, compensation benchmarks, sectoral

hiring patterns, and student placement progress.

 Support the preparation of placement presentations, review documents,

accreditation reports, rankings submissions, and annual placement reports, as

required.

C. Corporate Relations Support

 Maintain and update the corporate database, including company profiles,

recruiter contacts, hiring history, job roles, and compensation details.

 Track recruiter interactions, job descriptions received, hiring requirements,

interview schedules, and recruitment outcomes via ERP.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely sharing of student

profiles, CVs, shortlists, and other recruitment-related information with

companies.

D. Placement Process Coordination

 Track placement activities from job announcement and student applications

through shortlisting, interviews, offers, and final joining.

 Maintain trackers for student eligibility, applications, interview participation,

selection status, offer acceptance, and joining confirmation.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely communication of

recruitment schedules, deadlines, and process updates.

 Identify discrepancies or delays in placement data and follow up with relevant

stakeholders for closure.

 Support the smooth execution of placement drives, pre-placement talks,

assessments, interviews, and other recruitment activities.

E. Student Placement Tracking

 Maintain accurate student-wise records of placement readiness, applications,

interview performance, offers, and placement status.

 Track student participation and progress across recruitment processes.

Generate reports on student availability, placement eligibility, offer status, and

pending placement requirements.

 Assist in identifying students requiring additional placement support based on

data and feedback from the placement team.

 Ensure that placement-related student information is handled confidentially

and shared only with authorised stakeholders.

F. Process Improvement and Documentation

 Standardise placement data formats, reporting templates, trackers, and

documentation processes.

 Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, turnaround time, and

operational efficiency through automation and better data practices.

 Maintain proper documentation of placement processes, recruiter interactions,

and placement outcomes.

 Support data verification, audit requirements, and reconciliation of placement

figures before internal and external reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Analyst – Placements will be evaluated on the following

parameters:

1. Data Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of student, recruiter, offer, and

placement records.

2. Reporting Timeliness: Submission of placement MIS, dashboards, and

reports within defined timelines.

3. Target Tracking: Timely monitoring and reporting of placement progress

against approved batch-wise targets.

4. Analytical Quality: Quality of insights, trend analysis, exception reporting,

and management information provided.

5. Process Compliance: Adherence to placement data protocols, reporting

formats, and documentation standards.

6. Data Reconciliation: Consistency of placement figures across internal

trackers, dashboards, and official reports.

7. Stakeholder Coordination: Responsiveness and effectiveness in

coordinating with the placement team and relevant stakeholders.

8. Process Improvement: Contribution to improved reporting efficiency,

automation, and standardisation.

**Educational Qualifications:**

 Postgraduate qualification in Business Analytics, Management, Statistics, or a

related field.

6. Experience

 Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in MIS, data analytics,

reporting, operations, recruitment operations, or placement administration.

 Experience in an educational institution, business school, recruitment

organisation, or corporate HR function will be preferred.

7. Skills and Competencies

Technical Skills

 Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions,

conditional formulas, data validation, and dashboard preparation.

 Working knowledge of PowerPoint and professional report preparation.

 Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualisation tools will be an

advantage.

 Ability to work with large datasets, identify inconsistencies, and derive

meaningful insights.

 Familiarity with CRM systems, placement management platforms, or

database management tools is desirable.

title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
description:
**Req ID:**
395324
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in WB, West Bengal (IN-WB), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.
  
  
This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.
* Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.
* Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.
* Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.
* Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.
* Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.
* Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.
* Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.
* Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.
* Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.
* Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.
* Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.
* Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.
* Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.
* AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.
* PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.
* Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.
* Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.
* SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.
* AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.
* AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.
* Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.
* Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.
* Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.
* Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.
* Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.

**Critical selection criterion:**
Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
About Offcomfrt

Most of us have worked inside the system corporate India runs on — layers of approval, and the quiet understanding that you are a resource before you are a person. Offcomfrt started from a disagreement with that.

We are building a company where everyone is treated the same, owns their work, and does not need permission to do it well.

You will own paid acquisition at Offcomfrt. This is a role closely connected to revenue — helping decide where advertising spend goes and analysing what comes back.

What You Will Do

* Run Meta Ads and Google Ads end to end against an assigned monthly budget.
* Track ROAS, CAC, AOV and contribution margin, and report on them weekly.
* Set the creative testing agenda — brief it, launch it, analyse it and document learnings.
* Maintain tracking across Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4 and UTM parameters.
* Brief the video editor so winning angles can inform the next round of creative.
* Track competitor activity and share insights on where the category is moving.

What We Are Looking For

* Around 1 year of experience managing paid media, ideally for a D2C or e-commerce brand.
* Hands-on experience managing advertising budgets.
* Working fluency in Meta Ads Manager and familiarity with Google Ads.
* A strong understanding of unit economics, including ROAS, CAC, AOV and contribution margin.
* The judgement to pause underperforming campaigns and the patience to let meaningful tests run.

How We Hire

Our hiring process is designed to assess relevant skills and fit for the role. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a brief, role-relevant assessment or discussion as part of the selection process. Any assessment will be clearly explained in advance and will be used solely for evaluating the candidate's suitability for the role. Candidates will not be asked to complete unpaid production work that directly contributes to ongoing business operations.

How to Apply

Email your CV to growth@offcomfrt.com with the subject line "Performance Marketer — [Your Name]".

title: Performance Marketer, Marketplaces
description:
If you can win a listing page of fifteen near-identical products in under two seconds, this one is yours.

Marketplaces are not a channel we bolt on at the end. For a lot of Indians, the listing is the brand.

**ABOUT CLIENT:**

Our client is in the business of building tasteful brands across categories and geographies. That could mean 0 to 1, 1 to 10, or 10 to 1000. Six months in, they are about 25 people, each one here to do the best work of our lives.

**WHY WE THEY HIRING**

Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Different platforms, different rules, different shoppers, and almost no transferable playbook between them. They need someone who actually knows the difference.

This is the unglamorous half of the business and it still decides the year. Share of search, assortment, ratings, the merchandising calendar, whether they are in stock in the dark store that matters. You own all of it.

You will work across several brands at once, some launching, some scaling, and you will decide where each one deserves to show up.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

•
**Retail media.**
Sponsored products, brands and display on marketplaces, plus ad products on quick commerce. Keyword harvesting, bid logic, placement, budget split by platform.

•
**Share of search.**
The keywords they intend to own, where they currently rank, and the plan to close the gap. Organic and paid together, not as separate projects.

•
**Listings and content.**
Titles, bullets, A+ content, images, thumbnail logic, variant structure. You brief the writer and designer and you are the last check before it goes live.

•
**Assortment and pricing.**
Which SKUs go where, pack sizes by platform, price ladders, promos, platform-funded offers and what they actually cost them.

•
**Ratings and reviews.**
Seeding, responding, spotting the product problem hiding inside a run of two-star reviews, and telling the people who can fix it.

•
**Stock and operations.**
Working with supply chain on forecasts, appointments, fill rate and the dark-store footprint. Going out of stock in your top city is a performance problem.

•
**The numbers.**
ROAS and TACoS by platform, velocity per store, conversion by listing, contribution after platform fees. You own the dashboard and report it honestly, including the months it looks bad.

**MUST HAVES**

**Skills**

• Two to four years running marketplace or quick commerce accounts with your own budgets. Brand side, seller side or agency, they care about the accounts.

• Platform depth, not surface familiarity. Seller Central or Vendor Central, Flipkart Ads, and at least one quick commerce platform you have actually operated.

• Keyword and bid craft. Harvesting, negatives, placement modifiers, and a view on when to stop bidding on your own brand term.

• Listing judgment. You can look at a page and say why it is losing, and it is usually not the price.

• Sheets at a working level. Pull a bulk file, fix it, upload it, without breaking the catalogue.

• Comfort with the operations side. Forecasts, fill rate and appointments are part of the job, not someone else’s.

**Additional**

• Food or FMCG experience is a real advantage. Shelf life, pack sizes and compliance copy change every answer.

• Startup speed. A listing goes live today, a promo is live tomorrow, and the read happens before the weekend.

• Comfort with ambiguity. New brands, no history, no benchmarks to lean on.

• You can think without AI. Use the tools to move faster, never to think for you.

• You read the back of packs in other people’s trolleys and you have opinions about a shelf you had nothing to do with.
