title: DTC Performance Video Editor
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout**
is looking for a
**Direct Response Video Editor**
to join our team! As our video editor, you will be responsible for editing, producing, and managing multiple creative projects with a heavy focus on paid ad creatives for Meta Platforms - VSLs, short and long form. You'll take raw UGC and transform it into high-converting direct response ads that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience editing paid ads, understands direct response principles, runs a current AI stack in production, and delivers volume and quality in the same week without being chased.
  
  
**Who are we?**
KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.
  
  
**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a
**generous performance bonus structure**
— then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Key Objectives**

* Consistent output of 8 ad briefs per week, maintaining volume and quality simultaneously
* Increase your performance bonus by analyzing prior video metrics to increase views and conversions
* Apply direct-response copywriting principles to review scripts
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your daily workload efficiently to meet deadlines without needing hand-holding or frequent check-ins
* Quickly learn and master new tools and software, and editing techniques as social media trends evolve, often with less than a day's notice
* Ensure every video meets our exacting quality standards and perfectly matches the provided instructions, minimizing the need for revisions
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with the company founders and executive team, providing updates when necessary
* Create ad variations and iterations to scale winning ads and improve performance
* Collaborate with the creative strategy team to bring ad concepts to life
* Apply direct response marketing principles to editing (hooks, problem/solution flow, testimonials, CTAs)
* Stay up to date on internet trends and editing styles to ensure our ads feel native and engaging

**Requirements**

* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Proven experience creating short-form direct-response videos for DTC brands
* Proven experience with professional video-editing software is required. We have a strong preference for Adobe Premiere Pro
* Paid Ad Focus: Proven experience editing Meta/Facebook paid ads that convert
* Volume: Comfortable producing 8 ad briefs per week
* Tools: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
* Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to combine storytelling with data-driven feedback to refine and improve ads
* No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You're passionate about your work and excited by the idea of producing ads that millions will see
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders
* Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run
* AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased

**KPI'S you will own**

* 8 ad briefs per week Quota
* 80% First-Pass Approval Rate: At least 80% of submissions require no revisions

**Accountabilities**

* Deliver 8 ad briefs per week
* Edit VSLs and DR video ads with AI-first workflows
* Weekly iterations on top-performing ads to drive continuous improvement
* Ensure ads are visually compelling, on-brand, and optimized for performance
* Stay plugged into social media/UGC trends to keep our creatives fresh and competitive
* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns by testing different edits, structures, and hooks
* Work fluently across AI video and UGC tools (Higgsfield, and similar)
* Collaborate closely with strategists, copywriters, and performance teams

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You are a meticulous video perfectionist who will spend hours refining a single transition or effect. With a high daily quota, success in this role demands efficiency. Adhering perfectly to the video template at speed is valued over spending extra time on minor details that don't contribute to views or conversions
* You thrive in highly collaborative, team-oriented environments with frequent meetings and brainstorming sessions. This is a high-autonomy, "heads-down" role where you will be working independently the majority of the time to meet your individual production goals
* You are a methodical planner who prefers stable, long-term projects and predictable workflows. Our environment is inherently dynamic. The tools, guidelines, and video styles can change overnight, and you must be able to pivot instantly without frustration

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**
We review applications on a rolling basis. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens up, exceptional candidates may be hired immediately.
  
  
Our process has three stages:
  
  

* Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit
* Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work
* Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us

KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
  
  
For this role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed.
  
  
**Salary Expectation**
USD $1,000 - $1,500 per month (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
  
  
**We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.**

description:
**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft administration including Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Intune, identity, access, endpoint and policy management.
* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, CCNA, CCNP, VMware Certified Professional, ITIL Foundation, RHCSA, RHCE, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability for infrastructure availability and operational continuity.
* Leadership capability to manage teams, vendors, escalations and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
* Clear communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, distributed and time-sensitive operational environment.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, service improvement, security and compliance.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner with application, security, cloud, operations and business teams.

**Reporting Structure**

* The role will report to the Infrastructure Lead / Head of Technology.
* The role will work closely with application teams, Information security teams, station IT teams, business operations teams, service providers, OEMs and external technology partners.

**Location / Work Environment**

* The role will operate in a multi-location environment with centralized governance and distributed station-level support.
* The position may require coordination across corporate offices, operational stations, data centers, cloud environments, vendors and field IT teams.

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.
  
  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architecture and Design
  
  

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation
  
  

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability
  
  

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform.

**Working Pattern**

**Purpose and Context**

FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments.

This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.

title: Strategy Consultant
description: Position: Program Manager – Urban InitiativeLocation: DelhiAn initiative supported by The Convergence FoundationAbout URBAN ProjectIndia is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:Regional economic and spatial planning: Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.Ease of doing business: Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.Governance: Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.Financing: Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.Position SummaryThe Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral & written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.Areas of Work:The Program Manager will:Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planningEngage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)Develop evidence-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growthEngage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnershipsOversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completionProvide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exerciseRequired Qualifications, Skills and AbilitiesUndergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferredUp to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environmentExcellent analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skillsSolid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadlineExcellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in styleExcellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skillsHigh level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands requireAbility to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive mannerOperating style suited to working in a small-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valuedCompensationRemuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experienceLocationNew Delhi, India

title: Founder's Office (Psychologist)
description:
About Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. It is built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Founder, Sitender is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. It is active across UAE, the US, NZ, and scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does — the bridge between Sitender and the world. You will hold the whole picture, ensure nothing is dropped, and protect the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

This role calls for a grounding in psychology. Much of the work is human: reading a room, understanding what a participant or private client needs, handling sensitive relationships with care, and shaping experiences that feel safe and meaningful. Your training helps you understand people, not treat them. This is a non-clinical role.

You will run the day-to-day across the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media assisted by interns — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: able to manage a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and to sense what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

What You Will Do

• Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats

• Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up

• Bring a psychological lens to participant and client experience — onboarding, follow-up, feedback, and noticing when someone needs more care or a referral

• Help design and refine gatherings and programs with an understanding of group dynamics, belonging, and emotional safety

• Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination

• Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and a consistent voice and aesthetic

• Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators in multiple time zones

• Keep the founder's office moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and making sure projects don't stall

• Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

Essential

• A degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Psychology, Counselling, or a closely related field

• 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles

• An exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details

• A strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency

• Comfortable delegating social media and marketing execution

• Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed

• Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

**Preferred**

• Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure

• Experience in counselling, organisational psychology, wellbeing programs, or community and group facilitation

• A background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation

• Willing to travel to the UAE, US

• A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities

• Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

• You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped

• Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters

• Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things

• A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

• Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location

• A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide

• Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer

• Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role

• Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

A background in psychology is essential. Beyond that, we care less about where you studied and more about who you are: your capability, character, and care. We're looking for someone whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

Compensation & Onboarding

The role begins with an 8-week probation period, paid at a mutually agreed figure while we find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion, based on performance and delivery, you'll step into the role permanently with a full CTC upwards of 6 LPA, negotiable for the right profile and growing as the work expands across cities.

To Apply

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

Without the personal note, we will not be responding to your application.

www.antaha.org

www.sitendersehrawat.com

title: Online Admission Counselor
description:
About the Role

We are looking for experienced and result-oriented
**Online Admission Counselors**
who have hands-on experience in online higher education admissions, particularly for Online BBA, Online MBA, Online PG, and other online degree programs.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and convincing skills, a strong understanding of online education programs, and a proven ability to convert prospective students into enrolled students.

We are looking for professionals who can manage leads, counsel students, handle objections, follow up consistently, and successfully close admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.
* Counsel students regarding Online BBA, Online MBA, Online PG, and other online degree programs.
* Understand students' educational backgrounds, career goals, eligibility, and course preferences.
* Explain course structure, admission procedures, eligibility criteria, fees, payment options, and program benefits accurately.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed admissions by following a structured sales process.
* Handle student objections related to course fees, university selection, recognition, career opportunities, and online learning.
* Follow up with interested students through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and other communication channels.
* Maintain accurate lead information, follow-up schedules, and admission records in the CRM.
* Achieve monthly admission targets and conversion KPIs.
* Coordinate with the admissions and operations teams to ensure a smooth enrollment process.
* Maintain professional relationships with students throughout the admission journey.
* Ensure transparent communication and avoid making misleading claims about universities, degrees, or placements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum 1–2 years of experience in online education sales, admission counseling, or higher education enrollment.
* Previous experience in Online BBA, Online MBA, Online PG, or similar degree programs is strongly preferred.
* Good knowledge of online universities, admission processes, eligibility requirements, and course structures.
* Proven experience in lead conversion and admission closure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to handle high-volume leads and maintain consistent follow-ups.
* Experience using CRM software, Google Sheets, or other lead management tools.
* Target-oriented mindset with a strong focus on enrollment numbers and revenue generation.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We prefer candidates who have previously worked with online education platforms, universities, admission consultancies, or edtech companies.

Candidates with a proven track record of achieving monthly admission targets and converting counseling leads into paid enrollments will receive preference.

**Important:**
This role is best suited for candidates with actual admission-closing experience, not just telecalling or lead generation experience.

Performance Expectations

Candidates will be evaluated on:

* Number of qualified leads contacted.
* Quality and consistency of follow-ups.
* Lead-to-admission conversion rate.
* Number of confirmed and paid admissions.
* Achievement of monthly admission targets.
* Student counseling quality and CRM discipline.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives for successful admissions.
* Opportunity to grow in the online education and edtech industry.
* A performance-driven and growth-oriented work environment.
* Career growth opportunities for high-performing counselors.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume with our recruitment team.

Please mention the following details in your application:

1. Total years of experience in education counseling or online admissions.
2. Experience with Online BBA, Online MBA, and Online PG programs.
3. Previous company or organization.
4. Average number of admissions closed per month.
5. Experience with CRM and lead management tools.
6. Current salary and expected salary.
7. Notice period and preferred work location.

**We are hiring 5 Admission Counselors. Candidates with strong counseling, conversion, and admission-closing skills are encouraged to apply.**

title: Sr Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
Job Description — Solution Engineer (aka STS), CCaaS & Voice AI (Individual Contributor)
  
  
Company: Tata Communications
  
  
Function: Solution Engineering (aka STS) — Customer Interaction Suite
  
  
Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — no people management
  
  
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, or Gurugram (hybrid; on-site as per project needs)
  
  
Experience: 6–9 years in contact centre / cloud telephony / voice AI solution engineering
  
  
Travel: Up to 30% (client sites within India and occasional overseas)
  
  
**About The Role (a Note From The Hiring Head)**
Tata Communications is one of the world’s most interconnected digital infrastructure companies, built on our Digital Fabric that connects networks, cloud, and customer interactions for global enterprises. Within our customer experience portfolio, we sell and deliver cloud contact centre (CCaaS) and AI-driven engagement solutions end to end — including our InstaCC™ contact centre platform, the Smartflo CCaaS platform, and the Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS suite we acquired in 2023 (messaging, voice, video and chat APIs), alongside a global OEM ecosystem spanning Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone
  
  
Every enterprise deal we win now hinges on two things: a well-architected CCaaS solution and a compelling Voice AI story — voice bots, IVR transformation, speech-enabled self-service, and agent-assist. I am looking for a hands-on Solution Engineer who lives in that intersection: someone who can take a customer’s call-flow diagram and turn it into a winning, priced, demonstrable solution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-sales and Solution Design
  
  

* Own the technical win in the sales cycle: conduct discovery workshops with enterprise customers, document their current contact centre estate (telephony, routing, IVR, CRM, WFM, analytics), and translate business requirements into a target-state CCaaS + Voice AI architecture.
* Design end-to-end solutions across our portfolio — InstaCC, Smartflo, and Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS — and across OEM platforms (Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone, Five9), including telephony integration (SIP trunking, WebRTC, SBCs), channel routing (voice, chat, WhatsApp, email), and CRM/helpdesk integration.
* Architect the Voice AI components specifically: conversational IVR and voice bots, ASR/STT and TTS selection, NLU and LLM-driven dialogue design, barge-in, DTMF fallbacks, latency and WER budgets, and clear escalation to human agents.

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept
  
  

* Build and maintain compelling demos that showcase CCaaS workflows and Voice AI behaviours (voice bot conversations, sentiment detection, agent-assist) that our sales teams can take into customer rooms.
* Scope, build, and run PoCs with customers; define success criteria (containment, deflection, CSAT impact) and deliver crisp readouts.

RFPs, RFIs and Commercial Support
  
  

* Lead the technical portions of RFPs/RFIs and solution defence presentations; write the technical response, solution narrative, and architecture diagrams.
* Support commercials: build bill-of-materials, platform sizing, voice/AI consumption estimates, and effort/cost inputs for SOW and pricing decisions — while keeping the solution technically honest.

Partner and Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Work closely with our platform partners (Genesys, Amazon, Webex, and others) on roadmap access, licensing nuances, and joint solutioning for large deals.
* Validate third-party and our own AI component choices (speech engines, LLM-based voice agents, analytics) against real customer use cases.

Implementation Handoff and Feedback
  
  

* Hand over won deals to delivery/implementation teams with clean solution documentation; join the first design reviews to ensure what was sold is what gets built.
* Feed market learnings — what wins, what doesn’t, what customers ask for — back into our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)
  
  

* CCaaS depth — 6+ years designing, demonstrating, or deploying contact centre solutions on at least one leading platform (Genesys Cloud/CX, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Avaya, Webex CC) and a working command of cloud telephony: SIP, PRI/trunking, WebRTC, SBCs, DTMF, call recording, and omni-channel routing.
* Voice AI expertise — Demonstrable experience designing and delivering voice AI / conversational AI solutions: IVR and voice-bot design, ASR/STT and TTS engines (e.g., Azure Speech, Google STT, Amazon Transcribe/Polly), NLU and/or LLM-driven dialogue flows, barge-in and error handling, and real-world tuning for accuracy (WER), latency, and containment.
* Solution engineering craft — Proven track record in pre-sales: discovery, solution architecture, demos, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM and pricing support.
* India market context — Understanding of India’s telecom/enterprise landscape relevant to voice workloads: carrier numbering and provisioning practices, TRAI/DoT compliance considerations, and how enterprise contact centres buy telephony in India.
* Communication — Ability to explain architecture to CIOs and call flows to operations heads; comfortable presenting and debating in customer rooms; excellent written technical documentation.

Good to Have
  
  

* Exposure to CPaaS APIs (messaging, voice, WhatsApp) — experience with Kaleyra or similar is a plus.
* CRM and ecosystem integration knowledge (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, helpdesk platforms).
* Working knowledge of speech analytics, sentiment analysis, real-time agent-assist, and LLM-based voice agents.
* Relevant certifications (Genesys, AWS Connect, Google/cloud speech services, etc.).
* Experience with managed services or telco hosting models in the CCaaS space.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
  
  

* Technical win rate on supported opportunities; number of deals where our solution architecture and demos were decisive.
* PoC success rate and time-to-PoC.
* Quality and completeness of RFP responses and solution documentation (on-time, high first-pass accuracy).
* Accuracy of solution/BOM estimates versus won contract scope.
* Customer and internal stakeholder feedback (sales, delivery, partners).

to develop and execute ABKASA’s content strategy, creative direction and digital storytelling.

You will work closely with the founder, video creators, photographers, stylists and social media team to build brand awareness, engagement and desirability.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Content Strategy & Planning**

* Develop monthly content strategies and calendars for Instagram Reels, Stories, carousels and other relevant platforms.
* Build recurring content series around men's style, lifestyle, craftsmanship, the founder’s journey and customer stories.
* Identify relevant trends, audience interests and content opportunities.
* Balance premium brand-building content with relatable, informative and interactive content.

**2. Creative Conceptualisation & Storytelling**

* Develop original concepts for Reels, campaigns, styling videos, product launches and behind-the-scenes content.
* Write engaging hooks, scripts, captions, storyboards and creative briefs.
* Turn product features, fabric choices, embroidery and craftsmanship into compelling stories.
* Create content around occasions such as work, dinners, celebrations, social gatherings and travel.
* Develop storytelling that communicates the personality and lifestyle of the ABKASA man.

**3. Creative Direction & Production**

* Plan and direct photoshoots, video shoots and social-first content production.
* Prepare mood boards, shot lists, styling directions and production briefs.
* Coordinate with video creators/editors, photographers, models, stylists and freelancers.
* Guide outfit selection, locations, props and visual presentation.
* Maintain premium creative standards and ensure timely delivery of content.

**4. Instagram Growth & Engagement**

* Create content designed to encourage shares, saves, comments, profile visits and meaningful interactions.
* Develop interactive Stories, polls, creator collaborations and customer-generated content initiatives.
* Identify relevant creators and collaboration opportunities in fashion, grooming, travel and lifestyle.
* Stay updated on Instagram features, formats and emerging content trends.

**5. Brand Identity & Consistency**

* Develop and maintain ABKASA’s visual language, tone of voice and storytelling style.
* Ensure that all content reflects a contemporary, masculine, distinctive and premium brand identity.
* Study successful Indian and international fashion and lifestyle brands to identify inspiration and opportunities for differentiation.
* Work with the founder on collection launches, campaigns and key creative decisions.

**6. Performance Analysis**

* Monitor content performance through Instagram Insights and Meta Business Suite.
* Track reach, watch time, retention where available, saves, shares, comments, follower growth and website visits.
* Identify successful content themes and experiment with different hooks, formats and storytelling approaches.
* Prepare regular performance reports and use insights to improve future content.

**7. Team & Workflow Management**

* Coordinate with the video creator/editor, social media executive and external creative partners.
* Manage briefs, deadlines, approvals, production schedules and creative assets.
* Ensure consistent content delivery within approved budgets.
* Present creative ideas, progress updates and performance insights to the founder.

Required Skills

* Strong creative thinking and storytelling ability.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories and short-form video formats.
* Strong visual sense, styling awareness and understanding of brand aesthetics.
* Interest in men's fashion, designer wear, contemporary culture and lifestyle branding.
* Good copywriting, scriptwriting and communication skills.
* Ability to conceptualise campaigns and direct content shoots.
* Familiarity with Instagram Insights, Meta Business Suite and content analytics.
* Strong planning, project management and coordination skills.
* Ability to combine creativity with data-driven decision-making.
* Proactive attitude, attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.

**Tools:**
Google Sheets, Canva/PowerPoint, Meta Business Suite and content-planning tools such as Notion or Trello. Basic editing knowledge is an advantage.

Candidate Profile

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in content creation, creative strategy, brand marketing or social media.
* Experience with fashion, lifestyle, apparel, premium retail or D2C brands is preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating original concepts, campaigns, Reels or brand storytelling.
* Experience coordinating shoots, editors, creators or production teams.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate closely with the founder.
* Relevant qualifications are desirable, but portfolio quality and practical ability matter more.

Key Performance Indicators

* Consistent and timely delivery of the monthly content calendar.
* Quality, originality and consistency of creative output.
* Growth in relevant audience reach, saves, shares and engagement.
* Improvement in content retention and discovery among non-followers.
* Effective execution of creator collaborations and campaigns.
* Contribution to product enquiries, website traffic and sales where measurable.

What We Are Looking For

We want someone who thinks beyond simply posting on social media. Someone who understands how to make a fashion brand interesting, how to communicate the story behind a product, and how to build a community around a lifestyle and identity.

You should be curious about fashion, creatively ambitious, commercially aware and passionate about turning ideas into high-quality content.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and portfolio, along with links to relevant brand accounts or campaigns. Include three examples of content you personally conceptualised or executed and any available performance results.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to an interview and a practical creative assignment.

**Join ABKASA and help shape the content, identity and next phase of a growing designer menswear brand.**

title: Launchpad Fellowship
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

**The Role**

The
**Launchpad Fellowship**
is a full-time, in-office internship designed for final-year students and recent graduates looking to gain meaningful, hands-on experience before stepping into their first full-time role.

You’ll work closely with teams across operations, growth, research, strategy, customer experience, product, and process improvement, gaining exposure to how a high-growth startup operates, makes decisions, and solves real customer problems at scale.

**The Job**

* **Growth, Research & Strategy:**
  Work on business problems across growth and strategy, conduct research, identify opportunities, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Operations & Customer Experience:**
  Work on real customer journeys, manage core visa operations, and understand how we deliver a seamless experience at scale.
* **Product & Process Improvement:**
  Identify user pain points and operational inefficiencies, and work with product and process teams to build better solutions, tools, and workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Work closely with different teams, take ownership of projects, and learn to prioritise, move quickly, and solve problems in a fast-paced startup environment.
* **Capstone & Leadership Exposure:**
  Take ownership of a real business challenge, develop a solution, and present your work to leadership, while receiving regular mentorship and feedback throughout the fellowship.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a final-year student or recent graduate looking for a full-time, in-office, high-intensity internship.
* Are a quick learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and unfamiliar problems.
* Communicate clearly and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do.
* Are curious about product, operations, customer experience, or how businesses work.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy figuring things out independently.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**
  , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Tutor - Digital Trust
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
  
  
**Purpose of the position**

* Deliver public training courses and in-house training as per BSI standards of excellence, in order to develop knowledge and skills of delegates. Typical domains (in which BSI trainings are delivered) comprise information security, IT service management, business continuity management, data privacy and risk management.

* Ensure that value is added to customers and their business/organisation through the delivery of BSI training courses (examples of domains mentioned above)
* Continually enhance the reputation and perception of BSI through excellent delivery of training courses/solutions and day-to-day interactions with customers and other key stakeholders
* Mentor & qualify new and existing tutors on tutor competencies, learning styles and accelerated learning techniques. Proactively engage with BSI tutors and key stakeholders to ensure continual improvement, in line with the BSI standards of excellence for training delivery
* Provide feedback to support course development in line with the new course and existing product development process and methodologies
* Provide advice on the design of training solutions (e.g. classroom training, virtual training, or hybrid modes of training delivery).

**Act as a brand ambassador for BSI by demonstrating professionalism, ethical conduct, and promoting BSI services to help clients “Make Excellence a Habit.”**
**Key Results Areas**

* Achieve high level of customer satisfaction (9 or above, out of 10)
* Training course development for various formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid, etc.)
* Coaching and qualifying new and existing BSI tutors to deliver as per BSI standards of excellence
* Engage with key clients and propose training solutions in accordance with BSI standards and formats. Manage key client expectations from proposal to delivery.
* Demonstrate continual professional development in best practices for ITES sector, with focus on information security, service management, business continuity management and data privacy. Disseminate knowledge and skills to BSI India tutors on such new products and practices.

**Customer Focus**

* Able to interpret data and information about the Customer to solve problem, add value and exceed expectations
* Can be recognised by the Customer as an industry/sector or market expert and provides thought leadership/development in customer’s industry
* Able to demonstrate high quality and reliability in delivery

**Training Operations Delivery**

* Able to demonstrate high levels of organisational skills; ensuring all facilities, materials and equipment is to BSI standard of excellence
* Can deliver training to ensure compliance and BSI standards of excellence are met at all times
* Able to communicate effectively with delegates at all levels in order to motivate and engage them for learning.
* Can proactively deal with issues during training delivery and provide resolution.
* Demonstrate the ability to make improvements to course content based on customer evaluation feedback and training needs analysis

**Candidate Specification (minimum Skills And Experience)**

* Having experience of 10 years in the IT/ ITES industry; worked in IT service operations, with exposure to IT service management, information security, data privacy and business continuity management.
* Where appropriate, a qualified internal or lead auditor in these disciplines.
* Ability to coherently deliver training courses across the full spectrum of the delegate profile
* Knowledge of individual learning styles and how to address these through the design and development of training courses through the use of accelerated learning techniques.
* Proven administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage customer expectations
* Travel within the country is required.

**Essential**

* Certified Tutor and Lead Auditor for ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO/IEC 42001 Management System standards.
* More than 5 years of hands-on experience in conducting management system trainings and audits across diverse organizations.
* Extensive expertise in delivering professional training, including lead auditor and awareness programs for international standards.

**Desirable**

* Certified for delivering in Payment Card Industry – PCI DSS, CSA Star and other ISO based trainings. CB background preferred but not essential for qualified candidates.

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular travel required for on-site assessments.

**Language Requirements**

* Proficiency in Business English (written and spoken).

**BSI**
**Excellence behaviours**

* Client Centric – I put internal and external clients at the centre of my thinking. I am proud to deliver outstanding client service.
* Collaboration – I build trust-based relationships through my ability to communicate openly and honestly. I value what others bring and I work inclusively with others at all times.
* Agility - I am open to change and willing to adapt my ways of working. I explore new ideas and ways to improve things to grow the business effectively.

**About Us**
BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
  
  
Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
  
  
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
  
  
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
  
  
BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Licensed Clinical Psychologist
description:
**Company Description**
  
  
Mind Mining Pvt. Ltd. is a mental health services organization focused on delivering evidence-based psychological care and support. The company is committed to improving emotional well-being through professional counseling, assessment, and therapeutic interventions. Mind Mining collaborates with multidisciplinary professionals to design personalized treatment plans for diverse client populations. The organization values ethical practice, client-centered care, and continuous professional development for its team members.
  
**Role Description**

* Demonstrated expertise in Mental Health care, including assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of a range of emotional and behavioral conditions.
* Experience in Clinical Supervision or mentoring, supporting trainees or junior professionals in developing clinical skills and ethical practice.
* Recognized license or registration as a Clinical Psychologist, in line with relevant regulatory or professional bodies.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work sensitively with diverse client groups.
* Ability to manage a structured caseload, maintain confidentiality, and adhere to professional and ethical standards.
* Comfort with hybrid work arrangements, including effective use of telehealth platforms and digital record systems.
* Previous experience in a clinical, hospital, or counseling center setting is highly beneficial.

title: Capital Raising & Investor Relations
description:
**Company: Triverra Holdings**
**Location:**
Bengaluru (Manyata Tech Park) | Mumbai and Delhi NCR (Remote)
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ years preferred
  
  
**Compensation:**
₹30–36 LPA fixed, depending on experience, plus performance-linked incentives
  
  
**About Triverra Holdings**
Triverra Holdings is building an AI and robotics venture studio and developing an upcoming Alternative Investment Fund (AIF). The company is looking for an experienced capital-raising professional who can mobilise investments through HNI/UHNI investors, family offices, and wealth management networks.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a capital-raising professional with a strong investor network and a proven track record of personally sourcing and closing investments.
  
  
The immediate focus is to mobilise
**USD 5–7 million over the next 3–6 months**
, while contributing to the long-term goal of building a
**USD 100 million AIF corpus**
.
  
  
This is initially an individual contributor role, with direct responsibility for investor outreach, fundraising, and capital mobilisation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Raise capital from HNIs, UHNIs, family offices, and other qualified investors.
* Leverage existing investor relationships to generate fundraising opportunities.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective investors.
* Develop relationships with wealth managers, private bankers, investment advisers, and distribution partners.
* Present investment opportunities and communicate the venture studio's investment thesis.
* Manage investor discussions, follow-ups, negotiations, and conversion into investment commitments.
* Build strategic relationships with family offices and institutional investors.
* Support fundraising for the upcoming AIF and other investment opportunities.
* Track fundraising progress, investor commitments, and conversion performance against targets.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* 8+ years of relevant experience in capital raising, private wealth management, private banking, investor relations, or alternative investment distribution.
* A demonstrable track record of personally sourcing and closing equity investments or investment commitments.
* Strong relationships with HNIs, UHNIs, family offices, and other qualified investors.
* Access to investors capable of making individual investments of ₹1 crore or more.
* Experience raising capital through PMS, AIFs, private equity, venture capital, or other alternative investment vehicles.
* Established relationships with wealth managers, private bankers, IFAs, or other investor distribution channels.
* Ability to independently generate investor leads and convert them into capital commitments.
* Strong negotiation, relationship management, and investor communication skills.
* Experience with family offices and institutional investors will be an advantage.

Who Should Apply?
  
  
**Professionals Currently Working As**

* Capital Raising or Fundraising Heads
* Investor Relations professionals with direct fundraising responsibility
* Private Wealth Management professionals with HNI/UHNI relationships
* Private Bankers and Senior Relationship Managers with proven investment mobilisation
* PMS/AIF Distribution professionals with demonstrated fundraising results
* Family Office Investment and Capital Mobilisation professionals

**Important:**
Candidates whose experience is limited to managing AUM, selling financial products, handling investor servicing, or supporting fundraising without personally sourcing and closing capital may not be suitable.
  
  
Compensation & Location
  
  

* Fixed CTC: Up to ₹30 LPA for 8–12 years of relevant experience and up to ₹36 LPA for 13+ years, subject to fit.
* Performance Incentives: Additional performance-linked incentives may be considered based on fundraising outcomes and agreed terms.
* Bengaluru: On-site at Manyata Tech Park.
* Mumbai and Delhi NCR: Remote arrangements may be considered.
* Other locations: Exceptional candidates may be considered remotely.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Building a qualified pipeline of HNI/UHNI and family-office investors.
* Independently sourcing and converting investor relationships into commitments.
* Contributing towards the immediate USD 5–7 million fundraising target.
* Supporting the long-term development of a USD 100 million AIF corpus.

title: Director (Portfolio Support)
description:
ACT is looking for a Director (Portfolio Support) to lead its new Systems Scale Acceleration Unit (SSAU), a dedicated platform that builds the capabilities, networks and institutional readiness high-potential nonprofits and social enterprises need to move from proven innovation to population-scale impact. This is a leadership role.
  
  
We are looking for a leader with experience in the impact sector, someone who has worked inside nonprofits or social enterprises in operating roles such as fundraising, operations, technology or programs, and understands firsthand what it takes to move from a proven model to scale. You will lead the Unit’s full scope: strategic fundraising support, facilitating engagement with the public sector, supporting technology adoption, sharing knowledge, and building new capabilities as the Unit evolves. You will be supported by two team members who will focus on fundraising and public systems engagement respectively.
  
  
**About ACT**
ACT provides catalytic capital to founders building category-defining innovations for population-scale impact. We provide flexible, risk-tolerant grant capital to founders aiming to create “impact unicorns”: ventures that use technology and other innovation to solve large, systemic challenges in sectors such as education, health and environment.
  
  
Over the past five years, ACT has developed a distinctive venture philanthropy model. We support organisations early, provide the risk capital needed to experiment and innovate, and double down on those showing strong signals of scale. Till date, ACT has supported 60+ technology-led impact organisations, including Rocket Learning, Khushi Baby, Adalat AI, Indra Water and Forus Health.
  
  
**About The Systems Scale Acceleration Unit**
India has a growing pipeline of high-potential, impact-focused organisations, but many are not yet institutionally equipped to make the transition to systems-scale impact. Proven pathways for government adoption exist, yet they vary widely across sectors, geographies and institutional contexts, and early innovators occasionally lack the capacity to adapt them.
  
  
ACT is incubating the SSAU to close this gap. The Unit builds the capabilities organisations need most on this journey: government engagement and adoption pathways, strategic fundraising and scale-capital readiness, technology adoption, evidence generation, scale strategy and ecosystem partnerships.
  
  
**The Unit Will Work Across Five Complementary Areas**

* Scale-readiness programs: cohort-based programs, co-created with founders, that address common barriers to systems-scale adoption.
* Embedded fundraising and market intelligence: hands-on support that operates as an extension of founding teams.
* A library of systems-scale knowledge: practical playbooks, case studies and learning forums drawn from the sector's existing body of knowledge.
* Pathways for institutional navigation: access to the people and organisations with deep public sector knowledge and trusted public sector relationships.
* Digital public goods: reusable technology assets, toolkits and workflow solutions that address common scale barriers.

**Role Description**
This is a high-ownership leadership role at the intersection of strategy, fundraising and ecosystem-building. As Director, you will set the Unit’s direction, build and lead its team, and stay close to founders on the highest-stakes moments in their scale journey. You will:
  
  

* Lead the Unit: Own the strategy, delivery, budget and outcomes of the SSAU, and serve as its senior-most representative internally and externally. Build and lead a team that includes a Lead (Portfolio Fundraising) and a Lead (Public Systems).
* Provide embedded fundraising support: Guide the Unit’s work as an extension of founding teams across funder mapping, pitch refinement, positioning and diligence preparation. Engage directly on key funder relationships and help portfolio organisations build clear pathways to larger scale capital.
* Pilot and institutionalise scale-readiness programs: Design and manage cohort-based programs, possibly delivered with specialist partners. Co-create them with founders, refine them through feedback, and codify them into repeatable models.
* Oversee institutional navigation and the knowledge library: Ensure founders can reach the public sector stakeholders, experts and implementers they need, and guide the curation of existing knowledge on scaling through public systems into playbooks, case studies and learning forums.
* Contribute to digital public goods: Identify opportunities to codify reusable technology assets, implementation toolkits and workflow solutions into DPGs that benefit the wider sector.
* Measure and report impact: Track progress against the Unit's outcomes, and communicate learnings and results to ACT's leadership, partners and funders.

**Required Qualifications**
We are looking for a senior, high-agency leader with a strong track record and a genuine interest in building institutions that scale impact. The ideal candidate will bring:
  
  

* Leadership experience in impact organisations: 8–12 years of experience, including senior roles leading fundraising, operations, technology or programmes in nonprofits or sociel enterprises.
* Depth in fundraising, technology or public systems: Hands-on experience in at least one of these areas, and enough fluency in the others to direct and support a specialist.
* Relationships built on trust: The ability to build deep, lasting relationships with individuals and institutions, especially funding organisations and the public sector.
* Hustle with high standards: The drive to move fast without compromising on quality, working at the pace our founders deserve.
* Team building: The ability to hire, develop and bring out the best in a small, high-calibre team with a mix of seniority, which may be geographically dispersed.
* Collaborative leadership: Comfort working alongside ACT's leadership to jointly define the Unit's vision, manage progress and communicate it transparently.

title: Structural Forensic & Diagnostic Engineer
description:
**About RAMS Digital**

RAMS Digital, a product of INODE – RAMS Built Env Tech Pvt. Ltd., is transforming warehouse safety, efficiency, and compliance through Digital Twin technology, IoT-based monitoring, and advanced structural diagnostics.

By combining deep domain expertise in racking systems with cutting-edge technology, we help businesses understand what is physically happening inside their warehouses and make data-driven decisions.

🌐 Learn more: https://www.rams.digital

**What You’ll Do**

This is more than a conventional structural engineering role. You’ll investigate, analyse, and evaluate some of the tallest and most complex warehouse racking structures, combining on-ground audits, structural analysis, forensic investigations, and technology-driven engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Structural Audits Using Digital Twin Technology**

* Map warehouse racking systems, including structures up to 43 metres high, into a digital environment.
* Identify and classify beam deflections, bracing failures, corrosion, anchorage issues, and frame misalignments.
* Prepare digital inspection reports with risk assessments and repair recommendations.

**2. Structural Revalidation & Design Analysis**

* Perform structural calculations in accordance with applicable engineering codes and standards.
* Evaluate warehouse-specific loading conditions, material handling equipment (MHE) interactions, impact loads, and lateral drift.
* Analyse frame stability, load paths, buckling, and anchorage failures.

**3. Forensic Structural Investigations**

* Conduct post-incident investigations involving rack failures or structural collapses.
* Reconstruct incidents using site evidence, Digital Twin models, and back-analysis of loading conditions.
* Identify root causes, design deficiencies, and operational violations, and recommend corrective actions.

**4. Retrofit, Repair & Strengthening Design**

* Develop engineering solutions involving member replacement, additional bracing, anchorage redesign, and customised strengthening.
* Validate proposed solutions using the RAMS platform and simulate their performance before implementation.

**5. Technology-Driven Structural Diagnostics**

* Use Digital Twin technology for structural visualisation, inspection, and issue tracking.
* Explore AI-powered drone integration for detecting tilt, deflection, and component misalignment.
* Work with IoT-based monitoring systems for impact tracking, vibration analysis, and structural health indicators.

**What Makes This Role Unique?**

* Work at the intersection of structural engineering, forensic investigation, and advanced technology.
* Solve real-world engineering challenges across warehouses in India and international markets.
* Gain hands-on exposure to complex industrial structures and technology-enabled diagnostics.
* Explore career growth opportunities in technical leadership, product development, and specialised structural audit consulting.
* Work with leading brands and global warehouse operations.
