title: Associate Specialist – Hydraulics
description:
**Job Description**
**Position Requirements**
Provide high-quality CFD and hydraulics support while contributing as an experienced mechanical engineer across new product development, engineering testing, proof-of-concept development, rapid prototyping, design improvement and product issue resolution. The role combines deep analytical capability with hands-on product engineering and cross-functional execution
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**CFD, Hydraulics and Simulation Support**

* Perform CFD and hydraulic analyses for Pentair products and systems, including flow distribution, pressure drop, thermal-flow interaction where applicable, cavitation risk, pump/system performance and design optimization.
* Develop appropriate analysis plans, modelling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies and solver approaches; assess result quality and clearly communicate limitations and engineering implications.
* Provide project teams with timely, decision-oriented technical recommendations rather than analysis output alone.
* Support root-cause investigations and product issue resolution using simulation, first-principles engineering and test evidence.
* Promote consistent CFD and hydraulics methods, templates, review practices and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Mechanical Engineering, NPD and Product Realization**

* Contribute across the NPD lifecycle, from problem definition and concept generation through detailed design, verification, validation and design transfer support.
* Develop and evaluate mechanical concepts, layouts and design trade-offs using sound engineering judgement, calculations, CAD and simulation.
* Work with laboratories and technicians to define test objectives, test setups, instrumentation, acceptance criteria and data interpretation.
* Apply design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly, tolerance, material and cost considerations when maturing concepts into product-ready solutions.
* Support value engineering, cost reduction, reliability improvement, field failure analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, turbomachinery, and mechanical design.
* Hands-on expertise with Ansys CFX and/or Ansys Fluent for pump or turbomachinery applications.
* Practical experience in geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence assessment, and CFD post-processing.
* Experience with centrifugal pump hydraulic design and performance characteristics, including head, flow, efficiency, power, NPSH and cavitation.
* Proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo/ProE or equivalent, including solid modelling, surface modelling and assemblies.
* Working knowledge of pump design tools such as CFturbo, BladeGen or equivalent is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or equivalent language for engineering calculations, data processing, or workflow automation.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Strong analytical thinking with a hands-on, product-focused mindset.
* Comfort operating across both specialist analysis work and broader mechanical engineering assignments.
* Ownership, adaptability and the ability to progress work despite incomplete information.
* Effective teamwork, mentoring, stakeholder management and technical communication.
* Commitment to engineering quality, safety, integrity and continuous learning.

**Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, preferably with specialization in CFD, turbomachinery, thermal engineering or a related field.
* 5-7 years of relevant professional experience in CFD analysis and mechanical or hydraulic design.
* Demonstrated experience with pumps, turbines, or other rotating machinery is strongly preferred.

**Added Advantage**

* Experience correlating CFD results with laboratory test data and supporting prototype validation.
* Exposure optimization, process automation, AI/ML applications in engineering, or patent-related product development.
* Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, sustaining engineering, and new product development for industrial products.
* Position title will be given based on the experience & work capability of the candidate

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

title: Monitoring and Evaluation Officer, South Asia Hub – Health Systems (Learning and Impact)
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About The Project**
PATH works with governments and partners to strengthen health systems and improve the availability, quality, and use of data for program planning, implementation, and decision-making. Across its health systems portfolio, PATH supports monitoring, evaluation, learning, assessments, digital data systems, analytics, and evidence generation to improve program performance and health outcomes.
  
  
The Monitoring & Evaluation function supports project teams to establish practical measurement systems, strengthen data quality, track progress against agreed indicators, generate actionable insights, and document learning. The M&E Officer will contribute to these efforts across assigned projects and work closely with program, technical, digital, research, and implementation teams.
  
  

* Strengthen routine monitoring systems, indicator tracking, and data quality across projects.
* Support assessments, analysis, visualization, reporting, and evidence generation for program improvement.
* Promote the use of data and learning for adaptive management and decision-making.

**About The Position**
PATH is seeking a Monitoring & Evaluation Officer to support monitoring, evaluation, learning, and data-use activities across health systems projects. Reporting to the Lead - Learning and Impact, the M&E Officer will support the design and implementation of M&E frameworks, data-collection systems, assessments, data-quality processes, analysis, visualization, reporting, and documentation of learning. The position will work closely with project teams and partners to ensure that timely, reliable, and actionable evidence is available for program management and decision-making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the Lead – Learning and Impact in developing and updating the project’s results framework, logframe, MEL plan, indicator reference sheets, data management plans, data dictionaries, and M&E standard operating procedures, with clear definitions, data sources, frequency, responsibilities, and quality standards.
* Help set baselines and targets for key project indicators and track progress against them on a regular basis.
* Design, test, and update data collection tools such as surveys, facility checklists, and interview guides, including digital forms on platforms such as KoBoToolbox or ODK.
* Train state and city teams, field staff, and partners on data collection tools, sampling, informed consent, and data quality.
* Coordinate routine monitoring and periodic assessments, including baseline, midline, and endline data collection across intervention geographies.
* Carry out regular data quality checks, including spot checks, back-checks, and data verification visits; document errors found and corrections made.
* Ensure project data is stored securely and handled in line with PATH’s data protection and research ethics standards; maintain structured, well-documented, and version-controlled datasets with appropriate metadata and access controls.
* Clean, analyse, triangulate, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; disaggregate findings as appropriate, conduct trend and gap analyses, and maintain progress trackers and dashboards in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to generate actionable insights for programme teams.
* Support government counterparts at state, district, and city level in analysing and using routine data from HMIS, AB-HWC, and other national portals for planning and review.
* Draft monthly, quarterly, and annual progress reports, donor reports, and data summaries, clearly separating observed data from estimates and stating data limitations.
* Support the design and management of internal assessments and external evaluations, including development of protocols, sampling approaches, analysis plans, terms of reference, review of tools, ethics-related documentation where applicable, and quality assurance during fieldwork.
* Coordinate with external data-collection, research, or evaluation agencies/consultants, as required, to ensure adherence to agreed methodology, data-quality standards, timelines, and deliverables.
* Help organise review meetings and learning sessions; support the project learning agenda, document lessons learned, case studies, and good practices, and track agreed actions so that monitoring and evaluation findings are used for course correction and programme improvement.
* Prepare technical reports, impactful presentations, and knowledge products for government, donor, and internal audiences.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor from time to time for the smooth functioning of the program and to achieve program goals.
* Available to travel up to 30-40% of the time.

**Required Experience And Qualifications.**

* Master’s degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Statistics, Population Studies, Health Informatics, Social Work, Economics, Development Studies, or a related field.
* At least 3-5 years of professional experience in monitoring and evaluation of public health or development programmes.
* Hands-on experience in designing data collection tools, managing field data collection, implementing data-quality assurance processes, managing datasets, and analysing programme data.
* Working knowledge of at least one statistical package such as Stata, SPSS, or R, with a sound understanding of quantitative analysis; experience with qualitative data analysis is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated understanding of results-based monitoring, indicator design, target setting, sampling, data-quality assessment, and interpretation of routine health information systems.
* Experience with digital data collection platforms such as KoBoToolbox, ODK, or SurveyCTO.
* Experience with INGOs in the health sector and/ or Ministries of Health, government is preferable.
* Familiarity with Indian public health system, health data sources, and flagship initiatives such as NHM, NUHM, Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centers, PM-ABHIM, XV-FC, and HMIS.

**Skills/ Abilities**

* Self-starter and committed to performing their duties with a high degree of autonomy and independence in line with project goals and objectives.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and research ethics.
* Ability to explain data and findings in simple language to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to translate monitoring, assessment, and evaluation findings into clear recommendations and follow-up actions for technical and programme teams.
* Strong written and oral communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi.
* Direct experience of working with government health functionaries, district level administrators and other development partners on data and reporting.
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with dashboards such as Power BI or Tableau and GIS mapping is desirable. Familiarity with database management or automated data workflows would be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate in a matrix organizational structure.
* Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines.

Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
As the Support Platform Administrator, you will play a key role in ensuring the stability, configuration, and ongoing enablement of the enterprise support platform. You will be responsible for managing platform configuration, supporting operational workflows, enabling reporting, and ensuring governance as the platform scales across teams, while leveraging AI and automation capabilities to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and drive smarter support operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage users, roles, and permissions to ensure secure, compliant, and role-based access across the platform
* Configure and maintain queues, workflows, routing logic, and macros to enable efficient and standardized ticket handling
* Perform day-to-day platform health checks, monitor system performance, and proactively resolve configuration or workflow issues
* Support supervisors and operations teams with dashboards and reporting capabilities, ensuring accurate and consistent data availability
* Coordinate configuration changes, ensure proper documentation, and partner with engineering or vendors for enhancements or escalations
* Manage API integrations, webhooks, and certificates while monitoring integration health and troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Maintenance of our existing automation and alerting systems
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and enhance platform efficiency through configuration
* Leverage AI and automation capabilities (e.g., workflow automation, AI-driven routing, virtual agents, Copilot integrations) to improve support efficiency and reduce manual effort
* Identify repetitive support tasks and enable automation through workflows, APIs, or AI-driven solutions in collaboration with engineering
* Monitor adoption and effectiveness of AI and automation features, continuously refining configurations to improve accuracy and outcomes
* Investigate and resolve automation-related issues promptly to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted support services.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including Support, Development, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, streamline workflows, and improve system performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
* 6-8 years of experience with ITSM or support platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Zendesk, Sprinklr)
* Strong understanding of: Workflow configuration and routing logic, Role-based access control (RBAC) and permissions, Automation, Reporting and dashboard enablement
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale support or service operations
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and SaaS platforms
* Familiarity with database management systems including MongoDB and SQL Server.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to stay updated with emerging technology trends and their applicability to productivity and collaboration.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google Ads)
description:
**We’re hiring an Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google) at Neuroid**

Location: Ghitorni, New Delhi

Setup: In-office (4 days WFO)

Type: Full-time

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

We’re hiring an Account Manager to own the relationship side of 8 to 10 D2C accounts. You sit between the founder, the media buyers and the client. The buyers run the ads; you run the account - the numbers, the conversation, the next step, and the renewal. This is not a client-servicing role where you forward emails. If you can’t open Ads Manager and explain why ROAS moved without a buyer in the room, this isn’t for you.

**What you’ll do**

* Weekly performance reviews with every client: what we spent, what it returned, what changes next week, sent before they ask
* The relationship: you are the first call for every account you hold; the founder is the escalation, not the default
* Scope and renewals: track what was promised, flag scope creep, run the renewal conversation 30 days before expiry
* Churn prevention: spot an unhappy account early and fix it with the buyer, not after the client has already decided
* Creative and content coordination: make sure what the buyer needs from the content team is briefed, dated and delivered
* Upsell: know when a client is ready for Google, retention or a creative mandate, and make the case

**Who this is for**

* 2 to 4 years in performance marketing for D2C or ecommerce - ideally a media buyer who now wants to own accounts, or an AM at a performance agency who actually understands the ads
* You know what a healthy D2C P&L looks like: ROAS, CAC, AOV, contribution margin, and why a brand at 2X might be fine and a brand at 4X might not be
* You write clearly, run a meeting without a deck, and are comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear
* You’ve managed at least 5 accounts at once and nobody slipped
* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

* 8 to 10 named accounts from day one, with real authority over how they’re run
* Direct access to the founder, the Head of Ops and the buyers; no layers
* A path to Head of Accounts as the book grows

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Account Manager”. Tell us in three to five lines about one account you saved or grew, with numbers. No cover letters.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
**About the Role**

We’re looking for a creatively driven Senior Copywriter who can turn brand briefs into compelling stories, sharp messaging, and memorable campaign ideas.

The ideal candidate has agency-side experience working across multiple brands and categories, with a strong portfolio of digital campaigns, brand communication, and creative concepts. You should be equally comfortable crafting a powerful headline, developing a campaign narrative, or brainstorming a big idea that gives a brand a distinctive voice.

We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond the words someone who understands the audience, challenges the obvious, and knows how to make brand communication relevant, engaging, and impactful.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Creative Ideation & Campaign Development**

* Lead copy-led ideation and conceptualisation for brand campaigns, digital-first campaigns, product launches, and integrated marketing initiatives.
* Develop original campaign ideas, creative territories, communication platforms, and storytelling approaches aligned with brand objectives.
* Translate client briefs, consumer insights, and cultural observations into distinctive creative concepts.
* Collaborate with art directors and designers to develop cohesive campaign ideas and compelling creative executions.

**Copywriting & Brand Storytelling**

* Write compelling headlines, taglines, campaign scripts, social media copy, ad copies, website content, landing pages, and other brand communication.
* Develop strong brand narratives and adapt messaging across formats, platforms, and audience segments.
* Build and maintain distinct brand voices while ensuring consistency across campaign touchpoints.
* Write scripts and storylines for digital films, reels, videos, and other content formats, wherever required.

**Strategic Thinking & Client Collaboration**

* Understand brand positioning, campaign objectives, target audiences, and consumer behaviour to develop relevant communication.
* Present and articulate creative ideas, explaining the thinking behind the concept and its relevance to the brand.
* Work closely with strategists, account managers, designers, and production teams to take ideas from brief to execution.
* Incorporate feedback constructively while protecting the core strength of the creative idea.

**Quality & Creative Excellence**

* Edit and proofread copy to ensure clarity, originality, accuracy, and consistency with brand guidelines.
* Stay curious about advertising, pop culture, emerging digital formats, and consumer conversations.
* Bring fresh perspectives to brainstorming sessions and continuously push for stronger, more distinctive creative work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4–6 years of relevant copywriting experience, preferably in a creative, advertising, or digital agency.
* Experience working across multiple brands, industries, and campaign briefs.
* A strong portfolio showcasing campaign concepts, original copy, brand storytelling, and digital creative work.
* Proven ability to contribute to campaign ideation and develop ideas beyond routine social media content.
* Excellent command of language, storytelling, tone of voice, and creative writing.
* The ability to translate a brief into a clear creative direction and compelling communication.
* Strong collaboration, presentation, and communication skills.
* Someone who is curious, culturally aware, receptive to feedback, and comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment.

What Matters Most

We’re looking for someone who can take a brief, find the interesting story within it, and turn that story into an idea people remember.

**If your portfolio demonstrates how you think, conceptualise, and write - not just what you publish - we’d love to hear from you.**

Please share your portfolio or relevant campaign case studies along with your application.

title: Account Manager
description:
**We’re Hiring: Account Manager (Client Decoder & Internal Orchestrator)**

Most Account Managers operate as glorified postmen—they take a messy email from a client, forward it to the creative team, and watch the chaos unfold. We aren’t looking for a postman.

We are looking for a lethal Account Manager who operates in the future. We need someone with the emotional intelligence to decode exactly what a client
*actually*
wants, and the internal leadership to rally our creative and performance teams to deliver it flawlessly. If you thrive on proactive organization and hate last-minute scrambles, this is your room.

**What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Work):**

* **The Client Decoder:**
  Clients don't always know how to articulate their business problems. You will read between the lines, extract their true objectives, manage their expectations, and translate their feedback into razor-sharp, actionable briefs for our team.
* **The 30-Day Proactive Rule:**
  You do not operate reactively. Your core mandate is to build systems and timelines that ensure we are fully prepped, aligned, and have assets ready
  **30 days**
  before the client even realizes they need them. You eliminate the "urgent" agency culture.
* **The Internal Diplomat:**
  You are the bridge between the client and the agency, but you fiercely protect the internal team's time. You build immense rapport with our designers, copywriters, and media buyers because you bring them clarity, structured timelines, and zero friction.
* **Account Growth & Strategy:**
  You don’t just farm accounts; you grow them. Because you are constantly 30 days ahead, you have the mental bandwidth to pitch new strategic initiatives, cross-sell services, and act as a true growth partner to the founders we work with.
* **Expectation Management:**
  You are comfortable saying "no" to a client when a request threatens the quality of the work or the timeline, but you do it with such tact that they thank you for it.

**Who You Are:**

* **You are a master communicator:**
  You can de-escalate a panicked client on a phone call and immediately write a clear, calm Slack update to the internal team.
* **You are hyper-organized:**
  Your project management boards (ClickUp, Asana, Notion) are immaculate. You track deliverables with military precision.
* **You are a culture multiplier:**
  The internal team actually
  *wants*
  to work on your accounts because you make their jobs easier, not harder.
* **You understand digital marketing:**
  You aren't just a people person; you understand performance marketing, creative strategy, and D2C brand growth enough to have highly technical conversations with both the client and the media buying team.

**If you know how to build deep client trust and keep an agency running 30 days ahead of schedule, apply below.**

title: Founders’ Office ( IITian Preferred)
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

**Tier One Education, IIT/IIM Preferred.**

**Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A consistent growth story will be awarded.**

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Product owner, Analytical Skills, Business Acumen, and Stakeholder Management as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
You will work closely with business, operations and cross-functional partners to solve complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and ensure efficient delivery. Acting as the key interface between business and functional stakeholders, you will support the development of product propositions, and/or service strategies—from concept and release.
  
  
To be successful as an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Critical / Essential Skills**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.
* Extract and analyse data from Barclays Information Warehouse using Structured Query Language, translating complex datasets into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify fraud loss trends, performance drivers, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Use management information, dashboards, funnel data, complaints, contact drivers and customer feedback to support evidence-based decision-making.
* Own and assess customer journeys end to end, map pain points and conduct journey health checks to improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Establish, monitor and interpret journey and customer-outcome measures, including Net Promoter Score, complaints, customer effort, fraud losses and operational performance.
* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional and cross-skilled teams to deliver sustainable journey, fraud strategy and customer-outcome improvements.
* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Copywriter
description:
We’re looking for a
**Copywriter**
who knows how to turn ideas into copy that captures attention, builds interest, and drives action.

This role is ideal for someone who understands
**D2C brands, consumer psychology, and performance marketing,**
and enjoys experimenting with different hooks, messaging and creative angles to influence buying decisions.

If you genuinely enjoy writing, love testing what works, and want to grow with a fast-paced D2C wellness brand, we’d love to hear from you.

**About Ayuvya**

Ayuvya is building a modern Ayurveda and wellness brand rooted in trust, authenticity, and innovation.

We believe great copy is more than just creative writing-it should communicate value, build credibility, connect with consumers, and ultimately drive measurable results and conversions.

**Key Responsibilities:-﻿**

* Write performance-driven copy and video ad scripts
  **for Meta, Google, YouTube, and other digital platforms, with a focus on attention, engagement and conversions.**
* Develop strong hooks, creative angles, headlines, storytelling, value propositions and CTAs tailored to different audiences and stages of the customer journey.
* Create platform-native copy for ads, social creatives, carousels, landing pages, product pages, WhatsApp, emailers, sale campaigns, and marketplace platforms such as Amazon, Blinkit and Nykaa.
* Collaborate closely with the Performance Marketing, Design, Video, CRM and Creative teams to turn ideas and copy into engaging, on-brand, and execution-friendly creatives.
* Experiment with different hooks, messaging, formats and creative concepts, and continuously iterate based on campaign performance and audience response.
* Analyse key performance metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, Hook Rate and Hold Rate to understand creative performance and improve copy effectiveness.
* Research competitor communication, advertising strategies, consumer behaviour, and emerging content trends, including using platforms such as Meta Ads Library to identify insights and creative opportunities.
* Maintain the quality, clarity, accuracy and consistency of brand communication across all touchpoints while proofreading and editing copy and creatives before execution.

**Requirements:-**

* 1–3 years of experience in
  **Copywriting, preferably with D2C, Wellness, FMCG, Beauty, Lifestyle or E-commerce brands.**
* Strong portfolio showcasing performance ad copy, video scripts, landing pages, product copy, social media email or CRM campaigns.
* Excellent command of English with strong storytelling, conceptual thinking and communication skills.
* Understanding of performance marketing, consumer psychology, customer behaviour and conversion-focused communication.
* Ability to write strong hooks, headlines, benefits, value propositions and persuasive CTAs.
* Comfortable working with performance metrics and using data and audience insights to improve creative communication.
* Ability to balance creativity with business and performance objectives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who**

* Thinks consumer-first and understands what makes people stop, read, watch, click and buy.
* Enjoys writing for performance and conversions not just engagement.
* Can turn product features into clear, relatable and persuasive benefits.
* Is comfortable testing multiple copy angles and learning from performance data.
* Brings ideas and initiative to the table instead of relying entirely on detailed briefs.
* Is open to feedback, iteration, and continuously improving their craft.

**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**

* **﻿**
  You think copywriting is limited to captions, hashtags and social media posts.
* You’re not interested in performance, testing or conversion metrics.
* You’re uncomfortable rewriting copy based on feedback or campaign performance.
* You focus only on how copy sounds without considering who it is for, why they should care and what action they should take.

title: Lead, User-Led Growth (Referrals & Affiliates)
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**User-Led Growth Lead**
to turn our 1M+ travellers into one of Atlys’s most powerful growth channels.
  
  
You’ll own the referral & affiliate program end to end, from how it is constructed and how it shows up in the product to the data and operations that make it run, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Data.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role for someone who has built something from scratch and can own both the strategy and the execution.
  
  
**The Job**

* Own the referral program construct, the incentives, reward economics and placement in the traveller journey, rebuilt from first principles and extended with new levers like an affiliate program.
* Reimagine the referral experience with Product and Engineering, from discovery and sharing to reward redemption across the app and website, shipping experiments that move the numbers.
* Understand who refers and why, digging into data on non-referrers, new referrers and power referrers and running motivation studies that turn into targeted interventions.
* Build the processes behind the program, from reward fulfilment to reporting, so it runs reliably at scale.
* Run a tight ship on delivery, executing referral and UGC campaigns relentlessly, paying every reward on time and catching fraud before it scales.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 3–4 years of experience in growth, product or strategy roles at a startup.
* Have built something from 0 to 1, ideally a referral, loyalty or user-led growth program, and taken it from idea to scale.
* Are a first-principle thinker who is deeply data-driven and lets numbers, not opinions, guide decisions.
* Have a strong grasp of consumer psychology and product, and understand how incentives, timing and UX shape user behaviour.
* Are execution-heavy with strong ops diligence: you sweat the details, close loops and ship fast.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.
