title: Software Portfolio Specialist - Delhi NCR (Hybrid)
description:
Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our Professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enables clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Software Portfolio Specialist supports the end-to-end management of the organization’s software application portfolio, from initial business need and sourcing through provisioning, ongoing administration, renewal, optimization, and retirement. This role partners with business stakeholders, Purchasing, Cybersecurity, software vendors, and other IT teams to ensure applications are effectively managed and aligned with business needs.

As a founding member of our new Delhi hub, this individual will play a key role in helping establish and shape the function locally, contributing to process development, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the team while supporting a global technology environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Software Application Management**

* Support the full lifecycle of software applications, including evaluation, onboarding, administration, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Administer software applications as assigned, including user access, license allocation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine configuration.
* Coordinate with other Technology teams on application-related security, identity/access, endpoint, infrastructure, architecture, and support requirements.
* Maintain accurate application records, including licensing information, business ownership, renewal dates, contracts, entitlements, and other portfolio data.
* Execute established policies, procedures, and controls.
* Support software license optimization and reclamation activities.
* Assist with license and user audits to promote compliance with contractual requirements.
* Gather and analyze business requirements for new applications.
* Assess existing applications to determine whether current solutions can meet a business need before introducing additional software.
* Support application integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions.
* Coordinate software demonstrations, solution discussions, and technical/vendor evaluations.
* Support cross-functional evaluation of new software, including applicable Cybersecurity, Compliance, Legal, Purchasing, and technical reviews.
* Use AI, workflow automation, and intelligent agents to modernize software asset management.
* Help develop an increasingly autonomous operating model, where routine activities are proactively identified and automated.
* Maintain application documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and administration guides.

**Procurement and Sourcing**

* Support software sourcing, procurement, contract renewal, and licensing activities.
* Engage software vendors and resellers to obtain pricing, proposals, licensing options, and product information.
* Assist with vendor negotiations and evaluate commercial options to support competitive pricing and appropriate licensing.
* Proactively analyze licensing, usage, and market options to develop innovative recommendations for cost optimization and portfolio consolidation.
* Track software agreements, renewal dates, license quantities, costs, and contractual requirements.
* Review software usage and licensing needs ahead of renewals to identify opportunities for consolidation, right-sizing, or cost avoidance.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with software vendors and internal sourcing partners.

**Incident and Request Management**

* Manage assigned software application incidents, service requests, and tasks
* Review and triage requests, gather missing information, troubleshoot application issues, and coordinate resolution.
* Serve as a liaison between end users, internal technology teams, and vendor support
* Monitor assigned queues and follow up on outstanding approvals, dependencies, and actions.
* Escalate application issues appropriately based on business impact, complexity, or required technical expertise.
* Identify recurring support issues and contribute to knowledge articles, process improvements, and self-service documentation.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Support software access requests and new application requests in accordance with established governance processes.

**Qualifications**

* Self-starter who demonstrates initiative, ownership, curiosity, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities.
* Ability to learn new technologies and platforms quickly
* Experience in software application management, application support, IT operations, and cross-functional enterprise IT environments.
* Understanding of application lifecycle management and software asset management best practices.
* Working knowledge of different types of software and licenses
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management Professional (SAM Pro) and IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident and request management.
* Experience working with software vendors, procurement processes, contracts, licensing, renewals, license optimization, and reclamation.
* Understanding of single sign-on (SSO), software installation and configuration requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting application implementations or technology projects preferred.

Ensure the database architecture is optimized for query performance, scalability, and security. Handle data migrations, backups, and data restoration processes. ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) Processes: Build and manage ETL pipelines to extract data from various sources, transform it to fit the needs of analytics and business intelligence, and load it into storage systems. Ensure data quality and consistency throughout the ETL pipeline. Data Modeling: Design and implement data models, schemas, and structures that efficiently store and retrieve data. Work with stakeholders to ensure that the data model aligns with business requirements and optimizes performance. Data Integration: Integrate data from multiple sources (internal and external) into a unified platform. Ensure proper data mapping, transformation, and consolidation across systems. Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize data processing pipelines to handle increasing volumes of data efficiently. Troubleshoot and resolve any performance bottlenecks in data processing and storage systems. Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver solutions that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning efforts. Collaborate with software engineers to integrate data systems with other software applications. Required Skills: Programming Languages: Proficiency in languages such as Python and SQL Data Pipeline & Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, Luigi, or similar workflow management systems. Big Data Technologies: Familiarity with big data platforms like Hadoop, Spark, and Hive. Data Modeling & Architecture: Experience in designing data models, schemas, and data storage architectures. title: Manager
description: * Network Automation & Orchestration: Develop low-level automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, and Puppet to configure routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto), and enforce policy-driven changes across hybrid environments. 2) Core Network Engineering: Hands-on expertise in Layer 2/3 protocols (MPLS, BGP, OSPF, VRRP, STP, VLANs) and physical/logical infrastructure design for large-scale, multi-region enterprise networks. 3) Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement version-controlled, repeatable network provisioning using Terraform modules, YAML-based configs, and Git workflows to manage complete network lifecycles. 4) Cloud Network Provisioning: Automate and manage cloud-native networking (VPCs, subnets, route tables, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, firewalls, NACLs, Security Groups) in AWS, Azure, and GCP. 5) CI/CD for Network Ops: Integrate network changes into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for test-driven deployments with linting, validation, rollback, and minimal operational downtime. 6) Internet & Perimeter Security: Configure and manage internet-edge security layers (firewall policies, DDoS protection, IPS/IDS, web proxies) and ensure secure ingress/egress traffic flows. 7) Monitoring, Telemetry & Auto-Remediation: Deploy NMS/telemetry tools (SolarWinds, Prometheus, InfluxDB) and write custom scripts for real-time alerting, anomaly detection, and event-driven remediation. 8) Troubleshooting & Packet Analysis: Perform low-level debugging using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump), flow telemetry, syslog, and routing table state analysis to resolve incidents in multi-vendor networks. 9) Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation: Collaborate with CloudOps, DevOps, Security, and platform teams to align network architecture with application needs. Maintain up-to-date HLD/LLD, runbooks, topology maps, and compliance records. 10) Innovation & Optimization: Evaluate SDN, SASE, Zero Trust, and AI-based networking solutions to continuously improve agility, reliability, and performance of the network ecosystem.

title: Principal Engineer (Conveyance – Water & Wastewater Networks)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means delivering efficient, resilient, and future-ready water supply and wastewater conveyance systems that support urban growth and environmental sustainability.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering large-scale water and wastewater network solutions, driving technical excellence and innovation across projects.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer – Conveyance, you will act as a subject matter expert and technical lead for the planning, modelling, and design of water distribution and wastewater collection systems. You will guide teams on complex assignments while remaining actively involved in critical technical deliverables. You will collaborate within a multicultural, high‑performing engineering environment and contribute to achieving project targets related to quality, schedules, technical rigor, and client satisfaction.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in the design and planning of water supply and wastewater conveyance networks.
* Lead and review development of hydraulic models (steady state and extended period simulations) for large-scale systems.
* Oversee master planning studies, including

+ Demand forecasting and load assessment
+ Land-use analysis
+ System capacity assessment and gap analysis

* Drive network optioneering and optimisation, ensuring cost-effective and sustainable solutions.
* Lead preparation and review of

+ Capital investment plans and phasing strategies
+ Implementation roadmaps for network expansion/upgrades

* Review and guide engineering design deliverables, including

+ Pipeline sizing and network layouts
+ Hydraulic calculations and system controls
+ Pumping systems and rising mains

* Provide expertise in pumping systems, including system curves, pump selection, operational strategies, and integration with networks.
* Ensure effective integration with treatment plants, reservoirs, and pump stations.
* Perform and lead technical QA/QC reviews of models, calculations, reports, and drawings.
* Support Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC projects, including constructability inputs and contractor coordination.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, civil, electrical, BIM) to ensure aligned delivery.
* Prepare and review technical reports, design basis documents, and client presentations.
* Act as a key technical interface with clients and stakeholders, supporting reviews, approvals, and technical discussions.
* Support bid/proposal development, including methodology, technical inputs, and effort estimation.
* Identify and manage technical risks, providing mitigation strategies.
* Mentor engineers and support development of technical capability within the team.
* Promote adoption of digital tools, modelling best practices, and data-driven workflows.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Hydraulic Modelling WaterGEMS & SewerGEMS,
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWorks ICM & InfoWorks WS Pro
* GIS ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Design & Coordination Civil 3D, Navisworks
* Coordination/ Clash Detection Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority with ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capability.
* Confident communicator with effective client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in multidisciplinary environments.
* High attention to quality, accuracy, and technical integrity.
* Mentorship-oriented, with focus on developing team capability.
* Committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in water and wastewater conveyance planning and design.
* Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, master planning, and detailed design of water distribution and sewer networks.
* Proven ability to lead complex modelling studies and infrastructure planning projects.
* Hands-on experience with

+ Water distribution networks
+ Wastewater collection systems (gravity + rising mains)
+ Pumping and transmission systems

* Experience in optioneering, system optimisation, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Experience in multidisciplinary infrastructure projects and coordination.
* Exposure to Design‑Build / EPC delivery models is an advantage.
* Experience in technical reviews, QA/QC, and mentoring engineers.
* Strong familiarity with international design standards and best practices.
* Experience in technical proposal preparation and client engagement.
* Awareness of BIM-enabled design environments is desirable

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)

**Preferred Attributes**

* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) / Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Experience in international projects and global delivery frameworks
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, client‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. title: Founder’s Office – Community & Growth Intern
description:
**Location:**

Chhatarpur, New Delhi

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office (mild hybrid only for genuine college/residence constraints)

**Type:**

Paid internship · Full-time

**Duration:**

3–6 months · Full-time conversion possible

**Website:**
https://zooplive.com

**About Zoop**

Zoop sells fashion through live auctions and drops. We own our supply: factory outlet stock and excess and liquidation inventory from brands and manufacturers. Our in-house studios and creators sell it live, every day, to young shoppers who want great brands at prices that feel like a steal. It’s shopping that feels like an event, not a catalogue scroll.

We sell out every auction, and our shoppers keep coming back. Our repeat rates are among the healthiest in the category.

We’re based in New Delhi and backed by Peak XV Partners (Surge) and Lumikai.

**The role**

Great products bring people in. How we treat them is what makes them stay.

We want every Zoop user to feel like part of something: a community that loves us, talks to us, shows up for every live and keeps coming back because of how we interact with them. You’ll own that.

Our WhatsApp communities are growing fast, and they’re where Zoop’s personality lives. You’ll make them warm, buzzing and personal. Every new member should feel welcomed, every regular should feel seen, and every live should feel like an event worth showing up for. We have a clear activation playbook to start from. You’ll bring it to life every day and keep making it better.

You’ll work in close proximity to the founders.

**What you’ll do**

* **Be the voice of Zoop.**

  Run our communities day to day: post, reply, react and keep conversations alive.
* **Turn members into regulars.**

  Use welcome flows, polls, contests, sneak peeks and winner shoutouts so new joiners feel like insiders and get talking.
* **Make every live an event.**

  Build anticipation before, keep the energy up during and celebrate after, while nurturing the power users who become the heart of the community.
* **Learn and bring insights in.**

  Track what drives engagement, lives and repeat purchases, then feed what members love, ask for and complain about back to the team.
* **Shape our growth engine.**

  Work with the founders on ad creatives, messaging and new channels like organic content, using what you learn from the community about what makes our shoppers tick.
* **Get hands-on across the business.**

  Pitch in on livestream ops, campaigns and new experiments as we scale, wherever the action is.

**Who we’re looking for**

* **Social.**

  You already live in online communities, you genuinely enjoy talking to people, and you know the difference between a dead group chat and a buzzing one.
* **Copywriting & creative.**

  You write sharp, fun copy in Hindi and English and switch between them the way our buyers do. You have a feel for what makes people stop, react and reply.
* **Fashion & trend first.**

  You get fashion, deals and how young Indian shoppers behave online, and you know what’s trending before it’s everywhere.
* **Consistent.**

  Community is built daily, not in bursts. You show up every day with the same energy.
* **Inquisitive & data-curious.**

  You ask why something worked, test new ideas, and care whether your work actually moved the needle.

**What success looks like**

* **Community-to-buyer conversion keeps climbing.**

  More of our community bids, buys and comes back to buy again. This is the number you own.
* Communities where members talk to each other, not just to us.
* New members who become active, loyal regulars.
* A documented community playbook the team can scale.

**Why join us**

* You’ll get a front-row seat to building a new category in India.
* You’ll work in close proximity to the founders in a team backed by Peak XV and Lumikai.
* You’ll get real ownership from day one: the community is yours to build.
* Strong performers get a clear path to a full-time role.

title: Sr. Meta Performance Marketer
description:
**We're hiring a Sr. Meta Performance Marketer at Neuroid**

Location: Ghitorni, New Delhi

Setup: In-office (4 days WFO)

Type: Full-time

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

You will own five D2C accounts end to end as the primary point of contact: structure, budgets, creative direction, the weekly call with the founder, and the number at the end of the month. If your idea of media buying is duplicating ad sets and sending a ROAS screenshot on Friday - close this tab.

**What you'll do**

\* Accounts: run 5-6 D2C accounts as primary POC - strategy, account structure, budget pacing and the weekly decision review with the client

\* Buying: full-funnel Meta with simplified structures, CAPI and event-match quality sorted, partnership ads always on, and scale governance that holds the margin floor when spend goes up

\* Creative: write the creative hypotheses with our strategists, brief the production team sitting next to you, read the signal every week and kill or scale on it

\* Numbers: accountable for revenue, MER and blended ROAS per account, not in-platform ROAS alone, and you flag the offer or landing page problem before it shows up in the ad

\* Clients: update out every Monday, proactive not reactive, and you lead renewals and upsells on your own accounts

\* Team: mentor one junior buyer and add what you learn to the Meta playbook

**Who this is for**

\* 3 to 5 years running Meta for D2C brands with real spend - ₹20L+ per month across your accounts, and you can show the before and after

\* You have taken at least one brand from a plateau to scale and can say exactly what broke and what you changed

\* Direct with clients, calm when ROAS drops, honest when the problem is the product and not the ad

\* You think in margin and MER, not just in-platform ROAS, and you can explain the difference to a founder in two minutes

\* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

\* Five accounts with crores in combined monthly spend across furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel and F&B

\* A creative team in the same room - you brief on Monday, it is shot by Wednesday

\* Weekly decision reviews with the founder and a direct line when an account needs a call made

\* Path to Team Lead on the Meta desk

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject "Sr. Meta Media Buyer".

Three to five lines on one account you scaled: starting spend, ending spend, blended ROAS or MER, and the one change that did it. Attach one screenshot of that account with the brand name blurred. No cover letters.

title: Client Servicing
description:
**About the Role**

We run high-volume campaigns for international affiliate networks and performance advertisers. Every rupee we earn passes through a network — their campaign lists, their conversion reports, their caps, and their validation.

This role owns that relationship commercially. You are the person the networks deal with: you hold them to their reporting commitments, and you are the first to challenge a number that does not add up.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

• Own day-to-day relationships with our affiliate network partners as their named point of contact

• Request and maintain campaign lists, payouts and offer terms across all networks

• Negotiate daily caps and monthly budgets once a campaign is approved for scale, and renegotiate as performance justifies it

• Hold each network to an agreed reporting turnaround — our media buyers cannot optimise without their data

• Review the variance analysis prepared by the reporting team and raise every material gap formally, within the network's own dispute window

• Escalate unresolved deductions to Finance with the supporting evidence assembled

• Keep a written record of every commercial conversation — caps agreed, terms changed, disputes raised and closed

• Flag campaign or offer changes to the media buying team the day you hear about them

**WHAT YOU NEED**

• 3–6 years in affiliate marketing, performance marketing or ad-network account management

• You have dealt with affiliate networks directly — you know what a payout, a cap, a scrub and a validation cycle actually are

• Confident negotiating commercial terms with a counterparty who holds more information than you do

• Comfortable enough with numbers to argue a variance line by line, not just forward it

• Clear, professional written English; most of this job happens over email

• Organised by instinct — many networks, many campaigns, many open threads, nothing dropped

**GOOD TO HAVE**

• Existing relationships with US-facing affiliate networks

• Experience disputing or recovering deductions from a network

• Understanding of Google Ads & Meta well enough to hold a technical conversation with a media buyer

**HOW WE WORK**

This seat handles commercially sensitive data — payouts, validation rates and network terms. All work happens on company systems and company accounts, access is role-based, and the appointment letter carries confidentiality, data-handling and conflict-of-interest terms. We are explicit about this upfront because the role deserves someone who expects it.

description:

Develop and execute a communications strategy that establishes SFLC.in as a leading, credible voice on digital rights in India. Identify opportunities to shape public conversations and increase national visibility.

Competitive and commensurate with experience.

Someone who understands how newsrooms operate, knows how to pitch a story, can build lasting media relationships, and can turn SFLC.in's substantive work into national conversations.

We want a proactive professional who brings ideas, acts quickly, and takes ownership of results.

Full Time

description:
**Role:**
Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
  
  
**About Us**
**:**
Scrubsy is India’s #1 foam-based household cleaner - trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We’re a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality and we’re building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:**
Scrubsy is building out a dedicated Consumer & Market Insights function to put the consumer at the centre of everything we launch, from formulations to fragrance to packaging to campaigns.
  
  
As
**Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer and Market Insights**
, you will be a core member of that team, working closely with the Senior Manager - Consumer and Market Insights. You will run the day-to-day research: Coordinating fieldwork with agency partners, Supporting Qualitative and Quantitative studies, Analysing Consumer and Market Data and turning them into clear, well-told and actionable findings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end research. Help plan and run Qualitative and Quantitative studies from Brief to Final Report.
* Coordinate agency and field partners. Share briefs, discussion guides and questionnaires, track timelines and fieldwork quality, and keep projects moving on schedule.
* Analyse and synthesise. Work through transcripts, verbatims, surveys and market data to pull out trends, themes, need states and clear takeaways.
* Build the story. Prepare clean, insight-led presentations and toplines for the Leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Track the consumer after launch. Monitor reviews, ratings, feedback and repeat signals from our D2C website and marketplaces, and flag what needs attention.
* Do desk research. Scan Category, Competitor and Trend information to support study design and brand, R&D and marketing questions.
* Keep the insights engine organised. Maintain trackers, a library of past studies and learnings, and research budget and timeline records.
* Use modern tools. Use GenAI and analysis tools to speed up synthesis and reporting without losing rigour.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Mandatory Requirement**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in consumer insights or market research, in an agency, a brand or a D2C company.
* Hands-on exposure to Qualitative research and Quantitative research.
* Hands-on knowledge of Research Methodology: you know which approach fits which questions work and can design and run studies accordingly.
* Hands-on data interpretation: You can work through surveys and tracking data and turn them into clear, actionable insights.
* Experience with Consumer interactions and insights, from speaking with consumers to drawing out what matters.
* Qualitative experience, particularly exploratory research (FGDs, IDIs or immersions), and the ability to summarise them into themes.
* Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree, ideally MBA / PGDM (Marketing) or equivalent.

**Additional Requirement**

* Exposure to AI-driven insight tools, social listening platforms, or e-commerce/quick-commerce analytics
* Exposure to FMCG (Home care, Personal care) industry.
* Experience supporting NPD launches from exploratory research through to post-launch evaluation.
* Brand health tracking experience.
* Concept testing experience.
* Pre and Post Campaign evaluation experience.
* Familiarity with syndicated data and brand tracking platforms.

**Who You Are**

* Proactive - You don't wait to be told a metric or perception is slipping; before marketing asks "what happened," and you come with the why, not just the what
* Ownership Driven - You own the research question end-to-end — from writing the brief to fieldwork to the final recommendation that actually gets used
* Data Conscious - You validate every insight or "consumer said" claim across segments, methodologies, and sample sizes before it goes to leadership
* Organized - you run a busy, always-on calendar of trackers, ad-hoc studies, and agency deliverables across multiple categories without a wave, deadline, or stakeholder slipping through the cracks.
* Progressive Learner - You understand that Learning is a continuous process and are willing to learn new methodologies and ways of working, while being unafraid to think outside the box and putting across your PoV.

Airtel is building one of India’s most ambitious consumer financial services franchises under the Airtel Finance brand. India

:

The organization partners with leading security technology providers, including CATO Networks, Palo Alto Networks, Tenable, Delinea, and others, to offer comprehensive information security solutions. eSec Forte® has also developed “Crackbox,” a high-performance hardware solution for password processing and related security tasks.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for Saviynt IAM Professionals based in Gurugram. The role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using Saviynt, including role engineering, access policies, and governance workflows. The professional will configure integrations with directories, applications, and cloud platforms; manage onboarding and offboarding processes; and support access reviews and compliance reporting. Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting IAM issues, optimizing Saviynt configurations, collaborating with security and infrastructure teams, and contributing to documentation and best practices. The role also includes participation in security audits, risk assessments related to identity and access, and continuous improvement of IAM controls aligned with organizational security objectives.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Saviynt expertise, including IAM configuration, role-based access control, access governance, and workflow management.
* Candidates should possess skills in identity lifecycle management, user provisioning/deprovisioning, directory services (e.g., AD/LDAP), and integration with enterprise and cloud applications.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of information security fundamentals, including access control models, least privilege, compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, ISO 27001), and audit requirements.
* Candidates should possess abilities in troubleshooting, incident analysis, and performance optimization of IAM solutions in complex environments.
* Candidates should possess strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, document technical processes, and support end users.
* Relevant experience with other IAM tools or security platforms, scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python), and familiarity with security operations will be beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, along with prior experience in IAM or security engineering, is preferred.

Role Overview
  
  
The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.
  
  
Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Platform Engineering & Reliability:**
Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.
  
  
**CI/CD & Release Engineering:**
Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.
  
  
**DevSecOps Adoption:**
Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.
  
  
**Security by Design:**
Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
**Infrastructure as Code:**
Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.
  
  
**GitOps & Kubernetes:**
Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.

Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.
  
  
**Automated Governance:**

**Observability & Self-Healing:**

**Cross-Functional Architecture:**

**AI-Assisted Engineering:**
Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.
  
  
**Documentation & Enablement:**
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation Culture:**
Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.

in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.

description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Infrastructure Engineering

As a Load Balancer Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain load balancing and traffic management solutions that support secure, scalable, and highly available network services. You will partner with network, security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver resilient solutions across data center and cloud environments. Your work will help improve application availability, strengthen enterprise network performance, and support secure infrastructure modernization.

* Experience supporting cloud-native application delivery and hybrid network architectures.
* Experience in financial services, payments, or similarly regulated infrastructure environments.

Axslogic is a fintech analytics enterprise software company that helps financial institutions digitize their lending data analytics while they progress their overall digitization journey. * Background in scripting development in Bash and Python
* Experience with GitOps practices
* Knowledge of IBM and Oracle platforms that support analytics solutions
* Understanding of financial services domain, particularly lending analytics
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures
* Engineering Graduate from a top-tier college

* Work on Winnow™, a cutting-edge patented SaaS platform that provides pre-programmed early warning capabilities and state-of-the-art reporting and analysis for financial institutions
* Support a robust solution with over 1500 Alert Thresholds, 250+ Reports with multi-variate segmentation over 60+ dimensions
* Build infrastructure for a platform that disrupts traditional manual processes in financial risk management
* Use cutting-edge cloud infrastructure tools and participate in advanced security implementations
* Help shape a secure and scalable DevOps culture within a fast-growing fintech company
* Work with a strong management team with significant domain expertise in Commercial Lending, Banking, and Consumer Financial Services
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible working arrangements and a collaborative team environment

The platform handles sensitive financial data and powers analytics that help banks and financial institutions make critical business decisions. title: Cloud Ops Engineer
description:
**The Team**
The Mobility Division within S&P Global uses technology and data science to deliver insights, forecasts, and advisory services across the automotive value chain. The Cloud Operations team enables these products by running a reliable, well-governed cloud foundation—working in a collaborative culture focused on shared learning, operational rigor, and continuous improvement across a multi-account environment.
  
  
**The Impact**
This role is the operations owner for cloud governance and compliance at scale. You’ll keep cloud environments “day-1/day-2 ready” through strong account lifecycle management, guardrails, patch/vulnerability workflows, and audit-ready evidence. You’ll partner with Security/Risk (as stakeholders) and with Platform/App teams (as executors/owners) to ensure standards are implemented without slowing delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and improve core cloud operations capabilities: account vending, guardrails, compliance evidence, and vulnerability/patch hygiene
* Work cross-functionally with Platform Engineering, application teams, IAM, Risk/GRC, and Audit in a global environment
* Drive automation (policy-as-code / IaC / scripting) to reduce toil and improve consistency
* Gain exposure to multi-cloud operations (AWS/Azure/GCP) where applicable, while building durable governance patterns

**Required Skills**

* 3-6 years in cloud operations / platform engineering / cloud governance (operations-first, not a security analyst role)
* Hands-on experience running multi-account / multi-subscription environments: provisioning, inventory/metadata, tagging standards, baseline logging/monitoring, and decommissioning
* Strong cloud governance + guardrails experience (OU/org structures, inherited controls, policy change management, exception handling)
* Operational experience with policy-as-code (e.g., Cloud Custodian): deploying policies, tuning, handling exceptions/rollbacks, producing metrics/evidence
* Practical vulnerability + patch operations: using tools like Tenable, triaging findings, routing to owners, tracking SLAs, reporting aging, maintaining coverage/data quality
* Automation skills (Python/Bash/PowerShell) and familiarity with IaC concepts (Terraform/CloudFormation-style)
* Strong operational discipline: runbooks, change management, incident support, stakeholder communication, audit evidence handling

**Nice to have**

* Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and comfort standardizing controls across platforms
* IAM governance exposure (RBAC/least privilege patterns, access reviews, break-glass processes)
* Experience integrating compliance/guardrails into CI/CD and platform “paved roads”
* Backup/DR operational experience (restore testing, RTO/RPO alignment, documentation)
* Cloud certifications (ops/architecture certifications are a plus)

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
****Overview:****
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “*
*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.*
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*
*.*
****In This Role, You Will:****
Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at:
  
  

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

**Collaboration & Enablement**

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

title: Application Packager
description:
Screening Questions: Application Packager and Deployment Engineer

Profile: 9-10 years' experience. PSADT packaging, Intune deployment (Win32, Microsoft Store, Enterprise App Catalog), working knowledge of Entra and DEX tools (Aternity, Nexthink).

Packaging and Deployment

**1.**
A PSADT package works when you run it as an admin on your test VM, but fails when Intune deploys it. List the differences between the two contexts that could cause this.

**2.**
An installer is user-context only (writes to HKCU or %AppData%), but you need to deploy it to shared or multi-user devices. How do you approach it?

**3.**
You must upgrade an app from v1 to v2 where v1 was installed with a different installer type (EXE to MSI) and has user config to retain. Describe your packaging and deployment design.

**4.**
Your detection rule is version-based, but some devices report "not installed" after a successful install, while others loop with repeated install attempts. What causes this and how do you fix it?

**5.**
Walk through the Intune Win32 app lifecycle on a device, from assignment to reporting. Which logs and services are involved, and where would you look if an app is stuck at "Download pending" or "Installing"?

**6.**
How do you handle an app that requires a reboot, a long install window, or user interaction in a pre-login or Autopilot (ESP) scenario?

**7.**
You are packaging an app with prerequisites (for example Visual C++, .NET, or a Java runtime) and a config file that differs per region or business unit. How do you structure packages, dependencies and assignments?

**8.**
When would you deploy an app as a Win32 package vs the Enterprise App Catalog vs a Microsoft Store (new) app vs a line-of-business MSI? Give a real example of each, including its limitations.

**9.**
Describe your approach to app updates at scale. How do you keep 50+ apps current without breaking users, and how do you roll back a bad version?

**10.**
You are asked to standardise packaging across a team of 5 engineers. What would you put in place?

Entra and DEX Tools

**11.**
Your team uses Aternity or Nexthink alongside Intune. What role does each tool play in an app deployment lifecycle, what data comes from where, and how would you use them to validate that a rollout actually worked?

title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.
* 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
As a Data Center Technician, you'll deploy and maintain Google's advanced Data Center Server and Network Infrastructure by installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing hardware and server software. You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, bridges, and switches. You will participate in or lead local project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.
  
  
In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of data center related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g., machine learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, escalate and resolve defined problems.

title: Senior Recruitment Manager
description:

**Josh Technology Group (JTG)**

You must deeply understand software engineering mindsets, tech stacks, and team dynamics to partner seamlessly with department heads, decode candidate behavior, and craft sharp, tech-fluent sourcing strategies. 6-12 years of progressive end-to-end Recruitment and Leadership experience, fostering a results-oriented and high-energy team environment.

**Gurugram (WFO)**

Graduate/Postgraduate degree in any domain, preferably an MBA in HR or Master’s in Psychology from a college of repute

Josh Technology Group is a 16+ year old product engineering company with 300+ engineers across 20+ countries, known for de-risking technology for businesses through AI-accelerated, outcome-accountable delivery — not staff augmentation. We have delivered 100+ projects with a client retention rate of over 90%. 

Our North America practice has been active for close to two decades, anchored in Texas and expanding across the East and West Coasts, serving Enterprises, Startups/VC-backed companies, Family-run businesses, and PE/Investment funds. 

Our deepest domain strength is in Healthcare and EdTech/HR-Tech (each ~25–30% of revenue). We engage across four models: Build from Scratch, Reinvent/Modernize, Product Engineering CoE, and Tech Due Diligence — primarily for North American and European clients. 

**What do we do?**

JTG is a bootstrapped organization that has multiple fully owned software products. JTG acts as a “Product Builder” for multiple US & UK-based startups. JTG has successfully created and launched more than 100 products, spread across various industries, and is working on many more exciting new ones. It has been 14+ years since its inception & JTG has been profitable from day 1 & aspires to reach new heights.

We work on only the latest & trending technologies & never shy away from inculcating the latest technologies in the organization. Currently, we are extensively working on the technologies like - NodeJS, Golang, Flutter, DotNet, Java, Python, Django, PySpark, DataBricks, ROR, PHP, Spark, Angular, Angular JS, React (JS and Native) DevOps: AWS, GCP (Google Firebase), Azure, Terraform, Ansible, etc.

Our very own software product, Pod.AI is in the recruitment & assessment industry and it has received an overwhelming response in the market.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Take full ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process for suitable candidates across multiple domains and teams, as per the manpower requirements and business goals.

* Utilize sourcing techniques on various job boards like Naukri, LinkedIn, etc, social media and lead campus hiring initiatives to find high-performing professionals.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters. Provide daily guidance on sourcing bottlenecks, negotiation tactics, and candidate management.
* Manage team bandwidth and resource allocation to ensure 100% fulfillment of the manpower plan.
* Lead the diversification of sourcing channels; evaluate the ROI of various job portals and social media platforms to optimize the recruitment spend.
* Act as a subject matter expert on industry hiring trends, salary benchmarking, and talent mapping to advise leadership on hiring strategy.
* Lead social media campaigns and campus engagement programs to build a robust pipeline of  talent.
* Promote and manage the internal employee referral to leverage the existing network for high-quality, culturally aligned candidates.
* Design candidate journey, ensuring every applicant has a professional and positive experience.

**What are we looking for in you?**

* 6-12 years of experience in lateral recruitment and coaching and developing junior recruiters, fostering a results-oriented and high-energy team environment.
* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in any domain, preferably an MBA in HR from a college of repute
* Expert knowledge of headhunting, and building talent pipelines.
* Ability to translate complex data into executive-level summaries and strategic recommendations.
* A self-starter who doesn't just identify problems but implements scalable solutions.
* Master-level negotiation and interpersonal skills to handle senior-level candidates and internal leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously with a high sense of urgency and attention to detail.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft & G Suite.
* Self-motivated and has an internal drive to produce high-quality work.
* Excellent communication & interpersonal skills.
* Excellent team player with strong skills in Research, Analysis, and Coordination.

**A stellar performer who:**

* Has the desire to make it BIG
* Is Self & Goal Driven, Quick Thinker, Action-Oriented, and Diligent
* Has good Interpersonal skills and a Go-Getter personality
* Has an eye for detail and good cognitive skills
* Maintains Integrity and Professionalism in work

**How will you grow here?**

* Work & interact directly with senior directors in an open and flat hierarchical structure
* Opportunity to source on multiple technologies

title: KYC Processing Analyst
description:
Step into the role of KYC Processing Analyst , where you’ll be responsible for completing periodic KYC/CDD reviews for Barclaycard Issuing customers, ensuring customer information remains complete, accurate and up to date. The analyst will review customer profiles, obtain and validate required information/documentation, identify potential financial crime risks, and progress cases in line with applicable procedures and defined service levels.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Complete end-to-end KYC/CDD periodic refresh reviews for customers allocated within the Barclaycard Issuing portfolio.
* Review existing customer information and identify gaps or changes requiring further investigation or supporting documentation.
* Validate key customer information, including:





* Customer/entity details
* Knowledge of identification & verification from public domain and third party approved sources.
* Transactional analysis
* Nature of business and business activities
* Ownership and control structure
* Directors and relevant connected parties
* Source of funds/source of wealth, where applicable
* Other information required under the relevant KYC/CDD standard
* Perform appropriate customer and financial crime risk assessment in accordance with approved procedures.
* Review available internal and external information and evidence to support completion of the refresh.
* Identify cases requiring additional information and initiate appropriate customer outreach.
* Review information and documentation received from customers and determine whether requirements have been satisfactorily met.
* Maintain accurate case notes and a clear audit trail of decisions, evidence and actions undertaken.
* Identify potential AML, sanctions, PEP, adverse media, or other financial crime risk indicators and escalate concerns through the prescribed process.
* Ensure cases are completed within agreed SLA and ageing requirements, proactively managing outstanding actions and dependencies.

title: Research Analyst - Quantitative Research
description:
**Location:**

Mumbai / Delhi NCR

**Work Mode:**

Hybrid

**Company:**

Flickly

**About Flickly**

Flickly is an AI-powered quantitative research platform that delivers decision-ready consumer insights in 72 hours, across markets, languages, and audience segments. Going beyond response collection, Flickly helps brands turn consumer data into actionable insights that inform business decisions. We work with D2C brands, growing businesses, and enterprise teams across concept testing, pricing research, packaging evaluation, brand studies, and category deep-dives.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Research Associate - Quantitative Research**

to join our research team and take ownership of key deliverables across the research lifecycle, from understanding client briefs and designing questionnaires to analysing data and developing actionable insights.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of quantitative research fundamentals. You will work closely with the research manager, founder, and cross-functional teams on live client projects, ensuring that research is methodologically sound, data is accurate, and findings translate into clear business recommendations.

The ideal candidate has experience working on quantitative research projects, is comfortable handling data independently, and can take a structured approach to solving research problems in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities****1. Research Design & Project Execution**

* Understand client briefs, research objectives, and the business decisions the study is intended to inform.
* Develop questionnaires, survey flows, screeners, and response options aligned with research objectives.
* Work across concept testing, pricing studies, brand tracking, packaging evaluation, creative testing, usage and attitude studies, and category research.
* Review survey programming, question logic, skip patterns, quotas, and response options before launch.
* Coordinate fieldwork, monitor sample progress, and flag potential data quality issues or deviations from the research brief.
* Manage assigned project deliverables and timelines, escalating risks and dependencies proactively.

**2. Quantitative Data Analysis & Insights**

* Clean, validate, and organise datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and analytical readiness.
* Build analysis tables, cross-tabulations, and relevant data cuts using Excel.
* Conduct quantitative analysis, including percentage analysis, subgroup comparisons, and significance testing where applicable.
* Identify meaningful patterns, consumer segments, behavioural differences, and relationships within the data.
* Investigate unexpected results, inconsistencies, and contradictory findings before drawing conclusions.
* Translate analytical findings into clear, evidence-backed insights and actionable business recommendations.

**3. Reporting & Quality Assurance**

* Develop research reports, presentation decks, charts, and supporting analysis for client delivery.
* Structure reports around research objectives and key business questions rather than simply presenting data.
* Write clear, concise insight narratives supported by quantitative evidence.
* Verify calculations, base sizes, percentages, significance markers, charts, and interpretations before final delivery.
* Incorporate internal and client feedback while maintaining analytical accuracy and consistency.
* Ensure all deliverables meet Flickly's quality standards and agreed project timelines.

**4. Client & Team Collaboration**

* Participate in client discussions to understand briefs, clarify research requirements, and document key decisions.
* Communicate research findings and analytical rationale clearly to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Work closely with the research manager and founder across project planning, execution, analysis, and final delivery.
* Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, prioritising tasks based on deadlines and business requirements.
* Contribute to improving research templates, analytical frameworks, quality checks, and internal workflows.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables while seeking guidance when decisions require methodological or business judgement.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:**

  1-2 years of relevant experience in quantitative market research, consumer insights, research consulting, or a related analytical role.
* **Research fundamentals:**

  A good understanding of questionnaire design, sampling, survey methodologies, quantitative research techniques, and common sources of research bias.
* **Analytical skills:**

  Strong ability to interpret numerical data, identify patterns, compare consumer groups, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
* **Excel proficiency:**

  Comfortable working with large datasets, pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, cross-tabulations, and data validation. Familiarity with statistical tools is an advantage.
* **Presentation skills:**

  Proficiency in PowerPoint and the ability to structure research findings into clear, well-organised presentations.
* **Attention to detail:**

  A systematic approach to reviewing questionnaires, datasets, calculations, charts, and reports.
* **Business understanding:**

  Ability to connect consumer research findings with business objectives and practical recommendations.
* **Communication:**

  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly.
* **Ownership:**

  Ability to independently manage assigned deliverables, meet deadlines, and communicate risks or delays early.
* **Problem-solving:**

  A willingness to question assumptions, investigate discrepancies, and understand the underlying problem before jumping to conclusions.
* **Adaptability:**

  Comfort working across different research categories, changing priorities, and tight timelines in a growing startup.

**Working at Flickly**

* Take ownership of meaningful research deliverables across the entire project lifecycle.
* Work directly with the founder and research leadership on diverse client engagements.
* Gain exposure to a broad range of consumer research methodologies, industries, and business questions.
* Develop expertise in quantitative analysis, insight generation, and client-facing research delivery.
* Work with AI-enabled research workflows and contribute to improving how quantitative research is designed, analysed, and delivered.
* Help build scalable research processes and quality standards as the company grows.

**Work Location & Model**

Flickly operates as a digital-first organisation, with this role following a
**hybrid work model**

. Candidates should be based in Mumbai or Delhi NCR and be comfortable working both remotely and from the office as required.

**Confidentiality**

The role involves access to confidential company, consumer, and client information. The candidate is expected to handle all research data and business information responsibly and adhere to applicable confidentiality and data protection requirements.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HEAD – HUMAN RESOURCES (HR)

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Location:**
Delhi
