Full-time

**Industry:**
Industrial Services / Engineering / Projects / Manpower Services

About Indian Trade Links

Indian Trade Links is an industrial services company supporting projects across India. Our operations include scaffolding, industrial painting, roof sheeting, rope access, manpower deployment and other project-based services.

As we continue to strengthen and scale our operations, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven
**Head – Human Resources**
to lead the complete HR function and build a professional, performance-oriented and compliant organization.

Role Overview

The
**Head – HR**
will be responsible for the complete employee lifecycle, from manpower planning and recruitment to payroll coordination, performance management, statutory compliance, employee engagement and HR systems.

This is a
**hands-on leadership position**
. We are looking for someone who can not only develop HR policies and systems but also ensure their effective implementation across the Head Office and multiple project/site locations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Development**

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's business and growth plans.
* Establish HR policies, standard operating procedures and organizational structures.
* Define job roles, responsibilities, reporting structures and accountability across departments.
* Build measurable HR systems and management dashboards.

**2. Recruitment & Manpower Planning**

* Lead recruitment for Head Office, project management, engineering, commercial, safety, supervisory and site manpower positions.
* Develop manpower planning based on current and upcoming project requirements.
* Improve recruitment turnaround time and candidate quality.
* Build reliable recruitment channels for project and site-based manpower.

**3. Performance Management**

* Develop and manage a structured
  **KPI/KRA-based performance management system**
  .
* Establish goal-setting, appraisal and review processes.
* Coordinate with department heads to identify performance gaps and improvement requirements.
* Develop suitable reward, recognition and incentive frameworks.

**4. Payroll, Attendance & Employee Records**

* Ensure accurate attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee records.
* Coordinate salary revisions, deductions, advances, settlements and employee documentation.
* Strengthen digital HR records and employee data management.
* Ensure timely completion of joining and exit formalities.

**5. Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee HR and labour-related statutory compliance applicable to the organization and project locations.
* Coordinate compliance relating to PF, ESIC, wages and other applicable employment requirements.
* Maintain appropriate employee and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants and project locations for timely compliance.

**6. Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Build a disciplined, professional and positive workplace culture.
* Handle employee grievances and workplace issues appropriately.
* Improve employee communication, engagement and retention.
* Introduce structured induction and employee engagement programs.

**7. Learning & Development**

* Identify training and competency requirements across departments.
* Develop induction and skill-development programs.
* Coordinate managerial, behavioural, safety and functional training as required.
* Support development of future managers and departmental leaders.

**8. HR Systems & Digitization**

* Drive digitization of employee onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll inputs, approvals, appraisals and HR records.
* Improve HR reporting and dashboards for management visibility.
* Reduce dependency on manual processes and strengthen data accuracy.

Candidate Profile

**Education**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* Strong HR leadership experience, preferably in
  **industrial services, EPC, construction, engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing, manpower services or project-based organizations**
  .
* Experience managing both
  **corporate/office employees and project/site manpower**
  will be highly preferred.

Key Skills

* HR Strategy & Operations
* Talent Acquisition
* Manpower Planning
* Performance Management
* Payroll & Attendance Management
* Labour & Statutory Compliance
* Employee Relations
* HR Policies & Processes
* Training & Development
* HRMS / HR Digitization
* Management Reporting
* Strong communication and leadership abilities

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Hands-on and execution focused**
* **Comfortable working in a fast-moving, project-driven environment**
* **Strong in systems, processes and discipline**
* **Capable of working closely with management and department heads**
* **Data-driven and comfortable with HR dashboards and digital systems**
* **Proactive in identifying and resolving people-related challenges**
* **Able to balance employee engagement with organizational accountability**

Why Join Indian Trade Links?

This role provides an opportunity to
**lead and transform the complete HR function**
of a growing industrial services organization.

The selected candidate will work closely with senior management and have significant responsibility for strengthening the company's people practices, HR systems, organizational structure and culture as the business grows.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn with their updated CV.

title: YouTube & Instagram Growth Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a
**YouTube & Instagram Growth Strategist**
to be the driving force behind our content and brand communication — 1.6M+ YouTube subscribers, 200K+ IG audience, and a fast-growing business in the Numerology space.

This is a seat at the creative table —to build a content machine that actually performs and scales.

If your idea of a good time is thinking about content, breaking down what works, and building systems that turn ideas into results — please read on 🙂

**Hours:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
New Delhi — This is essential. We not looking for someone remote. We’re looking for someone who works with the team IRL, closely and consistently.

**Salary:**
₹14 LPA – ₹18 LPA

**Experience:**
5-8 Years

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Own the Creative Vision**

You are the CEO of this media product. You’ll set the strategic direction of the channel — drawing on channel data, competitor research, and platform trends — and translate it into clear weekly and monthly creative priorities. We should be able to ask almost any question about what we’re making and why, and get a confident, evidence-backed answer from you.

**Drive the Ideation Machine**

You’ll build a systematic, ever-evolving process for generating and evaluating video ideas. You’ll know what the audience wants, what’s trending, what’s working, what we should do next and you’ll bring consistency to how ideas are created and scaled. You’ll also translate these ideas into short-form formats for Instagram — understanding what works for Reels vs long-form, and how to adapt content without losing depth.

**Master the Packaging**

Title. Thumbnail. Hook. These are the things that determine whether a brilliant video reaches 100,000 people or 10 million. You’ll own these decisions with both creative instinct and systematic testing

**Structure the Content**

You won’t be writing full scripts. Your role is to take the core idea and design how the content flows:

* What comes first
* What hooks the viewer
* Where key points should land
* How the narrative builds and retains attention

You’ll work closely with us to understand the topic, then translate it into a clear, high-retention format that editors can execute.

**Run the Production Pipeline**

End-to-end ownership of long-form and short-form production (YouTube + Instagram) — from idea through to upload. You’ll manage video editors to a high standard, ensure filming days run effortlessly, and own upload hygiene down to the last pinned comment. The goal: a production machine that feels calm, repeatable, and world-class.

**Live in the Analytics**

Deep mastery of CTR, retention curves, watch time, and traffic sources — and the ability to translate all of it into clear creative decisions. You don’t just report what happened. You explain 
*why*
, and you tell us what we’re going to do about it. You’ll track performance across YouTube and Instagram, understanding how metrics differ across platforms and what to optimize for on each.

**What We’re Looking For**

**YouTube native**
 — You’ve spent years watching long-form YouTube. You have favourite creators. You think about the platform instinctively. Ideally you’ve grown a channel (or played a central role in one), but what matters more is that you 
*get*
 YouTube deeply.

**Short-form instinct**
— You understand how Instagram works. You know what makes someone stop scrolling, what formats work on Reels, and how to adapt long-form thinking into short-form content that performs.

**Packaging obsession**
 — You can look at any video concept and immediately generate compelling title/thumbnail ideas. You test systematically and your instincts sharpen over time.

**Systems thinker**
 — You build processes that scale. You document what matters. You don’t rely on heroics — you build repeatable systems that make high-volume publishing feel calm and sustainable.

**Data fluent**
 — You live in YouTube Studio and Instagram insights. You understand which metrics actually matter across platforms — CTR, retention, watch time on YouTube, and hooks, holds, shares, and saves on Instagram. Most importantly, you don’t just read numbers, you translate them into clear content decisions.

**AI-forward**
 — You’re genuinely excited about using AI tools to get an edge, and you implement them quickly. The more experience the better, but the willingness to learn and go deep matters even more.

**Proactive communicator**
 — We should never have to chase you. You surface problems before they escalate and deliver updates that are actually useful.

**High trust, high character**
 — We’re a small, tight team. We’d rather have someone with slightly less experience and extraordinary character than the other way around.

title: Meta Ads Operation Manager
description:
**Job Description: Meta Ads Operations Manager**

**Location:**

Kirti Nagar, New Delhi, India

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office

**Department:**

Ad Operations

**Job Type:**

Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Meta Ads Operations Manager**

to manage and streamline the operational activities related to Meta advertising. The role involves managing ad accounts, Business Managers, access permissions, media buyer allocation, billing, advertiser verification, and account suspension tracking.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager, strong coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot operational issues while ensuring compliance with Meta's advertising policies and internal procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Ad Account & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with agencies and partners to request new Meta ad accounts, profiles, Pages, and Business Managers.
* Manage account access, permissions, and asset allocation for media buyers.
* Maintain accurate mapping of ad accounts, Pages, Business Managers, and assigned media buyers.
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of all advertising assets.

**2. Media Buyer Allocation & Coordination**

* Allocate ad accounts to media buyers based on business requirements and approved access.
* Maintain updated records of account assignments, access permissions, and asset ownership.
* Coordinate with media buyers to resolve account-related queries and operational challenges.
* Ensure smooth coordination between media buyers, agencies, and internal teams.

**3. Business Manager Setup & Management**

* Coordinate the setup and configuration of Meta Business Managers.
* Manage approved asset mapping, partner access, and user permissions.
* Monitor account and asset access to ensure appropriate authorization.
* Troubleshoot Business Manager access issues and coordinate resolutions.

**4. Technical Support & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor ad account functionality, ad delivery issues, and website-related technical concerns.
* Investigate operational issues reported by media buyers and coordinate with relevant technical teams.
* Track issues and ensure resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders when required.

**5. Account Suspension & Policy Compliance**

* Monitor and maintain records of suspended or restricted ad accounts and Pages.
* Coordinate legitimate appeals and follow up on account reviews through official Meta channels.
* Track the status of appeals, restrictions, and reinstatement requests.
* Ensure all operational activities comply with Meta advertising policies and applicable platform rules.
* Support the use of alternative eligible advertising assets only where permitted by Meta's policies.

**6. Payment & Advertising Spend Monitoring**

* Coordinate the addition and management of approved payment methods.
* Monitor advertising spend, payment status, billing activity, and account spending limits.
* Identify billing discrepancies, failed payments, and unusual spending patterns.
* Coordinate with the finance team, agencies, and relevant stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain accurate payment and spend records for reporting and reconciliation.

**7. Advertiser Verification**

* Track advertiser verification and business verification status across relevant accounts.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of required business documents through official channels.
* Follow up on pending verification requests and document-related issues.
* Maintain records of verification progress, approvals, rejections, and pending actions.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date trackers for ad accounts, Business Managers, Pages, media buyer allocation, suspensions, payments, and verification.
* Prepare regular operational reports covering pending issues, account status, spend, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of escalations, follow-ups, and completed actions.
* Provide timely updates to management regarding operational risks and bottlenecks.

**9. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with agencies, media buyers, finance, technical teams, and management to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Establish consistent tracking and follow-up practices for account provisioning and issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, access-control requirements, and Meta policies.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.
* Understanding of Meta ad accounts, Pages, business portfolios, user roles, partner access, and permissions.
* Experience handling ad account restrictions, suspension tracking, appeals, and advertiser verification.
* Understanding of advertising billing, payment methods, spend monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and operational tasks simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a process-oriented approach.
* Understanding of Meta advertising policies and platform compliance requirements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience in Meta Ads operations, digital advertising support, Business Manager management, or advertising account operations is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with media buyers, agencies, and internal teams will be an advantage.
* Candidates with strong operational knowledge and hands-on experience managing Meta advertising assets are encouraged to apply.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Timely provisioning of ad accounts and allocation to media buyers.
* Compliance with defined SLAs for issue resolution and escalation.
* Accuracy of ad account, Business Manager, Page, and media buyer mapping.
* Effective tracking and follow-up of suspensions, appeals, and verification requests.
* Accuracy of payment, billing, and advertising spend reports.
* Timely maintenance of operational trackers and documentation.
* Efficient coordination with agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Adherence to Meta policies, approved access procedures, and internal compliance standards.

Upriver Ecommerce is looking for an Account manager to own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end across e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce platforms. Hands-on experience on Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces is mandatory. This is a P&L-owning role: the candidate is accountable for each client’s revenue growth, profitability, account health, and advertising efficiency — not just operations or reporting. The role combines three disciplines in a single senior owner: marketplace account management (catalog, pricing, promotions, operations), performance marketing (ad strategy, ACoS/TACOS, scale with efficiency), and client reporting and coordination on a day-to-day level. The ideal candidate has 3-4 years of hands-on marketplace experience, preferably from an agency background managing multiple brands simultaneously, with a demonstrated record of scaling revenues while holding or improving advertising efficiency. Prior experience in an e-commerce agency, marketplace management agency, or similar client-servicing role

Based on experience and as per market standards

Gurgaon (5 days – in office)

Team Lead

2-3 direct reportees

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the account operationally, driving growth and profitability.

* Understand each client’s brand, category, competition, pricing, and business objectives from a holistic perspective, and develop and execute marketplace growth strategies covering visibility, conversion, and account health.

* Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance across the portfolio; identify growth opportunities and remove bottlenecks with corrective action plans.
* Prepare performance reviews, projections, and action plans to clients; ensure complete, accurate weekly reporting with updates, recommendations, and insights

title: Growth Business Manager- D2C
description:
**About Nory For You:**

Nory For You is a direct-to-consumer brand that sells through its own website, Nory.com. As the business grows, we are looking for a commercially minded professional to own the website as a business and drive profitable, sustainable growth across acquisition, conversion and retention.

**About the Role:**

The D2C Growth Business Manager will own and scale revenue from Nory.com. This is not a pure performance-marketing or website-operations role. You will own the complete website growth funnel, from traffic quality and conversion to average order value, CRM revenue, repeat purchase and overall profitability, working closely with the Performance Marketing Manager and the Creative Strategist.

**Core mandate:**
own Nory.com as a business and continuously identify what is limiting faster, profitable revenue growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Website revenue, growth targets and overall D2C business performance, with monthly and quarterly revenue plans and early flags on gaps.
* Contribution margin and profitable revenue, including the impact of discounts and offers.

**Funnel and Conversion**

* The full funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase.
* Conversion-rate optimisation across landing pages, PDPs, cart and checkout, with a structured, prioritised testing roadmap.

**Acquisition Economics**

* Traffic quality analysis by channel, campaign, product and customer segment.
* Guidance to the Performance Marketing Manager on where to scale, reduce or redirect spend, based on CAC, conversion and profitability.

**Average Order Value**

* Bundles, cross-sell, upsell, multi-packs and offer architecture that lift AOV without eroding margin.

**Retention and Lifecycle**

* Email and WhatsApp journeys: abandoned-cart recovery, reactivation, cross-sell and repeat purchase.
* Customer cohorts, repeat rate, LTV and CAC tracking.

**Insight, Collaboration and Reporting**

* Joint work with the Creative Strategist to identify the messages, customer problems and creative concepts that drive high-quality traffic and conversion.
* Weekly reporting on what changed, why it changed and what action should follow, backed by a prioritised experimentation roadmap.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Website revenue growth
* Contribution margin / profitable revenue
* Blended CAC
* Website, PDP-to-cart and checkout conversion
* Average Order Value
* CRM revenue and abandoned-cart recovery
* Repeat purchase rate and customer LTV

**What You Bring**

**Must Have**

* 4–8 years in D2C, e-commerce, digital commerce or growth, with experience owning website revenue or an e-commerce funnel.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset; able to separate vanity metrics from real business performance.
* Sound understanding of paid acquisition economics, even if you do not run campaigns yourself.
* Hands-on experience with CRO, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Good grounding in CRM, lifecycle marketing and retention.
* Working command of Shopify, GA4, Meta and Google advertising data, and e-commerce analytics.
* A structured, action-oriented approach: analyse, diagnose, prioritise, execute and measure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer health, wellness, beauty or other education-led D2C businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and engagement tools (for example Klaviyo or WebEngage) and A/B testing tools.

**Why This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of a D2C website as a business, not a single channel.
* A clear, measurable mandate with direct impact on revenue and profitability.
* Close collaboration with performance marketing and creative strategy on a shared growth agenda.

title: Product Ops and Growth (Intern)
description:
Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)

Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time

About Voice Arena

Voice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.

We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.

Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:

* Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.
* Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.
* Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.
* A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.

**About the role**

**Voice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.**

**We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.**

**The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?**

**This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.**

**In this role, you will**

**The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:**

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.
2. Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.
3. Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.
4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.
5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.
6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.

In a typical week, you might:

* Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day
* Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team
* Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them
* Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts
* Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

**What matters most**

**Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.**

**1. Reaching the right people**

**Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:**

* Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.
* Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.
* Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.
* Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:

* Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.
* Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.
* Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.
* Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.
* Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

**What we offer**

* High ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.
* A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.
* Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.
* Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.

**Minimum qualifications**

* 2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused company
* A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself
* Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption
* Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it
* Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated
* High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

**Preferred qualifications**

*You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.*

* Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting
* An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators
* Experience running creator or influencer campaigns
* Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)
* Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

**Why join Voice Arena**

* Shape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.
* See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.
* Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a brand built on real research: papers at Interspeech 2026, a Hugging Face partnership and benchmarks the field checks.
* Reach the whole world's speech. Our data and evals reach far beyond English, across the wider Global South, so the audience is global.
* Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.

**How to apply**

**Send your CV, a short note and links to accounts, posts or campaigns you've grown to amritansh@voicearena.com.**

title: Podcast Analyst, Strategist & Researcher
description:
**About us**

**Humour Me**
is a creative agency that is built for the here and now. We’re a contemporary creative services and content marketing agency with an expertise in driving relevance for our clients and delivering high impact business results. The independently-owned agency was founded in 2012 and has its office in the capital city of the country. Humour Me has been recognised as a global honouree at The Webby Awards and has won over 16 global creative awards for excellence in storytelling, filmmaking, animation and new media disruption.

From brands like Tata Play, Tata Play Binge, Paper Boat, bigbasket, 1 Finance, Duolingo, Arctic Fox, Heads Up For Tails, Xiaomi, Tata 1mg, Dunzo, Airtel to many others, Humour Me has created category inventing work, helping build some of India’s most loved brands.

We are seeking a driven and experienced client services manager to join our business team. This person would be responsible for managing key client relationships, strategically lead the existing businesses, and drive performance of their team, based out of New Delhi.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Podcast Analyst, Strategist & Researcher**
who can help us build better podcast episodes through strong research, audience understanding and content strategy.

Our podcast focuses primarily on
**health, wellness, psychology, lifestyle and human behaviour**
. You don't need to come from a medical background. What matters most is your ability to
**research deeply, think critically, understand information and turn it into interesting content.**

You'll work closely with the content and production team to research topics, analyse podcast performance, identify trends, research guests and develop insights that can make every episode stronger.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Research & Topic Development**

* Deeply research potential podcast topics and identify interesting angles.

* Find relevant studies, reports, expert opinions, statistics, news and credible sources.

* Understand a topic from multiple perspectives instead of relying on a single source.

* Identify myths, misconceptions, interesting facts and unanswered questions.

* Convert research into clear and useful insights for the host and writing team.

* Develop research briefs for upcoming episodes.

**2. Health & Wellness Research**

* Research health-related topics with accuracy and responsibility.

* Learn how to navigate credible health and scientific sources.

* Understand the basics of reading studies and evaluating claims.

* Cross-check important claims before they are used in an episode.

* Clearly distinguish between established evidence, expert opinion, emerging research and speculation.

* You don't need to be a doctor or medical expert.
  **You need to be willing and capable of learning how to research health topics properly.**

**3. Guest Research**

* Research potential guests and understand their background, expertise and work.

* Study their previous interviews, articles, books, research and public conversations.

* Identify interesting stories, opinions and areas that can lead to deeper conversations.

* Prepare detailed guest research documents.

* Develop questions and follow-up questions based on your research.

**4. Podcast Analytics**

* Analyse episode performance across views, CTR, watch time, retention and engagement.

* Identify which topics, guests and formats perform better.

* Study audience drop-offs and understand where attention is being lost.

* Analyse titles, thumbnails, hooks and episode structures.

* Identify patterns across multiple episodes.

* Turn analytics into clear recommendations for future episodes.

**5. Content & Podcast Strategy**

* Identify topics that have strong audience potential.

* Track what audiences are searching for and talking about.

* Study successful podcasts and creators to understand what is working.

* Identify content gaps and opportunities.

* Suggest new formats, recurring themes and episode ideas.

* Help build a long-term podcast content roadmap.

**6. Trend & Audience Research**

* Track emerging conversations around health, wellness, psychology, lifestyle and culture.

* Analyse YouTube, social media, search trends and audience discussions.

* Understand what questions people are asking.

* Identify the gap between what people believe and what research or experts suggest.

* Convert these observations into potential podcast topics.

**7. Fact-Checking & Quality Control**

* Verify important statistics, claims and information before publication.

* Check whether a source actually supports the claim being made.

* Flag weak, exaggerated or misleading claims.

* Maintain organised sources and references for each episode.

* Help ensure that the podcast remains informative without becoming unnecessarily complicated.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent research skills.

* Strong curiosity and ability to go down a research rabbit hole.

* Good understanding of YouTube and podcast content.

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

* Ability to find patterns and insights from information.

* Good writing and communication skills.

* Ability to simplify complex information.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Interest in health, psychology, science, human behaviour, culture and lifestyle.

* Willingness to learn how to research health and scientific topics properly.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**You DON'T Need**

* A medical degree.

* To be a doctor, nutritionist or psychologist.

* Previous experience working specifically on a health podcast.

**If you're a strong researcher and content thinker, we can teach you the domain.**

**Good to Have**

* Previous experience in YouTube, podcasts, journalism, research or content strategy.

* Experience with YouTube Analytics.

* Familiarity with Google Trends, YouTube Search and audience research.

* Basic understanding of research papers and scientific studies.

* Experience researching guests or preparing interview briefs.

* Experience working with health, psychology, science or lifestyle content.

**The Ideal Person**

You're the kind of person who sees a topic and immediately starts asking:

**Why does this happen?**

**Is this actually true?**

**What does the research say?**

**What are people getting wrong about this?**

**What is the interesting story here?**

You don't just collect information.

You
**connect the dots.**

You can take a complicated topic, spend hours researching it, find the important insights and turn

them into something that makes the audience think:

**"Wait, I never thought about it this way."**

**What You'll Deliver**

* Topic research documents

* Episode research briefs

* Guest research dossiers

* Question banks

* Fact-checking documents

* Source libraries

* Podcast performance reports

* Audience insights

* Trend reports

* Topic recommendations

* Content strategy recommendations

* Competitor analysis

* Short-form content opportunities

**Role**

**Position:**
Podcast Analyst, Strategist & Researcher

**Experience:**
2-5 years

**Type:**
Full-Time

**Domain:**
Health, Wellness, Psychology, Lifestyle & Human Behaviour

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

title: Associate TSE II
description:

Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have

* 4+ years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding and grasp of the following areas
* Systems administration
* Troubleshooting Systems
* Scalable and Highly available distributed systems
* Network Administration
* Application Architecture
* Data architecture and design
* Understanding of database architecture and administration
* Experience in performance tuning and benchmarking
* Previous experience in technical support
* A B.Tech / B.S. or equivalent work experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Comfortable with modern AI concepts and proficient in using AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and enhance day-to-day technical support workflows.
* Knowledge on one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl
* It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

Success Measures

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: RCM Admin
description:
**Position Summary:**

The RCM Administrator serves as the central administrator and subject matter expert for the OneStream Account Reconciliation Management (RCM) platform. This role is responsible for maintaining global account reconciliation master data, supporting monthly close and reconciliation processes, administering user access and security, ensuring policy compliance, and providing operational support to regional and business unit finance teams.

The RCM Administrator acts as the primary point of contact for RCM-related activities, partnering with Corporate Accounting, Finance Systems, Internal Controls, Segment Controllers, and regional Super Users to ensure the integrity, accuracy, and effectiveness of the global account reconciliation process.

**Key Responsibilities**

**RCM System Administration**

* Administer and maintain the OneStream RCM application and supporting processes.
* Execute monthly Discover and Process activities to identify new reconciliation inventory and account changes.
* Maintain company-wide RCM settings, reconciliation attributes, workflows, due dates, and risk profiles.
* Create, update, and maintain account groups, ownership assignments, and reconciliation hierarchies.
* Manage mass updates and configuration changes within the RCM environment.
* Coordinate implementation of approved governance and change-control decisions.

**Monthly Close and Reconciliation Support**

* Create and communicate monthly RCM task plans and deadlines.
* Monitor reconciliation progress and completion status throughout the close cycle.
* Maintain monthly folders, reporting files, and supporting documentation.
* Perform integrity reviews of reconciliation inventories, account groups, frequencies, due dates, and risk assignments.
* Identify and resolve reconciliation ownership gaps, including assignment of newly created accounts.
* Support global finance teams throughout the month-end reconciliation process.

**Master Data Management**

* Maintain reconciliation ownership structures, including preparers, approvers, locations, business units, and regional assignments.
* Review and process requests for organizational changes, personnel changes, and account realignments.
* Ensure consistency and compliance of reconciliation group structures.
* Support implementation of acquisitions, reorganizations, business transfers, and entity changes affecting reconciliation ownership.

**User Support and Security Administration**

* Serve as first-level escalation point for RCM administration and system support.
* Coordinate OneStream access requests, user onboarding, reactivations, and security changes.
* Assist users and Super Users with troubleshooting, training, and process questions.
* Provide guidance regarding security groups, reconciliation assignments, workflows, and reporting.

**Governance, Compliance, and Controls**

* Ensure reconciliation processes comply with company policy and internal control requirements.
* Perform monthly validation of group integrity, risk classifications, frequencies, and due dates.
* Support internal and external audit requests related to reconciliation administration.
* Participate in governance reviews and change-control discussions impacting RCM operations.
* Maintain documentation supporting compliance and control effectiveness.

**Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain reconciliation trackers and management reporting files.
* Support Power BI reporting and reconciliation analytics.
* Analyze recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Partner with Finance Systems teams to improve automation and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate and facilitate recurring RCM management meetings as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of accounting, finance operations, controllership, shared services, or financial systems experience.
* Experience with account reconciliations and month-end close processes.
* Experience administering financial systems, ERP applications, or reconciliation platforms.
* Strong understanding of internal controls and financial governance processes.
* Advanced Excel skills and ability to manage large volumes of financial data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* OneStream Account Reconciliation Management (RCM) experience.
* Experience supporting global finance organizations.
* Knowledge of financial master data management and workflow administration.
* Experience with Power BI, reporting tools, or finance system integrations.
* Project management and change management experience.

**Critical Success Factors**

* Strong attention to detail and data integrity.
* Excellent organizational and workload management skills including email management.
* Ability to influence and partner across multiple business units and regions.
* Strong customer-service mindset and responsiveness.
* Ability to manage sensitive financial data and maintain appropriate controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical/critical thinking skills

**About Haalpeco Hotels**

Haalpeco Hotels is an emerging hospitality management and development company focused on building a diversified portfolio of hotels across India.

Our portfolio strategy encompasses boutique hotels, heritage properties, resorts and business hotels, with a focus on identifying promising hospitality opportunities and developing long-term partnerships with hotel owners and investors.

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced
**Hotel Development Manager**
to support our expansion and strengthen our presence across key hospitality markets in India.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, well-connected and results-oriented Hotel Development Manager to drive new hotel acquisition and development opportunities.

The primary responsibility will be to identify, source and generate qualified leads for new hotel management and lease opportunities across India, with an initial focus on North India.

The ideal candidate should have an established network of hotel owners, real estate developers, investors and hospitality industry professionals, along with a strong understanding of the Indian hotel development landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Hotel Development & Lead Generation**

* Proactively identify potential hotels, resorts and hospitality projects suitable for management agreements or long-term leases.
* Generate and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified hotel development opportunities.
* Identify existing independent hotels suitable for conversion, repositioning or rebranding.
* Explore greenfield and brownfield hospitality development opportunities.
* Conduct market research to identify emerging destinations and potential growth markets.

**2. Owner & Investor Relationships**

* Develop and maintain relationships with hotel owners, developers, investors and real estate consultants.
* Build a strong network of hospitality industry contacts to generate new business opportunities.
* Conduct initial meetings with property owners to understand their requirements and investment objectives.

* Conduct preliminary assessments of potential properties, including location, inventory, facilities and market positioning.
* Gather relevant property information, including ownership details, existing performance and development status.

**4. Business Development & Deal Coordination**

* Present Haalpeco Hotels management capabilities and proposed operating models to prospective owners.
* Coordinate initial discussions regarding hotel management agreements and lease arrangements.
* Assist in preparing development proposals, presentations and letters of intent.
* Support commercial negotiations and coordinate with internal teams through the contracting process.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective owners to progress opportunities towards closure.

**5. Pipeline Management & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated database of hotel development leads and prospective owners.
* Track opportunities from initial identification through evaluation, negotiation and signing.

* Strong existing relationships with hotel owners, developers and hospitality investors.
* Good understanding of hotel management agreements, lease structures and hotel development processes.
* Strong communication, networking, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

title: Nutritionist (Functional Medicine & Functional Nutrition)
description:
**About Us:**
At Smriti Kochar Healthcare LLP, we specialize in root-cause healing, helping individuals reverse chronic health conditions through functional medicine, nutrition, and lifestyle interventions.
  
If you are passionate about healing from the root, committed to lifelong learning, and want to work closely with people who genuinely want to transform their health, this is your place.
  

**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Nutritionist who is deeply passionate about root-cause healing through functional nutrition and lifestyle medicine. This role goes far beyond calorie-counting and weight loss—it is about helping people heal from chronic health issues by addressing the root causes using food, functional supplements, and lifestyle interventions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong clinical experience in handling gut-related disorders like acidity, GERD, reflux, SIBO, IBS, and gut infections. A solid understanding of the gut microbiome and its role in chronic health conditions is essential. Additionally, they should have working knowledge of hormonal imbalances in women (PCOS, thyroid dysfunction, PMS, perimenopause), metabolic dysfunction, and skin conditions linked to poor gut health.
  
  
You will be required to create individualized healing protocols using:
  
· Functional nutrition frameworks
  
· Functional supplements
  
· Lifestyle interventions (stress management, sleep optimization, circadian rhythm, detoxification support)
  
  
Weight loss protocols will also be a part of this role, but always with a root-cause, healing-first approach—designing personalized plans that nourish the body while helping clients achieve their body composition goals.
  
This is a lead-level position, requiring clinical skills AND excellent communication skills to counsel, coach, and guide clients through transformational healing journeys.
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (including but not limited to):**
**Client Care & Case Handling**
· Conduct 1:1 consultations to assess client health history, lifestyle, labs (if applicable), and goals.
  
· Design individualized, root-cause healing protocols using functional nutrition, supplements, and lifestyle interventions.
  
· Confidently handle clients struggling with:
  
o Gut health concerns (acidity, reflux, SIBO, gut infections, IBS, constipation, diarrhea, bloating, etc.)
  
o Hormonal imbalances (PCOS, hypothyroidism, insulin resistance, PMS, perimenopause)
  
o Metabolic dysfunction, stubborn weight loss issues
  
o Skin conditions linked to gut dysfunction
  
· Collaborate with the founder/lead practitioner for complex cases.
  
  
**Program Delivery & Engagement**
· Lead and run health programs across different categories offered by the organisation.
  
· Engage with clients via scheduled calls, follow-ups, emails, or messaging groups.
  
· Troubleshoot, provide emotional support, and guide clients step-by-step through their healing process.
  

**Documentation & Reporting**
· Maintain professional client records, case notes, and track progress systematically.
  
· Manage reporting sheets, client dashboards, or CRM systems.
  

**Knowledge Contribution & Development**
· Assist in developing client resources: diet plans, supplement protocols, program documents.
  
· Stay up-to-date with functional medicine research and developments in nutrition science.
  
· Contribute to team learning and program evolution.
  

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
**✅ Technical Qualifications:**
· BSc/MSc in Nutrition & Dietetics, Clinical Nutrition, or related field.
  
· 3-5+ years of clinical practice as a practicing Nutritionist or Dietitian.
  
· Expertise in functional nutrition, healing protocols, and supplement interventions.
  
· Ability to create calorically appropriate, nutrient-dense weight loss programs that promote healing.
  
· Knowledge of hormonal balancing diets, gut-healing protocols, and liver detoxification strategies.
  
  
**✅ Communication & Soft Skills:**
· Excellent spoken and written English.
  
· High emotional intelligence, empathy, and ability to build rapport with clients.
  
· Good organizational skills with structured thinking and follow-through.
  
· Confidence in leading webinars, video calls, or client group sessions.
  

**✅ Preferred (but Not Mandatory):**
· Knowledge of functional testing protocols (GI Map, DUTCH, Organic Acids, advanced blood panels).
  
· Functional Medicine certifications, or equivalent experience.
  
· Background in working with integrative health setups, clinics, or wellness brands.
  
  
**Personality Fit**
· Approaches health from the root cause, not just symptom management.
  
· Genuinely passionate about helping people heal.
  
· Constant learner, always updating knowledge.
  
· Values client-centered care, integrity, and evidence-based practices.

title: Lead Operations Researcher
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Praxas AI is the AI-native decision layer for supply chains. We sit on top of the ERP a company already runs and continuously re-optimize what to make, stock, buy and ship as conditions change helping four primary departments: sourcing, inventory, production planning and logistics. When a supplier slips or a rush order lands, Praxas recommends the response (accelerate a PO, delay a production run, adjust safety stock), and our agents carry it out with Human-on-the-loop approval, , with the long term goal shifting to Human-in-the-loop approval.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring our first Operations Research Engineer to own the math behind every Praxas decision. You'll build the optimization engine for production planning first, then inventory, sourcing and logistics.

This is a hands-on build role, not academic research or consulting. You'll turn messy factory realities (capacities, changeovers, bills of materials, late suppliers) into models that run on real customer data and re-plan continuously. You'll move between a planner's desk on a factory floor, a solver log and a whiteboard with our engineers without losing the thread.

Our principle is simple: the solver decides, the AI explains and acts. You own the solver. You'll work directly with the founders, our AI and data engineers, and the planners who use what you build every day.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the decision engine**

• Model real plants: capacities, routings, bills of materials, changeovers, labor, material availability and due dates.

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling problems (lot sizing, sequencing, capacity allocation) that minimize lost sales and cost.

• Pick the right method for each problem: mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics or decomposition.

• Keep solve times fast enough to re-plan on demand for plants with hundreds of products.

• Design models that are configured per customer (industry, production type, demand pattern), not rewritten per customer.

**Make re-optimization continuous and trustworthy**

• Build rolling-horizon re-planning that reacts to new orders, delays and breakdowns without reshuffling the whole plan.

• Use time fences, frozen windows and change penalties so planners can trust the schedule.

• Turn the trade-off between optimality and stability into a setting planners understand.

• Model uncertainty in demand, lead times and yields with stochastic or robust approaches.

**Extend into inventory optimization and forecasting**

• Build inventory optimization: safety stock, reorder points, service-level targets and multi-location policies.

• Use probabilistic forecasts (ranges, not single numbers) as optimizer inputs, working with our forecasting engine.

• Backtest every model against customer history before it touches a live plan.

Ship with customers and the team

• Work directly with planners and plant heads at our design partners to validate constraints and results.

• Feed our AI agents the decisions they act on: delay a production run, expedite a PO, adjust safety stock.

• Tell our data engineers exactly what data each model needs, and how to handle missing or messy inputs.

• Define and track the metrics that prove value: lost sales avoided, inventory freed, on-time-in-full and machine utilization.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days**

• Ship v1 of the production planning model, running on real data from our first design partners.

• Set a baseline for each partner: current lost sales, utilization, changeover time and plan versus actual.

• Agree solve-time and plan-stability targets with the team, and meet them on partner data.

• Document every model's formulation, assumptions and parameters so others can extend it.

**Within 6–12 months**

• Run continuous re-optimization in production for every customer, with stability controls planners trust.

• Deliver results customers sign off on: fewer lost sales, less excess inventory and better on-time-in-full.

• Connect inventory optimization and probabilistic forecasts to production planning in one engine.

• Build reusable model templates by production type (job shop, batch, assembly, continuous) to cut implementation time.

• Own the operations research roadmap, and help hire and mentor as the team grows.

**Who You Are**

**Required**

• Operations research and advanced modeling: design and implement advanced analytical models using techniques such as mixed-integer linear programming, discrete event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic modeling and decision analysis under uncertainty.

• Experience building optimization or planning models that real operations ran on, beyond academic work.

• Strong formulation skills in mixed-integer and/or constraint programming.

• Experience with optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, etc.).

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Working knowledge of production planning: master scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, lot sizing and sequencing.

• Solid probability and statistics, including demand uncertainty and safety stock math.

• Production-quality Python and comfortable SQL.

• Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

**Preferred**

• Experience at a supply chain planning software company (such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or Coupa), or on an in-house planning or OR team at a manufacturer, retailer or 3PL.

• Rolling-horizon planning and schedule-stability methods used in production systems.

• Inventory optimization: service-level targets, (s, S) and (R, S) policies, multi-echelon networks.

• Forecasting for intermittent or lumpy demand (Croston, SBA, TSB) and probabilistic forecasts.

• Heuristics, metaheuristics or decomposition for large problem instances.

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Process industries (chemicals, food, CPG): batches, shelf life, sequence-dependent cleaning.

• Experience with Indian mid-market manufacturers or their ERPs (Tally, SAP Business One).

• APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

• Experience pairing optimization with LLM or agent systems.

• Familiarity with Silver, Pyke and Thomas, Inventory and Production Management in Supply Chains, the foundation of our engine.

**What We Offer**

• A founding-team role where you own the core IP the company is built on.

• Competitive salary plus meaningful ESOPs.

• Real customer data from day one, and a direct line to the founders.

• The chance to define how a new generation of supply chain software makes decisions.

title: Apprentice Engineer - Highways

Your impact
  
  
A well-motivated and creative Graduate Engineer with excellent numerical, logical, and analytical abilities who is interested in building a career in Engineering, Planning, or Design Consulting on multidisciplinary engineering projects.
  
  
The Apprentice Program is designed to provide hands-on, real-world experience through structured on-the-job training within live projects. Apprentices will work closely with Jacobs' senior professionals and project managers, gaining exposure to technical practices, project delivery processes, and organizational culture.
  
  
This position is an Apprentice role under the Government of India’s Apprentices Act, 1961, and is part of a structured 1-year training program. As per the regulations and eligibility criteria prescribed under the Act, Jacobs is required to adhere to the government-mandated guidelines for apprentice engagement. Therefore, it is mandatory for all applicants to meet the specified eligibility requirements.
  
  
He/ she will be responsible for quality design delivery. Good understanding of teamwork in the highways business area. Exhibits clear progression towards a technical career path.
  
  

* Undertake and successfully complete all technical and such other trainings as identified / allotted.
* Learn, understand and apply all aspects of Highway Engineering including geometric design of highways (roundabout, intersection and interchange, calculation of earthwork, preparation of detailed cross-sections, preparation of super elevation data, Junctions and Roundabout grading, parking facility, checking maneuvering of vehicles in parking area using Auto-Turn, Signing & Marking and estimation of quantities), implications and impact of various codal provisions (for multiple regions) and preparation of specifications and technical reports.
* Undertake and assist in basic engineering and planning tasks, such as design works, preparing engineering calculations and drawings, modelling of engineering behaviour, etc., as an originator with minimum guidance from team members.
* Preparation of plans, profile, Assemblies and Corridors.
* Taking responsibilities for their own work and producing higher quality technical output.
* Ability to listen, understand and follow instructions.
* Shows flexibility in work tasks and locations
* Successfully and effectively complete the Graduate Development Program

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor's in Civil / Master's degree in Transportation specialization from a recognized university.
* Academic passing year 2026.
* No dead or live backlogs/ATKT.
* Minimum 7 CGPA throughout all semesters.
* Candidates must not have any prior work experience.
* Candidates with a master's degree are eligible only if their bachelor's degree was completed within four years of the application date. Therefore, a B.Tech degree completed before 2022 would not meet this requirement.
* Candidates must not be registered on the NATS portal.
* Internship, academic project, or industrial training experience related to engineering design or project delivery is preferred.
* Exposure to international engineering standards and practices is desirable.
* Knowledge in any highway design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads) is not needed but will be an added advantage.

**Apprentice Eligibility Requirements**
As this opportunity falls under the Apprentices Act, 1961, applicants must additionally meet the following criteria
  
  

* Must be eligible for apprenticeship training under the Government of India guidelines.
* Must not have previously undergone apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.
* Must satisfy all eligibility conditions prescribed by the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) and applicable government regulations.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

* Reverse-engineer geometry: take an STL/mesh with no feature history and reconstruct the design intent as parametric, code-first CAD (build123d), inferring sketches, features, datums, patterns, and key dimensional relationships.
* Evaluate AI-generated design solutions, 3D models, feature trees, mating strategies, drawings, and pin down failure cases, edge cases, and quality gaps.
* Decompose complex modelling and verification tasks into structured, step-by-step workflows the model can learn from and be measured against.

**Domain Responsibilities**

* Build and assess parametric models, assemblies, and detailed2D drawings across machined, sheet-metal, cast/moulded, and weldment parts.
* Judge design intent, constraints, and robustness, modelling approach.
* Apply and check GD&T, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing across the full product design lifecycle (concept → detailing → design review → handoff).
* Validate code-first reconstructions against source geometry via deviation and dimensional-accuracy checks.

**Requirements**

***Must Have***

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/Ph.D in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related) from a Tier 1/Tier2 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT, DTU/NSUT, or equivalent).
* 4+ years of hands-on CAD/mechanical design with breadth across multiple platforms (Autodesk Fusion, SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, or Inventor), multiple part types, and the full design workflow.
* Strong command of parametric modelling, assembly design, engineering drawings, GD&T, and DFM.
* Working Python ability and genuine comfort with code-first CAD (build123d / Cad Query), or a clear track record of picking up scripting fast.

***Good to Have***

* Mesh processing (trimesh, Open3D, numpy-stl) and familiarity with OpenCascade/OCCT.
* Exposure to adjacent disciplines, surfacing, simulation-driven design, generative/topology optimization, or CAM handoff.
* PLM/PDM and configuration management.

**Interested candidates are required to complete the attached CAD assessment as part of the application process and submit @shilpa.srivastava@softage.net.**

Choose one of the three CAD projects and recreate the model from scratch using the reference image and STEP file as guidance. Match the shape, proportions, and key dimensions as accurately as possible, record your complete modelling session using OBS Studio, and submit the recording along with the final CAD files via a shared Google Drive folder.

Assessment Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ADwGVYovLVc\_mXi32Sbe-urXUWK-X-fb/view?usp=sharing

title: Assistant Manager - Accounts Payable
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented
**Assistant Manager – Accounts Payable with exposure in Manufacturing Industry**
who can manage end-to-end Accounts Payable activities and support financial reporting, vendor management, statutory compliance, and expense monitoring.

The role involves ensuring timely and accurate invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, MIS reporting, and effective monitoring of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycle. The ideal candidate should have
**hands-on experience in SAP/SAP HANA**
, particularly PR/PO, MIGO, and MIRO transactions, along with a strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes, financial controls, and capital expenditure (Capex) accounting.

1. **Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable Management**

* Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable activities, including invoice processing, verification, accounting, and payment-related activities.
* Ensure timely and accurate booking of vendor invoices in SAP/SAP HANA through MIRO and journal vouchers (JV).
* Monitor pending Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) and coordinate with relevant departments for timely MIGO and MIRO completion.
* Verify invoices against applicable POs, goods receipts/service entry sheets, and supporting documents.
* Identify and resolve invoice discrepancies, blocked invoices, and pending GR/IR items.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and classification of expenses in accordance with company policies.
* Handle Capex MIRO transactions and write-offs in SAP.

**Vendor Reconciliation and Ageing**

* Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences.
* Prepare and review vendor ageing reports and monitor overdue and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement, business teams, and vendors to resolve open items.
* Monitor vendor advances and ensure timely adjustment and settlement.

**MIS and Management Reporting**

* Prepare periodic Accounts Payable MIS reports for management review.
* Prepare and analyze Budget vs. Actual expenses and highlight significant variances.
* Analyze key AP metrics, outstanding liabilities, vendor ageing, and pending invoices.
* Provide financial data, analysis, and ad-hoc reports to support management decision-making.

**MSME Compliance**

* Identify and monitor MSME-registered vendors.
* Track outstanding MSME dues and ensure compliance with applicable statutory payment timelines.
* Maintain records and provide information required for MSME-related reporting and compliance.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve MSME-related issues.

**Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Process Monitoring**

* Monitor the complete PR–PO–MIGO–MIRO–Payment cycle.
* Track pending PR, PO, MIGO, and MIRO transactions and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely closure of open items and minimize ageing of pending transactions.
* Work closely with Procurement, Stores, Supply Chain Management (SCM), and business teams to improve P2P processes.

**Internal Controls and Audit**

* Ensure compliance with internal accounting policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and financial controls.
* Support internal, statutory, and tax audits by providing required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen Accounts Payable controls and operational efficiency.

**2. Educational Qualifications**

* CA Inter from a recognized institution.
* Any graduate or Post Graduate

**3. Experience and Technical Competencies**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable or Finance & Accounts.
* Hands-on experience in SAP/SAP HANA is required, particularly in MIRO and related transactions.
* Experience in manufacturing, agriculture, Agri-inputs, seeds, or related industries will be an added advantage.
* Experience managing a high-volume vendor base and complex Procure-to-Pay transactions will be preferred.

**4. Key Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay processes.
* Good knowledge of vendor ageing, vendor reconciliation, and Accounts Payable MIS.
* Understanding of Budget vs. Actual expense analysis.
* Knowledge of MSME vendor compliance and payment requirements.
* Strong MS Excel skills, including data analysis and MIS preparation.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Procurement, Stores, SCM, and other business functions.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**5. Role Expectations**

The successful candidate will ensure efficient Accounts Payable operations, accurate financial records, timely vendor reconciliations, adherence to statutory payment requirements, and effective monitoring of the Procure-to-Pay cycle while supporting financial controls and reporting requirements.

title: Article Trainee

**Company Description**
MUKUL GARG & ASSOCIATES | CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS provides end-to-end professional services for businesses, from setup and registration to ongoing compliance and advisory. The firm offers Virtual CFO services and handles litigation related to income tax and GST, including refunds and demand matters. The firm also supports NGOs and non-profit organizations with registration and regular income tax compliance, giving team members exposure to diverse sectors and regulatory frameworks.

**Role Description**
The Article Trainee will work full time on-site at the firm’s office in Delhi, India. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with accounting, bookkeeping, and preparation of financial statements, as well as supporting audits and tax filings under Income Tax and GST laws. The trainee will help in drafting working papers, preparing documentation for assessments and appeals, and supporting litigation and compliance matters. The role involves learning and applying concepts of international taxation and Ind AS/IFRS, helping with NGO and non-profit registrations and compliance, and maintaining accurate client records. * Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/tax software, with an ability to prepare working papers, reconciliations, and compliance reports.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical and research skills to interpret laws, notifications, and case studies, and to support litigation and advisory work.
* Candidates should possess clear written and verbal communication skills, professional ethics, and the ability to interact confidently with team members and clients.
* Candidates should possess good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple assignments and meet compliance deadlines.
* Prior internship or practical exposure in a CA firm, and interest in NGO/non-profit sector compliance, will be considered an added advantage.
