title: Global Property Consultants
description:
**Company Description**
HearthAway supports international students in securing accommodation before they move abroad, helping ease the transition to living away from home in a new country and environment. Instead of simply listing options, HearthAway enables students to compare and choose between student halls, studio apartments, shared houses, and homestays near their university. The platform focuses on clear guidance and informed decision-making so students can feel confident about where they will live. Students use HearthAway to secure housing across the UK, Ireland, and France prior to arrival, allowing them to “find accommodation before you fly” and arrive with greater peace of mind.

**Role Description**
The Global Property Consultants role is a full-time, hybrid position based in New Delhi, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. In this role, the consultant will guide international students through the accommodation selection process by understanding their needs, presenting suitable options, and explaining differences between property types and locations. Daily responsibilities include managing inquiries, scheduling and conducting consultations (online and in-person), coordinating with property partners, and maintaining accurate records of student preferences and bookings. The consultant will also help improve internal processes by sharing insights on student needs, market trends, and partner performance, and will contribute to the development of content and tools that make housing decisions simpler and more transparent. Collaboration with the wider team to ensure high-quality service, timely responses, and a consistent student experience across regions is a key aspect of the role.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain housing options clearly and build trust with international students and property partners.
* Customer service and consultation skills, including active listening, problem-solving, and handling multiple inquiries with attention to detail.
* Organizational and time-management abilities to manage schedules, follow up on leads, and keep accurate records in CRM or similar systems.
* Comfort with digital tools and online platforms, including video conferencing, collaborative tools, and basic data entry or reporting.
* Knowledge or interest in international education and student housing markets, especially in the UK, Ireland, and France, is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment from New Delhi, collaborating with a distributed team and adapting to changing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in any field; experience in real estate, accommodation services, study abroad consulting, or related domains is a plus.
* Professional fluency in English; additional language skills relevant to international student communities are beneficial.

title: Fire Protection Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Slk ENGINEERS Pvt Ltd is an engineering services firm specializing in high-quality design and consulting solutions for building and infrastructure projects. The company focuses on delivering safe, efficient, and compliant systems that align with national and international standards. With a strong emphasis on technical excellence and practical implementation, Slk ENGINEERS collaborates closely with clients, contractors, and authorities to ensure reliable project outcomes. Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas and grow their expertise through hands-on project experience and professional development.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Fire Protection Engineer role based in Delhi, India. The Fire Protection Engineer will design and review fire protection and suppression systems for commercial, industrial, and residential projects, ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards. Daily responsibilities include performing fire safety and life safety calculations, preparing engineering drawings and technical specifications, and coordinating with architects, structural engineers, and MEP teams. The role also involves conducting site inspections, supporting installation and testing activities, and preparing reports and documentation for approvals from regulatory authorities. The engineer will participate in risk assessments, recommend safety improvements, and assist in client meetings and technical presentations as needed.

* Strong foundation in Fire Protection Engineering and Safety Engineering, with the ability to design and evaluate fire protection systems.
* Knowledge of Fire Safety and Life Safety principles, including code compliance, emergency egress, and occupant safety considerations.
* Experience with Fire Suppression Systems, such as sprinkler systems, hydrant networks, fire alarms, and gas-based suppression solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Familiarity with relevant standards and codes (e.g., NFPA, NBC India, local fire authority regulations).
* Proficiency in engineering design tools and software (e.g., AutoCAD or similar drafting tools; exposure to hydraulic calculation software is an advantage).
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with multidisciplinary project teams and external stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct site visits, inspections, and coordination activities in an on-site project environment.
* Prior experience in fire protection design or safety engineering projects is preferred but motivated early-career professionals will also be considered.

**We are looking for a**

The role combines human physiology, clinical data analysis, statistical research, and scientific writing, with opportunities to work alongside doctors and multidisciplinary healthcare professionals.

* **Research & Study Design:**
   Develop research questions, design observational studies, review scientific literature, and conduct statistical analyses.
* **Scientific Publications:**
   Prepare research reports, manuscripts, research papers, and scientific presentations.
* **Clinical Collaboration:**

* Experience in clinical research, health data analysis, or physiological research.
* Knowledge of research methodology, study design, and statistical analysis.
* Proficiency in Excel and statistical tools such as SPSS, R, or Python.
* Ability to interpret scientific literature and prepare research reports.
* Strong analytical thinking and scientific writing skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with longitudinal clinical or health datasets.
* Prior involvement in scientific publications or research manuscripts.
* Knowledge of preventive medicine, exercise physiology, metabolic health, or longevity science.

**Why Join ODDS Longevity?**

* Work with real-world health data and advanced diagnostic assessments.
* Contribute to India-specific research on preventive health and longevity.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical and research teams.
* Participate in scientific studies, publications, and presentations.
* Opportunity to contribute to emerging research in healthy ageing and personalised preventive healthcare.

title: Assistant Producer/Producer, BBC News Hindi (1 Year Fixed Term Contract)
description:
**Job Description:**

  
We are looking for an imaginative and detail-oriented Assistant Producer/ Producer to create high-quality visual content for our BBC News Hindi service. You are not just "making videos"; you are defining the visual identity of a story creatively and bring it to life through digital, social, and TV platforms. Producer/Assistant Producer will be responsible for error-free writing, editing and producing a range of digital content - in text, video, and audio formats for our Website, TV, Social Platforms and podcasts, to the highest professional standards
  

**Who We Are**
  
From April 2024, the majority of the BBC’s Indian operations moved to the Collective Newsroom which has been set up by some of the BBC’s most experienced journalists in India. It has more than 250 journalists and operational staff, bringing you distinctive, impartial and world-class content and is the BBC’s sole provider of content for its Indian language websites and social media platforms including English. Based in the BBC’s largest international market, we bring you the best of Indian journalism guided by the world’s biggest and most reputable news organisation. We provide digital, audio and television content in Bangla, Hindi, Tamil, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, Telugu, Urdu as well as English.

Our Vision: “Home to India’s most credible, creative and courageous journalism.”
  
  
Our Mission: “To lead with facts bringing diverse voices through innovative and impactful journalism in the public interest.”
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer, that strongly supports diversity and inclusion at the workplace, and encourages female candidates and persons from other diverse groups such as marginalised, under-privileged communities and differently-abled people, to apply.
  
  
To know more about us, visit our website: https://collectivenewsroom.com/
  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* This role involves editorial control, video production and planning stories for Hindi service’s social media platforms.
* Use a range of video, audio and digital equipment and information technology to research, write, assemble, edit and deliver outputs in the appropriate medium, to the highest professional standards.
* Act as a final check for accuracy, impartiality, and legal compliance (Libel, Contempt of Court, and Privacy) before publication.
* You will pitch, develop original video concepts and text stories and oversee their execution from pre-production to post-production.
* Manage cross-platform responsibilities, working seamlessly across web publishing, video production, and on-screen presentation.

Present and deliver live segments, studio explainers, and digital-first video formats with confidence and clarity.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Energeia is an Industrial Energy Savings Company. We find energy waste in factories and commercial buildings, fix it, and get paid from the savings we verify. Since 2018 we have completed 1,200+ site appraisals and 250+ energy audits, and saved customers ₹256 Crore in energy costs. We are a BEE-accredited ESCO with offices in 5 cities and technology partnerships with ABB, L&T and GFS Corp (USA).

In August 2026 we launched August Energeia with Singapore-based August Energy: a $100M platform that finances, installs and operates energy infrastructure for Indian industry, so customers pay from savings instead of upfront capex. Energeia brings the audits, engineering, sales and the IoT and AI platform behind every project.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

We are scaling from 54 people toward 75 over the next 12 months without losing the culture that got us here. You will design how.

Payroll and compliance have to stay flawless. The next phase also needs auditors and engineers hired faster than the market, a performance system people trust, and retention we measure instead of guess. This role reports to the CEO, with a clear path to Head of People.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

• Hiring: end-to-end recruitment across 5 cities, from trainees to senior leaders, through Naukri, LinkedIn, agencies and referrals

• Structured hiring: scorecards for every role, and coaching hiring managers to use them

• Onboarding: joining, induction and 30/60/90 plans for every new hire

• Payroll and HR operations: monthly payroll, attendance and leave reconciliation in Zoho People, and every employee letter from offer to relieving

• Statutory compliance: PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, Shops and Establishments and annual labour-law returns in every state we operate in

• Performance: goal setting, probation reviews and the annual review cycle with calibration

• Employee relations: a logged grievance mechanism, fair and confidential investigations, and exits through full-and-final

• Engagement and retention: eNPS, surveys, town halls and recognition; analyse attrition and act on it

• Company offsites: plan and run offsites end to end, from agenda and venue to logistics and budget

• HR systems and MIS: monthly headcount, attrition and hiring dashboards; handbook, policies and SOPs; AI tools to automate the routine

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

• 30 days: fully onboarded on our systems: Zoho People, payroll, statutory filings and POSH

• 90 days: hiring and recruitment plan aligned with the CEO and function heads

• 6 months: 10 roles hired, written goals for every employee, zero payroll errors

• 12 months: ~20 roles closed with median time-to-hire under 45 days and 90-day retention of 85%+; review cycle completed with calibrated ratings; 100% statutory compliance; eNPS baseline set and improving

**WHAT YOU BRING**

• 6 to 10 years in HR, including 3+ as the senior HR person in a growing company of roughly 50 to 500 people

• End-to-end recruitment at volume, including technical or field roles, with time-to-hire and quality numbers you can quote

• Hands-on payroll ownership on an HRMS, ideally Zoho People

• Working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi-state statutory compliance, including POSH

• Has designed or run a performance review cycle end to end

• Can build a headcount and attrition report from raw data in Excel or Google Sheets

• Sound judgement and discretion on grievances, exits and pay

**STRONG PLUS**

• MBA or PGDM in HR, or a master's in HR or Industrial Relations

• Hiring engineers, auditors or site teams in manufacturing, EPC, energy or industrial services

• Startup or scale-up experience

• POSH Internal Committee experience

• Zoho One, and daily use of AI tools (Claude or similar)

**HOW WE WORK**

• Trust: radical openness and transparency in everything we do

• Growth mindset: experiment, fail forward, invest in your own learning

• Ownership: results-driven people who solve more than their own problems

• Community: collaborative, inclusive teams that enjoy working together

• Fairness and decency: do what is right, not what is easier

• Resilience: welcome the challenges that push us, and come back stronger

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Competitive compensation based on experience

• A direct line to the CEO and a defined path to Head of People

• A people function in its biggest growth phase, yours to build

• Exposure to global partners: ABB, GFS Corp and August Energy

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

• You want to set strategy and hand payroll to a team. For the first year, you are the team.

• You need a finished HR playbook. Much of ours is still being written, and you will write it.

• You wait for problems to reach you. Grievances, attrition and compliance deadlines need someone who goes looking.

Energeia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and ownership, and welcome applicants of every background.

title: Research Analyst
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose**

The CEEW’s sustainable water programme informs policy-making for the sustainable development of water resources and their effective management through research in the areas of: circular water economy for urban resilience; climate risk-informed water security planning; climate-adaptive water governance; and water accounting-based planning.

For its sustainable water programme, CEEW seeks to hire a Research Analyst with a good understanding of India’s water sector. An ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of urban water management issues and challenges, especially considering the climate variability and change, and the current policy discourse (supply and demand management, and used water treatment, recycling, and reuse) for addressing them. The candidate should have prior experience working in the used water management and circular economy sectors.

Along with a policy research orientation, the candidate should possess strong data analysis skills and support the organisation in accessing various existing secondary data sets, such as those from the Census of India, Urban Local Bodies, Central and State Pollution Control Boards, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Jal Shakti, India WRIS or any other data sets available in the public domain. The candidate should have proficiency in using statistical tools. Hands-on experience with geo-spatial tools and experience of working in projects involving the engagement of urban local bodies will be desirable.

**Job Duties and Accountabilities**

**Research:**

* Undertaking policy and data analysis for mainstreaming treated used water (TUW) reuse in local governance.
* Assist in the development of city-level TUW reuse plans.
* Conduct primary surveys, including sampling, design and questionnaire development, and undertake field visits to collect data and information related to water supply and demand across different sectors within the city or specific region.
* Analyse primary and secondary water-related datasets using statistical tools to estimate the city water balance, assess the existing used water management scenario, and identify TUW reuse avenues.
* Conduct a financial assessment using various budget estimation techniques to assess the financial viability of the proposed city-level treated used water reuse plan
* Conduct life cycle cost assessments of used water treatment technologies
* Assist in writing high-quality research reports
* Generate knowledge content – blogs, policy briefs, etc., at regular intervals

**Project Assistance:**

* Assist in preparing presentations, fact sheets, and other research communication material
* Assist team members for important meetings and sessions, prepare notes, and conduct follow-ups, as required
* Assist in coordination with the outreach team, engagement with a wider network of stakeholders, and concerned policymakers
* Travel to project sites, if required, to monitor field surveys, conduct interviews or collect data for different research projects
* Any other assistance that may be required

**Selection Criteria**

**Education and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in environmental sciences/management/planning, water resources management, urban planning/management, hydrology, public policy or a related field
* Prior experience in working with urban local bodies, used water treatment technologies and reuse solutions, and the economics of used water resource management.
* Proven evidence of conducting effective stakeholder engagement.
* 1–2 years of work experience

**Skills:**

* Competent in collecting and analysing data
* Good report writing skills
* Good data visualisation skills
* Competent in using MS Office application suite
* Proficiency in RS/GIS will be an added advantage

**Personality:**

* Willingness to learn new skills in research and project management
* Ability to adapt and deliver work under tight deadlines in a professional environment
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment

**Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate with the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

**Application Process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate based on age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Interested candidates are requested to send their applications to jobs@ceew.in with ‘Application – Research Analyst –Water’ as the subject line. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate your interest.

title: GTM Lead - B2B
description:
Experience: 6-8 years

Location: Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)

Department: B2B / Business Development

Employment Type: Full-time

CTC: Up to 12 LPA

**Company Description:**

Sneakare is a New Delhi-based, fastest-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.

**Job Overview:**

We're looking for an experienced GTM Lead to build and own Sneakare's B2B business, largely from scratch. The mandate starts with two known pillars — brand collaborations and corporate gifting — and extends to identifying and standing up whatever other B2B channels make sense for the brand (distribution/wholesale, hospitality, institutional bulk orders, etc.). This is a strategy-plus-execution role: you'll define the B2B GTM plan with the Founder, then build and run the pipeline yourself in the early stages.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1.  Corporate Gifting:**

• Build a pipeline of corporate clients (HR/admin/procurement teams) for bulk/festive/onboarding gifting orders

• Own pricing, packaging, and proposal templates for corporate orders, including customization options

• Manage the deal cycle from pitch to contract to delivery, coordinating with ops/warehouse on fulfillment timelines

• Build repeat relationships aimed at annual/recurring gifting contracts rather than one-off orders

**2. Brand Collaborations:**

• Identify and pitch co-branded product or campaign opportunities with complementary brands

• Negotiate collaboration terms (commercials, exclusivity, timelines) and manage the partnership through to launch

• Work with marketing/product on execution — packaging, launch content, and joint promotion

**3. New B2B Channels (Build-Out):**

• Scope and validate additional B2B revenue channels — e.g. distributor/wholesale partnerships, hotel/airline amenity kits, event and gifting agencies, marketplace B2B — and bring recommendations to the Founder

• Pilot one or two of these channels, defining what a repeatable sales motion looks like before scaling

• Build the playbook (pricing, pitch, process) for each channel you stand up, so it can eventually be handed off or scaled

**4. Pipeline, Deal Cycle & Reporting:**

• Own the full deal cycle — prospecting, pitching, negotiation, contracting, and post-sale account management

• Maintain a live pipeline/CRM view of leads, deal stage, and expected revenue

• Track B2B revenue against targets and report performance regularly to the Founder and leadership

**5. Marketing & Representation:**

• Work with marketing to build B2B collateral — decks, case studies, one-pagers — that support the sales pitch

• Represent Sneakare at industry events, expos, and networking forums to build pipeline and brand visibility in the B2B space

**What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months):**

• A qualified, trackable B2B pipeline exists (not just informal conversations) with clear deal stages and expected value

• Corporate gifting is generating consistent month-on-month revenue, with at least a few clients converted to repeat/annual contracts

• At least one brand collaboration has been pitched, negotiated, and launched

• A recommendation (backed by a small pilot) exists for at least one new B2B channel beyond gifting and collabs

• Leadership has a regular, reliable view of B2B revenue and pipeline health

**Requirements:**

• 6-8 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate gifting, partnerships, or key account management

• Proven track record of building a pipeline from scratch and closing corporate/B2B deals

• Experience in a D2C, FMCG, or lifestyle brand background preferred

• Strong negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent communication and presentation skills — comfortable pitching to corporate and institutional buyers

• Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a vertical largely from scratch with limited existing playbook, and turning ambiguity into a structured plan

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

title: Executive Assistant (US Shifts Hybrid)
description:
**Who we are**

As a global law firm our work spans jurisdictions, cultures, and languages – and so do our people.

Our culture is collaborative and inclusive — where diverse perspectives are recognised and valued. Where performing to your highest ability, unlocks equal access to opportunities to learn, thrive and grow.

With over 800 business professionals based in Gurugram and Hyderabad, we’ve been driving operational excellence and innovation for more than 15 years.

We contribute to global success in areas such as Information Technology, Finance, Human Resources, Risk & Compliance, Legal Support, Research & Knowledge, Document Production, Virtual Executive Assistance, Programme Management, Client & Market Development, and Continuous Improvement.

**Job Description**

**The role**

The Global Business Support (GBS) function provides high-quality support to Clifford Chance offices worldwide through its various teams, including Document Production, Design Studio, Virtual Assistants, and World Firm EAs.

As a virtual Executive Assistant (EA), you will provide dedicated support to allocated GBS stakeholders, assisting with a range of executive and administrative tasks. The role is primarily US hours but requires flexibility, spanning early mornings and afternoons/ afternoons and evenings/ evenings and night. Adjustments to working hours may be expected upon reasonable request.

**Who you will work with**

You will report to the Operations Lead, Virtual Assistant (VA) Team, while working collaboratively with colleagues across London, Delhi, Hyderabad, Newcastle, and Warsaw, ensuring a seamless delivery of service across locations.

**What you will be responsible for**

You will be responsible for providing comprehensive executive assistance to your assigned stakeholders.

**What you will do**

As an EA, you will provide executive assistance and support to the allocated Stakeholders, including, and not limited to:

* **Inbox Management:**
  Prioritise and streamline email correspondences, keeping the inbox organised and junk-free. File emails systematically to prevent overflow and ensure easy retrieval. Respond on behalf of the stakeholder when required.
* **Calendar & Meeting Management:**
  Proactively plan and manage dynamic calendars, resolving scheduling conflicts efficiently. Arrange meeting logistics, including agendas, pre-reads, and coordination. Attend meetings, take minutes, and circulate action points in a timely manner.
* **Travel Management:**
  Organise comprehensive travel itineraries, including flights, rail, taxis, hotels, visas, and travel insurance. Ensure calendars are updated with logistical details and maintain structured travel records.
* **Expense & Budget Management:**
  Accurately and promptly submit claims (expenses, mileage, etc.) with quick turnaround times. Assist with invoice processing, purchase orders, and budget tracking as required and delegate to Administrative Assistants appropriately.
* **Documentation & Data Management:**
  Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, including reports, presentations, and correspondences. Manage document control via iManage and other relevant platforms, ensuring efficient record-keeping.
* **Project Coordination:**
  Support stakeholders by researching, compiling, and analysing project data. Draft and review status reports, escalate risks and issues, and monitor project milestones. Make informed decisions independently to meet critical deadlines.
* **Confidentiality & Integrity:**
  Maintain the highest level of discretion and professionalism. Adhere to policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements while fostering trust and reliability in stakeholder interactions.
* **Collaboration & Team Engagement:**
  Work closely with stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication. Actively contribute to the VA Team in all offices, assist in onboarding new team members, and provide absence cover when needed.
* **Ad-Hoc Support:**
  Assist with various ad-hoc tasks, including onboarding new hires, managing distribution lists, organising off-sites and team gatherings, and supporting stakeholder upskilling initiatives.

**Qualifications**

**Your experience**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s/MBA from a reputed institute preferred.
* 8+ years of experience, preferably in a multinational organisation with cross-cultural exposure.
* Proven experience supervising teams in a professional services environment, with a strong focus on service delivery and performance management.
* Prior experience supporting senior leadership, including minute-taking, presentation creation, and managing Excel-based reports.
* Project management experience is desirable; coaching will be provided if needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge at all levels.
* Comfortable working across international, regional, and local contexts.
* Structured and strategic approach to balancing long-, medium-, and short-term team priorities.
* Strong organisational and delegation skills.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Flexible and effective communicator—both verbal and written.
* Maintains regular and transparent communication with managers and colleagues.
* Approachable, helpful, and adaptable in a dynamic team environment.

**Analytical & Problem Solving**

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, interpret, and present data insights.
* Excellent problem-solving ability; capable of breaking down complex issues and identifying solutions.
* Makes sound decisions based on available information or guidance.
* Proactively identifies opportunities to improve service quality based on stakeholder feedback.

**Work Ethic & Professionalism**

* Demonstrates resilience and the ability to manage competing deadlines under pressure.
* Quick learner with a proactive, results-driven mindset.
* Able to manage workload independently and as part of a team.
* Exceptional attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables.
* Confident handling new and unfamiliar situations.

**Additional Information**

**How we will support you**

From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.

**Equal opportunities**

At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.

We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age. This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.

We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.

Our goal is to deliver an equality of opportunity, an equality of aspiration and an equality of experience to everyone who works in our firm.

Find out more about our inclusive culture here.

title: Bridge design engineer
description:

Ltd. is a prominent organization in India specializing in the construction and maintenance of National Highways, Expressways, State Highways, and other key road networks. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, durable, and efficient infrastructure that supports national connectivity and economic growth. In addition to core infrastructure projects, S&P Infrastructure is expanding into the tourism sector with sustainable and innovative developments. This is a full-time remote role for a Bridge Design Engineer. * A bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline is required; a master’s degree in Structural or Bridge Engineering and professional certifications or licensure are advantageous.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills, ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, and willingness to adapt to evolving project needs are expected.

title: Executive Assistant - AI & Business Operations
description:
Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD
  
  
**About Us**
We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.
  
  
**Job Description**
As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.
  
  
Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.
  
  
You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.
  
  
You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
* Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
* Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
* Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
* Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
* Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
* Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
* Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
* Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
* Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
* Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.
* Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination.
* Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used.
* Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership.
* A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required.
* Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination.
* Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports.
* Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work.
* Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations.
* Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools.
* Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools.
* Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly.
* Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
* Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly and maintain quality under pressure.
* A practical approach to solving problems and taking ownership when established processes or clear instructions are not yet available.
* Confidence raising capacity constraints early, proposing realistic alternatives and clarifying which tasks take priority.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Working directly with a founder or supporting a small startup team.
* Improving processes that span several business functions.
* Using AI agents, tool integrations or automation platforms to reduce repetitive work.
* Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to build useful automations and AI assistants.
* Building reusable procedures and shared knowledge that other team members can use.
* Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

**What We Offer**

* Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
* Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
* A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
* A fully remote working arrangement.
* Monthly compensation in USD.

**Remote Working Arrangement**
You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. Include an AI skill or workflow you created or substantially adapted, the business task it supported, and how you ensured the result was useful and reliable. An example of coordinating work across different business functions would also be helpful.

title: US Immigration Case Analyst
company: My Visa Source Legal - US & Canada Immigration Lawyers
description:
**Company Description**
My Visa Source Legal – US & Canada Immigration Lawyers is an award-winning, full-service immigration law firm with an experienced team of Canadian lawyers and licensed practitioners. The firm provides legal solutions for personal and business immigration matters across Canada and the United States, with physical offices in Toronto, Vancouver and Scottsdale, Arizona. Its mission is to offer clear, effective legal guidance that improves the likelihood of favorable outcomes for clients from diverse backgrounds. My Visa Source uses efficient, proven processes and up-to-date knowledge of immigration laws and trends, contributing to its status as one of North America’s fastest-growing immigration law firms. The firm has received multiple national and international awards recognizing excellence in corporate and personal immigration services.

**Role Description The Immigration Case Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting the preparation, organization, and tracking of immigration files for both personal and business clients. This role involves gathering and reviewing client documents, performing legal and policy research, summarizing case facts, and drafting clear, accurate case notes and supporting materials under lawyer supervision. The analyst will communicate with clients to clarify information, follow up on outstanding documentation, and ensure timelines and filing deadlines are met. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating with legal team members, updating case management systems, maintaining accurate records, and helping streamline workflows to improve efficiency and client experience. The role requires a high level of attention to detail, discretion with sensitive information, and a commitment to service excellence in a fast-paced, deadline-driven env

ironment.
**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical and research abilities, including the capacity to interpret immigration regulations, policies, and official guidance, and summarize findings clearly.
* Excellent written communication skills for drafting case summaries, correspondence, and supporting documents, with strong grammar, clarity, and precision.
* High level of organization and time management skills to handle multiple files, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate digital records in case management systems.
* Client service and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate respectfully and clearly with clients from diverse backgrounds and maintain confidentiality.
* Technical proficiency with common office software (e.g., document editors, spreadsheets, PDF tools) and comfort learning new legal or CRM platforms.
* Post-secondary education in law, paralegal studies, political science, international relations, or a related field; paralegal or legal assistant training is an asset.
* Prior experience in immigration law, legal services, or a regulated professional environment is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, collaborate effectively with a distributed team, and adapt to evolving processes and priorities.
* Strong ethical judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy when dealing with sensitive personal and corporate information.**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
At
**Blue Dart**
, we go beyond delivering shipments—we deliver trust, precision, and excellence. As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. Backed by the strength of DHL Group, we bring together international standards with deep local expertise. Our dedicated Boeing freighter fleet, 12,000+ vehicles, and best-in-class service ensure time-definite delivery that businesses and customers count on every day.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work®**
and recognized as part of the DHL Group’s Top Employer certification across multiple regions. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal—it’s a fundamental part of who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and proud to belong.
  
  
If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—Blue Dart is where you belong.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Regional Manager – RSP / BDO Operations role is accountable for the operational performance, service quality, governance and sustainability of the Regional Service Provider (RSP) and Blue Dart Office (BDO) network across multiple states and non-metro / remote markets.
  
  
The network operates through a combination of franchise / service-partner locations, outsourced manpower and lean Blue Dart-operated offices, typically serving markets where shipment volumes do not require a full-scale Blue Dart facility.
  
  
The role ensures that customers in these markets receive consistent Blue Dart service standards irrespective of whether operations are delivered through a partner, contractor-supported office or lean Blue Dart location.
  
  
Owns regional governance of RSPs and BDOs covering pickup and delivery performance, shipment connectivity, operational compliance, partner capability, manpower productivity, customer experience, cost effectiveness and business continuity.
  
  
Acts as the regional anchor between RSP / BDO locations and Area / Branch Operations, PUD, Hub, CPU, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance and other functions to ensure reliable service delivery across the extended network.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To build and govern a reliable, scalable and cost-efficient RSP / BDO operating network across Tier 2, Tier 3 and remote markets by strengthening partner performance, operational standards, service quality, network connectivity and compliance while ensuring sustainable Blue Dart presence in lower-volume geographies.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Regional RSP / BDO Network Leadership**

* Own and govern operational performance of RSP and BDO locations across the Region.
* Establish consistent operating standards across franchise, outsourced and lean Blue Dart locations.
* Translate regional operational priorities and service standards into location-level execution requirements.
* Establish structured performance-review mechanisms across the RSP / BDO network.
* Identify weak-performing locations and drive time-bound corrective action plans.
* Ensure appropriate escalation and intervention for locations with recurring service, compliance or viability concerns.
* Act as the regional SME for RSP / BDO operating models and remote-market operations.

**Partner & Franchise Operations Governance**

* Monitor operational performance of Regional Service Providers and franchise / channel partners against agreed service standards.
* Ensure partners understand and adhere to Blue Dart operating processes, customer commitments and brand standards.
* Establish partner scorecards covering service, productivity, quality, compliance and customer experience.
* Conduct periodic operating and capability reviews with partners.
* Drive corrective action where partner performance falls below defined standards.
* Provide operational inputs for appointment, continuation, renewal, expansion or rationalisation of partners in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure business continuity during partner transitions or service disruptions.

**BDO & Remote Location Operations**

* Govern performance of Blue Dart Offices operating with lean Blue Dart manpower and predominantly outsourced resources.
* Ensure BDOs maintain adequate operational capability despite lower shipment volumes and geographically dispersed locations.
* Drive consistent pickup, delivery, shipment handling and customer-service standards.
* Monitor location productivity and ensure manpower deployment remains aligned with business volumes.
* Ensure adequate supervisory controls where direct Blue Dart manpower is limited.
* Review operating viability and recommend changes to the service model where appropriate.
* Ensure continuity of service across difficult-to-access and remote locations.

**Service Performance & Customer Experience**

* Drive achievement of pickup, delivery and service-quality commitments across RSP and BDO locations.
* Monitor First Attempt Delivery, pending / ageing shipments, NDR, pickup performance and operational exceptions.
* Identify recurring service failures and ensure structured root-cause resolution.
* Monitor customer complaints arising from RSP / BDO locations and drive preventive actions.
* Ensure service levels in partner-operated locations remain aligned with Blue Dart standards.
* Partner with Area and Branch Operations teams on customer-critical issues requiring intervention.

**Network Connectivity & Shipment Flow**

* Ensure timely shipment movement between RSP / BDO locations and parent Service Centres, Hubs, CPUs and downstream network locations.
* Monitor adherence to pickup, dispatch and network cut-offs.
* Identify connectivity gaps affecting remote-market service performance.
* Work with Surface, Air, PUD and Network teams to optimise connections and operating schedules.
* Ensure appropriate contingency plans for route disruptions, volume spikes or partner resource shortages.
* Minimise shipment delays arising from weak upstream or downstream connectivity.

**Manpower & Productivity Governance**

* Monitor productivity and manpower deployment across outsourced / partner-supported operations.
* Ensure staffing levels are aligned with shipment volumes and service requirements.
* Improve productivity through better workforce deployment, route planning and process discipline.
* Monitor absenteeism, attrition and continuity risks among outsourced resources.
* Ensure partners maintain adequate staffing and backup capability.
* Work with HR / Operations teams on workforce issues requiring regional intervention.

**Cost & Operating Model Optimization**

* Monitor cost-to-serve across RSP and BDO locations.
* Evaluate operational productivity and sustainability of remote-location operating models.
* Identify opportunities to optimise manpower, routes, infrastructure and service-partner costs.
* Balance cost efficiency with network reach and service commitments.
* Recommend alternative operating models where existing arrangements are no longer operationally or financially appropriate.
* Support development of scalable models for low-volume and emerging markets.

**Compliance, Safety & Brand Governance**

* Ensure partner and BDO operations comply with Blue Dart SOPs, security standards, statutory requirements and applicable contractual conditions.
* Conduct periodic operational and compliance reviews across locations.
* Ensure appropriate controls over shipment custody, scanning, cash / documentation processes and Blue Dart assets wherever applicable.
* Drive timely closure of audit findings and compliance gaps.
* Ensure partner-operated locations maintain required workplace, signage and customer-interface standards.
* Escalate serious compliance, ethics, security or customer-risk concerns promptly.

**Capability Building & Standardisation**

* Build operational capability among RSPs, BDO coordinators and outsourced teams.
* Drive structured onboarding and refresher training on Blue Dart operating standards.
* Standardise SOPs, dashboards and governance mechanisms across the regional network.
* Identify and replicate best practices across locations.
* Support digital adoption and use of operational systems by partners and outsourced resources.
* Build stronger local operating capability to reduce dependence on continuous regional intervention.

**Network Expansion & Rationalisation**

* Support evaluation of new RSP / BDO locations based on service reach, business potential and network requirements.
* Provide operational inputs into location feasibility, coverage and resource requirements.
* Review existing locations for service performance, productivity and continued relevance.
* Recommend strengthening, consolidation, relocation or alternate service models where required.
* Ensure new locations achieve operational readiness and defined service standards before stabilisation.
* Support expansion into underserved Tier 2 / Tier 3 and emerging markets in alignment with business requirements.

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with Regional Operations Head, Area / Branch Operations and regional functional teams.
* Collaborate with PUD, Hub, CPU, Surface, Air, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR, Procurement, Security and IT as required.
* Conduct structured regional reviews of RSP / BDO performance.
* Provide clear visibility of operational, service, compliance and partner risks to regional leadership.
* Ensure timely resolution of cross-functional issues impacting partner-operated locations.
* Drive consistency between the RSP / BDO operating model and the wider Blue Dart network.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline; MBA / PG desirable.
* Experience: 10 –15 years of relevant experience in express logistics, courier, distribution, franchise / channel operations, last-mile logistics, 3PL or multi-location service operations.
* Strong experience managing geographically dispersed operations across multiple cities / states.
* Demonstrated exposure to partner, franchise, outsourced or third-party operating models.
* Strong understanding of pickup and delivery operations, service quality, network connectivity and operational governance.
* Experience managing performance through indirect teams where resources are not directly employed by the organisation.
* Exposure to cost-to-serve, manpower productivity and operating-model optimisation.

* Strong stakeholder-management capability across Operations and enabling functions.
* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Distribution, Retail / Franchise Networks and other large multi-location service networks.

**Skills & Capabilities:**

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:
**About This Role**
The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.

title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

title: Assistant Manager Accounts Payable
description:
About the Role

Maxima Apparel is hiring an Assistant Manager – Accounts Payable for its Finance & Accounts team in Gurugram. You will own the end-to-end AP cycle for domestic and international vendors — from vendor onboarding and invoice booking through payment, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance and month-end closure. You are responsible for the accuracy of the AP ledger, timely vendor and payroll payouts, and the AP MIS pack that supports treasury and management decisions.

Position: Assistant Manager – Accounts Payable

Function: Finance & Accounts (Accounts Payable / Controllership)

Reports to: Manager – Accounts Payable / Finance Controller

Location: Gurugram (on-site)

Experience: 3–6 years in Accounts Payable, preferably in apparel / retail or a multi-entity international setup

Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance); CA Inter / CMA Inter preferred

Employment type: Full-time

Timing: US working hours

Key Responsibilities

Bank Reconciliation

* Prepare and review daily / weekly / monthly BRS for all domestic and overseas bank accounts (current, EEFC, collection).
* Match bank entries against books, clear reconciling items within ageing norms, and resolve long-outstanding items (stale cheques, un-credited receipts, bank charges, interest, FX differences).
* Maintain bank balance and fund-position tracking for daily treasury and payment planning; certify month-end reconciliations for auditors.

International AP Booking, Bank Booking & Tax Compliance

* Book overseas vendor invoices (raw material, trims, freight, agency, professional and IT services) with correct GL, cost centre, entity and currency mapping.
* Apply correct exchange rates at booking, payment and period end; account for realised / unrealised FX gains and losses, remittances, bank charges, interest and forward contracts.
* Ensure TDS / TCS deduction and deposit, withholding tax on foreign payments and review of tax residency certificates.
* Support GST compliance on payables — RCM on import of services, GSTR-2B vs books reconciliation, ITC eligibility review and vendor follow-up.
* Assist with TDS, GST and other statutory returns and respond to notices relating to payables.

Monthly Closure & Accrual Booking

* Drive AP activities on the month-end close calendar within agreed timelines.
* Book provisions and accruals (GRNI, services not billed, freight, job work, utilities, professional fees, rent) and maintain an accrual tracker with reversal review.
* Prepare AP schedules — vendor ledger, vendor advances, GRNI, employee reimbursements, prepaid expenses — and reconcile the AP sub-ledger to GL.
* Run vendor balance confirmations; clear debit balances and old credit balances; close audit observations relating to AP.

AP MIS & Ageing Reporting

* Prepare and circulate the AP MIS pack — creditors ageing, GRNI ageing, advance ageing, debit balance analysis and open PO / invoice pipeline.
* Report spend analytics by vendor, category, cost centre and entity with variance commentary.
* Track AP KPIs — DPO, invoice booking TAT, on-time payment %, unbooked invoices, hold / rejection analysis.
* Prepare the outflow forecast and payment plan for cash-flow projections; automate recurring reports via advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, Power Query) and ERP report builders.

Weekly Vendor Payout & Payout Ageing

* Run the weekly vendor payment cycle — payout proposal based on due dates, credit terms, ageing and approved priority; circulate for management approval.
* Validate payment runs for three-way match, duplicates, TDS, advance adjustment and bank detail accuracy before uploading to the banking portal.
* Release payments via NEFT / RTGS / cheque / wire and ensure timely accounting and vendor acknowledgement.
* Manage the vendor helpdesk — payment queries, payment advice, TDS certificates and dispute resolution with commercial and procurement teams.

Vendor Onboarding & Master Data Management

* Manage vendor onboarding — registration form, bank details and cancelled cheque, and W-8 / W-9 / tax forms for overseas vendors; validate details before code creation.
* Create, update and deactivate vendor master records in the ERP with correct payment terms, currency, tax codes, TDS sections and GL defaults.
* Enforce maker-checker discipline, documented approvals and a full change-log audit trail, especially for bank-detail changes.
* Run periodic vendor master hygiene reviews; track MSME vendors and statutory payment timelines.

Weekly / Monthly Payroll Payout

* Coordinate with HR / payroll to validate payroll registers for weekly (contract / wage) and monthly (staff) cycles; verify headcount, net pay, bank details and control totals.
* Execute payroll disbursement through the banking portal within committed pay dates; handle failed credits.
* Book payroll journal entries and reconcile the payroll ledger to GL; ensure timely payment of PF, ESIC, PT and TDS on salary.
* Process employee reimbursements, travel advances and full-and-final settlements; maintain strict confidentiality of payroll data.

Controls & Process Governance

* Operate AP in line with the delegation-of-authority matrix and SOPs; maintain audit-ready documentation for all bookings, payments and master data changes.
* Identify process gaps and drive automation and control improvements in invoice processing, approvals and payment release.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong working knowledge of AP accounting, bank reconciliation and month-end close.
* Practical exposure to foreign remittance compliance.
* Hands-on ERP experience — SAP / Oracle / Microsoft Dynamics / Tally Prime; AP automation tools an advantage.
* Advanced MS Excel — pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, large-data reconciliation and MIS modelling.
* Understanding of multi-entity, multi-currency accounting and intercompany transactions.
* High accuracy, strong ownership of timelines, and ability to work to a fixed close and payout calendar under pressure.
* Clear communication with vendors, bankers, auditors, procurement and HR; integrity and discretion with payment and payroll data.
* Process-improvement mindset with a bias for automation and standardisation.

Key Performance Indicators

* All bank accounts reconciled daily / weekly; no unexplained item beyond 30 days.
* AP schedules and accruals completed within the close calendar.
* Invoices booked within agreed TAT; weekly payout released per approved schedule.
* 100% on-time, error-free payroll credit every cycle.
* Nil delay / interest on TDS, GST and foreign remittance filings.
* Zero unauthorised vendor master changes; MIS pack circulated on the agreed date each cycle.

Key Interfaces

Internal: Procurement & Sourcing, Commercial / Import, Stores & Warehouse, HR & Payroll, Treasury, Taxation, Internal Audit, Business Finance.

External: Domestic and overseas vendors, bankers, statutory and internal auditors, tax consultants.
