title: Research & Insights Intern
description:
**Employment Type:**
Full-time Internship

**Work Arrangement:**
Hybrid — 4 days a week in office, 1 day WFH

**Working Hours:**
10:30 AM – 5:30 PM

**Stipend:**
₹15,000 per month

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**About EF**

Ember Foundry is a research and strategy studio that helps Indian promoters make sharper business and brand decisions. We work at the intersection of human insight, consumer understanding, business strategy and growth.

We believe that the best business decisions begin with understanding people — their needs, motivations, behaviours and choices.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and people-oriented Primary Research & Insights Intern who enjoys speaking to people, asking questions, uncovering patterns and understanding the reasons behind consumer and business behaviour.

You will work on primary research projects for Ember Foundry and its clients, helping us understand consumers, markets and business opportunities directly through conversations and fieldwork.

From designing questionnaires and identifying research participants to cold calling respondents, conducting interviews, managing surveys and analysing findings, you will be involved in the entire research process.

This role requires someone who is comfortable reaching out to strangers, initiating conversations, following up persistently and engaging with people from different backgrounds. You should be equally comfortable speaking to a consumer over the phone, interviewing a business owner or organising research findings into a structured presentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Research Design & Planning

* Understand the business problem and translate it into clear research objectives and questions.
* Help design primary research methodologies, including consumer surveys, in-depth interviews, expert interviews and focus groups.
* Develop questionnaires, interview guides, screening questions and respondent profiles.
* Identify the right target audience and determine how to reach relevant respondents.
* Help plan research samples, recruitment approaches and fieldwork schedules.

2. Respondent Recruitment & Outreach

* Identify and build lists of relevant research participants, consumers, professionals, business owners and industry stakeholders.
* Reach out to potential respondents through cold calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn and other appropriate channels.
* Explain the purpose of the research and encourage participation.
* Schedule interviews, manage appointments and coordinate respondent availability.
* Conduct follow-ups to improve participation and completion rates.
* Maintain respondent databases and track outreach, responses, scheduled interviews and pending follow-ups.
* Build rapport with respondents while maintaining professionalism and research ethics.

3. Primary Research & Fieldwork

* Conduct telephone interviews, in-depth interviews and structured consumer conversations.
* Administer surveys and collect responses from the defined target audience.
* Speak directly with consumers to understand their preferences, experiences, purchase decisions, motivations and pain points.
* Interview business owners, industry experts and other stakeholders when required by a project.
* Support focus groups, field visits and on-ground research activities where relevant.
* Record responses accurately, take detailed notes and document verbatim quotes where appropriate.
* Maintain confidentiality, obtain appropriate consent and follow ethical research practices.

4. Data Organisation & Analysis

* Clean, organise and consolidate survey responses, interview notes and fieldwork data.
* Identify recurring themes, behavioural patterns, contradictions and emerging insights.
* Analyse why people make particular decisions rather than simply documenting what they say.
* Help develop consumer profiles, customer journeys, behavioural segments and insight summaries.
* Distinguish between observed evidence, interpretation and assumptions.
* Support the development of actionable recommendations based on primary research findings.

5. Research Reporting & Presentations

* Translate research findings into clear, structured reports and presentations.
* Prepare charts, summary tables, respondent profiles and qualitative insight summaries.
* Present key findings, consumer quotes, patterns and implications to the strategy team.
* Help communicate what the findings mean for a client's business, brand, product or customer experience.
* Maintain accurate research records, respondent trackers and project documentation.

6. Project Coordination

* Coordinate with the Ember Foundry team on research objectives, respondent profiles and fieldwork requirements.
* Use research and productivity tools, including AI tools where appropriate, without compromising data accuracy or respondent confidentiality.

**What we're looking for**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in psychology, sociology, marketing, business, economics, communications or a related field.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Confidence in speaking to unfamiliar people and initiating conversations over the phone.
* Willingness to make cold calls, conduct follow-ups and recruit respondents consistently.
* Curiosity about human behaviour, consumer decision-making and business problems.
* Strong listening skills and the ability to ask thoughtful follow-up questions.
* A structured and organised approach to collecting and documenting information.
* Attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, surveys and presentations.
* Persistence, initiative and the ability to work independently.
* Openness to feedback and a genuine interest in learning research methodologies.

* Experience conducting interviews, surveys or academic fieldwork.
* Experience in telecalling, customer research, sales outreach or respondent recruitment.
* Familiarity with Google Forms, Google Sheets, Excel or survey platforms.
* Interest in qualitative research, behavioural science, consumer psychology or market research.
* Experience participating in college research projects, student societies or community outreach initiatives.

**Your role will entail**

* How to design a primary research study from scratch.
* How to recruit the right respondents and conduct effective outreach.
* How to conduct structured interviews and ask better questions.
* How to collect, organise and analyse qualitative and quantitative data.
* How to identify consumer insights and translate them into business recommendations.
* How research informs brand strategy, positioning, product development and growth decisions.
* How to execute research projects end to end in a professional consulting environment.

**Success Metrics**

* Quality and relevance of respondents recruited.
* Consistency and effectiveness of outreach and follow-ups.
* Accuracy and completeness of collected data.
* Quality of interviews, questioning and research documentation.
* Ability to identify meaningful patterns and insights.
* Reliability in meeting fieldwork targets and project deadlines.

About the Role

We’re looking for a fun, creative, and slightly crazy person who loves being on camera, making memes, cracking jokes, and turning random ideas into entertaining content.

If you’re the kind of person who can turn everyday bakchodi into a funny reel, understands internet humour, and isn’t afraid to make a fool of yourself on camera, you might be the one we’re looking for!

Face the camera confidently and participate in reels, sketches, and fun videos.

Creativity, spontaneity, and the ability to think of funny ideas on the spot.

For us, hard work is important, but even more important is keeping our promises, delivering on our commitments. Being a hero is good at Alike but being a team player is priceless. And finally, making the right choice usually means going the difficult path, and that is the Alike way.

**The role**

As a Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East), you will own the customer-facing side of our Experiences business in the Middle East, with a key focus on UAE. You will be the revenue owner for the geography, responsible for the user journey, website conversion, pricing, promotions and propositions that turn demand into bookings. You will report to the Director, Experiences and work in close partnership with the Supply Manager, Middle East, who owns supplier sourcing and contracting, as well as with the marketing, digital commerce, product, operations and finance teams.

You will take a data led approach to test and improve the customer journey and propositions across channels and customer segments and will be the in-market expert on what travelers want to do and experience in the region.

.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the revenue and margin targets for Experiences in the Middle East, with a focus on UAE – plan, forecast and deliver against them.
* Develop and execute the category strategy and roadmap for the Middle East, aligned with the global Experiences strategy and informed by customer insights, market research and competitor analysis.
* Own the end-to-end user journey for Middle East experiences, from discovery and search through to booking and post-booking, identifying and removing friction at every step.
* Drive conversion rate optimisation (CRO) on the website – define and run A/B tests, and optimise listing pages, content and checkout in collaboration with the product, digital and design teams.
* Manage the end-to-end proposition lifecycle, from ideation and validation to launch and optimisation, ensuring that propositions across attractions, tours, activities and curated experiences are customer-focused, differentiated and profitable.
* Develop and implement pricing strategies, aware of the seasonality, events and festivals, booking window, demand fluctuations and competitor pricing.
* Plan and run promotions, offers and campaigns with the marketing team, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and margin.
* Partner with the Supply Manager, Middle East and cross-functional stakeholders, including marketing, digital commerce, product, operations, finance and customer support, translating customer demand and performance data into supply priorities and delivering propositions that meet customer expectations and business goals.
* Monitor and report on funnel and commercial performance using data and customer feedback and contribute to the global Experiences playbook by sharing learnings with the other geographies.

.

**Key requirements for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* A deep understanding of the UAE market dynamics and trends is a must.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering successful and innovative propositions that meet customer needs and drive revenue and margin growth.
* Use AI-powered dashboards, analytics and experimentation tools to monitor funnel and commercial performance in near real time, and to inform pricing, promotions and conversion decisions.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Creative and customer-oriented mindset, with a passion for travel and creating memorable experiences.
* Highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented, able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

 

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Private medical insurance
* Family friendly work environment, we understand what’s important in people’s lives
* A supportive and ambitious team to help you grow

title: Online Campaign Manager
description:
Hiring: Specialist In | Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads & AI-Driven Advertising

About NeoRipples Marketing

NeoRipples Marketing is a digital marketing and growth solutions agency based in Gurugram, helping brands strengthen their digital presence, acquire customers, and achieve measurable business growth. We combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to deliver integrated digital solutions across performance marketing, social media, SEO, content creation, creative production, website development, and analytics. With 100+ projects delivered and experience across diverse industries and markets, we bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a results-driven approach to every client engagement. We are looking for an experienced
**Performance Marketing Specialist who combines strong advertising fundamentals with AI-driven marketing expertise**
to plan, execute, optimise, and scale campaigns across multiple digital platforms.

The Role

As our Performance Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. You should have hands-on experience in campaign strategy, budget management, conversion tracking, performance analytics, and optimisation. Equally important, you should understand how AI and automation are transforming digital advertising and know how to apply these capabilities to improve campaign efficiency and business outcomes. We are looking for someone who goes beyond launching campaigns — someone who can analyse performance, identify growth opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and take accountability for results.

Key Responsibilities1. Performance Marketing Strategy & Execution

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
* Develop channel-specific strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, budgets, and conversion goals.
* Manage campaign setup, keyword research, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, placements, remarketing, and ad scheduling.
* Execute lead generation, customer acquisition, website conversion, and retargeting campaigns.
* Independently manage multiple client accounts while maintaining campaign quality, timelines, and performance standards.

2. AI-Driven Advertising & Marketing Automation

* Understand and implement AI-powered advertising capabilities available across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, wherever applicable.
* Work with AI-driven campaign features such as automated bidding, audience optimisation, campaign automation, and creative optimisation.
* Understand Google's Performance Max, Smart Bidding, and relevant AI-powered campaign capabilities, as well as Meta's Advantage+ solutions and automated campaign optimisation features.
* Explore and use AI tools to support audience research, keyword discovery, ad copy development, creative testing, campaign analysis, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve campaign efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate optimisation.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations critically rather than relying on automated outputs without validation.
* Stay updated on emerging AI advertising capabilities, platform changes, and best practices, and recommend relevant applications for client campaigns.

3. Campaign Optimisation & Growth

* Monitor campaign performance and optimise key metrics such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS), depending on campaign objectives.
* Conduct A/B tests across creatives, messaging, audiences, landing pages, and campaign configurations.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and implement data-backed corrective actions.
* Optimise budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and creative combinations to improve campaign efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while maintaining lead quality and cost efficiency.

4. Conversion Tracking, Analytics & Reporting

* Set up, monitor, and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and other relevant tools.
* Verify tracking accuracy and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, website analytics, CRM records, and actual business outcomes.
* Analyse campaign data to identify audience behaviour, conversion bottlenecks, performance trends, and growth opportunities.
* Prepare weekly and monthly campaign reports with meaningful insights, performance summaries, and actionable recommendations.
* Maintain campaign dashboards, performance trackers, and optimisation records.

5. Budget & Account Management

* Plan and manage advertising budgets in line with campaign objectives and client requirements.
* Monitor spending, budget utilisation, and campaign pacing.
* Recommend budget reallocations based on performance and growth opportunities.
* Maintain campaign hygiene, naming conventions, account structures, and documentation.
* Take ownership of campaign delivery, flag risks proactively, and ensure timely execution.

6. Creative Strategy & Collaboration

* Work with creative, content, social media, and website teams to develop compelling ad creatives and conversion-focused landing pages.
* Prepare creative briefs informed by campaign data, audience insights, and customer behaviour.
* Recommend new messaging angles, creative formats, and testing strategies.
* Collaborate with client servicing teams to understand business objectives, communicate results, and support campaign reviews.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, preferably within a digital marketing agency managing multiple client accounts.
* Strong practical expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
* Demonstrable understanding of AI-powered advertising features, automated bidding, campaign optimisation, and marketing automation.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and conversion tracking.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, audience targeting, remarketing, bidding strategies, budget optimisation, and campaign analytics.
* Experience with A/B testing, performance reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ability to translate campaign insights into clear optimisation actions and measurable business improvements.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, work independently, and deliver in a fast-paced agency environment.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing B2B lead generation campaigns and LinkedIn Ads.
* Experience with CRM systems, lead quality analysis, and offline conversion tracking.
* Familiarity with landing page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).
* Experience using AI tools for marketing research, creative development, performance analysis, and reporting.
* Experience managing campaigns for clients across different industries and geographies.

Mandatory Application Requirement: Campaign Case Study

**Applications must include details of at least one performance marketing campaign that you have personally managed. Applications that do not provide this information may not be considered.**

For your campaign example, please include:

1. **Campaign objective:**
   What business outcome were you targeting?
2. **Platform and industry:**
   Which advertising platform did you use, and for what type of business?
3. **Budget and duration:**
   What was the approximate advertising budget and campaign duration?
4. **Performance achieved:**
   Share relevant results, such as leads generated, CPL, conversions, CPA, ROAS, or other measurable KPIs.
5. **Optimisation undertaken:**
   What specific changes did you make to improve campaign performance?
6. **AI and automation:**
   Which AI-powered advertising features or tools did you use, if applicable, and how did they contribute to the campaign?
7. **Your contribution:**
   What did you personally plan, execute, analyse, and optimise?

Candidates may anonymise client names and sensitive business information. Please share only information you are authorised to disclose. We will evaluate candidates on their practical understanding, ability to explain their decisions, and demonstrated contribution to campaign outcomes.

What We Value

* Ownership and accountability for campaign performance.
* Strong analytical thinking backed by practical execution.
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging advertising technologies.
* The ability to challenge assumptions, test hypotheses, and learn from campaign data.
* Clear communication and collaboration across teams.
* A results-oriented mindset focused on business outcomes rather than vanity metrics.

Why Join NeoRipples Marketing?

* Work across diverse industries, brands, and digital growth challenges.
* Take ownership of paid campaigns and contribute directly to measurable business outcomes.
* Collaborate with creative, content, technology, and marketing professionals.
* Work in an entrepreneurial environment that encourages experimentation, initiative, and continuous learning.
* Gain practical exposure to evolving performance marketing and AI-driven advertising capabilities.

How to Apply

**Interested candidates can write to corporate@neoripples.com with their updated resume**

Please include your mandatory campaign case study as part of your application, covering the campaign objective, advertising budget, measurable results, optimisation decisions, and your personal contribution. Mention any AI-powered advertising features or tools you have used.

Candidates who demonstrate genuine hands-on expertise, analytical thinking, and the ability to connect advertising performance with business results will be preferred.

Executive/Senior Executive – Communication & Branding

**Work Experience:**
02+ years of experience in the field of content, marketing, blog & email marketing, social media, etc.

**Education:**

Graduate/Post Graduate with good writing and communication skills.

Additional diploma/certifications in the field of marketing, SEO, content writing, Adobe Photoshop would be considered a plus.

**Reporting:**
Head – Communications Team/COO

**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who can write, shoot, edit, design, think, curate, and move fluidly between storytelling formats and platforms. Someone who understands that communication for a design university isn't just about captions or calendars — it's about cultural literacy, visual fluency, and the ability to craft seamless narratives that reflect what's happening in the world and on campus.

You'll wear multiple hats here: writer, photographer, video editor, designer, event coordinator, creative collaborator, trend spotter. If you're deeply curious, perpetually online in the best way, can hold a conversation about everything from Satyajit Ray to street style to semiotics — and know how to frame a shot and cut a story together — keep reading.

**What you will do**

● Write and edit across all platforms: social media, website copy, press releases, campaign scripts. Your writing should adapt to the medium and audience — Instagram captions aren't blog intros aren't press releases.

● Shoot and edit content: You'll be on the ground capturing moments — events, campus life, student work, faculty interviews. Then you'll edit those into Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube videos, or whatever format the story demands. You should know composition, lighting basics, and how to make a phone or DSLR work for you.

● Design when needed: Create social media posts, story graphics, email headers, or quick visual assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you should have an eye for layout, typography, and brand consistency.

● Curate video and visual narratives: Work with internal and external design and video partners to develop concepts, write briefs, and ensure the final output has both aesthetic integrity and narrative clarity. You should know what a good edit looks like and be able to articulate why.

● Manage events with a storytelling lens: From Convocation to campus visits to the Graduate Show — you'll help plan, coordinate, document, and amplify. You're not just logistics support. You're thinking: What's the story here? How do we capture and tell it before, during, and after?

● Stay contextually aware: You should know what's trending, what's being talked about, what movements are shaping culture — and how (or whether) IIAD should respond. Pop culture, design discourse, social issues, global and local — all of it informs how we communicate.

● Generate ideas, not just execute them: We need someone who can pitch concepts for campaigns, suggest content series, and spot opportunities to insert IIAD into larger cultural conversations. You're not waiting for a brief — you're co-creating it.

● Collaborate across departments: Regular touchpoints with faculty, students, admissions, program heads, and external agencies. You're gathering stories, aligning messaging, and ensuring that what we say actually reflects what we do.

● Track, analyse, refine: Monitor engagement, performance, and sentiment across platforms. Use insights to evolve our approach — what's resonating, what's not, and why.

**Who You Are**

You're a cultural omnivore.

You read books. You watch films (and not just the ones everyone talks about). You notice design in everyday spaces. You have opinions about typography, about casting choices, about how cities are planned. You're curious about history, geography, mythology, subcultures. You connect things that don't obviously connect.

You're a natural storyteller across mediums.

You can craft a narrative arc across platforms — an Instagram Reel isn't just a video, it's part of a larger conversation. You understand pacing, tone, visual rhythm, and context. You know when to be formal and when to be conversational. You know how a story changes when it's written vs. filmed vs. designed.

You're contextually switched on.

You know what's happening — culturally, socially, politically. You can spot a meme reference, understand a design movement, explain why something went viral. You're online, but critically so.

You're exhaustingly multi-skilled.

Writing? Yes. Photography and video? Absolutely. Basic graphic design? Of course. Event coordination? Sure. Video ideation, shooting, and editing? That too. Giving feedback to external designers? Yes. Spotting a typo in a 40-slide deck at 6pm? Unfortunately, also yes.

You're a self-directed learner.

You don't wait to be taught. You pick up tools, platforms, and skills as needed. If tomorrow we need to figure out a new platform, a new tool, or a new format — you're the person who dives in first.

**Technical skills you MUST have:**

● Fluent writing and editing in English

● Photography skills (phone + DSLR/mirrorless)

● Video shooting and editing (Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube — basic to intermediate level)

● Graphic design software: Canva (essential), Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (strong plus)

● Social media platforms and native analytics (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube)

● MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Technical skills that are a BIG plus:**

● Advanced video editing (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut)

● Motion graphics (After Effects basics)

● Figma or other design collaboration tools

● Email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, etc.)

● Understanding of SEO, content strategy, and digital storytelling

**Salary:**
25-35k (Negotiable and commensurate with skills and qualifications.)

**Title And Summary**

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.

Serving as a partner to regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide, this role translates complex information into actionable opportunities, shapes strategic recommendations, and enhances the impact and effectiveness of creative work.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strategic thinking and storytelling, transforming complex data into clear narratives that inspire action and strengthen strategic and creative decision-making.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Creative Data Strategist, you will support regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide through data-driven analysis, audience intelligence, and market insights across a broad range of client engagements.
  
  

* Gather, interpret, and synthesize quantitative and qualitative data, leveraging consumer and audience intelligence platforms to uncover actionable insights and strategic opportunities.

* 8+ years of experience in data strategy, consumer insights, or marketing analytics roles within advertising agencies, preferably full-service network agencies.
* Proven ability to translate data, research, and customer insights into strategic recommendations, creative opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of brand, marketing, communications, customer, and campaign effectiveness frameworks.
* Experience working closely with strategy, creative, and client teams to develop insight-led campaigns, experiences, and engagement programs.
* Ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable, and compelling narratives.
* Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience using consumer and audience intelligence platforms such as YouGov, GWI, TGI, or similar tools to uncover customer, category, and market insights.

Proficiency in data visualization and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
  
  

* Familiarity with digital, social, CRM, customer, and campaign measurement frameworks, methodologies, and analytics tools.
* Knowledge of AI-powered analytics, audience intelligence, and emerging data capabilities is a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and consulting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional proficiency in English is required

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
  
  
AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
The Field Application Engineer will be the technical interface for AMD’s commercial products with commercial end customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s commercial products, particularly commercial client and workstation. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of commercial computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s commercial pipeline with a special focus on pre-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur, align with AMD’s OEM partner support teams, and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting common client, and workstation applications and workloads on AMD hardware with priority end customers.
  
  
**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**

* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts and OEM partners
* Win new commercial client and workstation opportunities by working with OEMs and end customers by establishing technical solutions based on AMD technology
* Work with AMD internal teams across AMD Business Units to build technical presentations and documentation to be delivered in the field
* For priority pipeline opportunities, work directly with end-customers to optimize workloads and applications on AMD-based commercial solutions
* Deliver technical presentations and sales pitches to influence new AMD sales with customers and partners.

This position will require a broad technical understanding of client CPUs/GPUs, and platform architecture and the development process needed to successfully win client and workstation opportunities with end customers. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor architectures, commercial ecosystem environments including Operating systems (Windows, Linux), compilers, drivers, benchmarks, and targeted applications that may be used to validate client and workstation platforms for various target markets.
  
  
**The Customer Field Support Engineer In This Role Will**

* Provide technical assistance to INDIA sales personnel and the end customer in the evaluation, design and development of AMD based client and workstation solutions
* Build business and technical acumen, enabling to gain further "mindshare" within the customer base.
* Ensure that you build the right skills and experience to sell the solutions that we can bring to market.
* Technically qualify, prioritize and assign resources to sales opportunities
* Partner with sales in determining possible application of AMD based products and solutions to meet customer requirements
* Perform technical presentations, training and updates for OEM, partners and prospects
* Translate customer business issues and requirements into technical solution opportunities/engagements that best leverage AMD based product offerings
* Possess a solid understanding of the competitive landscape and clearly articulate the technical differentiation and value proposition associated with AMD versus its competitors
* Assist with the solution development/architectural design to meet specific customer needs
* Analyze OEM product solutions and evaluate product performance based on customer needs
* Keep up-to-date on relevant competitive solutions and work with internal teams to provide competitive responses where needed
* Articulate AMD based technology offerings across multiple verticals
* Partner with other AMD and vendor subject matter experts to build specific customer solutions
* Install and test solutions in-house, as required, to ensure successful deployments and evaluations
* Provide hands-on, expert-level technical assistance to end customer development and software teams
* Design and manage the execution of evaluation plans to ensure a quality solution is delivered
* Be a credible subject matter expert to end customer on direct and indirect product capabilities.
* Other related duties as assigned

**Job Requirements**

* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. Degree should be technology related bachelor's degree or other technical discipline (e.g. Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent combination of training and experience. Requires knowledge in one or more of the following areas: CPU and system architecture, benchmarks, and platform enablement. At least 4 years of system architecture and/or platform development experience
* Must demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi-disciplined, cross-functional teams
* Must have strong experience in leading IT/Technology sales engineers
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.
* Must demonstrate firm understanding of platform development process from concept to production
* Must be well versed in client software ecosystem in one or more areas including OS, Libraries, tools, development tools, workstation SW applications, and validation workloads
* Good hands on and working knowledge of client hardware ecosystem
* Hands on experience in the setup and configuration of systems including software, power settings, BIOS, drivers
* Strong knowledge of operating systems is required
* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills

Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)

* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications

* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines

* Container technologies

Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance

description:
Babaclick | Udyog Vihar Phase 4, Gurugram | Full-time, on-siteSalary: ₹25,000 per month | Urgent hiring: joining required 1–5 October 2026

About Babaclick
Babaclick is a UK-headquartered business building the systems behind global commerce. We connect local supply with international demand through marketplaces, software, logistics and AI-powered workflows, operating across 14+ countries.Our work brings together product sourcing, data, pricing, purchasing and fulfilment to make products accessible across borders. Our India team supports these operations through accurate data, clear processes and consistent execution.

Role Overview
We are hiring a Data Entry Executive to support our sourcing, operations and finance teams. The role involves finding and verifying products, maintaining accurate records and supporting financial reconciliation.

This is a structured, process-driven role suited to someone who is comfortable with repetitive tasks, attentive to detail and confident working with numbers. Accuracy, punctuality and timely completion of daily work are essential.

Key Responsibilities

* Product Sourcing & Data EntryMatch Amazon ASINs and customer orders to the correct products on approved retailer and supplier websites.
* Verify product names, variants, sizes, pack quantities, prices and availability.
* Compare buying options and identify suitable purchase links in line with sourcing guidelines.
* Accurately record buying links, purchase quantities, unit prices and delivery information in internal trackers.
* Flag unavailable products, unclear matches and pricing discrepancies promptly.
* Financial Reconciliation SupportHelp match purchases, payments and refunds against orders, invoices and receipts.
* Enter and update transaction details in spreadsheets and internal systems.
* Assist with reconciling bank, card and marketplace transactions against supporting records.
* Identify missing receipts, duplicate entries, unmatched transactions and differences in amounts.
* Organise supporting documents and follow up with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies.
* Operational SupportKeep Excel and Google Sheets trackers complete, accurate and up to date.
* Follow standard operating procedures, check work before submission and meet agreed deadlines.
* Communicate errors, missing information and blockers promptly.
* Handle company, supplier and financial information confidentially.

* Requirements
  Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering and basic formulas.
* Ability to research products online and compare information accurately.
* Comfortable with repetitive work requiring sustained focus and consistency.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to follow instructions carefully.
* Reliable, organised and punctual.
* Freshers are welcome; experience in data entry, sourcing, e-commerce operations or accounts support is an advantage.
* Familiarity with invoices, receipts or reconciliation is helpful but not essential. Training will be provided.

* Compensation & Work Details
  Salary: ₹25,000 per month (₹3 LPA).
* Location: Udyog Vihar Phase 4, Gurugram.
* Working hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Monday to Friday.
* Work mode: Fully on-site.
* Employment type: Full-time.
* Paid trial: Shortlisted candidates will complete a one-day paid trial to assess accuracy, task execution and suitability for the role.
* Joining requirement: Must be available to start during the first week of October 2026 (1–7 October).

This is an urgent requirement. Please apply only if you can join within the stated window and work from our Gurugram office. Include your earliest available joining date with your application.

title: AI Advisory and Governance Lead
description:
**About IDinsight**
*We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most impact.*
IDinsight Is a Global Nonprofit That Equips Leaders With The Data, Evidence, And Technology To Improve Lives At Scale. We Partner With Governments, NGOs, Multilaterals, And Funders To Support Decisions At Every Stage Of Their Impact Journey – From Bold Pilots To Nationwide Scale-ups. Our Teams Bring Rigorous Evidence And Practical Insights So Leaders Can Make Informed Decisions That Truly Change Lives. With Our Partners, We Are Pioneering The Next Frontier Of Social Impact, Where Data And Technology Accelerate Progress For Millions. We Help Leaders Overcome The Three Main Barriers To Impact
  
  

* Figuring out what works
* Learning and improving
* Reaching and operating at scale

We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other areas.
  
  
We Have Expertise In a Variety Of Rigorous Approaches And Methodologies, Which We Tailor To Each Client Depending On Their Needs And Constraints. To Achieve a Positive Social Impact, We
  
  

* Support our partners with the full ‘data and evidence’ value chain – from primary data collection to data systems, monitoring, evaluation, and learning tools, and data science
* Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective programs or approaches
* Create cutting-edge AI-for-good products that make the delivery of social interventions and learning tools more cost-effective and scalable

Our diverse, growing team of roughly 250 outstanding colleagues operates in nearly two dozen countries around the world. Learn more about our mission and values at
**www.IDinsight.org**
.
  
  
**Joining IDinsight at this moment**
IDinsight is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As demand for rigorous evidence and AI-enabled solutions accelerates across the sectors and geographies we work in, we are actively investing in our teams, deepening our regional footprint, and expanding the frontier of what data and technology can do for social impact. This is a moment of real momentum for IDinsight. We're looking for people who want to use data and evidence to improve lives at scale; who are energized by taking on problems without a playbook; and who want a hand in shaping what IDinsight becomes as we grow.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring an entrepreneurial senior leader to strengthen and develop our AI Advisory practice for government and social sector clients in India. You will collaborate with IDinsight’s Senior Leadership, Executive, and Data Science teams to develop AI and technology aspects of current engagements, develop new engagements primarily with government partners, and support delivery of projects. Read more about our AI strategy.
  
  
The role is particularly suited to someone who understands technology transformation and policymaking in Indian government institutions. It combines client-facing advisory work with business development, and sits at the intersection of AI, governance, and public sector consulting. The role will ideally be based in Delhi, or require substantial time spent in Delhi.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Lead policy advisory and AI support for governments**
Support IDinsight's current government partners navigate the intersection of technology, AI, and policy, and grow our portfolio by engaging new government departments/agencies in AI and policy advisory.
  
  

* Policy advisory on AI: Support current and new government partners in:

+ Design and deployment of tech-enabled systems, including AI-native tools, data systems, and digital platforms — with a grounded understanding of requirements and constraints in Indian government settings, including data governance, procurement constraints, interoperability, and the political economy of adoption.
+ Developing policies, regulations, governance and capacity building frameworks shaping AI use in India.
+ Translating broad questions around into concrete, impactful opportunities and recommendations

* Client engagement: Participate in high-level meetings, workshops, and consortium discussions with government officials, funders, and partner organisations as a credible voice on technology, AI, and AI policy in governance contexts.
* Government client development: Identify and develop new opportunities to support governments on AI and technology, through active origination of new AI advisory engagements, conversion of leads, and drafting and reviewing proposals, growing the practice's pipeline and revenue especially with government organisations
* Represent IDinsight externally through thought leadership and public communications (blog posts, conference presentations, sector convenings, and written outputs) that advance IDinsight's profile and influence on AI transformation.

**Develop new AI advisory and evaluation engagements**
Grow IDinsight's AI advisory and evaluation practice with NGOs, social enterprises, and foundations.
  
  

* Client development: Identify, scope, and structure new engagements. Build relationships with prospective partners and develop proposals that match IDinsight's capabilities to client needs.
* AI Transformation Advisory: Serve as the senior lead on advisory and evaluation engagements - identifying the right use-cases; building, testing and evaluating AI-based products; and integrating AI products responsibly into client systems and workflows.
* Thought leadership: Represent IDinsight in sector conversations on AI in the social sector through writing and external engagement.
* Training and workshops: Design and deliver executive workshops, workflow redesign sessions, and training programs that build lasting client capability.

**Financial management**

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of IDinsight's business model and contribute to a financially sustainable practice through sound strategic decision-making and resource stewardship.
* Review budget design and resource allocation, ensuring financial planning supports quality delivery, funder expectations, and growth of the practice.
* Build trust with clients and funders through timely, accurate, and strategic financial reporting.

**Qualifications**
**Who we are looking for**

* Commitment to IDinsight's values and mission
* 6-10 years of professional experience, with significant time in consulting, digital transformation, product management, or technology implementation, ideally serving governments, foundations, or social sector organizations.
* Technical fluency: Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, AI agent architectures, and the practical realities of deploying AI in organizations. Ability to credibly direct a technical team. The role does not require production coding skills.
* Direct experience working with Indian government: Ideally ministries, national commissions, or large national programmes, with a strong understanding of how decisions get made and how change actually happens in these institutions, and the requirements that technology and AI systems must meet in government settings
* Client-facing consulting: Experience leading complex advisory engagements, managing senior client relationships, and delivering results against defined success metrics.
* People management: Track record of building, managing, and developing high-performing teams that include both technical and non-technical roles.
* Demonstrated experience in client development: identifying opportunities, scoping engagements, developing proposals, and building relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with limited structure
* Entrepreneurial- can identify an opportunity and build from it without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Strong communicator who can adapt between technical, bureaucratic, and donor audiences.

**Professional development**
Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long-term impact strategy, and have been noted highlights of teammates’ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real-time feedback is embedded in our culture and formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend that they are encouraged to utilize to explore their career interests and develop their skills.
  
  
**Nuts & bolts**
**Location**
This position is based in IDinsight’s Delhi office. Candidates should be willing to relocate to Delhi or travel substantially, often on short notice.
  
  
Start dates
  
  
We would prefer for the candidate to start immediately and in light of the urgency would be evaluating applications on a rolling basis.
  
  
**References**
Applications should include three references, including email, phone, and title. Briefly state in what capacity you worked with each reference.
  
  
**Work authorization**
**If you’re not willing to sponsor work authorization:**
IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role. Successful candidates will not require IDinsight to sponsor their work authorization in the office in which they'll be based.
  
  
**If you’re willing to sponsor work authorization:**
IDinsight is able to sponsor employment visas for all nationalities in these locations; however, we will prioritize candidates who do not require IDinsight to sponsor work authorization in the aforementioned countries. All candidates who are not currently located in our country offices listed above will be expected to relocate to their office locations at the onset of their employment.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for, and competitive within the global development sector. We are especially proud of the people-focused benefits we offer including comprehensive international health insurance, including mental health coverage; paid vacation, sick, and parental leave; relocation benefits; a travel stipend; technology and work from home stipends; a professional development budget; and more.
  
  
Please note, as a non-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading private sector organizations.
  
  
**How To Apply**
This application includes several questions and requires a CV (one to two pages) covering your professional and personal experience as well as academic qualifications. Please omit headshots, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and similar personal information — these aren't relevant to our review.
  
  
More information, including details on I
**Dinsight’s hiring process**
and
**frequently asked questions**
, can be found online at IDinsight Careers. Any questions should be directed to india.careers@IDinsight.org.
  
  
**IDinsight’s commitment to reducing power asymmetries**
IDinsight is committed to
**reducing power asymmetries in the social sector**
. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.
  
  
We Seek a Diverse Workforce That Inherently Embodies Our Commitment To Fostering Inclusivity. This Also Helps Us Refine And Improve Our Methods And Relationships And Strengthen The Services We Provide Our Clients And Their Communities Or Constituencies. The Following Commitments Represent Our Vision For The IDinsight Team
  
  

* IDinsight will have greater representation from the populations with whom we work and the clients we serve.
* IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
* Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from historically excluded communities.
* IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their best work.

IDinsight is committed to non-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organizational culture, regardless of people’s age, disability, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Assistant-Program
description:
**Overview**
Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  
  
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems. Jhpiego currently works in over 14 states of India, focusing on women’s health — including maternal, reproductive, and women’s cancers — and provides technical assistance to governments on health systems, human resources, quality of care, health surveillance, digital health, and primary health care.
  
  
SAAKSHI (Strengthening Access to Affordable and Quality Healthcare for Worker Communities through Awareness, Prevention, and Public Health Linkages) is a three-year initiative supported by the H&M Foundation, working in Panipat’s textile recycling ecosystem. The project will strengthen health, hygiene, and workforce stability for 1,500 migrant workers and their families by establishing integrated, community-owned primary healthcare access systems; strengthening preventive and occupational health practices at the workplace and in the community; and driving behaviour change and facilitation support to increase uptake of Government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY and ESIC.
  
  
The project is organised around three sub-goals: (1) improving sustained access to preventive, occupational, and primary healthcare; (2) enabling behaviour change and community ownership for long-term outcomes; and (3) strengthening local systems, governance, and frontline capacity to sustain impact.
  
  
The Senior Assistant- Program will support the implementation of community-based project activities and work closely with migrant worker communities, public health systems, employers, frontline health workers, and community leaders. The role requires strong field coordination, community engagement, and stakeholder management skills to ensure effective delivery of project interventions
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support implementation of community outreach, health promotion, and occupational health activities.
* Mobilize communities for health camps, screenings, awareness sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Facilitate access to government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY, ESIC, and other welfare programs.
* Coordinate with ASHAs, ANMs, public health facilities, hospitals, employers, and community stakeholders.
* Support identification and capacity building of community champions and peer leaders.
* Assist in establishing and strengthening workplace health and safety committees.
* Maintain project records, beneficiary databases, activity reports, and referral tracking systems.

Contribute to data collection, monitoring, reporting, and project review processes
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in public health, community development, social protection, or related programs.
* Experience in community mobilization, behavior change communication, and stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with government health systems and social welfare schemes is desirable.
* Experience working with migrant populations, urban health, or occupational health programs will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong community mobilization and facilitation abilities.
* Good documentation, reporting, and data management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital data collection tools.
* Ability to work independently in field settings and manage multiple priorities.
* Fluency in Hindi; working knowledge of English preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Panipat and surrounding areas.

UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks.Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially.

Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service.
  
  
**Remarks**

UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable female candidates are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information.

title: Guest Advisory Associate (Arabic)
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for an
**Arabic-speaking Guest Advisory Associate**
to turn customer interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
  
  
You’ll be one of the first people travellers speak to at Atlys, understanding what they need, helping them navigate their options, and building trust through clear, thoughtful conversations.
  
  
This is a customer-facing role for someone who can combine strong communication with commercial instinct, follow through consistently, and move quickly in a high-volume environment.
**Fluency in Arabic and English is essential**
, as you’ll work closely with Arabic-speaking customers.
  
  
**The Job**

* Engage and qualify potential customers across calls, chats and email by understanding their travel needs and guiding them toward the right Atlys solution.
* Communicate with Arabic-speaking customers in Arabic and English, adapting your approach to ensure conversations are clear, natural and effective.
* Explain our products and visa processes clearly so customers understand their options, feel confident in their decision and know what happens next.
* Drive leads through to conversion through thoughtful follow-ups, objection handling and consistent ownership of the customer journey.
* Learn from customer conversations by identifying recurring questions, pain points and signals that can improve conversion and the overall experience.
* Work closely across teams with Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while keeping lead and interaction data accurate and up to date.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 1+ years of experience in pre-sales, sales, customer success or another customer-facing role.
* Are fluent in Arabic and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Information Technology Specialist
description:
**Job Purpose**

The IT Executive provides on-site IT support at the Visa Application Centre, ensuring smooth day-to-day operation of end-user systems, peripherals, and centre-facing equipment.

Working under the direction of the central IT team at VAS Headquarters, the role acts as the local on-ground resource for the centrally managed infrastructure — FortiGate networking with SD-WAN, biometric devices, access-control systems, and CCTV — and ensures incidents are diagnosed, escalated, and resolved within defined SLAs while maintaining compliance with VAS security and data-protection standards.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Provide Level-1 on-site IT support to Visa Centre staff under the direction of the central IT team at VAS Headquarters, covering end-user hardware, software, peripherals, and basic network connectivity issues.
2. Act as on-site remote hands for the central IT team to power-cycle, re-cable, swap, relocate, and label FortiGate firewalls, SD-WAN edge devices, switches, biometric capture units, passport scanners, access-control panels, CCTV cameras, and NVRs as instructed.
3. Execute scripted or runbook-based local tasks, including cabling checks, link tests, status-LED reporting, equipment photographs, and physical inspections, to support central troubleshooting. Make no independent changes to firewall, SD-WAN, or network configuration.
4. Monitor visa-processing systems, appointment portal, biometric workflow, internet and SD-WAN links at the centre, and report performance or outage issues to the central IT team through the approved ticketing channel within defined SLAs.
5. Maintain the local IT asset inventory at the centre, including tagging, location, serial numbers, condition, and movement, and synchronize updates to the central asset register as agreed.
6. Apply approved end-user device patches, antivirus checks, and Windows/Office updates pushed by the central team, and confirm completion through the agreed reporting mechanism.
7. Support new-joiner onboarding at the centre through handover of pre-configured devices and peripherals, IT acceptable-use induction, and basic user orientation once accounts and devices are provisioned centrally.
8. Provide first-line assistance for end-user issues involving VPN, email, Microsoft 365, biometric capture, and visa-processing applications, and escalate unresolved incidents to the central IT team with complete diagnostic information.
9. Coordinate with the central IT team for any change, upgrade, or third-party visit at the centre and act as the on-site point of contact for ISP technicians, spare-parts couriers, and authorised vendor engineers.
10. Comply with VAS information-security, data-protection, and acceptable-use policies, and immediately report any incident, suspected breach, unauthorised access, or tampering involving biometric, CCTV, or access-control equipment.
11. Maintain accurate local records, including ticket logs, change diaries, equipment movement, visitor IT-access logs, and configuration photographs, and submit them to the central IT team as agreed.
12. Provide on-the-ground support during Mission, government, regulator, and internal audits, hardware refreshes, and new technology rollouts driven by the central IT team.

**Qualification & Experience Requirement**

Education

* Minimum: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.

Experience

* 2–4 years of experience in on-site IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering, preferably in a multi-site, branch-office, or public-facing service-centre environment.
* Hands-on familiarity with Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive), and common end-user business applications.
* Working knowledge of LAN/WLAN cabling, switches, Wi-Fi access points, basic network troubleshooting, and end-user VPN clients.
* Exposure to FortiGate firewalls and SD-WAN concepts is preferred.
* Practical experience with peripherals and field equipment, including printers, scanners, biometric capture devices, passport readers, CCTV/NVR systems, and access-control readers, at support, swap, and replacement level.
* Ability to follow written instructions, runbooks, and remote guidance from a central IT team accurately and document work, observations, and outcomes clearly.
* Strong communication and customer-service skills, with the ability to support non-technical end users and external visitors in a high-traffic, public-facing centre.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak appointment hours and audit, inspection, or system-rollout windows.
* Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and extended hours according to the centre operating schedule, and remain reachable on call for centre-impacting incidents.

**Competencies / Personal Attributes**

Functional Competencies

1. End-User Support & Helpdesk Operations
2. Site Infrastructure Awareness (FortiGate / SD-WAN / Biometric / CCTV / Access Control)
3. IT Asset & Inventory Management
4. SOP Adherence & Operational Discipline

Additional Requirements

* Hands-on exposure to biometric equipment (fingerprint, iris, facial), passport readers, CCTV/NVR systems, access-control readers, and visa-processing applications.
* Awareness of ITIL service-management practices (incident, request, change) and ability to follow them under central direction.
* Familiarity with enterprise ticketing tools such as Jira, Freshdesk, ServiceNow, or similar, including detailed ticket logging and SLA-driven follow-through.

title: Articled Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
D BHATIA & CO LLP is a Chartered Accountancy firm dedicated to providing ethical, accurate, and expert financial solutions to businesses and individuals. The firm offers a comprehensive range of services, including Audit & Assurance, Taxation, GST advisory, Information Systems audit, financial advisory, and regulatory compliance management. Experienced Chartered Accountants and legal professionals work together to build long-term partnerships grounded in trust, integrity, and excellence. The firm is accessible to clients through multiple communication channels, ensuring responsive and professional support.

Responsibilities include assisting in statutory, internal, and concurrent audits, preparing working papers and documentation, and supporting tax and GST compliance, including return preparation and basic litigation support. The role also involves helping with financial and business advisory tasks, performing data analysis, and contributing to Information Systems audit reviews under supervision. The Articled Assistant will interact with clients for data collection and clarification, maintain accurate records, and ensure adherence to professional and regulatory standards. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India.

**Qualifications**
