* Strong foundational knowledge of accounting principles, auditing standards, taxation laws, and GST regulations.
* Ability to work with MS Excel, Word, and accounting/tax software; comfort with technology-driven tools and data analysis.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear working papers and reports.
* Attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a commitment to ethical and professional conduct.
* Capacity to work independently and as part of a team, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines during peak compliance periods.
* Prior internship or basic exposure to audits, tax filings, or financial compliance will be considered an advantage.

title: Performance Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Are you looking for an opportunity to manage the digital transformation for Ecommerce and Digital Marketing across all brands and therapeutic areas? If so, this is the job for you. As Multichannel Marketing Manager you will be responsible for establishing an integrated digital support network for the development of e-commerce channel partnering across Haleon. You will also develop and execute an integrated business plan while managing relationships with strategic partners and pilot initiatives. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career.
  
  
These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Strategy Development: Develop and implement comprehensive on-platform performance marketing strategies aligned with business objectives on Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Bigbasket, Swiggy and other e-comemerce platforms.
* Campaign Management: Manage and optimize performance marketing campaigns to maximize ROI, CPC, CTR, and other key performance metrics.
* Performance Analysis: Conduct thorough analysis of campaign performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency. Continuously test and optimize campaigns based on data insights.
* Budget Management: Utilize data-driven approaches to make informed decisions and optimize marketing budgets for maximum impact.
* Agency Management: Manage agency to implement performance marketing strategies.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Brand and Design teams
* Third Party Stakeholder: Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising platforms teams to identify opportunities for growth.
* Stay Updated: Stay informed with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in performance marketing, and implement innovative strategies to stay ahead of the competition.
* Reporting: Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and marketing metrics to track progress towards goals and objectives and communicate insights to stakeholders.
* Lead the digital capability for the brand teams as well as key stakeholders in other functional areas
* Create and pilot e-commerce initiatives
* Continue to feed the customer insight to the commercial team’s brand strategy
* Lead the 12-month digital operational plan to deliver the activities that build towards the longer-term strategy

**Why you?**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* MBA Tier 1 colleges.
* 6+ years in a large multi-national working environment.
* 4+ year’s Marketing experience.
* Experience in multi-channel/digital marketing.
* On platform experience on blinkit, amazon, flipkart etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**
:
  
  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* MBA (Marketing, Brand Management, Communications, or a Technology related field in Pharmaceuticals) consult manager on Technology related field experience
* Digital course work
* Expert in digital marketing channels in sales and marketing
* Ability to influence, challenge and gain credibility with senior commercial leaders
* Digital/social/interactive marketing experience with a clear commercial focus, including digital analytics and metrics
* Excellent communication skills, strong presentation and facilitation skills to explain/sell creative concepts
* Proven track record of driving sales performance
* Agency management experience
* Proficient in customer understanding and campaign development
* Capable of working across boundaries and functional areas
* Familiarity with copy approval process
* Experience in the Pharma sector
* Project management experience

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-17
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

title: Digital Media Planning - Senior Executive
description:

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:

* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive – Implementation Planning who will:
  
  

* Develop strong relationships with Client Servicing and Activation teams to facilitate flawless execution of plans.
* Communicate effectively across all levels of the team and across all practices.
* Support Media Planning Managers to ensure the smooth delivery of campaigns and their performance against agreed outcomes.
* Conduct research and compile data to guide and support planning and optimization recommendations.

* Assist in the management of testing plans for assigned campaigns.

* Meet with vendors and attend presentations to build knowledge of the media landscape

We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, business, or a related field.
* 2-4 years of B2B program marketing experience, preferably in the technology field; enterprise infrastructure software marketing experience is a huge plus
* In-depth knowledge of media planning principles, techniques, and best practices across various channels (digital & social)
* Familiarity with media buying, negotiation, and contract management.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions.
* Proficiency in using media planning and tracking tools (Marketo, Convertr or Data Studio is a plus)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Computer literate with good skills in all basic Office programs (including Excel)
* Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* A passion for everything media and advertising, coupled with a continued desire to expand your knowledge

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Programmatic Media Executive
description:

**Programmatic Media Specialist**
to manage and optimize programmatic advertising campaigns across DSPs and digital channels. Key Responsibilities

Required Skills & Qualifications

  **DV360 or The Trade Desk**
  .
* Good understanding of the programmatic ecosystem:

  .
* Strong knowledge of digital advertising metrics and campaign KPIs.

ibaby is a premium baby retail brand offering parents in India a curated range of essentials across feeding, travel gear, bath & body, toys, and more. * 2-5+ years of experience in CRM, customer retention, tele-sales, or a similar customer lifecycle role.

* Exposure to WhatsApp Business API, bulk messaging tools, or CRM platforms.

Today, brands also need to appear in AI Overviews, featured answers, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI-powered discovery platforms.

Chasing Illusions Studio is looking for an AI SEO Specialist who understands both sides of modern organic visibility:

Traditional SEO + Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

This is not a role for someone who only knows keyword research, backlinks and meta tags.

We need someone who understands how search engines crawl, rank and evaluate content — and also how AI systems discover, interpret, cite, summarize and recommend brands.

What You’ll Own

**1. Traditional SEO**

You should have strong hands-on knowledge of:

●     Keyword research and search intent mapping

●     Competitor and SERP analysis

●     On-page + Technical SEO audits

●     Content optimization + Internal linking strategy

●     URL structure and website architecture

●     Meta details (title, description, headings, etc.)

●     Image SEO

●     Schema markup + Core Web Vitals

●     XML sitemaps and robots.txt

●     Canonicalization

●     Indexing and crawlability

●     Page speed optimization

●     Duplicate content management

●     Redirects and 404 issues

●     Backlink analysis and link-building

●     Local and location-based SEO

●     Google Search Console and Google Analytics

●     Organic traffic, ranking and conversion analysis

You should be comfortable diagnosing why a page is not ranking, not indexing, losing traffic or underperforming against competitors.

**2. AEO — Answer Engine Optimization**

We need someone who understands how to optimize content for direct answers, not just blue-link rankings.

You should know how to:

●     Structure content around real user questions

●     Identify conversational and long-tail queries

●     Optimize for featured snippets

●     Build FAQ-driven content strategically

●     Improve answer clarity and information hierarchy

●     Create concise answer-first sections

●     Optimize content for voice and conversational search

●     Use relevant structured data/schema

●     Improve topical authority through question clusters

●     Analyze People Also Ask and related-question opportunities

●     Match content format with informational, commercial and transactional intent

The objective is simple:

When users ask a question related to our services, our content should have a strong chance of becoming the answer.

**3. GEO — Generative Engine Optimization**

This is a critical part of the role.

You should understand how brands can improve their visibility across generative AI platforms and AI-powered search experiences.

You will work on:

●     Optimizing content for AI Overviews

●     Increasing brand/entity visibility in generative search

●     Building strong topical and entity associations

●     Creating content that AI systems can easily understand and summarize

●     Improving factual clarity and semantic relationships

●     Strengthening E-E-A-T signals

●     Developing citation-worthy content

●     Creating original statistics, insights, examples and expert-led content

●     Building topic clusters and knowledge depth

●     Strengthening brand mentions across authoritative third-party sources

●     Monitoring how Chasing Illusions Studio appears in AI-generated answers

●     Tracking competitor visibility across AI search platforms

●     Identifying prompts where our competitors appear but we do not

●     Improving content so it can be referenced or recommended by AI systems

You should understand that GEO is not keyword stuffing for ChatGPT.

It requires strong content structure, authority, entities, citations, context, relevance and brand signals.

**4. Content Strategy for Search + AI Discovery**

You must have knowledge of content writing + optimization for at least 2 years.

Your responsibility will be to identify:

What are people searching?

What are they asking AI?

What problems are they trying to solve?

What type of content would make our brand the most useful answer?

**5. SEO + AI Visibility Analysis**

We expect you to think beyond rankings.

You should regularly analyze:

●     Google organic rankings + Search impressions

●     CTR + Organic traffic

●     Conversion opportunities

●     Competitor content + Content gaps

●     SERP features + Search intent satisfaction

●     ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity brand mentions + AI Overview appearances

●     Citation opportunities + Entity visibility

●     Topic authority + Backlink quality

Your reports should answer:

What improved?

What declined?

Why did it happen?

What should we do next?

Not just screenshots and exported spreadsheets.

Tools You Should Be Comfortable With

Experience with most of the following is expected:

●     Google Search Console + Google Analytics 4

●     Google Keyword Planner + Ahrefs / Semrush / similar SEO tools + Google Trends

●     Screaming Frog

●     PageSpeed Insights

●     Google Tag Manager

●     Schema testing tools

●     ChatGPT + Perplexity + Gemini + similar AI websites

●     AI-search monitoring or visibility tools

**Who We Are Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if:

●     You have
**2–3 years of hands-on SEO experience**

●     You have independently handled SEO projects

●     You understand technical SEO, not just content optimization

●     You understand the difference between
**SEO, AEO and GEO**

●     You actively follow changes in Google Search and AI search

●     You understand search intent deeply

●     You can identify ranking and traffic problems independently

●     You understand that modern SEO is increasingly about
**visibility, authority and answers — not just rankings**

**What We Do NOT Need**

We are not looking for someone whose SEO experience is limited to:

●     Adding keywords into content

●     Submitting backlinks to directories

●     Posting generic guest blogs

●     Checking rankings every morning

●     Generating AI articles without strategy

●     Following outdated SEO checklists

We need someone capable of thinking strategically about how a brand gets discovered across both search engines and AI engines.

**Why This Role Matters?**

Search behavior is moving from:

“Search → Click → Read”

toward:

“Ask → Compare → Get an AI-generated recommendation.”

We want someone who understands this transition and can help build our organic visibility for both environments.

If you understand Traditional SEO + AEO + GEO and want to work hands-on with a growing animation and video production company, we’d like to hear from you.

**Experience:**

●     SEO: 3 years (Required)

●     Creative writing: 3 years (Required)

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**We’re Hiring | Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)**

**Quick Clean Laundry Solutions | Gurugram, Haryana | Full-time | Leadership Role**

Build the Organisation. Develop Leaders. Drive Performance.

At Quick Clean, we are building more than a laundry services company. We are transforming how the hospitality and healthcare industries manage their laundry operations through technology, operational excellence, and sustainable solutions.

With 140+ On-Premise Laundry (OPL) sites across India, a workforce of 1,000+ employees, and ambitious expansion plans, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth.

We are looking for a Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) who can build the organisation, develop future leaders, strengthen our performance culture, and create the people infrastructure required to support our next phase of growth.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role working directly with the Founder & CEO. The mandate goes beyond traditional HR: we expect our CHRO to influence business performance through better leadership, workforce productivity, talent quality, and organisational effectiveness.

If you are passionate about building high-performance organisations and thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment, this opportunity is for you.

What Will You Own?

1. Organisation Strategy & Design

\* Partner with the Founder & CEO and leadership team to translate business objectives into a comprehensive people strategy.

\* Design scalable organisation structures, workforce plans, and reporting frameworks aligned with business growth.

\* Establish clear accountability, role ownership, and performance expectations across functions and locations.

\* Identify organisational capability gaps and build solutions to support rapid expansion.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Build a robust recruitment engine to support leadership, sales, operations, engineering, and corporate hiring.

\* Develop manpower plans aligned with new-site launches, business expansion, and operational requirements.

\* Strengthen recruitment quality, hiring turnaround time, and onboarding effectiveness.

\* Build leadership pipelines, campus recruitment programmes, and management trainee initiatives.

\* Establish talent acquisition metrics covering hiring efficiency, quality of hire, and early-tenure retention.

3. Workforce Productivity & Operational HR

\* Partner with Operations and regional leadership to improve manpower availability, deployment, and productivity across our pan-India sites.

\* Develop workforce planning models covering staffing requirements, absenteeism, attrition, shifts, and overtime.

\* Establish productivity benchmarks and workforce management dashboards.

\* Strengthen HR engagement with frontline employees and operational teams through regular site visits.

\* Drive initiatives that improve workforce efficiency without compromising service quality, employee welfare, or safety.

4. Performance Management & Accountability

\* Build a high-performance culture through clear KRAs, measurable KPIs, quarterly reviews, and structured performance appraisals.

\* Align individual and functional performance with company objectives and business outcomes.

\* Establish transparent performance calibration, promotion, rewards, and performance improvement processes.

\* Work with business leaders to address sustained underperformance and strengthen managerial accountability.

\* Design performance-linked incentive and recognition frameworks that reward ownership, execution, and results.

5. Leadership Development & Succession Planning

\* Develop leadership capabilities across regional teams, functional heads, and operational site managers.

\* Build structured career progression, succession planning, and internal talent development programmes.

\* Identify high-potential employees and prepare them for larger responsibilities.

\* Coach managers to become stronger people leaders who can build capable, accountable teams.

\* Reduce dependence on external hiring by developing a strong internal leadership pipeline.

6. Employee Engagement, Retention & Culture

\* Strengthen Quick Clean’s culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, integrity, and customer focus.

\* Identify attrition drivers and develop targeted retention strategies for critical talent and frontline employees.

\* Build effective employee feedback, recognition, communication, and grievance-resolution mechanisms.

\* Improve managerial effectiveness, employee experience, and consistency of people practices across locations.

\* Develop initiatives that make Quick Clean an employer of choice for high-performing professionals.

7. HR Systems, Analytics & Governance

\* Build a data-driven HR function supported by effective HRMS utilisation, automation, and people analytics.

\* Establish dashboards covering attrition, recruitment, attendance, manpower costs, productivity, and performance.

\* Standardise HR processes across corporate offices, regional teams, and operational sites.

\* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, employment policies, and workplace regulations.

\* Strengthen HR operations, payroll governance, documentation, and internal controls.

8. Compensation, Rewards & HR Team Leadership

\* Develop transparent compensation structures, salary bands, grading systems, and performance-linked rewards.

\* Ensure compensation decisions are aligned with performance, internal equity, market benchmarks, and business affordability.

\* Build and lead a high-performing HR team across talent acquisition, HR operations, business partnering, learning and development, and employee relations.

\* Establish clear HR team KPIs, service standards, and execution accountability.

\* Position HR as a strategic business partner rather than a purely administrative function.

What Are We Looking For?

Experience & Qualifications

\* 10–15 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3–5 years in a senior HR leadership or strategic HR business partnering role.

\* Demonstrated experience managing HR for a multi-location organisation with a geographically dispersed workforce.

\* Strong experience in talent acquisition, workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, and organisation development.

\* Experience working with frontline employees, site-based teams, and regional leadership.

\* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and multi-state HR compliance.

\* Experience building HR systems, dashboards, and measurable people processes.

\* A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline. An MBA/PGDM in HR from a reputed institution would be preferred.

Preferred Background

Experience in one or more of the following sectors would be advantageous:

\* Hospitality and healthcare

\* Manufacturing and industrial services

\* Facilities management

\* Logistics and supply chain

\* Retail or other multi-location, service-intensive businesses

Experience in a founder-led, high-growth, entrepreneurial, or private-equity-backed organisation will be a strong advantage.

The Leadership Qualities We Value

We are looking for someone who:

\* Thinks like a business leader: Understands the relationship between people, productivity, revenue, and profitability.

\* Executes relentlessly: Converts ideas into measurable outcomes rather than stopping at policies and presentations.

\* Builds leaders: Develops managers who can take ownership and deliver results.

\* Makes tough decisions: Addresses performance issues with courage, fairness, and sound judgement.

\* Uses data to drive decisions: Relies on evidence, analytics, and measurable outcomes.

\* Stays close to the ground: Is comfortable engaging directly with frontline employees and visiting operational sites.

\* Thrives in a growth environment: Can bring structure and discipline without slowing down entrepreneurial execution.

What Does Success Look Like?

In the first 12 months, you will be expected to:

\* Build a scalable organisation structure aligned with Quick Clean’s growth ambitions.

\* Improve workforce planning and manpower productivity across operational sites.

\* Strengthen leadership capability and succession coverage for critical positions.

\* Establish a robust performance management and accountability framework.

\* Improve retention of high-performing and critical employees.

\* Build a dependable recruitment engine for business expansion.

\* Introduce reliable people analytics and HR dashboards for leadership decision-making.

\* Develop a capable HR team that delivers measurable business impact.

Specific targets will be agreed upon after an initial assessment of the organisation and its current performance baselines.

Why Join Quick Clean?

This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder & CEO and play a defining role in building a high-growth Indian company.

You will have the opportunity to shape the organisation’s culture, develop its future leaders, influence business decisions, and build the people systems required for national and international expansion.

We value ownership, integrity, speed of execution, continuous improvement, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

We are not looking for someone to simply manage HR. We are looking for a leader who can help build the organisation that will take Quick Clean to its next level of growth.

Interested?

If you are ready to build, lead, and make a measurable difference, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Accounts Receivable and Collections Analyst
description:
**About Teads**
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users.
  
  
At Teads, we believe
**your impact travels further**
. We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
The
**Senior Accounts Receivable & Collections Analyst**
plays a critical role in supporting the company's global financial operations by leading the accounts receivable and collections function across an international customer portfolio. Combining strong operational execution with a proactive, customer-focused approach, this role is responsible for optimizing collections, resolving complex billing and payment issues, and ensuring a seamless customer experience.
  
  
As a subject matter expert for AR systems such as
**NetSuite, SAP, and Salesforce**
, you will drive process improvements, maintain data integrity, and enhance the efficiency of the order-to-cash cycle. You will also produce timely and insightful reporting on accounts receivable performance, debtor balances, cash collections, and bad debt exposure, providing valuable insights to business stakeholders while building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**A day in the life**

* Arrive with a live view of global portfolio aging to identify exactly where pressure points are before the first call of the day.
* Contact customers (agencies, Enterprise, and brand clients) by telephone and email to move collections forward on high-risk accounts.
* Maintain positive relationships with our customers by providing excellent, responsive service.
* Maintain meticulous notes on follow-up and contact within ERP and CRM systems so nothing falls through overnight.
* Handle a non-stop flow of cases, DIY billing queries, and financial requests via a shared inbox and Salesforce with high operational resilience.
* Send monthly statements to customers and resolve discrepancies immediately upon receipt.
* Reduce DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), improve CEI (Collection Effectiveness Index), and minimize bad debt expense of the assigned global portfolio.
* Identify systemic billing or operational issues impacting cash flow and proactively lead cross-functional resolution efforts.
* Act as a key contributor in cash forecasting by providing accurate short- and long-term collection projections based on portfolio trends.
* Communicate real-time account status, risks, and next actions proactively to Sales and Account Managers.
* Oversee daily cash applications in ERP systems and lead investigations into complex unallocated/unapplied cash receipts.
* Issue reminder and legal notices to customers based on the Credit Control policy.
* Collaborate with Internal Sales, AMs, Finance, Legal, and billing teams with an "on-your-toes" urgency to resolve discrepancies and unblock revenue.
* Monitor and report on potential bad debts and portfolio health with a sharp, numerical eye.
* Strengthen internal controls and compliance around AR processes, ensuring audit readiness and policy adherence.
* Determine when accounts should be sent to outside collection agencies when all internal strategic efforts have been exhausted.
* Generate sophisticated monthly and ad-hoc reporting metrics on the performance of the portfolio.
* Lead the setting of credit limits for new and existing customers.
* Manage credit card workflows end-to-end, including charges, refunds, and formally challenging invalid chargebacks with supporting evidence.
* Actively leverage Enterprise AI platforms (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to drive process optimization, build automations, and streamline collection workflows.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Minimum 10–12 years’ experience in an Accounts Receivable / Collections role.
* Ability to adjust priorities instantly under pressure to meet non-stop deadlines.
* High stamina and flexibility within a constantly changing, high-volume environment.
* Elite interpersonal and diplomatic negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to cooperate and lead collaboration effectively with team members.
* Proven track record of reducing DSO and improving cash collections.
* Sharp, proactive attitude – the ability to take immediate initiative to get things done.
* Expert Microsoft Excel (Power Query/Pivot) and IT skills with an exceptional eye for numbers.
* Highly motivated with a continuous eye for process improvement and automation.
* Deep expertise in managing global portfolios across multiple currencies and international markets.
* Deep expertise in Tier-1 ERP and CRM ecosystems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce) with the ability to drive system-related projects.
* AI-savvy and curious about technology; comfort using Enterprise AI tools to automate repetitive tasks.
* Experience of working with advertising/marketing agencies is highly preferred

**Life at Teads**
At Teads, we don’t just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting-edge data to shape the future of media.
  
  
As a Teadster, you’ll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy-first world.
  
  
We are builders, innovators, and future-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI-driven media, you belong here.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**

title: senior Admission counsellor
description:
Job Description

**About Masters’ Union**

Founded in 2020, Masters’ Union is a new-age, industry-led university focused on business, technology, engineering, and entrepreneurship. Built around learning by doing, the institution combines academics with real-world projects, startup building, and global exposure, with the ambition of becoming one of the world’s top business schools and multidisciplinary universities over the next two decades.

Today, Masters’ Union has nearly 3,500 students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programs, with almost half being experienced professionals. Spread across nearly 5 lakh square feet in Gurgaon and Manesar, the institution houses the PwC Center for Generative AI, a Bloomberg Lab, Gurgaon’s premier maker space, AI and robotics infrastructure, advanced bioengineering workshops, and startup incubation spaces, while also expanding into areas such as bioengineering and genetic engineering.

The institution is chaired by Manoj Kohli, former CEO of Bharti Airtel and former Country Head of SoftBank India. Its leadership ecosystem includes Vivek Gambhir, Pankaj Bansal, Sanjiv Bikhchandani, Amitabh Kant, and 30+ other founders, CEOs, investors, and policymakers who contribute to teaching and institution building.

Masters’ Union’s flagship postgraduate program has recorded the highest average salary among MBA-equivalent programs in India, with graduates placed at firms such as Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Google, and Microsoft. The institution has also built one of the country’s strongest student startup ecosystems, with 10+ students pitching on Shark Tank India and 20+ students raising external funding for their ventures, alongside several successful creators and internet entrepreneurs.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Admission Counsellor professional to join our team, who will be responsible for engaging with working professionals for our specialised program in capital markets. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in inside sales and will be instrumental in helping working professionals enhance their careers by enrolling in our high-impact, capital markets-focused program.

**Specifically, this role will involve**

* Engaging with working professionals to identify their career needs and how the program can enhance their skills in capital markets.
* Conducting online and offline product demonstrations, providing detailed insights into the program’s features, benefits, and career opportunities.
* Scheduling and conducting consultations and follow-up sessions with prospective students, addressing their concerns and queries.
* Developing an in-depth understanding of the customer profile and align the program’s offerings to their career aspirations.
* Handling objections, provide solutions, and negotiate program fees to close sales and generate revenue.
* Consistently achieving weekly and monthly sales targets while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Building and nurturing a strong sales pipeline, managing prospects effectively through the entire sales cycle.
* Staying up-to-date with the program’s developments and sales techniques to continuously exceed targets.
* Building relationships with key decision-makers to ensure a seamless sales process.

**Ideal candidate will have**

* Proven experience in inside sales, Admission Counselor, particularly in a B2C environment.
* Strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Experience working with professionals, with an understanding of their learning needs and career aspirations.
* Knowledge of sales tools (CRM systems) to track leads and manage the sales pipeline.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and the regional language(s).
* Ability to build trust and rapport with working professionals.
* Highly enthusiastic and motivated to work towards achieving and exceeding targets.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and results-oriented environment.
* Confident with strong presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
* Willingness to work six days a week.

The role encompasses electromagnetic and thermal design evaluation, inverter hardware/software testing, control loop tuning (FOC, Closed loop control like DTC, MPC), analog/digital circuits (Encoder, resolver, Solenoids & Switches). Further integration with, often focusing on system-level functionality, testing. Motor-controller drive calibration, and seamless electromechanical integration into hybrid vehicle architectures.

Key Responsibilities
:**

**A. Powertrain & Drive System Design & Prototype Development**

* **System Design & Execution:**
  Lead end-to-end NPD activities for Hybrid Powertrain assemblies, including traction motor sizing, controller selection, and high-voltage (HV) architecture design.
* **Traction Motor & Inverter Integration:**
  Co-design and validate PMSM/SRM traction motors along with SiC/IGBT-based power drives like Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter.
* **BOM & Technical Documentation:**
  Prepare comprehensive Bills of Materials (BOM), Process Flow Diagrams (PFD), Control Plans, and DFMEA/PFMEA for hybrid drive systems.
* **Drawings & Design Review:**
  Review mechanical CAD models, PCB Schematic design & drawings, busbars, PCB layouts, and 2D blueprints with GD&T for high-speed motor and inverter assemblies.
* **Prototype Fabrication & Debugging:**
  Oversee functional prototype builds, dyno testing, drive-cycle simulation, and perform root cause analysis on drive/motor operational failures with error rectification / troubleshooting.

**B. Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) & Compliance**

* **Quality Frameworks:**
  Drive APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) for all new electro-mechanical and electronic components.
* **Audits & Process Validation:**
  Conduct regular supplier facility audits (process and system audits) to ensure adherence to ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 standards and assess manufacturing capabilities for precision components like encoders, resolvers, and actuators.
* **Defect Management & Resolution:**
  Lead root cause analysis for any supplier-related quality issues using methodologies like 8D, Fishbone, and 5-Why. Implement and verify Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

**C. Drive Testing, Calibration & Vehicle Integration**

* **Bench & Dyno Validation:**
  Define and execute test protocols on motor dynos for Torque-Speed curves, efficiency mapping, field weakening, thermal rise, and short-circuit response.
* **Controller Tuning & Calibration:**
  Perform drive tuning using Field-Oriented Control (FOC), Space Vector PWM (SVPWM), position sensor (Resolver/Encoder) calibration, and fault diagnostic routines.
* **Vehicle System Integration:**
  Validate powertrain integration with ICE/hybrid gearboxes, Vehicle Control Units (VCU), Battery Management Systems (BMS), and vehicle CAN/CAN-FD communication networks.
* **HIL & Environmental Testing:**
  Oversee Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, vibration, thermal shock, ingress protection (IP67/IP6K9K), and EMI/EMC compliance testing.

Qualification Requirements:**

* **Education & Qualification: B.Tech/B.E.**
  in Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Instrumentation / Mechatronics.
* **M.E. / M.Tech**
  in Power Electronics, Drives, Electrical Machines, or Hybrid Electric Vehicle Technology is an added advantage

**6.)
Technical Skills:**

* **Traction Motors & Drives:**
  In-depth understanding of PMSM,  SRM motor topologies, winding designs (hairpin/distributed), magnetic circuits, and high-voltage inverter architectures.
* **Power Electronics & Control:**
  Deep technical knowledge of SiC/IGBT power modules, gate driver circuits, field-oriented control (FOC), Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter and resolver-to-digital conversion.
* **Simulation & Development Tools:**
  Hands-on experience with ANSYS Maxwell / Motor-CAD, MATLAB / Simulink, PSpice/LTspice, and FEA tools.

**Company Description**
Eyemantra Eye Hospital is a leading multi-specialty eye care provider in North India, offering high-quality vision care across four state-of-the-art branches in Delhi. **Qualifications**

* Completed MBBS and MS/MD/DNB in Ophthalmology (or equivalent), with eligibility for fellowship training.

* Ability to use modern ophthalmic diagnostic equipment (e.g., slit lamp, OCT, fundus camera, perimetry) and interpret clinical findings accurately.

* Commitment to ethical, patient-centered care, adherence to clinical protocols, and maintenance of high safety and quality standards.
* Interest in academic growth, participation in clinical research, case presentations, and continuous professional development.
* Flexibility to work in a fast-paced hospital environment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage a varied clinical workload.
* Proficiency in English and local languages used in Delhi is an advantage.

PMP Certification and experience in Salesforce

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with more than 10,000 entrepreneurial, action- and results-oriented professionals across over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. Our culture values independent thinkers and doers who create meaningful impact for clients and shape the consulting industry. A&M offers a collaborative environment and engaging work grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. The organization values practical execution, thoughtful partnership, and high standards of professional conduct. Teams work across functions and geographies to deliver client outcomes, while empowering people to take ownership and contribute ideas. This role supports the Valuations team and partners closely with a London-based Managing Director, making reliability, discretion, responsiveness, and strong cross-border coordination essential to the way work gets done.

**About the Role**

This is a pure Executive Assistant role with an expanded operations mandate supporting a London-based Managing Director in the Valuations team. You will own complex executive coordination while also managing project administration, client onboarding, billing support, and cross-functional follow-through. The key differentiator from a generic EA role is hands-on experience with project billing and client or project coordination, including new client onboarding and MD-level support. You will create operating rhythm across calendars, meetings, project codes, conflict checks, documentation, invoices, expenses, travel, events, and deliverables. Success means the Managing Director and team can focus on clients because priorities are organized, project information is accurate, billing processes move on time, and stakeholders receive clear communication. The role requires Gurgaon-based onsite collaboration and dependable overlap with London working hours until 11 PM IST.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own complex calendars, meetings, agendas, logistics, correspondence, presentations, reports, and follow-ups for a London-based Managing Director, protecting priorities and improving executive decision readiness.
* Coordinate new client onboarding by submitting project-code and conflict-check requests, reviewing outcomes, escalating issues, and ensuring required records are complete before work progresses.
* Maintain project folders, documentation, and compliance standards; perform periodic audits so Valuations teams can locate accurate information and meet organizational governance expectations.
* Track project milestones, deadlines, actions, and deliverables across internal teams, creating visibility and timely escalation that keeps client and business commitments on course.
* Support project billing by drafting client invoices, coordinating invoice processing, entering time and expenses, resolving Finance queries, and supporting budget tracking and reconciliation accurately.
* Arrange domestic and international travel, visas, itineraries, leadership meetings, workshops, and events, reducing logistical friction for executives, teams, clients, and external participants.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, IT, Marketing, Legal, clients, vendors, and business partners while supporting presentations, marketing materials, client documents, and special projects.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Demonstrated project billing and client or project coordination experience is non-negotiable, including new client onboarding, project administration, invoicing support, and MD-level executive support.
* Strong executive administration, calendar management, stakeholder coordination, communication, organization, discretion, and prioritization skills are essential for managing competing global demands under pressure.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams, with Salesforce strongly preferred; familiarity with Concur, Box, or similar business systems is valuable.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience in a Big Four firm, MBB, or another professional services organization is strongly preferred because the role requires familiarity with senior client-facing and project-based operating environments.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders across multiple time zones, particularly London-based leaders, will help maintain dependable communication and execution through the required late-hour overlap.
* Exposure to process improvement, project folder audits, conflict checks, budget tracking, event coordination, and marketing or business development support will strengthen effectiveness in the role.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring 7–10 years of experience in executive assistance, administrative support, or business operations, ideally from a Big Four firm, MBB, or another professional services organization. You have supported senior executives and global stakeholders across multiple time zones, and you understand how to manage high-volume priorities without losing accuracy or discretion.
* Crucially, you have hands-on project billing and client or project coordination experience, including new client onboarding, project codes, conflict checks, invoice support, and follow-through with Finance. You are highly organized, proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable operating independently while collaborating across functions.
* Your communication is clear, polished, and service-oriented, whether working with a Managing Director, client, vendor, or internal team. You bring strong calendar management, travel coordination, presentation preparation, documentation, and meeting-management capabilities.
* You are confident using Microsoft Office and preferably Salesforce, with the adaptability to learn tools such as Concur, Box, or comparable applications. You maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and composure under pressure, and you are willing to work onsite in Gurgaon with overlap until 11 PM IST.

**Why Join Us**

* Support a senior leader and the Valuations team in a global consulting environment where disciplined coordination directly improves client delivery, commercial administration, and executive effectiveness.
* Build a broader operations career while remaining anchored in executive assistance, gaining exposure to onboarding, billing, project governance, stakeholder management, events, and business support.
* Work with entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals across an international firm that values independent ownership, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and meaningful client impact.

**What We Offer**

* A high-visibility opportunity to partner with a London-based Managing Director and support a globally connected Valuations team from Gurgaon.
* A role combining executive support with project coordination, client onboarding, billing, stakeholder management, and operational improvement, offering meaningful scope beyond a generic EA position.
* Exposure to a collaborative professional services environment guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity.
* The opportunity to work with international stakeholders and develop expertise across executive operations, project administration, financial coordination, and business support.

title: Senior Manager, Expert Services
description:
**Job Description – Senior Manager, Construction Expert Services**
Kroll’s Expert Services practice provides economic damages, shareholder disputes, forensic accounting, valuation, and other financial and investigative services to attorneys and companies involved in litigation, among other forms of disputes and investigations. We’re looking for a Senior Manager to support our Expert Services team. You will work on engagements related to financial securities matters, economic damages analyses, forensic accounting matters, investigative services, and other dispute consulting.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead complex delay analysis, disruption, and construction claims engagements on major infrastructure and capital projects.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or a related discipline.

* Excellent analytical, report writing, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to manage client relationships and lead project teams.
* Strong commercial awareness and business development capability.
* Professional certifications such as PSP, PMP, MRICS/FRICS, CFCC, or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

**About Kroll-**
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity—not just answers—in all areas of business. We embrace diverse backgrounds and global perspectives, and we cultivate diversity by respecting, including, and valuing one another. As part of One team, One Kroll, you’ll contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
In courts and international tribunals worldwide, Kroll's experts help businesses, investors and legal advisers establish facts, determine values and settle critical questions. We provide credible analysis, robust valuations and familiarity with all legal and arbitration procedures and venues. Our professionals bring expertise from a wide range of industries, including construction and infrastructure; energy and mining; financial services; healthcare; retail; and technology, telecoms and media. We also help businesses anticipate project problems, protect their IP, prevent fraud, handle investigations, maintain compliance and deliver the world’s most challenging projects.
  
  
At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients’ most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
  
  
In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.

title: Senior Leadership Role – Energy Transition & Industry Transformation
description: 1. POSITION VACANT: Senior Leadership Role – Energy Transition & Industry Transformation, New Delhi2. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW:The organisation is a leading national institution in India’s industry and policy ecosystem, working at the intersection of business, public policy, knowledge and capability development. It works closely with business leaders, Government, academia, research institutions and international partners to promote industrial growth, competitiveness, innovation and sustainable economic development. With a long-standing presence in India’s economic and industrial landscape, the organisation contributes to shaping policy, strengthening industry capabilities and facilitating platforms for collaboration and knowledge exchange.Within this broader mandate, the organisation’s energy-transition portfolio spans clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, energy security, carbon markets, green fuels, transition finance, emerging technologies, research, knowledge exchange and industry capability development.3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:The senior leader will provide strategic leadership to a major national energy-transition portfolio, helping energy companies and energy-intensive industries respond to the policy, regulatory, technology, investment and competitiveness challenges created by a rapidly changing energy landscape. The role requires a grounded understanding of industry and the ability to translate transition needs into practical interventions across policy, technology adoption, investment readiness, knowledge, partnerships and sector capability.The ideal candidate will be a grounded, highly credible energy-transition leader who understands industry realities, is trusted by senior business and Government stakeholders, can engage regulators and financial institutions constructively, and can convert transition challenges into practical solutions. The role also offers the opportunity to build and lead an overarching energy-transition knowledge, innovation and capability platform, with specialist or thematic initiatives developed in response to evolving industry priorities.The role is expected to cover the full energy-transition agenda.Key Responsibilities:(A) Industry Transition Readiness & Transformation:(1) Maintain a close understanding of the policy, regulatory, technology, investment and market challenges facing energy companies and energy-intensive industries and use these insights to shape the organisation’s priorities and interventions;(2) Design initiatives that help industry strengthen transition readiness, energy productivity, decarbonisation pathways, resilience and long-term competitiveness;(3) Accelerate industry awareness, evaluation and adoption of relevant clean-energy, efficiency, low-carbon and emerging technologies, financing approaches and business models;(4) Support enterprises in learning from leading national and international transition pathways and in navigating evolving standards, markets, regulations and investment requirements.(B) Policy Engagement & Government Advisory:(1) Set and lead the energy-transition policy agenda, identifying key policy, regulatory and market priorities shaping India’s energy transformation;(2) Engage at senior levels with Union Ministries, Government institutions, regulators and policy bodies on clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, energy security, carbon markets, green fuels, transition finance and related priorities;(3) Lead preparation of evidence-based policy recommendations, position papers, consultation responses and policy inputs to Government, grounded in research and stakeholder perspectives;(4) Anchor high-level dialogue between industry and Government on strategic energy-transition priorities and facilitate collaborative approaches to emerging challenges.(C) Energy Transition Knowledge, Innovation & Capability Platforms:(1) Lead the development and strategic direction of an overarching energy-transition platform dedicated to knowledge, innovation and capability-building, with flexibility to develop specialist or thematic initiatives under it based on emerging industry priorities;(2) Define the platform’s strategic focus, programme architecture, operating model, team and expert network, and position it as an authoritative national vehicle for industry-transition knowledge and capability;(3) Curate and disseminate national and international best practices, benchmarking, transition pathways, emerging technologies, innovations, financing models and new business approaches relevant to Indian industry;(4) Build partnerships with leading companies, technology providers, research institutions, academia, financial institutions and international centres of expertise to bring cutting-edge knowledge and solutions to industry;(5) Translate knowledge into action through pilots, capability-building, advisory initiatives, benchmarking, transition tools and other scalable interventions;(6) Build a sustainable portfolio of programmes, partnerships and revenue streams that secures the long-term institutional and financial viability of the platform and its initiatives.(D) Research, Insight & Thought Leadership:(1) Lead the energy-transition research and knowledge agenda, including sector studies, surveys, policy briefs, white papers and analyses on technology, markets, investment and implications for Indian industry;(2) Develop thought leadership on clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, green hydrogen, sustainable fuels, carbon markets, transition finance, energy security and other emerging themes;(3) Build research and knowledge partnerships with think tanks, academic institutions, technology organisations, financial institutions and international partners;(4) Position the organisation as an authoritative national voice on competitive, resilient and sustainable energy transition.(E) Industry Convening & Strategic Partnerships:(1) Conceptualise and lead flagship national and international convenings on energy transition, including leadership forums, conferences, summits and roundtables, and curate their agendas with business, Government, regulatory, technology and financial stakeholders;(2) Ensure high-quality programme management and execution of large-scale engagements, including coordination with stakeholders, speakers and partners;(3) Build strong, trusted relationships with energy companies, energy-intensive industries, technology providers, financial institutions, regulators and relevant sector organisations;(4) Facilitate structured consultations that convert sector perspectives into actionable policy, programme and knowledge priorities;(5) Build strategic partnerships with national and international institutions that strengthen the energy-transition agenda and facilitate knowledge, technology and investment exchange.(F) Team Leadership & Portfolio Delivery:(1) Steer senior industry advisory groups, expert forums, strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives with clear priorities, accountabilities and outcomes;(2) Guide internal teams in executing research, policy engagement, industry programmes, publications, consultations and flagship platforms, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery;(3) Build, lead and develop a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team with strong sector capability, accountability and execution discipline;(4) Strengthen the organisation’s institutional engagement with industry, Government, regulators and national/international partners.(G) Financial Leadership & Resource Mobilisation:(1) Share accountability with senior leadership for the financial performance and P&L of the energy-transition portfolio;(2) Develop and implement an annual revenue and resource-mobilisation plan aligned with portfolio priorities and emerging opportunities in the energy-transition ecosystem;(3) Build a diversified pipeline of programmes, projects, partnerships, research and knowledge initiatives that provides predictable, multi-year revenue visibility;(4) Prepare business cases, budgets and financial projections for significant initiatives, and oversee contribution margins, receivables, cost discipline and efficient use of resources;(5) Monitor financial performance closely, identify potential shortfalls early and initiate timely corrective action;(6) Balance financial sustainability with the quality, independence and credibility of policy, research and stakeholder-facing work.4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:Qualifications:Master’s degree in Energy, Engineering, Economics, Public Policy or a related discipline from a reputed institution.Experience:(1) Minimum 20+ years of professional experience in energy, energy transition, industry, consulting, policy or related domains, with substantial senior leadership responsibility;(2) Senior leadership experience in industry, energy businesses, consulting, policy or knowledge institutions, or comparable organisations will be preferred;(3) Demonstrated depth of engagement with energy and/or energy-intensive industries and strong understanding of the commercial, regulatory, technology, investment and competitiveness challenges associated with the transition;(4) Proven experience engaging senior Government stakeholders, regulators, industry leaders, financial institutions and multi-stakeholder platforms;(5) Demonstrated ability to lead high-impact programmes, research/knowledge initiatives, industry platforms and large teams;(6) Experience building or scaling an institutional platform, business unit, centre, practice or comparable initiative will be strongly valued, particularly where it involved technology/innovation, knowledge partnerships and financial sustainability.Skills and Competencies:(1) Grounded sector judgement, strategic thinking, policy analysis and broad energy-transition perspective;(2) Government, regulatory and industry engagement;(3) CEO-level stakeholder management, convening and relationship building;(4) Thought leadership, research and knowledge development;(5) Institution building, technology/innovation orientation and global perspective;(6) Business development, financial acumen and resource mobilisation;(7) Strategic communication, influencing and public speaking;(8) Team leadership, development and performance management;(9) Collaboration, partnership building and execution orientation.5. COMPENSATION OFFERED:Annual salary for the role is attractive and aligned to market rates. The offer made to the selected candidate will be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.6. LOCATION: New DelhiThe role will involve regular travel, as required for industry engagement, stakeholder interactions and key programmes and initiatives.7. REFERENCE: SL-ET-CONF8. CONTACT INFORMATION:Team SAMSStrategic Alliance Management Services P Ltd.1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat NagarNew Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025Phone Nos.: 011-4081 9900; 4165 36129. APPLICATION PROCESS:Eligible candidates interested in the position are requested to apply through the SAMS recruitment platform using the link below by the prescribed closing date. All applications and enquiries will be handled on a strictly confidential basis. The precise designation and identity of the hiring institution will be disclosed to selected candidates at an appropriate stage of the process.Application Link: https://www.samsstc.com/Jobs/job-description/senior-leadership-role-energy-transition-industry-transformation-confidential-new-delhi-delhi/861
