title: Trainee Captain
description:
**Location:**
 Lodhi Colony, New Delhi

**Experience:**
 2–4 Years

**Department:**
 Food & Beverage / Front of House

**About The Frame**

The Frame is a distinctive dining destination in Lodhi Art District, where food, art, and storytelling come together to create a memorable hospitality experience. As we build our pre-opening team, we are looking for hospitality professionals who bring refined service skills, strong product knowledge, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a skilled and guest-focused 
**Trainee Captain**
 to oversee service within an assigned section of the restaurant. The ideal candidate should have experience in fine-dining service, a sound understanding of wines and alcoholic beverages, and the ability to guide the service team while ensuring a seamless and personalised dining experience.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Oversee service within the assigned section, ensuring efficient, attentive, and professional guest service.
* Welcome guests, understand their preferences, and provide personalised recommendations based on menu and beverage offerings.
* Demonstrate sound knowledge of wines, spirits, liqueurs, and other alcoholic beverages, including their characteristics, serving methods, and food-pairing principles.
* Assist guests with wine and beverage selections and confidently explain relevant options from the menu.
* Ensure the correct presentation and service of wine and alcoholic beverages, including appropriate glassware, serving temperatures, and service etiquette.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and bar teams to ensure timely order execution and a smooth dining experience.
* Guide and coordinate with servers and assistant servers to maintain service standards and efficient floor operations.
* Ensure tables are properly set, service stations are organised, and the assigned section is prepared before service.
* Handle guest requests, feedback, and service-related concerns with professionalism and discretion.
* Ensure compliance with restaurant SOPs, hygiene standards, grooming guidelines, and responsible alcohol-service practices.
* Support the Restaurant Manager in maintaining service quality, team coordination, and smooth day-to-day operations.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 2–4 years of experience in Food & Beverage service, preferably in a fine-dining restaurant, luxury hotel, or premium hospitality establishment.
* Previous experience managing an assigned section and coordinating service staff.
* Good working knowledge of wines, spirits, liqueurs, and other alcoholic beverages is essential.
* Understanding of wine varieties, grape varietals, basic wine regions, food and wine pairing, and appropriate serving techniques.
* Familiarity with beverage presentation, glassware, serving temperatures, and fine-dining service etiquette.
* Strong communication and guest-engagement skills, with the ability to make informed food and beverage recommendations.
* Professional grooming, attention to detail, and the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced dining environment.
* A proactive approach to teamwork, problem-solving, and delivering high service standards.

**What You Can Expect at The Frame**

* The opportunity to contribute to the pre-opening journey of a distinctive dining destination.
* Exposure to premium dining, refined service standards, and curated food and beverage offerings.
* Opportunities to strengthen wine knowledge, beverage service, guest engagement, and floor management skills.
* A collaborative environment that values professionalism, accountability, and continuous development.

title: Tele calling
description:
**Company Description**
FlyWings Simulator Training Centre Limited (FWSTC) is India’s most advanced aviation training institute, specializing in Safety and Emergency Procedures (SEP) for cabin and cockpit crew. Headquartered in Gurgaon, FWSTC designs training programs that align with airline regulatory standards and real-world operational requirements. The institute serves leading domestic airlines, selected non-scheduled operators, and regional international carriers as a B2B training partner, while also offering B2C programs for aviation and hospitality aspirants. Its broader portfolio covers aviation fundamentals, in-flight services, basic first aid, passenger handling, grooming, personality development, and voice and accent refinement. FWSTC’s training philosophy is driven by world-class infrastructure, experienced faculty, and close engagement with aviation professionals to promote safety, service excellence, and operational readiness.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Telecalling role based in Dwarka. The Telecaller will be responsible for making outbound calls to prospective students and corporate clients, introducing FWSTC’s training programs, and explaining course features, schedules, and fees. The role includes responding to incoming inquiries, maintaining call logs and lead records, and following up regularly to convert leads into enrollments or corporate training engagements. The Telecaller will coordinate with the admissions and training teams to schedule counseling sessions, share program information, and support smooth onboarding of participants. Daily responsibilities also involve meeting call and conversion targets, updating CRM or lead management tools, and providing feedback on common questions or market trends to improve communication and outreach strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication skills, including clear spoken English and Hindi, active listening, and polite telephone etiquette.
* Customer service and relationship-building skills to handle inquiries, address concerns, and maintain a positive caller experience.
* Basic sales and persuasion abilities, including lead qualification, follow-up discipline, and enrollment or booking conversion.
* Comfort with telecalling tools, CRM or lead tracking software, and basic computer applications (MS Office, email, online forms).
* Ability to work in a target-driven environment, manage time effectively, and prioritize follow-ups and scheduled calls.
* Previous experience in telecalling, inside sales, counseling, or call center operations, preferably in education, training, or services, is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred.
* Professional demeanor, reliability, and willingness to learn about aviation training programs and industry terminology.

title: High-Ticket Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist
description:
**Company:**
Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI)

**Industry:**
Business Coaching | Consulting | Fitness Entrepreneurship

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Remote – India

**Compensation:**
Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives

**Experience Required:**
1–3 Years (Relevant Experience Preferred)

About FBCI

Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI) is a premium business coaching and consulting company that helps fitness coaches, nutritionists, and health professionals build, grow, and scale profitable online coaching businesses.

We help entrepreneurs improve their client acquisition, sales processes, marketing strategies, business positioning, and operational systems.

Our mentorship programs range from ₹90,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

As we expand, we're looking for a highly motivated and communication-driven
**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist**
to join our sales team.

Important: This Is NOT a Traditional Telecalling Job

We are not hiring someone to simply make calls, read scripts, or fill our sales team's calendar.

**Your primary responsibility is to pre-qualify every incoming lead before they are connected with our sales department.**

You'll speak with fitness coaches and business owners, understand their current situation, identify their challenges, assess their investment readiness, and determine whether they're a suitable fit for our premium mentorship programs.

You must be someone who
**genuinely loves talking to people, enjoys understanding their problems, and is passionate about helping them find the right solutions.**

This role requires strong communication skills, business understanding, patience, persistence, and excellent follow-up discipline.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification**

* Contact incoming leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct structured pre-qualification conversations.
* Understand prospects' current monthly revenue, business challenges, goals, and growth expectations.
* Assess their financial readiness and ability to invest in premium mentorship programs.
* Identify serious prospects who are genuinely interested in growing their businesses.
* Ensure only qualified leads are forwarded to the sales department.

**2. Appointment Setting**

* Book strategy consultations with the sales team for qualified prospects.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and expectations of the consultation.
* Coordinate appointment timings and ensure proper scheduling.
* Confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates.

**3. Follow-Ups & Relationship Building**

* Conduct multiple follow-ups with prospects through calls and WhatsApp.
* Maintain consistent communication with interested leads.
* Re-engage prospects who haven't responded or booked their consultations.
* Build genuine relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to poor follow-up.

**4. CRM & Sales Coordination**

* Maintain accurate lead information and conversation notes in the CRM.
* Update lead statuses, qualification details, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales closers to ensure smooth handovers.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, appointment bookings, and follow-up performance.

Who We're Looking For

* Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong listening, questioning, and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, or a similar role.
* Comfortable making multiple calls and follow-ups daily.
* Ability to understand business problems and ask intelligent questions.
* Confident discussing revenue, business growth, and premium investments with entrepreneurs.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Comfortable using CRM software, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Preferred:**
Experience in business coaching, consulting, premium mentorship, digital marketing agencies, or high-ticket service businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured by:

* Lead response time
* Number of leads contacted and qualified
* Qualified appointments booked
* Appointment show-up rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Quality of appointments passed to the sales team
* CRM accuracy and lead management
* Contribution to overall sales conversions

**We value qualified appointments over the total number of appointments booked.**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Someone looking for a basic telecalling or scripted calling job.
* Someone who dislikes speaking with people or making follow-up calls.
* Candidates who book appointments without understanding the prospect's needs.
* Individuals who give up after one or two unsuccessful contact attempts.
* Someone who prioritizes quantity over quality.
* Candidates who are uncomfortable with accountability and performance targets.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to work directly with fitness entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Training in business consultation, qualification, and premium sales processes.
* A performance-driven and growth-focused working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Sales Operations, Senior Appointment Setting, and Sales Leadership.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with answers to these questions:

1. How much experience do you have in lead qualification or appointment setting?
2. How many leads or calls have you handled daily in your previous role?
3. Have you worked with high-ticket services or premium coaching programs?
4. How do you handle prospects who don't respond after multiple follow-ups?
5. Why do you believe you're a good fit for this role?

Our Hiring Philosophy

**We don't need someone who just makes 100 calls a day.**

We need someone who can turn meaningful conversations into qualified business opportunities.

Someone who listens carefully, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

**At FBCI, your success is not measured by how many appointments you book, but by how many of the right prospects you bring to our sales team.**

If you're a people person who loves conversations, takes ownership, and thrives in a performance-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Apply now and become part of Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI).**

Our work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.
  
  
If you are a motivated and passionate individual who shares our conviction that a better world is possible through improved nutrition, wants to leave the world a little better than they found it, and is looking to be part of a team with a clear vision, we want to hear from you. Please consider applying for the position below which is being advertised for an anticipated project.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Preconception Nutrition and Care project is an exciting new initiative in India. It aims to change how families begin: by reaching couples of reproductive ages with nutrition, health interventions and counselling before pregnancy, so that women enter pregnancy healthier and better nourished. Healthier beginnings lead to better maternal and birth outcomes. The project takes a systems-based approach. It brings together service delivery, evidence generation, learning and government partnership, so that preconception care becomes integrated into overall health system delivery. At the heart of the project is a commitment to putting the nutritional needs of women and couples at the center of design and implementation. The project aims to generate evidence and learning from implementation, and to use it to shape national dialogue on preconception nutrition and care.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Project Director will lead this work from New Delhi. You will head a small, focused team, guide a range of implementing partners and engage with state and national government. You will also be the primary voice of the project with the donor, government, research bodies and the private sector. You will work closely with Nutrition International's Maternal Newborn Health and Nutrition and Health Economics and Nutrition Financing portfolios, as well as colleagues in the Asia Regional Office and headquarters in Ottawa.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-visibility project, with full accountability for results, partnerships and resources. You will help set the direction for how India, and the wider region, approaches nutrition and care before pregnancy.
**In this role you**
**will be responsible to:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for donor/s, national government representatives and strategic partners to lead evidence-based negotiations on project priorities, scope, and deliverables
* Facilitate shared understanding of project scope, goals and deliverables and among project staff, partners and stakeholders
* Guide the implementation of project activities and ensure project staff and partners are executing the project according to the approved project plan
* Manage relations with partners, service providers and consultants of the project, according to Nutrition International's policies. This includes the development of terms of reference, service provided and consultant/firm selection, contracting, monitoring and end of contract processes
* Oversee and work closely with government stakeholders and partners to develop detailed annual workplans that clearly define the strategies, activities and resources (time, budget and equipment etc.) required for effective implementation of the project; and update workplans regularly to ensure the timely completion of activities and achievement of the deliverables
* Cultivate and manage strong, collaborative relationships with implementing partners, government authorities, donors and other key stakeholders. Ensure open communication channels and a shared understanding of the project's goals, responsibilities, and timelines
* Identify and engage with potential new partners that align with the project's objectives, ensuring their capacities complement the project's needs and strategies
* Ensure monitoring and learning strategies and systems are applied within the project in collaboration with the Monitoring, Data and Learning sub-unit
* Ensure a monitoring plan is developed and followed by the project team and partners. Ensure monitoring data is analyzed and used for course correction as needed
* Ensure that the project has a comprehensive staffing strategy with the appropriate composition of team members to ensure adequate oversight and quality assurance of all work within the project
* Manage project staff contracts and consultants in a timely manner and according to local legislation and Nutrition International policies
* Provide financial oversight for the full scope of the project. Maintain oversight on all sub-grants within the project and their associated budget(s) and ensure that partners establish appropriate financial procedures and tools required to be in alignment with Nutrition International requirements and standards
* Develop regular cash flow projections and monitor expenditure and review variance analysis to ensure the project operates within its budget parameters
* Ensure all project funds are managed according to established accounting policies, procedures and donor regulations
* Ensure donor stewardship with our committed donors to sustain relationships. Build and strengthen relationships with key project stakeholders and partners to ensure the project is harmonized with other donors funded project/programs and facilitates government leadership and ownership
* Establish mechanisms for regular communication within the project team, Country leadership and across partners and with Nutrition International leadership to maximize opportunities for program integration and to elevate issues or risks

title: NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator
description:
Location: New Delhi, India
  
  
Reporting to: Kate Fisher, Senior IT Associate
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.
  
  
With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
**About The Role**
The NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro System Administrator will be responsible for maintaining and managing CPI’s NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro environment, ensuring that project and resource data remain accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with organizational standards. This role will provide day-to-day system support, manage user access and configuration, and work closely with Operations, Finance, and IT teams to ensure smooth system adoption across the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, enjoys working with data and systems, and has a strong service mindset to support staff queries and drive efficient system usage.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage and maintain the NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro (Formerly Net Suite OpenAir) system, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
* Configure, test, and update system settings, workflows, and permissions as required.
* Provide first-line user support, resolving issues and queries in collaboration with the Operations and IT teams.
* Monitor and maintain project, resource, and timesheet data, ensuring consistency across departments.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics to support operational decision-making.
* Coordinate with the vendor (Xero/Oracle NetSuite/OpenAir) for upgrades, enhancements, and troubleshooting.
* Managing large data imports and updates manually and via integration manager.
* Manage a SuiteProjects pro system where financial data is not held in NetSuite and integrates with CPI’s
* Conduct user training and onboarding sessions, ensuring consistent use of the platform.
* Create and maintain management processes in the system including data checking and validation.
* Create and maintain system documentation, SOPs, and data dictionaries.
* Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience.

About You: Competencies and Experience
  
  

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science/IT systems Management and/or Business Administration, Engineering, and/or relevant certifications or professional experience.
* Overall, 6 years of relevant experience in system administration or operations roles with ERP, PSA, or project management tools such as NetSuite Suite Projects Pro, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
* Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and workflow configuration.
* Strong Excel skills particularly for data transformation, cleaning and validation, including formulas, text formulas, XLookup and pivot tables.
* Experience working in small set up and managing projects independently with limited supervision.
* Experience working in multi-country or global organizations preferred.
* Experience creating documentation, and training users in IT Systems and processes.
* Familiarity with reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) is a plus.

About You: Personal Attributes
  
  

* Confidence to engage with a wide range of stakeholders and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
* Excellent organizational skills and a proactive, organized, and innovative approach to problem solving.
* Customer-service orientation with the ability to manage queries efficiently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Position Details
  
  
CPI is recruiting for one full-time position of NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator (40 hours) to be based in our New Delhi office.
  
  
CPI India has adopted a flexible working policy whereby staff are able to mix working remotely with days in the office.
  
  
CPI offers an excellent and competitive compensation and benefits package.
  
  
Applicants must be eligible to work in India – we are unfortunately unable to offer any visa sponsorship for this role.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
As part of your application please upload your resume and cover letter, both documents must be submitted in English and respond to the application questions by Monday, November 2, 2026.
  
  
We do not recommend the use of AI to complete your application.
  
  
Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, so we encourage applicants to submit at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.
  
  
Please be sure to add notifications@app.bamboohr.com to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.

title: GSPANN - SAP BTP Consultant

GSPANN is hiring an SAP Business Technology Platform Consultant to manage end-to-end SAP BTP administration, security, and integrations across cloud and hybrid environments. * Build integrations in SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration, API Management, and event-based flows.
* Optimize SAP Extension Suite and application extensions on SAP BTP.
* Manage SAP HANA Cloud provisioning, access control, and connectivity.
* Ensure system health, compliance, and security tracking via Alert Notification Service and Audit Logs.
* Design cloud networking and security configurations, including destinations, trust setups, and secure communication channels.
* Collaborate with functional, development, and BASIS teams to support hybrid (on-premise plus cloud) SAP landscapes.
* Lead troubleshooting of BTP-related issues and coordinate with SAP support where required.
* Drive compliance with organizational security, governance, and best practices.

**Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of hands-on SAP BTP administration experience.
* Any experience with DRC tenant is desirable.
* Holding SAP BTP or cloud-related certifications would be an advantage.
* Apply expertise to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps concepts on SAP BTP.
* Demonstrate strong expertise in SAP BTP Cockpit and sub-account configuration.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector, IAS, IPS, and core security concepts.
* Work with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, REST APIs, APIM, and OpenID Connect for authentication and integration.
* Develop in SAP cloud services across Integration Suite, Extension Suite, and SAP HANA Cloud.
* Demonstrate solid understanding of SAP landscape architecture and hybrid integration patterns.
* Utilize monitoring tools, audit logs, and alerting mechanisms across SAP BTP.
* Manage coordination with firewall and network teams for firewall openings and secure routing.
* Apply knowledge of setting up trust connections and destinations across SAP BTP.
* Demonstrate strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

description: We are looking for a highly driven, performance-obsessed Lead Creative Strategist to own our entire creative ecosystem, from social media and content strategy to performance marketing creatives, creative testing, and scaling winning concepts.This is not a conventional social media role. We are looking for someone who understands that creative is one of the biggest drivers of paid marketing performance and knows how to turn consumer insights, cultural trends, product USPs, and performance data into creatives that convert.You will own the creative process end to end: identifying opportunities, developing concepts, building creative briefs, directing shoots, producing and editing content, analysing ad performance, identifying winning and losing creatives, and continuously feeding those insights back into the next round of creative production.Your mandate is to build a creative engine capable of developing, testing, and iterating on 50–100 creative assets per week, depending on production complexity, with a strong emphasis on speed, quality, learning, and performance.You should be equally comfortable thinking strategically, getting your hands dirty with execution, analysing Meta Ads performance, and making decisive calls on what to scale, what to iterate, and what to stop.We need someone who thrives in an intense, fast-paced, high-energy environment, takes complete ownership of outcomes, and can move from an idea to a live creative without unnecessary layers of management.The goal is simple: build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces high-performing content, improves customer acquisition efficiency, and drives profitable growth.1. End-to-End Performance Creative StrategyYou will own the strategy behind every creative we produce for paid acquisition, retargeting, organic social, and brand-building campaigns.Develop a comprehensive performance creative strategy aligned with business objectives, revenue targets, CAC goals, ROAS, and conversion rates.Identify the creative angles, messaging, formats, hooks, and visual approaches most likely to resonate with our target audience.Translate product features, benefits, ingredients, fragrances, differentiators, and consumer pain points into compelling advertising narratives.Develop creative concepts across UGC, founder-led content, product demonstrations, testimonials, problem-solution ads, educational content, product comparisons, lifestyle content, and aspirational brand storytelling.Build a systematic approach to testing different hooks, scripts, opening frames, CTAs, offers, formats, lengths, and storytelling structures.Ensure every creative has a clear hypothesis, audience, objective, and reason to exist.Develop creative strategies for prospecting, retargeting, customer acquisition, new product launches, and seasonal campaigns.Understand the relationship between creative performance, audience intent, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.2. Build and Operate a High-Velocity Creative EngineBuild and manage a creative production pipeline capable of delivering approximately 50–100 creative assets per week, including variations, iterations, and new concepts.Establish a structured weekly workflow covering research, ideation, scripting, production, editing, approvals, deployment, analysis, and iteration.Develop creative calendars and production schedules that keep the team consistently ahead of upcoming campaign requirements.Turn a small number of strong concepts into multiple meaningful variations without relying on superficial changes alone.Create systems for generating new hooks, angles, scripts, storyboards, headlines, visual treatments, and ad variations at scale.Maintain an organised creative library with naming conventions, campaign tags, concept IDs, performance history, and learnings.Build a continuous feedback loop between paid marketing results and the creative production pipeline.Reduce production bottlenecks and unnecessary approval cycles while maintaining brand quality.Establish standard operating procedures, creative templates, briefing formats, and testing frameworks that allow output to scale without compromising learning quality.3. Continuous Testing, Iteration and ScalingDesign and maintain a structured creative testing roadmap.Develop clear hypotheses for each new concept and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, learning potential, and production effort.Run controlled tests wherever practical to understand which creative variables are driving performance.Develop multiple iterations of promising concepts, exploring new hooks, openings, scripts, creators, visual formats, product demonstrations, and messaging angles.Distinguish between testing a new concept and testing a variation of an existing winner.Identify repeatable creative patterns and turn them into scalable creative frameworks.Refresh creatives proactively when performance shows signs of fatigue.Maintain a healthy pipeline of new concepts so growth does not depend on a small number of winning ads.Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful tests to prevent repeated mistakes.Work closely with the performance marketing team to align creative testing with campaign structure, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.5. Creative Production, Shoots and Content ExecutionWrite scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, shot lists, storyboards, and detailed creative briefs.Plan and direct product shoots, UGC shoots, creator collaborations, founder-led content, and campaign productions.Brief and manage creators, editors, designers, photographers, videographers, and production partners.Ensure that shoots are planned efficiently to generate a high volume of usable assets from each production day.Identify opportunities to capture multiple concepts, formats, hooks, and variations in a single shoot.Review edits and provide precise, actionable feedback on pacing, storytelling, visual hierarchy, opening frames, subtitles, product visibility, and CTAs.Use tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, or AI-assisted creative tools to create or refine assets when needed.Maintain a high standard of execution across both rapid-turnaround performance ads and more polished brand content.Manage production timelines, asset delivery, and creative quality control.6. opportunities.Develop a structured repository of competitor references, creative inspiration, hooks, scripts, and tested concepts.Identify gaps in the market and develop differentiated creative angles title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Company**

DeHaat, a leading Agri-Tech startup, offers end-to-end solutions to India's farmers using AI technologies. With a presence in 12 states, 18,000+ DeHaat Centers, and 500+ FPOs, we impact 13 million+ farmers. Our AI crop advisory covers 30+ crops in regional languages & we export to 30+ countries. Founded by top institute alumni, DeHaat is fully funded, achieving consecutive
*Great Place to Work certifications*
. Recognized by NASSCOM, Forbes, ET, Niti Aayog, and Bill Gates Foundation, our 13-year journey reflects impactful innovation in the agricultural sector.

**Website:**
https://agrevolution.in/

**Role Overview:**

The Brand Manager – Agri Inputs will conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns for DeHaat’s agri-input portfolio. The role involves close collaboration with business, category, agronomy, and sales teams to drive farmer awareness, retailer engagement, product adoption, and revenue growth. As a brand custodian, the incumbent will translate product benefits and agronomic insights into simple, credible, and locally relevant communication across key touchpoints. The role requires strong project management, agency coordination, and campaign measurement skills, along with a keen understanding of rural markets and farmer needs.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

• Work with the Marketing Head to conceptualize and manage integrated marketing campaigns (ATL/BTL) for DeHaat’s agri-input portfolio, including seeds, crop-protection products, crop nutrition and other relevant offerings.

• Partner with Agri-Inputs business leaders, category teams and field teams to plan and execute campaigns that drive product awareness, farmer adoption, channel engagement and revenue growth.

• Act as a brand custodian, ensuring consistent brand positioning, messaging and communication across product packaging, trade marketing, digital channels, retail touchpoints and on-ground activations.

• Develop farmer- and retailer-focused value propositions by translating product benefits, agronomic use cases and category insights into clear, credible and locally relevant communication.

• Lead end-to-end marketing initiatives across trade, digital, print and on-ground platforms, including dealer/retailer engagement, village-level activations, demonstrations, field days and seasonal campaigns, in collaboration with relevant teams.

• Work seamlessly with internal stakeholders and external creative, media, activation and production agencies to develop campaign assets and deliver high-quality execution within agreed timelines and budgets.

• Coordinate with agronomy, product, sales and field teams to ensure product claims and usage communication are accurate, responsible and aligned with approved recommendations.

• Track campaign effectiveness through relevant metrics such as reach, engagement, leads, retailer participation, product adoption and sales uplift; use primary and secondary research to recommend improvements.

• Monitor agri-input market developments, farmer needs, seasonality, competitor activity and regional communication trends to inform brand strategy and campaign planning.

**Skills/Requirements:**

• A proactive, hands-on professional who works well across cross-functional teams and builds strong relationships with business, sales, product and other stakeholders.

• Experience in brand management and integrated campaign execution, with a good understanding of ATL, BTL, trade marketing, digital, print and on-ground activations.

• Ability to convert product and category information into simple, persuasive communication for farmers, retailers and other channel partners.

• Strong project management, communication and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and measure outcomes.

• Comfortable working in a dynamic, field-oriented environment and embracing ambiguity; willingness to travel to markets and interact with sales teams, retailers and farmers as required.

• An interest in agriculture and rural markets; prior exposure to agri-inputs, FMCG, rural marketing, channel marketing or a distribution-led business will be an advantage.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

• 3–5 years of overall experience, including 2–3 years in brand management or integrated marketing. MBA/PGDM in Marketing. Relevant experience in agri-inputs, rural marketing or farmer-facing categories is desirable

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time About Voice ArenaVoice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.About the roleVoice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.In this role, you willThe work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.In a typical week, you might:Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same dayPlan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research teamBuild a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach themBrief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their postsLook at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's planWhat matters mostEverything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.1. Reaching the right peopleReach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systemsToday a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.What we offerHigh ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.Minimum qualifications2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused companyA track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourselfStrong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart captionComfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on itGenuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluatedHigh ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the detailsPreferred qualificationsYou don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI companyHands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targetingAn existing network among AI researchers, builders or creatorsExperience running creator or influencer campaignsBasic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move fasterWhy join Voice ArenaShape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a brand built on real research: papers at Interspeech 2026, a Hugging Face partnership and benchmarks the field checks.Reach the whole world's speech. Our data and evals reach far beyond English, across the wider Global South, so the audience is global.Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.How to applySend your CV, a short note and links to accounts, posts or campaigns you've grown to amritansh@voicearena.com.

title: Associate Content Manager
description:
**Role snapshot**

You run two things end to end. First, the Instagram personal brands of our founder and core team, from research and scripting to the shoot and a fully programmatic edit. Second, our influencer marketing: finding creators, closing partnerships and keeping them posting about us.

**Title**
:- Associate Content Manager

**Location:**
- Gurgaon, India (onsite, in office)

**Type**
:- Full time

**Platform**
:- Instagram

**You Run:**
- The founder's and core team's Instagram profiles, plus our influencer partners

**Reports**
to:- Head of Marketing

**What you'll doInstagram personal branding**

1. **Research.**
   Track what is working on Instagram every week: formats, hooks, audio, pacing and edit styles. Find the outlier reels in the founder and business niche and bring your next bets to the weekly review, backed by numbers.
2. **Script.**
   Turn founder calls, voice notes, podcasts and Slack threads into tight scripts. Weave in each person's real journey and point of view, land the hook in the first 2 seconds, and keep one idea per reel.
3. **Shoot.**
   Plan and direct talking-head and B-roll shoots in the office: light, mic, framing, and getting the best take from a busy founder in the least time.
4. **Edit in code.**
   Edit every video programmatically with Claude Code, using HyperFrames and Remotion for motion graphics, animation, captions and sound. Build reusable templates so each reel ships faster than the last.
5. **Support the team.**
   Help the founder and core team members with their own production, from prep and shoot setup to the final cut.
6. **Publish and learn.**
   Run the content calendar, get the owner's approval before anything goes live, and post on time. Track retention, shares, saves and follows; double down on what works and kill what does not.

**Influencer marketing**

1. **Outreach.**
   Find and reach out to new influencers whose audience matches ours.
2. **Partnerships.**
   Agree deliverables, timelines and what we give in return, and close the deal in writing.
3. **Coordination.**
   Keep every partner posting about us on schedule, and follow up the day a post slips.
4. **Keep our promises.**
   Make sure every partner gets everything we promised them, on time.
5. **Content for partners.**
   Write their posts and edit their videos when they need it.

**What we're looking for**

1. **Full time, onsite.**
   You work from our Gurgaon office every day. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
2. **Instagram native.**
   You can show reels you made, for yourself or someone else, and explain why each one worked or did not.
3. **Research first.**
   You spot a trend before it peaks and back your opinion with views, retention and follower data.
4. **A storyteller.**
   You can pull a real story out of a founder and shape it into a hook, a turn and a payoff.
5. **Comfortable in code.**
   You already edit with Claude Code, or you learn fast and are happy working in a terminal. Basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript helps.
6. **Organised with partners.**
   You can run many creator relationships at once, track every promise in both directions and follow up without being chased.
7. **A creative eye.**
   You are the last check on quality and you say no to weak creative.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running influencer or creator partnerships
* Hands-on work with Remotion or HyperFrames
* A motion design background (After Effects or similar)
* AI video tools such as Higgsfield
* An Instagram account you grew yourself
* Content for B2B, SaaS or startup founders

📩

description:

Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business-function hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

title: Community Mobilizer
description:
**Company Description**
Why Waste Wednesdays Foundation is a non-profit Section 8 company focused on driving positive environmental change through sustainability and reduced reliance on single-use plastics. The foundation’s mission centers on community engagement and is aligned with UN SDGs 11, 12, 13, and 17, promoting sustainable cities, responsible consumption, climate action, and global partnerships. Its initiatives include programs like Vikalp “Borrow a Bag,” a community crockery bank, the Navjeevan Vihar RRR Centre, and Zero Waste events and models. With registrations including 12A, 80G, CSR-1, MSME, and NITI Aayog, the organization actively collaborates with communities, partners, and supporters to build a greener, cleaner future. Team members are encouraged to contribute to impactful projects that inspire behavior change and long-term sustainability.
  
**Role Description**
The Community Mobilizer is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for engaging local communities to support and scale the foundation’s sustainability initiatives. The role involves coordinating outreach activities, organizing awareness sessions and events, and mobilizing residents, institutions, and partners to participate in programs such as zero waste events, “Borrow a Bag,” and community recycling efforts. The Community Mobilizer will build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, record feedback from participants, and support behavior change campaigns focused on waste management and single-use plastic reduction. Daily tasks include field visits, facilitating community meetings, managing volunteer participation, and collaborating with the internal team to report progress and refine engagement strategies. The role requires regular documentation of activities, timely communication with project leads, and proactive participation in planning new community-based initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* MSW with 1-2 years experience in waste management sector
* Proficiency in MS Office and AI tools
* Candidates should possess strong Interpersonal Skills and Community Engagement abilities to build trust and mobilize diverse groups.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, both verbal and written, to conduct sessions, share information clearly, and prepare basic reports.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Community Management skills to respond to queries, support participants, and maintain active community networks.
* Candidates should have a demonstrated interest in sustainability, waste management, or environmental initiatives and a willingness to work in field-based settings.
* Candidates should have the ability to work collaboratively with teams and volunteers, with good organizational and time-management skills.
* Candidates with prior experience in social work, grassroots campaigns, NGOs, or community-based projects, and a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, will be preferred.

Clinic Pankh also provides Pregnancy Ultrasound, Follicular Monitoring, laboratory testing, mental health support, physiotherapy, nutrition counseling, yoga, Lamaze and lactation expertise, complemented by an in-house pharmacy and organic café. The team focuses on empowering individuals through knowledge, personalized attention and a supportive environment throughout their healthcare journey.

**Position**

You will work alongside our doctor to type, print and deliver ultrasound reports, and you will own all PCPNDT documentation so the clinic is always ready for inspection.

Daily tasks include reviewing ultrasound findings, entering patient and examination details into reporting systems, ensuring reports are complete and correctly formatted, and coordinating with healthcare professionals to clarify information as needed.

The Ultrasound Reporting Assistant helps manage patient flow by organizing records, maintaining confidentiality, and assisting with basic patient communication, such as explaining reporting timelines and follow-up procedures. The role also requires adherence to health and safety standards, accurate handling of patient documentation, and collaboration with the wider care team to support efficient, high-quality diagnostic services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Ultrasound reporting**

* Type findings live during scans and format reports using standard templates.
* Check patient details, referral information and measurements before the doctor signs.
* Print reports, confirm they are signed, and hand them over to patients and referring doctors on time.
* Manage the report queue and keep templates up to date.

**PCPNDT documentation**

* Fill Form F accurately and completely for every pregnant patient, including obstetric history and the referral indication, and pass it to the performing doctor for signature.
* Fill Form F correctly for follicular monitoring and fertility scans as per Delhi PCPNDT advisories.
* Maintain the daily PNDT register and patient records.
* File Form F on the Delhi online portal and keep signed hard copies with referral slips and case papers.
* Prepare daily and monthly PNDT reports for the Appropriate Authority as required.
* Keep all PNDT files (digital and physical) organised and preserved for at least 2 years, ready for audits and inspections.
* Check daily that the "no sex determination" signage in English and Hindi, the registration certificate and a copy of the Act and Rules are displayed.
* Flag any gaps or discrepancies to the doctor in charge immediately.

**Requirements**

* Graduate (any stream).
* Experience as an ultrasound/radiology typist, medical transcriptionist or PNDT documentation staff at a diagnostic centre or clinic.
* Neat, legible handwriting and the ability to fill forms carefully.
* Fast, accurate English typing (40+ WPM); familiarity with ultrasound terminology.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Strong computer skills: MS Word, Excel, reporting software, printing/scanning, and online government portals.
* Presebtable and Respectful towards doctors and staff
* Strong patient care and interpersonal skills to interact respectfully and clearly with patients and clinical staff.
* Should have attention to detail, accuracy in documentation
* A commitment to patient confidentiality, professional ethics, and continuous learning in ultrasound reporting and clinical workflows.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Form F experience, including fertility/follicular scans.
* Training in PCPNDT rules and guidelines (not mandatory; we will train the right person).

**Working hours**

Monday to Saturday, evenings (currently 5–8 PM). Timings may change based on clinic needs.

Send your CV and expected salary to clinicpankh.talent@gmail.com and whatsapp 9354468030
