title: Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**About IDinsight**
*We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and*
*non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most*
*impact.*
IDinsight is a global nonprofit that equips leaders with the data, evidence and technology to
  
  
improve lives at scale. We partner with governments, NGOs, multilaterals, and funders to support decisions at every stage of their impact journey – from bold pilots to nationwide scale-ups. Our teams bring rigorous evidence and practical insights so leaders can make informed decisions that truly change lives. With our partners, we are pioneering the next frontier of social impact, where data and technology accelerate progress for millions. We help leaders overcome the three main barriers to impact:
  
  

* Figuring out what works
* Learning and improving
* Reaching and operating at scale

We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors,
  
  
including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other
  
  
areas.
  
  
We have expertise in a variety of rigorous approaches and methodologies, which we tailor to each client depending on their needs and constraints. To achieve a positive social impact we:
  
  

* Support our partners with the full ‘data and evidenceʼ value chain – from primary data

collection to data systems, monitoring, evaluation, and learning tools, and data science
  
  

* Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective

programs or approaches
  
  

* Create cutting-edge AI-for-good products that make the delivery of social interventions

and learning tools more cost-effective and scalable
  
  
Our diverse, growing team of roughly 250 outstanding colleagues operate in nearly two dozen
  
  
countries around the world. Learn more about our mission, values, and principles at
  
  
www.IDinsight.org.
  
  
**Joining IDinsight at this moment**
IDinsight is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As demand for rigorous evidence and
  
  
AI-enabled solutions accelerates across the sectors and geographies we work in, we are actively investing in our teams, deepening our regional footprint, and expanding the frontier of what data and technology can do for social impact. This is a moment of real momentum for IDinsight. We're looking for people who want to use data and evidence to improve lives at scale; who are energized by taking on problems without a playbook; and who want a hand in shaping what IDinsight becomes as we grow.
  
  
**About The Financial Planning & Analysis Senior Manager Role**
The FP&A Senior Manager will support IDinsight with project and regional budgeting, forecasting, value-added analysis, and insightful financial reporting. The role sits in the Global Finance team and reports to the Head of Financial Planning & Analysis, working closely with the CFO and finance colleagues across our regional offices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Reporting and analysis**
***Project level***

* Oversee the monthly budget vs. actual BVA reporting process and share project-level

analysis and key takeaways with each project team, including quarterly review calls (or
  
  
more frequent ones, as warranted)
  
  

* Suggest and implement improvements to monthly project reporting tools and processes
* Develop and maintain a global dashboard for evaluating all projects, share meaningful

insights with the regions, and follow up on agreed action plans
  
  

* Give input into policies and guidelines for project reporting, charging, evaluation, and

ongoing forecasting
  
  

* Work closely with teams to keep pipeline and contract opportunities up to date, ensuring

annual revenue projections are accurate
  
  

* Prepare ad hoc reports for project teams and funders

***Regional level***

* Provide BVA analysis and commentary to leads of revenue-generating units through

monthly dashboards
  
  

* Help regional teams update the project pipeline with revenue projections
* Work with regions to interpret the utilization tracker and identify key takeaways for regional

leads and project managers
  
  

* Build project profitability analysis across the portfolio
* Prepare and update cash forecasts for each regional office, feeding into global reporting
* Help regions understand which opportunities are self-funded and analyze the related

utilization
  
  

* Prepare presentations for leadership of revenue-generating units and create additional

value-added financial reporting and tracking
  
  

* Prepare routine reporting on contribution revenue, restrictions, and receivables, working

with the accounting team to ensure accuracy
  
  

* Update specific sections of the quarterly board package, including the project pipeline and

dashboard
  
  
***Systems transition ERP/PSA***

* Lead FP&A reporting through IDinsight's ongoing finance systems transition, with a focus

on the project life cycle
  
  

* Work with regional and global finance and accounting teams to ensure data is accurate,

complete, and fit for reporting
  
  

* Work with systems analysts and implementation consultants to ensure reporting

requirements are built correctly into the new systems
  
  

* Train project teams to extract reports from the new systems and draw meaningful analysis

from them
  
  

* Document FP&A processes and SOPs, and prepare budgeting and revenue recognition

guidelines for the new systems
  
  

* Manage system maintenance from a project life cycle perspective alongside the system

administrator, including setting up new projects and team members
  
  
***Project and regional budgeting and forecasting***

* Guide FP&A Senior Associates as they support project teams with tools, analysis, and

guidance on project budget preparation, contract negotiations, and billing rate analysis
  
  

* Review project budgets after first-level review by FP&A Senior Associates
* Support revenue-generating units in annual budgeting and forecasting. This may include coordinating budget processes, supporting leadership in building their budgets, and coordinating project pipeline, staffing, and cash forecasts

***Revenue and receivables***

* Build processes to ensure correct billing of, and accrual for, all client revenue
* Review revenue recognition for client projects and ensure the amounts recorded reflect

progress toward project completion
  
  

* Ensure collection of all outstanding accounts receivable (external and intercompany),

working alongside the AR team
  
  

* Support the accounting team in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, and

reconcile it to management reporting and dashboards
  
  

* Support the monthly close and annual audit processes as needed

**Other**

* Lead or support other finance workstreams as needed, which may include cash forecasting

and investment management, finance operations, compliance, and treasury
  
  

* Coordinate with Legal and Operations on governance, compliance, and organizational

policy
  
  

* Coordinate with other finance functions, global support functions, and regions on projects

and processes that span the organization
  
  

* Act as backup for other finance functions

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 5 years of work experience in finance, covering all or most of the following: financial

planning (including budgeting and forecasting), financial reporting and dashboards,
  
  
accounting in a multi-entity environment, internal controls, and treasury
  
  

* Significant leadership experience in a finance function
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
* Skills and attributes:
* Strong leadership skills
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and is excited by opportunities to explore and implement new ideas
* Proactive attitude with a bias to action
* Excellent communication skills
* Strong project management and change management skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams located across many

countries
  
  
**Preferred**

* Professional accounting qualification CPA, ACA, ACCA Part II, or equivalent)
* Experience in the social sector and in a project-based environment (both highly desirable)
* Master's degree in a related field (helpful but not required)

**Professional development**
Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long-term impact strategy, and
  
  
have been noted highlights of teammatesʼ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real-time feedback is embedded in our culture and formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend that they are encouraged to utilize to explore their career interests and develop their skills.
  
  
**Nuts & bolts**
**Location**
This position is based in IDinsightʼs
**Dakar, Senegal; Delhi, India; Manila, Philippines; Nairobi,**
**Kenya; or Rabat, Morocco**
office(s). This position is not eligible for remote work, or otherwise, from the United States.
  
  
**Start date**
The start date of this position is flexible, with preference for candidates who can start immediately.
  
  
**Work authorization**
IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role. Successful candidates will not
  
  
require IDinsight to sponsor their work authorization in the office in which they'll be based.
  
  
**Compensation**
Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for, and competitive within the global development sector. We are especially proud of the people-focused benefits we offer including comprehensive international health insurance, including mental health coverage; paid vacation, sick, and parental leave; relocation benefits; a travel stipend; technology and work from home stipends; a professional development budget; and more. Please note, as a non-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading private sector organizations.
  
  
**How To Apply**
This application includes several questions and requires a CV (one to two pages) covering your
  
  
professional and personal experience as well as academic qualifications. Please omit headshots, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and similar personal information — these aren't relevant to our review. If you've previously applied to this role, please reapply only if you've gained relevant experience since. More information, including details on IDinsightʼs hiring process and frequently asked questions, can be found online at IDinsight Careers. Any questions should be directed to careers@IDinsight.org.
  
  
**IDinsightʼs commitment to reducing power asymmetries**
IDinsight is committed to reducing power asymmetries in the social sector. Our commitment to
  
  
diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon
  
  
unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work. We seek a workforce that is inclusive of a variety of perspectives that will help us refine and improve our methods and relationships, and strengthen the services we provide our clients and their communities or constituencies.
  
  
The following commitments represent our vision for the IDinsight team:
  
  

* IDinsight will have greater representation from the populations with whom we work and

**clients**
**we serve**
.
  
  

* IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
* Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from

**historically excluded communities.**

* IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their

best work.
  
  
IDinsight is committed to non-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and
  
  
organizational culture, regardless of peopleʼs age, disability, gender, gender identity, national
  
  
origin, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Executive Assistant, Country Director's Office (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The Executive Assistant will report to the Principal Manager, Strategy and Special Projects, providing high-level administrative support to Senior Executives and the Country Director. This role requires exceptional multitasking abilities, attention to detail, and the capability to handle sensitive information. The ideal candidate will be proactive, organized, and skilled in handling all important executive tasks.
  
  
The Country Director's week spans senior government counterparts, funders, Evidence Action's global leadership across multiple time zones, and state-level teams. This role makes that possible: protecting leadership time, ensuring they walk into every engagement fully prepared, and closing the loop on what follows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Calendar and Scheduling
  
  

* Own and actively manage the Country Director's calendar, resolving competing priorities and protecting time for strategic and deep work
* Coordinate multi-stakeholder meetings involving senior government officials, funders, partners, and Evidence Action's global leadership across time zones
* Ensure the Director is prepared for every engagement, with agendas, briefing notes, and background materials circulated in advance

Travel and Logistics
  
  

* Plan and book domestic and international travel end to end: flights, accommodation, visas, and ground transport
* Build practical, well-sequenced field itineraries in coordination with state teams, including frequent travel to state capitals and program sites
* Prepare and submit travel expense claims and reimbursements accurately and on time, in line with organizational policy

Communication and Correspondence
  
  

* Draft, review, and edit correspondence, official letters to government counterparts, presentations, and reports on behalf of the Director
* Screen and prioritize incoming calls, emails, and requests; respond, route, or escalate as appropriate
* Act as a liaison between the Count Director and internal teams, state offices, government stakeholders, and external partners

Meeting Support and Follow-Through
  
  

* Take clear minutes in leadership, partner, and government meetings
* Track action items to closure with named owners and deadlines, following up proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Maintain organized, easily retrievable records of key documents, agreements, approvals, and correspondence

Confidentiality and Judgment
  
  

* Handle sensitive personnel, financial, and government-related information with complete discretion
* Exercise sound judgment in the Director's absence on what requires immediate escalation and what can wait

**Requirements**
Essential
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in executive support, including at least 2 years supporting a senior leader (Country Director, CXO, Partner, or equivalent)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite, and comfort with collaboration tools such as Slack and Asana
* Demonstrated ability to manage a complex calendar and competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Exceptional attention to detail and reliable follow-through on every commitment
* Proven discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information
* Willingness to travel within India as needed, and to be reachable for occasional urgent matters outside standard hours

Desirable
  
  

* Experience supporting leadership in a non-profit, international development, public health, or government-facing organization
* Experience coordinating with government departments, ministries, or public officials
* Working knowledge of project management tools and methodologies
* Comfort using AI tools to draft, summarize, and organize work
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across time zones

This role is ideal for a highly organized and driven individual who wants their organizational skill to translate directly into public health programs reaching millions of people.
  
  
**Position Location -**
This role is based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Optional enrolment in the National Pension System (NPS) through our partner, HDFC Pension
* Optional Flexible Basket Plan, offering components such as meal allowance, fuel, top-up health and term insurance, and telecommunications & internet — all forming part of the employee's CTC
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
  
  
Note: This role will be open for applications until 30th October 2027. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
About Luxolis

Luxolis is an innovative technology company specializing in AI-powered computer vision, robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent inspection systems.

Our technologies combine Vision-Language Models (VLMs), spatial intelligence, and advanced robotic systems to enable smarter and more efficient industrial operations.

As we expand our international engineering and business teams, we are seeking a dedicated and highly organized
**Human Resources Manager**
to oversee recruitment, employee administration, HR operations, payroll coordination, and organizational development.

Key Responsibilities1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including job postings, candidate sourcing, interviews, evaluations, and employment offers.
* Coordinate recruitment activities across engineering, AI, robotics, sales, marketing, and administrative departments.
* Work closely with department managers to identify hiring requirements and workforce priorities.
* Maintain applicant tracking records, candidate databases, and recruitment schedules.
* Coordinate onboarding processes and ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
* Develop recruitment partnerships with universities, employment agencies, and professional networks.

2. HR Operations & Employee Administration

* Oversee daily HR operations, employee records, employment contracts, and personnel documentation.
* Manage employee onboarding, offboarding, attendance, leave, and vacation administration.
* Prepare employment agreements, offer letters, HR notices, and internal policy documents.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee information.
* Establish standardized HR procedures and administrative workflows.
* Support office administration and employee-related operational requirements.

3. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with finance teams and external payroll providers.
* Verify employee attendance, salary adjustments, bonuses, and compensation records.
* Administer employee benefits, insurance enrollment, vacation accruals, and other compensation-related programs.
* Maintain payroll schedules and ensure accurate submission of payroll information.
* Support compensation reviews, salary benchmarking, and workforce budgeting.
* Coordinate with external service providers to ensure timely payroll and benefits administration.

4. Employee Relations & Performance Management

* Serve as the primary contact for employee inquiries and workplace-related concerns.
* Coordinate probation evaluations, performance reviews, and employee development activities.
* Support department managers in addressing performance, attendance, and workplace conduct matters.
* Assist in handling employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and employment separations.
* Promote professional communication, accountability, and a positive workplace culture.
* Maintain appropriate records of employee performance and personnel decisions.

5. Labor Compliance & HR Policy

* Develop and maintain internal HR policies in accordance with applicable employment laws.
* Coordinate employment compliance matters with external legal counsel and labor specialists.
* Maintain legally required personnel records, employment documentation, and HR reporting.
* Support employment contract reviews, workplace investigations, and regulatory inquiries.
* Monitor employment regulation changes and recommend necessary policy updates.
* Support proper handling of employee terminations, resignations, and settlement documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate protection of employee information.

6. Global HR Coordination

* Support international HR operations across South Korea, Canada, the United States, and other applicable markets.
* Coordinate with regional managers, payroll providers, benefits administrators, and external advisors.
* Assist with international hiring, relocation documentation, and work authorization administration.
* Maintain consistent HR standards while accommodating local labor laws and employment requirements.
* Facilitate communication between international teams and company leadership.

7. HR Reporting & Process Improvement

* Prepare weekly and monthly HR reports covering recruitment, headcount, payroll, attendance, and employee status.
* Maintain organizational charts, staffing plans, and HR databases.
* Monitor recruitment progress, employee turnover, and workforce development indicators.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline HR processes.
* Support executive leadership with organizational planning and workforce management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Law, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in human resources, recruitment, or HR operations.
* Strong understanding of employee administration, employment contracts, payroll coordination, and HR procedures.
* Experience managing recruitment and onboarding processes independently.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and HR management tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional English communication skills.

title: MD Ayurvedic Doctor
description:
**Company Description**
HuHaHo (Human Happiness Hope) is a holistic wellness and human development organization dedicated to delivering health, happiness, hope, and skilling while honoring and respecting all cultures. The organization focuses on integrative approaches that support physical, emotional, and social well-being. HuHaHo designs programs that empower individuals and communities to lead more balanced and fulfilling lives. Potential team members join a purpose-driven environment that values compassion, cultural sensitivity, and continuous learning.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for an MD Ayurvedic Doctor based in New Delhi. The role involves providing Ayurvedic consultations, conducting detailed patient assessments, diagnosing conditions using classical Ayurvedic principles, and designing individualized treatment plans. Day-to-day responsibilities include prescribing herbal medicines and therapies, monitoring patient progress, maintaining accurate medical records, and ensuring adherence to ethical and clinical standards. The MD Ayurvedic Doctor will collaborate with other wellness and development professionals, contribute to health education sessions, and support holistic programs that promote long-term well-being. The role may also include participation in workshops, community outreach initiatives, and documentation of case studies to enhance practice quality.
  
**Qualifications**

* Recognized MD in Ayurveda from an accredited institution and valid registration with the relevant medical council.
* Strong knowledge of classical Ayurvedic texts, diagnostic methods (e.g., prakriti assessment, nadi pariksha), and evidence-informed practice.
* Experience in prescribing Ayurvedic medications, panchakarma and other therapeutic procedures, and lifestyle counseling.
* Ability to take detailed case histories, maintain clear and accurate medical records, and follow clinical protocols and safety standards.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain Ayurvedic concepts to diverse audiences in accessible language.
* Cultural sensitivity and empathy, with a commitment to patient-centered, non-discriminatory care aligned with HuHaHo’s holistic values.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and contribute to wellness programs, workshops, and community outreach.
* Basic computer literacy for electronic documentation and willingness to learn organizational systems and processes.
* Prior experience in a holistic wellness, hospital, or clinic setting is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Principal Engineer
description:

Data Strategy Group
  
  
**Industry:**
No Industry
  
  
**Overview**
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
  
  
**Scope**
We are seeking a highly accomplished
**Principal Engineer**
to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.
* Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Golang, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence.
* Container Platforms & Orchestration: Architect resilient, multi-cluster Kubernetes topologies at scale. Define best practices for workload scheduling, networking (service mesh), custom controllers/operators, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), and multi-tenant isolation.
* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Zero-Trust Security & Policy-as-Code: Embed DevSecOps at the architectural level—designing policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), secure supply chain standards (SBOM, image signing, Trivy), and compliance baselines (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.
* FinOps & Performance Optimization: Architect cost-efficient cloud topologies. Establish capacity planning models, multi-region traffic routing, right-sizing strategies, and automated cost-governance guardrails.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep Hands-on Coding & Automation: Proficiency in at least one modern systems programming language (e.g., Golang, Python) along with advanced scripting (Bash). Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems software design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).

Job Description:

***About RightWalk***

At

, we are committed to addressing the root causes of poverty and inequality by activating transformative social policies from inception to last-mile delivery. We work with
**System Leadership, Lawmakers, and Communities**

Our pioneering efforts have unlocked the RTE 12.1(c) provision in Uttar Pradesh,

with

and

. With a blend of policy advocacy, system design, capacity building, and on-ground execution, we
***aim to shape India’s social policy landscape***
***to be more equitable and inclusive.***
To know more about us, visit www.rightwalk.org.

***The Opportunity: Associate Director – Fund Raising & Donor Relations***

As Associate Director – Fundraising & Donor Relations, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping and driving RightWalk’s resource mobilization strategy. Reporting directly to the Executive Leadership, you will be entrusted with building, nurturing, and expanding high-value relationships with foundations, corporations, and high-net-worth individuals (HNIs). Beyond securing immediate funding, your mandate will include strengthening the organization’s long-term fundraising pipeline, ensuring that RightWalk has the sustained resources to deliver impact at scale.

This is an opportunity for a senior fundraising professional to operate at the intersection of strategy and execution — translating the organization’s vision into compelling donor narratives, designing innovative fundraising models, and aligning partnerships with RightWalk’s mission of equity and inclusion. As a member of the senior leadership team, you will not only deliver ambitious fundraising targets but also serve as a key voice in influencing organizational strategy, ensuring that financial sustainability and mission alignment go hand in hand.

***Key Responsibilities***

***1. Fundraising Strategy Development***

* Lead the design and execution of a multi-year fundraising strategy to ensure long-term financial sustainability for RWF.
* Align fundraising goals with the organization’s strategic priorities and expansion plans.
* Explore innovative funding models (blended finance, CSR, multi-donor platforms) to diversify income streams.
* Regularly report to Executive Leadership and the Board on fundraising performance, risks, and opportunities.

***2. Fundraising Pipeline & Resource Mobilization***

* Build and manage a robust pipeline of potential donors across foundations, corporations, HNIs, and international agencies.
* Establish systems to track prospects, monitor progress, and ensure disciplined follow-through.
* Drive prospect research and due diligence to identify high-value opportunities and new geographies for growth.
* Convert qualified leads into committed partnerships through compelling pitches and tailored cultivation strategies.

***3. Partnership Cultivation & Donor Engagement***

* Serve as the face of RWF in external fundraising conversations, representing the organization with gravitas and credibility.
* Cultivate, negotiate, and close large-scale partnerships with key donors, CSR heads, and ecosystem actors.
* Deepen relationships with existing donors through strategic stewardship, regular impact updates, and co-creation opportunities.
* Lead donor visits, events, and campaigns to showcase impact and strengthen confidence in RWF’s work.

***4. Donor Relationship Management & Stewardship***

* Oversee the development of high-quality proposals, reports, and communication materials tailored to donor priorities.
* Ensure timely compliance with donor reporting requirements and demonstrate measurable outcomes.
* Design donor engagement frameworks that ensure consistency, personalization, and long-term trust.
* Strengthen the donor CRM and knowledge management systems to enhance visibility and accountability.

***5. Strategic Collaboration & Organizational Leadership***

* Partner with program and policy teams to design fundable initiatives and ensure donor priorities align with on-ground realities.
* Provide market intelligence and donor insights to inform organizational strategy.
* Mentor and build capacity within the fundraising team, enabling them to deliver on ambitious targets.
* Play a leadership role in external forums, representing RWF’s thought leadership on social policy and fundraising innovation.

***Who Will Thrive in This Role? -***
You’ll love this role (and we’ll love working with you) if:

* Bring 10+ years of fundraising experience, including 5–7 years in the development sector.
* Hold a full-time Master’s degree in Social Sciences, Management, or Social Work (Premier B-School preferred).
* Have strong knowledge of the social sector landscape, fundraising best practices, and donor ecosystems.
* Excel at proposal writing, donor communication, and pitching.
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, and are willing to travel for donor engagements.
* Are self-motivated, results-driven, and able to balance strategy with hands-on execution.
* Have proficiency in MS Office Suite, Canva, Salesforce for Nonprofits (or equivalent), with attention to detail and design aesthetics.
* At RightWalk, thriving also means embodying our core values every day
* **Integrity & Ethics:**
  Do what’s right, always.
* **Ownership & Excellence:**
  Take full charge, no excuses.
* **Resilience & Audacity:**
  Be fearless, even when it’s hard.
* **Empathy & End-User First:**
  Listen, understand, and design what matters most.
* **Helicopter Mindset:**
  Zoom out to think big, zoom in to deliver relentlessly.

Location: Macleod – University Campus
  
  
Job Category: Academic
  
  
**Job Description**
A school is built on the strength of its people.
  
  
Great people make great schools. People create culture.
  
  
At Ivanhoe Grammar School, our people create a culture of belonging. A place where ideas are heard and supported. Where you are encouraged to try something new. A place to feel included and valued. Ivanhoe Grammar School is a values-driven, co-educational independent school with a commitment to fostering a community where students, teachers and professional services staff can continually become the best version of themselves. At Ivanhoe Grammar School, we are always looking for great people to join our team. We are always seeking people who are energetic, collaborative and courageous.
  
  
**Seeking a Learning Diversity Teacher**
The Learning Diversity Teacher is a member of the Academic Staff based at our University Campus, Macleod. This role plays an integral part in supporting the intellectual, social, emotional and personal development of students, in line with the School’s commitment to fostering young people of character who give their best to everything they do.
  
  
Working with our Year 9 students, you will contribute to an inclusive, student-centred learning environment where every learner is known, challenged and supported to achieve personal growth.
  
  
This is a full-time, 12-month fixed-term position, commencing in January 2027.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role, you will support students with diverse learning needs to thrive at school. You will work collaboratively with colleagues and families, applying evidence-informed practice and reflective teaching to enable meaningful progress. Your work will model and promote the Ivanhoe Learner attributes – courageous, innovative, balanced, collaborative, ethical, reflective and compassionate – and contribute to a culture where every student feels valued, capable and supported to grow.
  
  
**You Have The Necessary Experience, Knowledge And Skills To**

* Design and deliver targeted intervention programs informed by diagnostic data, school priorities, and student learning profiles
* Use assessments, evidence, and professional judgement to identify learning needs, track growth, and adjust strategies to maximise student progress
* Work collaboratively with Teachers, Heads of Pedagogy, and Curriculum Leaders to co-plan supports that align with curriculum and the instructional model
* Build strong relationships with students and families, providing clear communication, learning updates, and guidance to support progress and wellbeing
* Support student transitions back to full classroom learning and contribute actively to co-curricular and campus life, modelling Ivanhoe’s values and expectations

**Who You Are**
You are a reflective and purposeful educator who believes that learning and character are inseparable. You recognise the potential in every young person and understand that high expectations, strong relationships, and compassionate support create the conditions for students to thrive. You model the Ivanhoe Learner attributes – courageous, balanced, innovative, collaborative, ethical, reflective and compassionate – and you strive to bring them to life in your practice.
  
  
**You Bring**

* Teaching experience within a school setting, with relevant qualifications and expertise in supporting diverse learners; postgraduate study in Special Education, Curriculum or Pedagogy is desirable
* The ability to design and deliver targeted learning support using data, professional judgement and evidence-informed practice
* Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills, with the capacity to build trust, collaborate effectively and engage confidently with students, staff and families
* A demonstrated commitment to child safety, inclusion, and student wellbeing, supported by current VIT registration
* A solutions-focused, growth-oriented mindset and the capacity to uphold high professional standards
* The ability to model and foster a culture of respect, reflection, resilience and responsibility, while supporting others to grow and succeed

**What We Offer You**

* An impactful teaching role embedded in a thriving and values-driven educational community.
* A meaningful opportunity to support secondary learners at our Year 9 Campus, contributing to their academic growth and personal development.
* A collaborative, student-centred team culture where wellbeing is prioritised.
* Opportunities for professional growth through the Ivanhoe Institute and school-led wellbeing programs.
* Beautiful learning environments with access to state-of-the-art facilities, including onsite café, gym and pool.
* Salary packaging, discounted health insurance and school tuition discounts.

**Always seeking great people. Your move.**
Further information can be found by visiting the Ivanhoe Grammar School’s website – Careers - Ivanhoe Grammar School or by viewing the position description - here.
  
  
For a confidential discussion please contact People and Culture via employment@ivanhoe.com.au.
  
  
Applications close

at 5pm.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, as interviews may commence prior to this date.
  
  
Ivanhoe Grammar School is committed to providing a safe and inclusive environment where everyone is welcome to be themselves. We value student safety. All staff are required to adhere to the School’s policies and teachers are required to have a working knowledge and understanding of the Student Wellbeing Policy, the Health and Safety Policy, the Child Safety Code of Conduct and the Respectful Workplace Behaviour Policy.  All successful academic applications will be requested to complete a Summary Document of Relevant Work Experience, evidenced through the submission of Statements of Service.

title: Engineer/ Surveyor
description:
**Engineer/ Surveyor India Sub-Continent**

**Location:**
Delhi, India

**Contract Type:**
Permanent

**Hours:**
Full time, 44 hours per week, Monday to Friday

**Salary:**
171,240 (INR) Gross Pay per month, depending upon experience

**About the CWGC**

The Commonwealth War Graves Commission honours and cares for the people of the Commonwealth forces who died in the First and Second World Wars, ensuring they will never be forgotten. Funded by six Member Governments, our work began with building, and now maintaining, cemeteries at 23,000 locations all over the world.

Today, over a century after we first began, our work continues through our staff, supporters and volunteers who preserve our unique cultural, horticultural and architectural heritage and ensure that the stories of those who died are told.

**What you'll be doing**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Technical/Project Manager (Works) to lead a varied portfolio of estates, infrastructure and maintenance projects across the indian Sub-continent. This is a key role supporting the planning, development and delivery of works that help maintain our sites to the highest standards.

Working closely with operational teams and regional managers, you will oversee projects from survey and planning through to delivery. You will also play an important role in preventative maintenance programmes and construction-related cases across the area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake structural and property condition surveys and accurately input findings into the CWGC Condition Survey Software.
* Develop a programme of fully costed and internally approved projects, ranging from building refurbishment to heritage structure maintenance, for inclusion in the area’s five-year plan.
* Manage a small team consisting of a Technical Supervisor and manual operatives. Identifying development opportunities, providing clear guidance and supportive leadership.
* Work in partnership with Regional Managers and Contractors to deliver projects in line with the Area Business Plan and Estates Department guidelines.
* Manage all projects using the CWGC Project Management Office System, ensuring effective governance and delivery.
* Prepare and develop works contracts, including FIDIC and small works contracts, in collaboration with the legal team.
* Oversee the Area’s amendments and addenda process, identifying suitable solutions and preparing business cases for proposed works.
* Deliver the area’s planned preventative maintenance programme for all base sites and accommodation, ensuring continued compliance with Commission standards.
* Act as Project Manager for a range of property-related projects, ensuring outcomes meet organisational and stakeholder needs.
* Manage accommodation repairs across ISC, liaising directly with occupants to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and effectively.
* Manage delegated budgets, prepare cost estimates and submit monthly and quarterly expenditure reports as required.
* Work in collaboration with the Health and Safety Advisor to implement health and safety policies, with particular focus on contractor management and the promotion of safe working practices.
* Record and report project-related accidents and near misses, taking appropriate action to manage risk and support Area-wide health and safety compliance.
* Maintain accurate records of all building changes made during projects and provide as-built technical drawings, incorporating any new maintenance requirements into planned preventative maintenance schedules.
* Manage the procurement and installation of headstones and bronze plaques within your area.

**What you need to have**

* A recognised and relevant technical qualification (degree or equivalent).
* Experience (minimum 5 years) of working in a Managerial position.
* High computer literacy including AutoCad, Excel, Word, Outlook
* A qualification or proven training record in building surveying and/or architecture and conservation.
* Experience of working in different cultures, with understanding of cultural and political sensitivities and operations in complex environments.
* A recognised H&S qualification at the level of IOSH Managing Safely standard.
* Practical experience of direct project management (end to end – all phases).
* Experience of managing tendering processes for £50k to 300k range projects.
* Change and performance management at operational level.
* Experience in researching and compiling business case documents in support of project approval and bids for approved funding.
* Thorough knowledge of organisational policies, surveying practices, and a conservation-based approach to management of the Commission’s estate.
* Experience of travelling to remote locations including lone working.

**How to Apply**

If your skills and experience align with this opportunity, we would welcome your application.

Apply via our Career Portal (Engineer/Surveyor ISC at CWGC) by clicking the ‘Apply Now’ button.

As this is an active role, we will be interviewing as we go along, and the role will close when we have an offer accepted by a preferred candidate.

*We believe creating a diverse environment enriches our organisation and strengthens our mission, therefore, we welcome applications from everybody. Join our inclusive environment where every individual is valued.*

title: Transport Planner/Traffic Engineer
description:

Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a motivated and technically strong Transportation Planner/Traffic Engineer with approximately 4 years of professional experience in transport planning, traffic engineering, and modelling. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA), Travel Demand Forecasting, Traffic Simulation Modelling, and Urban Transport Design across residential, commercial, and area development projects.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical capability, proficiency in industry-standard tools, and the ability to independently deliver high-quality outputs while coordinating with multidisciplinary teams. The candidate should demonstrate clear progression in technical skills and project responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Support and deliver a range of transport planning and traffic engineering studies
* Conduct Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA), parking studies, and access/egress analysis for development projects
* Develop travel demand forecasts using appropriate modelling approaches and assumptions
* Build, calibrate, and validate traffic simulation models (micro-level) for urban corridors and developments
* Prepare traffic circulation plans, junction designs, and transport infrastructure layouts
* Contribute to urban transport and area planning studies, including multimodal integration
* Perform data analysis and interpretation to support planning recommendations
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and client deliverables with high quality and clarity
* Coordinate with team leads, project managers, clients, and reviewers to ensure timely delivery
* Apply best practices and standards in transport planning and modelling
* Work independently on defined tasks while contributing to overall project objectives

**Qualifications**

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
  
  
  

* Strong experience in Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) and transport studies
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for transport layout and design drawings
* Hands-on expertise in PTV VISSIM for traffic microsimulation modelling
* Experience in travel demand forecasting and modelling approaches
* Ability to develop, calibrate, and validate traffic simulation models

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to GIS tools (ArcGIS / QGIS) for spatial analysis
* Familiarity with junction design, road safety, and transport design standards
* Experience with macro-modelling tools such as PTV VISUM / CUBE / EMME
* Understanding of urban transport systems and multimodal planning

**Additional Information**

Ramboll is a global transportation consultancy, and we work on some of the biggest and most innovative infrastructure projects in the world. We are close to 3,000 bright minds working within Transport worldwide, creating practical, sustainable, and economic solutions for national transport authorities, private contractors, and municipalities alike.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Clinical Dietitian
description:
Work From Office

**Company Description**
Dietician Kajal's Clinic is a nutrition-focused wellness center dedicated to empowering individuals to achieve better health through expert, evidence-based guidance. The clinic offers highly personalized nutrition plans tailored to each client’s specific needs, including weight management, energy enhancement, and targeted support for health conditions. Led by Chief Dietician Kajal, the team emphasizes sustainable lifestyle changes over short-term diets, encouraging long-lasting habits that support overall well-being. Applicants can expect to work in an environment that values individualized care, practical advice, and continuous support throughout each client’s wellness journey.

**Role Description**
The Clinical Dietitian will provide individualized nutrition assessments, develop evidence-based meal plans, and deliver ongoing nutritional counseling to clients in accordance with their health status and goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing medical histories, collaborating with healthcare professionals when needed, educating clients on diet and lifestyle modifications, and monitoring progress through follow-up consultations. The role also involves maintaining accurate client records, staying updated on current nutrition research, and contributing to educational content or workshops. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Delhi, India, with a combination of in-clinic consultations and some work-from-home flexibility.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundational knowledge in Nutrition and Human Nutrition, with the ability to apply scientific principles to practical dietary guidance.
* Demonstrated expertise in Dietetics and Medical Nutrition Therapy for managing conditions such as obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and other clinical concerns.
* Proficiency in Nutritional Counseling, including building rapport, motivating behavior change, and tailoring recommendations to individual needs.
* Relevant degree in Dietetics, Nutrition, or a related field; registration or licensure as a dietitian/nutrition professional as applicable.
* Ability to interpret medical data, collaborate with healthcare providers, and document care plans clearly and accurately.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a client-centered, non-judgmental approach to counseling.
* Comfort with hybrid work arrangements, basic digital tools, and scheduling systems; prior clinical or wellness-clinic experience is an advantage.

title: CTO Technology & Data
description:
As the Director of Technology & Data, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the technology infrastructure and data management systems critical to our organization's success. Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for implementing and maintaining robust technology solutions and data management systems, ensuring the accuracy, privacy, and effective tracking of data in support of policy initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The list, not limited to, as below provides more detailed descriptions of the role.

**Technology Leadership:**
Lead organization's technology initiatives, ensuring the adoption of cutting-edge tools and systems that enhance efficiency and effectiveness in delivering social development programs.

* Evaluate, select, implement technology solutions to enhance program effectiveness.
* Maintain and upgrade existing technology infrastructure.
* Oversee IT systems, hardware, and software, ensuring functionality and security.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technology-related issues promptly.

**Data Strategy:**
Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with the organization's social development goals. This includes defining data governance standards, data collection and analysis methodologies, and data storage and security protocols.

* Design, develop, and maintain robust data management systems and databases.
* Oversee data collection, validation, and analysis processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Implement data quality control measures to minimize errors and discrepancies.
* Establish and enforce data quality standards and practices to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of data across the organization.

**Data Analytics & Tracking:**

* Develop and execute data analytics and reporting strategies. Extract actionable insights from data to inform decision-making.
* Develop and implement systems for tracking and reporting on key data metrics.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on the status & performance of data management systems.

**Data Management Systems:**

* Implement & manage data management systems specifically designed for policy tracking, analysis.
* Work closely with the Policy Research & Advocacy team to understand data requirements for effective policy development.

**Data Privacy and Security:**
Oversee data privacy & security measures, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Implement robust data protection protocols and ensure staff adherence.

* Implement data security protocols to safeguard sensitive information.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and ethical guidelines.
* Develop disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

**Technology Innovations, Partnerships, Continuous Improvement:**

* Collaborate with external partners, vendors, and experts to leverage technology solutions and best practices to enhance the organization's impact.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies. Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation to drive efficiency and effectiveness.

**Team Collaboration:**
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Policy Research & Advocacy & IT to ensure seamless integration of data systems with organizational processes.

**Qualifications:**

* Post-graduate degree in social sciences, management, Technology, computer science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10-15 years of Proven experience in overseeing technology infrastructure and implementing data management systems in Social Development Sector.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data privacy regulations & data security best practices.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and platforms. Experience with qualitative & quantitative data collection & analysis using packages like DHIS, ONA, GBVIMS, SPSS, MS-Excel, MS-Word, MS-Access, Tableau, etc.
* Knowledge of data protection regulations (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA) & ethical data handling.
* Strong understanding of data privacy regulations and best practices.
* Excellent project management and a strategic mindset.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to develop and manage budgets effectively.

**Desired Qualities:**

* Entrepreneurial spirit and ‘get-it-done’ attitude.
* Operating style suited to working in a small organization setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued.
* Excellent leadership skills, including ability to manage multiple projects at a time.

**Compensation**

We offer a competitive salary package matching relevant experience, fitment & candidate’s existing compensation, at par with the Development Sector.
