title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.
  
  
This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
#Nic

title: Quality Insights Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Quality Insights Lead (QIL) supports the daily operations of the Quality program, setting a high standard for quality across the Customer Support (CS) organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the QIL drives continuous improvement through Quality initiatives, including analysis, business case development, reporting on Quality monitoring, and applying Problem Solving Methodologies. They ensure all assigned tasks are completed on time, collaborate with other CS teams as the Quality representative, and may oversee Quality Partner sites as needed. The QIL also serves as a brand ambassador, upholding exceptional customer service standards.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Provide daily support for Quality programs.
* Design and oversee deep-dive projects for regional QIA teams to drive service improvements, managing through to project completion.
* Execute QI and ad-hoc after-action reviews.
* Use transaction monitoring insights to develop targeted continuous improvement initiatives for customer service enhancements.
* Utilize AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, such as Observe.AI, to oversee and analyze customer interactions at scale, validating model-driven scores and automated evaluations to pinpoint systemic performance gaps.
* Convert machine-generated insights from AI-assisted monitoring into strategic service enhancements and targeted coaching priorities.
* Participate in and lead global calibration sessions with internal and partner teams to standardize Quality monitoring and Problem Solving methodologies.
* Provide feedback on coaching effectiveness for internal and partner Team Leads, fostering a coaching culture.
* Coach CS agents to achieve Quality program standards.
* Act as the Quality representative for other CS teams (e.g., CM, BPI, Training) and contribute to relevant projects.
* Collect, analyze, and propose changes derived from Support Ambassador roundtable insights at internal and partner sites.
* Travel to partner sites to implement, train, and run key QA initiatives (e.g., onboarding workshops, certifications).
* Master CS policies, procedures, and workflows, ensuring timely knowledge updates for regional QIA teams.
* Conduct spot checks on Quality Analysts and report findings to their QA Leads/Managers.
* Recommend actions to improve based on QA dashboard outcomes.
* Upskill in relevant or new service tiers when needed.
* Lead Quality at partner sites if required.

**Your Expertise**

* Technical & Analytical Depth; strong analytical, statistical, and automation background — able to design and build AI-enabled tooling that streamlines review processes while maintaining rigor and high-quality analysis.
* Pursuing Excellence; setting the highest standards for the quality of work produced while holding yourself and others accountable
* Collaborative; skilled working with cross-functional peers/teams
* Presenting and Influencing; ability to develop action plans, business cases and data driven reporting that you would present to all levels of the organization
* Coaching; You objectively analyze performance and provide regular feedback. You modify your approach to suit your audience. Ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality while providing analysis and coaching.Maintain high levels of confidentiality while performing analysis and coaching
* Solving Problems; You quickly identify root causes as well as subtle, hidden issues. You use logic to propose effective solutions to a variety of problems. You dig deeper and utilize all available resources to reach the best possible solution.
* Managing Time Efficiently; You prioritize correctly, focusing your efforts on the things that are most important. You stay organized to ensure successful multitasking.

**Role Requirements**

* 4-6 years of Customer Experience management experience in a rapidly growing partner network
* Experience working in a QA Specialist or related role
* Working knowledge of contact center end to end processes
* Working knowledge of customer service assessment tools, i.e., Net Promoter System
* Working knowledge of google suite, including sheets
* Experience leading, inspiring and motivating others to meet goals and metrics
* Passionate about setting a high bar of exceptional customer service
* Highly-developed analytical and critical-thinking skills
* Ability to spot trends in data and provide recommended actions to drive performance
* Experience with AI automation workflows within contact center Quality environments; includes validating AI-generated outputs, identifying anomalies, and interpreting model-driven trends to formulate actionable service improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain COPC certification
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Travel to partner sites expected up to 20%
* Work with Operations teams in the region to address escalated issues, dips in performance and the roll out of new Quality initiatives to drive performance.

**Prefer To Have**

* Exceptional coaching abilities
* Advanced knowledge of Excel or Google Docs
* Strong knowledge of NPS and Quality tools (e.g. Medallia)
* Hands-on experience utilizing Observe.AI or equivalent AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, specifically involving speech analytics, automated scoring, and real-time guidance.
* Expertise in market-leading contact center Quality Assurance platforms and global program frameworks.
* Proven ability to operate alongside AI automation workflows; includes assessing AI-facilitated customer interactions, pinpointing model anomalies, and converting machine-generated insights into strategic service enhancements.
* Quality Assurance certification (e.g. COPC)
* Ability to create and deliver presentations to the organization

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹1,610,000—₹2,110,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:
**Overview**
**How are you creating an impact?**
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented
**Associate**
**Manager**
**Product Growth,**
to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the
**Higher Education market.**
The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to combine
**product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability**
to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long-term customer value.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
* Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
* Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.

**Revenue & Commercial Management**

* Own and contribute to product-level revenue and margin targets.
* Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
* Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
* Identify corrective actions for underperforming products

Identify opportunities for:
  
  

- Institutional contracts
- Digital subscriptions
- Bundling
- Custom publishing
- Licensing
- Institutional solutions
- E-commerce
- Cross-sell and upsell

**Internal Positioning & Messaging**

* Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
* Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
* Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer-centric benefits and outcomes.
* Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
* Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
* Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”

title: Intern, Founder's Office
description:
**About us**

BrightSense is building technology for the AI age. Its first product is Branly, an AI visibility platform.

How people discover brands has changed. More and more, they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers what to buy, and those answers name only a handful of brands. Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* **Grounded in research.**
  AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* **Signal over noise.**
  We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* **Customer first.**
  Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring an Intern in the Founder's Office to work directly with the founding team across growth, product, research and operations.

You will run projects end to end: launch campaigns, read user data, speak to customers, test product releases, research competitors and keep day-to-day work moving. Some projects will be planned. Others will come up because something needs fixing that day.

We are an AI-first team. AI is how we research, write, analyse and build, not an add-on. You will be expected to work the same way: hand the first pass to AI, check it properly, and spend your own time on judgement and the parts that need a human.

You will learn how the business works by working across it. We are looking for someone who asks good questions, figures things out and takes a task through to completion.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* **AI-first execution.**
  Use AI tools as your default way of working across research, writing, analysis and reporting. Build simple, repeatable workflows the team can reuse, check every output before it goes anywhere, and share what saves time.
* **Growth and go-to-market.**
  Run outbound and paid experiments end to end: list building, copywriting, campaign execution and performance analysis. Track what works, recommend what to change and stop what does not.
* **User funnel.**
  Track the journey from sign-up to activation and paid conversion. Find where users drop off, investigate why and work with the team to close the gaps.
* **User communication and channels.**
  Write and send the messages that move users forward: onboarding emails, follow-ups, reminders, community posts and content. Own each piece from first draft to publishing, and measure how users respond.
* **Cohort and segment analysis.**
  Use tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel or similar to understand how different user groups behave. Spot patterns, explain what they mean and recommend what to do next.
* **Direct user feedback.**
  Call and message users to understand what is and is not working. Capture feedback in their own words and bring clear findings back to the founding team.
* **Product testing and improvement.**
  Test upcoming releases, catch bugs before customers do and document issues the team can act on. Turn user feedback and funnel gaps into specific product ideas.
* **Competitor and market research.**
  Research competitors and relevant tools. Understand their pricing, strengths and differentiators, and identify where Branly can do better.
* **Operations and urgent priorities.**
  Take ownership of work across vendors, spreadsheets, hiring pipelines, launches and other operational needs. Keep information organised, follow up with the right people and close open tasks.
* **Learn the product inside out.**
  Use Branly the way our customers do. Understand how brands show up in AI answers, so your work in growth, research and support is grounded in the product.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who wants hands-on experience building and running a business.
* You have taken ownership of something and finished it. This could be an internship project, a campus initiative, a side project or something you built yourself.
* AI-first by habit. You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day, you have used them to get real work done, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can spot a pattern, investigate a drop-off and suggest a concrete fix.
* A clear writer who can put together an email, campaign message or research note that gets to the point.
* Comfortable calling or messaging users, customers and vendors directly to get feedback or move work forward.
* Curious about startups, B2B software and marketing. You take an interest in how products find users and turn them into customers.
* Organised enough to manage several tasks, keep people updated and follow through without repeated reminders.

**Bonus points**

* You have built something with AI: an automation, a custom GPT or Claude project, or a workflow that replaced manual work.
* Hands-on experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools.
* You have run an email campaign, built an online community, created content or tested a paid campaign.
* Experience testing a product and documenting bugs clearly.
* You have built a side project, worked at a startup or helped run an online business.

**What it is like working with us**

* **Build in one of marketing's most in-demand categories.**
  More brands want to understand how AI talks about them. You will help build a product that answers that question.
* **Learn to work the AI-first way.**
  You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with workflows and habits most teams are still figuring out.
* **High ownership, high visibility.**
  You will work side by side with the founders. Your work ships fast, and you will see what it changes.
* **A seat close to the decisions.**
  You will see how growth, product and operations connect, and help shape what the team does next.
* **Learn from founders who have scaled before.**
  You will work closely with a team that has led and grown operations across industries, and you will pick up how it is done.
* **Grow as fast as you learn.**
  As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger projects and more responsibility.

title: Intern, Evaluation
company: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies - IFRC
description:
Organizational Context
  
  
The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization, with a network of 191-member National Societies (NSs). The overall aim of IFRC is “to inspire, encourage, facilitate, and promote at all times all forms of humanitarian activities by NSs with a view to preventing and alleviating human suffering and thereby contributing to the maintenance and promotion of human dignity and peace in the world.” IFRC works to meet the needs and improve the lives of vulnerable people before, during and after disasters, health emergencies and other crises.
  
  
IFRC is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement (Movement), together with its member National Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The work of IFRC is guided by the following fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality.
  
  
IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. The Headquarters are organized into four main Divisions: (i) National Society Development and Coordination; (ii) Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization; (iii) Legal, Governance Support and Accountability; and (iv) People and Strategy.
  
  
IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegations and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.
  
  
IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles.
  
  
The Evaluation function is part of the Executive Office within the People and Strategy Division. It strengthens organizational accountability and learning by coordinating the IFRC Evaluation Framework and annual evaluation plan, promoting quality standards, maintaining evaluation knowledge systems, and supporting follow-up on evaluation recommendations and management responses.
  
  
Based in New Delhi, the Intern, Evaluations – Strategic Planning and Communications supports the global Evaluation Unit across headquarters, regional offices, delegations, and National Societies. The internship combines evaluation support with data management, evidence synthesis, digital innovation, knowledge management, and strategic communication.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Intern, Evaluations – Strategic Planning and Communications supports the Evaluation Unit in organizing and analysing evaluation information, maintaining portfolio data and knowledge systems, and preparing clear, accessible products that promote the use of evaluation evidence across the IFRC network.
  
  
Under the supervision of the Coordinator, Evaluations, the intern contributes to desk reviews, data quality checks, dashboards, evidence synthesis, dissemination, and communication products. The role also supports responsible testing and documentation of digital and AI-enabled approaches, with human verification and compliance with IFRC policies.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Evaluation Research and Portfolio Support
* Support desk reviews and the organization of background documents, evaluation reports, country case studies, interview notes, and other evidence.
* Assist with evaluation planning and coordination materials, including trackers, evidence matrices, stakeholder lists, meeting records, and dissemination plans.
* Support the consolidation of evaluation findings, lessons, recommendations, management responses, and follow-up actions.
* Data Management and Quality Assurance
* Maintain and update evaluation databases, portfolio trackers, document repositories, and relevant results-based management information.
* Review records and datasets for completeness, consistency, accuracy, version control, and compliance with agreed editorial, branding, accessibility, and information-management standards.
* Clean, organize, code, and document quantitative and qualitative information for analysis and reporting.
* Dashboards, Analytics and Digital Innovation
* Support the development and routine maintenance of Tableau, Power BI, Excel, or similar dashboards for evaluation planning, progress tracking, geographic coverage, and recommendation follow-up.
* Prepare charts, maps, scorecards, and other visual summaries that make evaluation information easier to understand and use.
* Assist in testing and documenting digital or AI-supported workflows for document review, evidence synthesis, qualitative analysis, and knowledge management, ensuring human verification and adherence to data-protection and information-security requirements.
* Knowledge Management and Strategic Communications
* Help curate the IFRC Evaluation Bank and other knowledge platforms, ensuring evaluation products are accurately classified, accessible, and up to date.
* Draft and format executive-ready reports, evaluation briefs, knowledge notes, presentations, infographics, web content, and multimedia or explainer products for different audiences.
* Support communication planning and, where relevant, use web analytics to assess the reach and use of evaluation and RBM content.
* Dissemination, Coordination and Team Support
* Support webinars, workshops, reference-group meetings, learning sessions, and global dissemination events, including agendas, participant coordination, materials, technical arrangements, notes, and follow-up actions.
* Liaise with colleagues in headquarters, regional offices, delegations, and National Societies to obtain and validate information required for evaluation and learning products.
* Contribute to team planning and continuous improvement, and undertake other evaluation, knowledge-management, or communication tasks agreed with the supervisor.

**Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued)**
**Duties applicable to all staff**

* Work actively towards the achievement of the Federation Secretariat’s goals.
* Abide by and work in accordance with the Red Cross and Red Crescent principles
* Perform any other work-related duties and responsibilities that may be assigned by the line manager.

Education
  
  

* Currently enrolled in, or recently completed, a bachelor’s or master’s degree in evaluation, public policy, international development, social sciences, statistics, data science, communications, information management, humanitarian studies, or a related discipline
* Relevant coursework in monitoring and evaluation, research methods, data analysis, data visualization, knowledge management, digital communications, or humanitarian action.

**Experience**
**Required:**

* Demonstrated experience through academic work, an internship, volunteering, or employment in research, monitoring and evaluation, data management, knowledge management, communications, or programme support.
* Experience organizing, cleaning, and analysing information using Microsoft Excel or comparable tools.
* Experience preparing concise written summaries, reports, presentations, or visual communication products.
* Ability to manage several tasks, maintain accurate records, and meet agreed deadlines with appropriate supervision

**Preferred**

* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Air table, Power Automate, Google Analytics, qualitative analysis software, survey platforms, or comparable digital tools
* Experience using generative AI or automated workflows for research, evidence synthesis, data analysis, or knowledge management
* Exposure to humanitarian action, international development, nonprofit organizations, or the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.
* Experience supporting webinars, workshops, events, web content, infographics, video, or other multimedia products.

Knowledge, Skills and Languages
  
  

* Basic understanding of monitoring, evaluation, research, accountability, and organizational learning concepts.
* Familiarity with qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis approaches
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to data quality and accurate source verification.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to learn and use dashboard, visualization, design, multimedia, automation, and AI tools responsibly.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and geographically dispersed team and to handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality.
* Fluent spoken and written English. (Required)

Competencies, Values and Comments

Respect for diversity; Integrity; Professionalism; Accountability

Communication; Collaboration and teamwork; Judgement and decision making; National society and customer relations; Creativity and innovation; Building trust

description:

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer (Compute) to design and build core systems that manage containerised and virtualised workloads running on bare-metal and hybrid environments. This role is ideal for engineers who love working close to the kernel, building tools that abstract hardware complexity, and optimising infrastructure for scale and speed.
  
  
Up for the challenge? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing and maintaining compute layer, focusing Kubernetes on bare metal
* Developing infrastructure-agnostic tooling and APIs to manage hybrid cloud environments at scale
* Ensuring infrastructure reliability through proactive detection/remediation of hardware failures and auto-healing
* Managing hardware lifecycle, from procurement and installation to decommissioning and upgrades
* Collaborating closely with network, security, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and public cloud
* Documenting infrastructure processes, configurations, and best practices

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages
* 3+ years of experience managing physical hardware
* Experience with Kubernetes on bare metal and open-source storage solutions (Ceph, MinIO)
* Experience automating infrastructure tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools
* Deep knowledge of data center operations, including power distribution, cooling, and rack management
* Familiarity with server hardware and storage systems (Dell, HP, Supermicro)
* Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to hardware failures and performance bottlenecks
* Expertise in one or more object-oriented programming languages (Go, Java, Python)
* An academic background in STEM

**Nice to have**

* Professional certifications (e.g., CCNP, CKA, Google Cloud, Red Hat)
* Experience working in regulated environments (financial services)
* Familiarity with security best practices and compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, SOC2, GDPR)

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.**
Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.
  
  
**Principle Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities
* Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices
* Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency

+ Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
+ Experience with Nutanix AHV required
+ Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
+ Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting

+ Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
+ Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
+ Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
+ Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
+ Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
+ Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security

* 10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems
* 10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)
* 5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required

+ Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred

* Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required
* Managed Services or consulting experience required

* ITILv4 certification preferred

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset
* Superior customer service and training skills
* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
This role is technical in nature and focuses on building and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server and Postgres databases. You will be responsible for the delivery of database support services to FNZ platforms hosted in public cloud environments (Azure and AWS), through Infrastructure as Code pipelines and manual builds.

The Cloud Infrastructure team is small, and each team member is given the opportunity to own significant parts of the solution end to end. The Cloud DBA is expected to work with the Cloud Engineers to develop the best possible database solution for our internal stakeholders to do our part in delivering customer success.

**Team Responsibilities: -**

1. Automate the design, build, and maintenance of database environments to ensure high availability and scalability.
2. Use monitoring tools to optimize performance and proactively resolve issues.
3. Implement automated backup and disaster recovery pipelines to protect critical data.
4. Enforce security through automated user and access management.
5. Diagnose and resolve performance issues using modern diagnostic tools.
6. Leverage cloud-native automation to scale storage and manage capacity efficiently.

**Specific Role Responsibilities:-**

* Maintain and monitor Azure and AWS database services to ensure high availability and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues, optimize queries, and meet performance SLAs.
* Implement and manage backups, failover solutions, and disaster recovery plans.
* Enforce security protocols and manage access controls.
* Collaborate with the cloud engineering team to design, build, and run pipelines that automate database build and maintenance tasks.
* Support database builds and project delivery while working closely with developers to optimize performance.
* Participate in a global on-call support roster to address critical issues and maintain service reliability.
* Stay updated on Azure and AWS technologies and share knowledge with the team.
* Manage incident, problem and change management via FNZs ticketing solution.
* Participate in risk management and information security initiatives, supporting internal and external audits.
* Manage escalations to the appropriate stakeholders.

**Performance Assessment**

* Uptime and performance metrics in Azure and AWS
* Quality of security documentation and adherence to cloud security standards.
* Backup and recovery test results, and DR plan performance in cloud environments.
* Project timelines, quality metrics, and cost efficiency.

**Experience Required**

* Required2+ years of experience as a Database Administrator in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ability or strong interest in working within dynamic, high-availability environments. Exposure to or eagerness to learn about mission-critical systems is highly valued.
* Proven ability to work as an individual, with excellent self-management and time management skills.
* Ability to participate in an on-call roster and perform some work outside normal business hours.
* Superior problem-solving capabilities and the ability to multitask and re-prioritise work in a rapidly changing environment.

**Desirable**

* Experience with other cloud data storage services such as Microsoft Fabric or Power BI .

title: Senior Engineer - Cloud
description:

title: Security Solution Engineer
description:
Join us at Orange Business!.
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
OINIS Security team responsible to manage & protect backbone network infrastructure and global internet exit points of Orange Business . This includes firewalls, IPS, Proxies and other security solutions installed between different networks. CI/CD adoption to build and implement Firewall Policy Installation.
  
  
Define and maintain security requirements; animate security; define security policies to mitigate risks; promote security awareness, ensure periodic security audits and collaboration between Security and other department.
  
  
To enhance the security posture of the organization by designing, implementing, and maintaining automated security solutions that detect, respond to, and prevent security threats efficiently and effectively.
  
  
Design, build, deploy, and operate Linux-based infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
  
  
Develop and deploy automation tools and scripts that streamline security operations and collaborate with security teams to identify automation opportunities and implement best practices.
  
  
Solution Engineer is expected to propose & implement comprehensive solutions, considering both technical feasibility and business goals. Also, these solutions should integrate seamlessly with existing systems and deliver value to the organization.
  
  
**Primary Skills**

* Enterprise Linux & OS Management: Extensive hands-on experience deploying, hardening, and managing multiple enterprise Linux environments.
* Infrastructure Automation & Configuration Management: Proven ability to eliminate manual tasks and drive operational efficiency through robust automation, utilizing tools like Python, shell scripting
* CI/CD & Deployment Pipelines: Strong expertise in implementing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins.

**Secondary Skills**

* Containerization & Orchestration: Understanding of Docker and container orchestration platforms including Kubernetes and Docker Compose will be an advantage
* Networking & Protocols: Comprehensive understanding of core networking and security technologies, including Firewalls, VPNs, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, IDS/IPS, TLS/SSL, encryption protocols, and packet analysis using Wireshark.
* Cloud & Hybrid Environments: Familiarity with multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid-cloud infrastructure integration.

**About You**

* 5+ years experience in a Network Security environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
* Relevant certifications such as CCNP(Cisco Certified), RHCSA/RHCE, CKA/CKAD, Red Hat OpenShift/Kubernetes certifications
* Cloud Security certifications from either AWS, Google will be preferred.
* Certifications or proven experience in Linux administration, firewall technologies and enterprise networking.

You bring rigor, passion for challenges, and determination. You seek the opportunity to expand your expertise, achieve your goals, and thrive.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
To realize our digital transformation, we need to transform our products, experiences, processes, technology and how we operate. Delivering our clients unrivalled experience of exceptional service, value and flexibility is part of our DNA. We are looking for people who are passionate about Agile ways of working and want to spread this approach within our teams and business processes.
  
  
As we advance our digital transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to lead multiple strategic projects. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to oversee the development, configuration, and maintenance of our digital products, ensuring alignment with market trends and business needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the rollout of the Smart Booking platforms/offering to BCG offices worldwide, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption.
* Maintain and manage upgrades and enhancements to the Smart Booking platforms, ensuring their capabilities are fully leveraged within our spaces.
* Evaluate Smart Office related digital products to ensure they align with market trends and business requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder discovery for feature definition, serving as a liaison between the IT squad and stakeholders.
* Ensure epics and user stories are prioritized, updated, and available for execution.
* Write user stories and conduct refinement sessions to ensure they meet team standards and acceptance criteria.
* Support business stakeholders in eliciting business and non-functional requirements, perform gap analysis and feasibility checks, and collaborate on comprehensive test plans.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshoot issues, and answer questions.
* Utilize tools (e.g., SaaS products, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, Tableau) to maintain system configurations, access data, develop logic, and analyze datasets to meet stakeholder needs.
* Leverage automation tools like Python, MS Forms, Workflows in Alteryx, and PowerShell to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop and implement automation scripts and workflows to improve system operations.
* Deliver AI-augmented SaaS capabilities using LLMs and Agentic AI.
* Automate workflows with Power Automate and integrate SaaS applications, APIs, and data sources.
* Work with REST APIs and MCP servers for secure AI and enterprise integrations.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, ServiceNow, Jira, and Trello.
* Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer service orientation with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer needs with functional goals and objectives.
* Proficiency in cross-team collaboration to resolve challenges.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities based on customer needs.
* Experience coordinating and implementing digital solutions in a complex organizational environment.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS applications, including system configuration and integration.
* Experience working with cloud-based software and APIs.
* Working knowledge of security, access management, and data privacy for SaaS and AI solutions.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a role supporting digital products, preferably in an analyst or engineering role.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Directly interact with the Director & Chapter Lead and peers within the Product Portfolio.
* Collaborate with every member of your squad, including Product Owners, Scrum Leads, Software Engineers, and QA Engineers, as well as internal customers and technical members from other Product Portfolios.

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Proactively monitoring and resolving issues, effectively communicating with key stakeholders and management.
* Leading with a strategic vision while managing technical challenges, ensuring detailed and effective execution.
* Identifying and solving non-routine problems independently, applying broad knowledge to troubleshoot system issues.
* Translating business needs into clear, actionable Agile user stories.
* Gaining a deep understanding of digital products to serve as a subject matter expert.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in the smart booking space to ensure our product portfolio aligns with market demands.
* Understanding IT architecture and effectively extracting and analyzing data across business systems.
* Organizing and presenting data to enable quick, informed decision-making.
* Prioritizing tasks and working independently, while communicating clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Managing multiple complex tasks with high-quality results within deadlines.
* Applying Agile methodologies and principles, including work estimation techniques.
* Quickly learning and adapting to new tools and technologies.
* Collaborating with multicultural, distributed teams across time zones and managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Stay current with trends in Smart Booking, SaaS, AI, automation, APIs, and data visualization.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

* Coordinating shift coverage, stakeholder communication, vendor engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to support global customer operations.
* Providing leadership for major incident management, root cause analysis activities, process improvements, and technical knowledge sharing.

* Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising technical support teams within backup, infrastructure, storage, or managed services environments.
* Strong expertise in Commvault backup and recovery solutions, including administration, troubleshooting, configuration, and operational support.
* Knowledge of backup infrastructure concepts including disaster recovery, storage systems, deduplication, retention management, and cloud backup targets.
* Experience managing major incidents, escalations, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
* Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with the ability to engage customers, vendors, and technical teams.

title: L4- Product Support Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure
*Life Is On*
for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for
**EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)**
—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled
**L4 Product Support Engineer**
to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers.
  
  
You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes.
* Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams.
* Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution.
* Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations.

**System-Level Analysis & Integration Support**

* Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows.
* Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations.
* Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance.
* Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication
* Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups.
* Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions.
* Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops.
* Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team.

**Support for Senior L4 Initiatives**

* Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements.
* Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions.
* Support the development of troubleshooting tools, diagnostic frameworks, and automation scripts.
* Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms.
* Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with HVAC systems and building controls.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers).
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows.
* Experience working in global, multiregional support environments.

**Performance Objectives:**

* Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs.
* Improve product reliability by contributing RCAs, reproducible defect scenarios, and engineering-quality test cases.
* Reduce repeat escalations through robust analysis and knowledge sharing.
* Strengthen team capabilities through mentorship, documentation, and diagnostic tool improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and system stability.

title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: IT Operations Assoc Manager - Digital Transformation (Supply Chain)
description:
**Overview**
The primary objective of this role is to enable, optimize, and digitally transform the end-to-end supply chain by designing, delivering, and sustaining technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, service levels, cost performance, and business agility.
  
  
The role acts as a strategic partner to Supply Chain functions—
**Planning, Procurement, Agro, Manufacturing, EHS, Quality, Warehousing, Logistics, and Customer Service**
—to ensure technology investments drive tangible business outcomes.
  
  
The purpose and scope of the role is to:
  
  

* Align Supply Chain business needs with digital & IT capabilities by deeply understanding functional processes and pain points.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives that leverage automation, analytics, AI/ML, and integrated platforms to modernize supply chain operations.
* Ensure seamless orchestration of systems and data across multiple functions and partners to support real-time visibility and decision-making.
* Serve as the bridge between business teams and technical teams, enabling solutions that are technically robust, scalable, secure, reasonable in cost and deliver the intended value.
* Enable continuous improvement and adoption, ensuring that solutions are effectively utilized and continually enhanced to meet evolving business needs.
* Engage cross-functional teams including Finance/Controls, Sales, R&D, Engineering and other external supply chain partners to ensure seamless integration of IT capabilities with business processes.

**Responsibilities**
**Business Engagement & Requirement Management**

* Act as the primary IT partner for Supply Chain teams across Planning, Manufacturing, Agro, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Customer Service.
* Proactively identify digital opportunities and pain points by engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
* Gather, validate, and translate functional requirements into clear solution specifications.
* Ensure alignment of all initiatives with supply chain strategy and enterprise architecture.

**Solution Design & Functional Leadership**

* Lead functional solution design for key Supply Chain processes (e.g. transportation, logistics, warehousing, Agro etc)
* Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions based on fit, scalability, cost, and integration needs.
* Set up and actively lead design workshops, process mapping sessions, and blueprint creation.
* Ensure data, process, and integration consistency across applications.

**Project & Program Delivery**

* End-to-end ownership of digital initiatives, including planning, vendor coordination, execution, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Drive cross-functional teams to meet timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Conduct and coordinate for UAT (user acceptance test) cycles, ensuring scenarios reflect true operational needs.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.

**Stakeholder Communication & Change Management**

* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and decisions needed.
* Prepare communication materials, training documentation, and user onboarding content.
* Foster a culture of digital adoption, helping users confidently leverage new tools and systems.

**Data & Analytics Enablement**

* Support accurate and timely data flows across systems.
* Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver dashboards, KPIs, and predictive insights.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and integration integrity across supply chain applications.

**Value Delivery & Performance Tracking**

* Track benefits realization of IT investments (cost savings, service improvements, automation benefits).
* Ensure digital initiatives directly support supply chain KPIs
* Present performance insights and improvement opportunities to leadership teams.

**Continuous Improvement & Digital Optimization**

* Identify automation, simplification, and digitization opportunities across supply chain processes.
* Lead process improvement initiatives using analytics and automation.
* Influence adoption through training, communication, and capability-building interventions.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure solutions follow IT and cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and audit guidelines.
* Maintain strong controls around change management, access management, and data protection.
* Represent Supply Chain IT in governance forums and architecture councils.

**Application Operations & Support**

* Ensure day-to-day stability, performance, and availability of supply chain applications.
* Act as the escalation point for high-priority incidents and coordinate resolution with support teams.
* Drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes to minimize repeated issues.
* Maintain system documentation, SOPs, and configuration records.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Coordinate with technology vendors, implementation partners, and managed service teams.
* Evaluate vendor deliverables, quality, SLAs, and compliance.
* Ensure external partners understand business context and deliver solutions aligned with expectations.

**Qualifications**
**Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Masters in Business Management
* 10–12 years of experience in Supply Chain IT, Digital, or Business-facing roles through Consulting assignments.
* Experience delivering or supporting large-scale digital transformation programs in FMCG or related industries.
* Proven experience in multi-stakeholder, cross-functional environments.
* Exposure to global or multi-market operations

**Technical & Systems Knowledge**

* Advanced Planning Systems (e.g. APO, Blue Yonder)
* WMS/TMS solutions (e.g. Blue Yonder, SAP EWM/TM)
* Control Tower platforms
* ERP (SAP ECC/S4HANA – core MM, PP, SD modules)
* Understanding of integration technologies (APIs, EDI, IDocs, event-driven platforms).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure) and their use in enterprise applications.
