title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.

Summary:
  
  
As a Senior Intune/MECM Administrator, a typical day involves managing and supporting Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enterprise environments. The role includes administering endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration profiles, application deployments, Windows Autopilot, patch management, Windows servicing, and co-management capabilities. The administrator provides advanced 3rd-line technical support, owns EUC incidents and problems through resolution, and works closely with internal teams and third-party vendors to troubleshoot complex endpoint issues. The role also involves supporting Modern Workplace initiatives, contributing to migration and transformation projects, developing technical documentation, and providing advisory support to customers on endpoint management and security strategies.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Expected to perform independently and become an SME in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM technologies.
  
  
Own and manage EUC incidents and problems, providing 3rd-line technical support through successful resolution.
  
  
Administer and support Microsoft Intune infrastructure, endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration policies, and application management.
  
  
Manage Windows Autopilot, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, co-management, and modern endpoint provisioning solutions.
  
  
Administer MECM/SCCM infrastructure, including Distribution Points, Management Points, SUP, WSUS, collections, applications, packages, task sequences, and client health.
  
  
Manage software updates, patch deployment, Windows servicing, OSD, and application deployments across enterprise endpoints.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows client, enrollment, application, policy, and compliance issues using appropriate logs and diagnostic tools.
  
  
Configure and maintain device compliance policies, configuration profiles, security policies, VPN, Wi-Fi, email, device restrictions, and custom scripts.
  
  
Support Conditional Access, DLP, Exchange integration, certificate-based authentication, NDES, and SCEP deployments.
  
  
Manage application deployment across Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS platforms using appropriate application formats and deployment methods.
  
  
Collaborate with Microsoft and third-party vendors for advanced troubleshooting, escalation management, and resolution of critical incidents.
  
  
Support Modern Workplace initiatives by providing technical advisory services, migration roadmaps, business cases, and implementation strategies.
  
  
Contribute to Intune/MECM transformation, migration, upgrade, and co-management projects.
  
  
Collaborate with project, security, infrastructure, and service management teams to ensure successful delivery of endpoint management solutions.
  
  
Participate in team discussions and contribute to technical solutions for complex operational and project-related challenges.
  
  
Create and maintain SOPs, RACI matrices, SRTs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and KT materials.
  
  
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to junior team members and offshore/nearshore delivery teams.
  
  
Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders in a large, matrixed organization.
  
  
Ensure endpoint solutions meet organizational security, compliance, availability, performance, and operational requirements.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills
  
  
Must To Have Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM.
  
  
Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, device enrollment, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, and endpoint lifecycle management.
  
  
Strong understanding of Intune Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, Device Restrictions, Security Policies, Custom Scripts, and Remediation.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Intune application deployment for Win32, MSI, EXE, APPX, APPXBUNDLE, LOB, PKG, IPA, and APK applications.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Conditional Access, DLP, Exchange integration, device compliance, and endpoint security.
  
  
Experience with Intune and SCCM co-management and dual-management environments.
  
  
Strong MECM/SCCM experience including Collections, Application Deployment, Packages, Task Sequences, OSD, Software Updates, SUP, WSUS, DP, MP, and client troubleshooting.
  
  
Experience in SCCM infrastructure administration, upgrades, migration, Current Branch/CU maintenance, and endpoint management.
  
  
Strong understanding of Windows patch management, servicing, software update deployment, and update channel management.
  
  
Experience with Windows Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, certificate management, and Windows Server technologies.
  
  
Hands-on experience configuring VPN, Wi-Fi, email, domain join, and other endpoint configuration profiles.
  
  
Knowledge of NDES and SCEP-based certificate deployment using Microsoft Intune.
  
  
Experience managing iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS device enrollment, compliance, retirement, and wipe processes.
  
  
Familiarity with MDT and Windows image management.
  
  
Good understanding of Azure Virtual Desktop/VDI environments and integration with VMware Horizon or similar technologies.
  
  
Exposure to third-party endpoint management and security integrations such as Jamf, TeamViewer, Nexthink, and related solutions.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting, log analysis, problem-solving, customer handling, and communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make sound technical decisions.
  
  
Ability to engage with customers in an advisory capacity and translate business requirements into technical endpoint-management solutions.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management technologies.
  
  
The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM administration.
  
  
Experience supporting medium to large enterprise or global endpoint management environments is preferred.
  
  
Experience working with global customers and distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams is an advantage.
  
  
Experience in Modern Workplace transformation, endpoint migration, and co-management projects is preferred.
  
  
Experience with MDT, Nexthink, Jamf, or other EMM/endpoint management solutions is an added advantage.
  
  
A Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
  
  
Experience providing voice-based technical support and handling high-priority customer situations is desirable.

title: Head of Operations - Scaffolding & Painting
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Trade Links is a rapidly growing provider of mechanical and industrial services, specializing in industrial scaffolding, piping, civil, mechanical, and painting solutions. With thousands of completed projects across India, the company is recognized as a trusted construction partner delivering safe and cost-effective services. Its diverse, high-quality product range and strong network of reliable vendors support stringent quality standards and competitive pricing. A focus on expertise, ethical business practices, and continuous improvement has positioned Indian Trade Links as a market leader. Candidates can learn more about the company at www.indiantradelinks.in or by contacting info@indiantradelinks.in.

Head of Operations – Scaffolding & Industrial Services

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Position:**
Head of Operations

**Department:**
Operations

**Industry:**
Scaffolding / Industrial Services / Projects

**Location:**
India, with travel to project sites as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Level:**
Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and commercially aware
**Head of Operations**
to lead and control our scaffolding and industrial project operations across multiple sites.

The ideal candidate must possess
**strong practical knowledge of scaffolding operations**
, including planning, erection, modification, dismantling, material management, manpower productivity, safety compliance, measurement and billing coordination.

The position will be responsible for ensuring that projects are executed
**safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets**
, while maintaining strong client relationships.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Scaffolding Operations

* Lead and monitor scaffolding activities across all project sites.
* Have sound knowledge of
  **scaffolding erection, alteration/modification and dismantling**
  .
* Understand different scaffolding systems such as:
* Tube and coupler scaffolding
* Cup-lock/system scaffolding
* Ring-lock/system scaffolding
* Mobile scaffolds
* Birdcage scaffolds
* Suspended and cantilever arrangements, where applicable
* Review scaffolding requirements based on site conditions, work fronts, access requirements and project schedules.
* Ensure proper planning for scaffolding material, manpower and equipment.
* Monitor erected quantity versus dismantled quantity and material utilization.
* Control excessive material consumption, unnecessary scaffolding retention and material losses.

B. Project & Site Management

* Take overall responsibility for operational performance of all active projects.
* Prepare and monitor project mobilization and execution plans.
* Conduct regular reviews with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, Safety personnel and commercial teams.
* Monitor:
* Daily progress
* Planned vs. actual work
* Productivity
* Manpower deployment
* Material availability
* Site constraints
* Client priorities
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action before they affect project commitments.
* Coordinate shutdown, maintenance and high-priority activities with site teams and clients.

C. Manpower & Productivity Management

* Plan manpower requirements project-wise.
* Ensure optimum deployment of scaffolders, helpers, supervisors, engineers and other operational personnel.
* Closely monitor
  **manpower productivity against actual work output**
  .
* Prevent unnecessary overtime and idle manpower.
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization according to workload.
* Develop capable site supervisors and project leadership teams.

D. Safety & Quality

The Head of Operations must establish a strong safety culture, particularly because scaffolding is a safety-critical activity.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure scaffolding work is executed according to approved procedures, drawings and applicable client/site requirements.
* Ensure inspection and tagging systems are properly followed.
* Ensure use of appropriate fall-protection and personal protective equipment.
* Work closely with the safety team on risk assessments, job safety analysis, toolbox talks and corrective actions.
* Review accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and serious safety observations.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Participate in client safety audits and operational reviews.
* Ensure defective scaffolding material is identified, segregated and prevented from use.

E. Material & Inventory Control

* Monitor scaffolding inventory across stores and project locations.
* Review material requirements before approving additional movement or procurement.
* Control:
* Material shortages
* Excess stock
* Damage
* Loss/theft
* Inter-site transfers
* Return of dismantled material
* Ensure proper reconciliation of scaffolding material at project completion.
* Improve material utilization and reduce unnecessary rental or procurement costs.

F. Commercial & Cost Control

The role should have strong commercial awareness, not only technical knowledge.

* Monitor project budget versus actual expenditure.
* Review manpower, material, equipment and subcontracting costs.
* Support measurement and certification of completed work.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Commercial teams for timely client billing.
* Monitor unbilled work and operational issues delaying certification.
* Understand the commercial implications of additional work and scope changes.
* Support variation/change-order documentation before additional work becomes a commercial dispute.
* Drive improvement in project profitability through productivity and cost control.

G. Client Management

* Act as a senior operational contact for key clients.
* Attend project review meetings with clients.
* Handle operational escalations professionally and promptly.
* Ensure client complaints are closed with proper corrective action.
* Maintain good relationships with client Operations, Projects, Safety, Maintenance and Commercial teams.
* Protect the company's reputation through disciplined and professional site execution.

H. Reporting & Management Review

Prepare/review weekly and monthly operational dashboards covering:

* Project-wise progress
* Scaffolding quantities
* Manpower deployment
* Productivity
* Safety performance
* Material utilization
* Billing status
* Cost performance
* Major site constraints
* Client issues
* Pending decisions
* Recovery/action plans

Escalate critical issues to management with
**clear facts, financial/operational impact and recommended action**
.

3. Required Experience

* Preferably
  **10+ years of experience**
  in industrial/project operations, with substantial experience in scaffolding operations.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of scaffolding erection and dismantling activities.
* Experience managing
  **multiple industrial project sites**
  is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with large industrial clients, EPC contractors, steel plants, power plants, refineries or similar facilities is preferred.
* Experience managing large site manpower and supervisory teams.
* Good understanding of project costing, productivity and commercial controls.

4. Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in
  **Mechanical, Civil, Industrial or a related engineering discipline**
  .

Relevant scaffolding, safety or project-management certifications will be an advantage.

For an exceptionally experienced scaffolding operations professional,
**strong practical project experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications**
.

5. Essential Scaffolding Knowledge

The candidate should be able to confidently discuss and review:

* Scaffold types and their applications
* Erection and dismantling sequence
* Working platforms and access
* Guardrails and toe boards
* Bracing, ties and stability
* Base arrangements and foundations
* Loading considerations
* Inspection and tagging
* Work-at-height controls
* Material identification
* Scaffolding quantity measurement
* Material reconciliation
* Manpower productivity
* Safe modification of existing scaffolds
* Planning for shutdown and maintenance scaffolding

6. Key Skills

* Strong leadership and decision-making
* Excellent scaffolding operational knowledge
* Multi-site project management
* Manpower planning
* Cost and budget control
* Client management
* Safety leadership
* Material management
* Problem solving
* Negotiation
* Commercial awareness
* Strong communication and reporting skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent site requirements

7. Key Performance Indicators

Performance of the Head of Operations should be measured using objective business and project metrics such as:

* Safety compliance
* Project schedule adherence
* Scaffolding productivity
* Manpower utilization
* Material utilization and recovery
* Reduction in material loss/damage
* Project cost versus budget
* Billing and measurement readiness
* Client issue closure
* Rework reduction
* Timely mobilization/demobilization
* Project close-out performance

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a
**strong operations leader who understands scaffolding from the ground level and can also manage the commercial side of projects**
.

* The candidate should be comfortable moving between a project site, a client review meeting and a management profitability review. This is
  **not purely an office-based managerial position**
  . Regular involvement with project sites and operational teams will be essential.

**Preferred**

• A hospitality background in Quality and/or Learning & Development

• Experience in luxury hotels

• A hotel management degree or diploma (not mandatory)

• Knowledge of Arabic and/or Spanish (an advantage)

**Working Arrangement**

• Remote (work from home); candidates from any country may apply

We thank all interested professionals for their consideration. This position is only for candidates with a hospitality background and direct hotel experience. Candidates with training or Learning & Development experience alone, without hotel experience, are respectfully requested not to apply.

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
**IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe**
, you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
  
  
Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
**joiner to mover to leaver**
. You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access-request, and access-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.

**What You Will Bring**
You should have more than 3 years of experience in operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
  
  
**We Are Looking For**

* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**

* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.

**Your new team**
You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long-term operational ownership.
  
  
This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.

**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline: 18-10-2026**
.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
We are looking for a
**skilled, analytical, and result-oriented SEO Executive**
with a strong understanding of traditional SEO, modern AI-powered search optimisation, and content strategies.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in
**On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Off-Page SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), AIO (AI Optimisation), and E-E-A-T principles**
.

You will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and improving organic search strategies across multiple client websites, with a strong focus on Google rankings, organic traffic, qualified leads, and visibility across AI-powered search platforms.

Key Responsibilities1. SEO Strategy & Execution

* Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies for multiple client projects.
* Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and keyword mapping.
* Manage complete On-Page SEO, including metadata, headings, URLs, internal linking, image optimisation, and content structure.
* Conduct technical SEO audits and coordinate with developers to resolve issues.
* Optimise website architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonical tags, redirects, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and structured data implementation.
* Identify ranking opportunities, traffic gaps, and SEO growth potential.

2. GEO, AEO & AI Search Optimisation

* Develop strategies to improve website visibility across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, and other AI-powered discovery platforms.
* Optimise content for conversational queries, question-based searches, entity relevance, and direct-answer formats.
* Implement GEO and AEO best practices, including structured content, semantic relevance, and accurate schema markup.
* Understand AI-driven search behaviour, zero-click searches, and evolving search engine algorithms.
* Improve brand discoverability, topical authority, and content credibility across traditional and AI search experiences.
* Analyse AI-generated search visibility and recommend practical improvements.

3. Content Planning, Assignment & Optimisation

* Prepare SEO content strategies, topic clusters, content calendars, and keyword-based content plans.
* Create detailed content briefs and assign articles, landing pages, blogs, and service-page content to content writers.
* Define primary and secondary keywords, search intent, content outlines, internal links, and SEO requirements.
* Review submitted content for quality, originality, accuracy, keyword relevance, and SEO effectiveness.
* Ensure content aligns with
  **E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness)**
  principles.
* Coordinate with writers, designers, and developers for timely content publication.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to refresh existing pages.

4. Off-Page SEO & Authority Building

* Plan and execute ethical, white-hat link-building campaigns.
* Perform backlink analysis, competitor backlink research, and link prospecting.
* Manage relevant outreach, digital PR opportunities, and quality link acquisition.
* Conduct backlink audits and identify potentially harmful or spammy links.
* Work on brand mentions, citations, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation, and business listings where applicable.
* Track referring domains, backlink quality, and organic authority growth.
* Avoid spammy link-building practices and manipulative SEO techniques.

5. SEO Tools, Analytics & Reporting

**Strong hands-on experience with the following tools is expected:**

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (basic understanding)
* Ahrefs / SEMrush
* Screaming Frog SEO Spider
* Google Keyword Planner
* Google PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse
* Google Trends
* Rich Results Test / Schema Markup Validator
* Google Looker Studio
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI research or SEO productivity tools

**Additional tool knowledge:**
Surfer SEO, Frase, SE Ranking, Moz, Microsoft Clarity, and Rank Math / Yoast SEO will be an advantage.

6. Performance Monitoring & Client Reporting

* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, CTR, conversions, and leads.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Track SEO deliverables, content assignments, published pages, backlinks, and technical improvements.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Maintain project trackers and ensure deadlines are met.
* Coordinate with internal teams and communicate SEO progress professionally.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum
  **2 years of practical SEO experience**
  , preferably in a digital marketing agency.
* Proven experience handling multiple SEO projects independently.
* Strong technical, on-page, and off-page SEO knowledge.
* Working understanding of GEO, AEO, AIO, and AI-driven search trends.
* Experience in keyword clustering, topic planning, content briefing, and assigning tasks to writers.
* Strong understanding of E-E-A-T, Google Search Essentials, and search intent.
* Ability to perform comprehensive SEO audits and prepare actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript SEO fundamentals, and CMS platforms such as WordPress and Shopify.
* Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and written English communication.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with international SEO projects targeting the USA, Canada, UK, or other global markets.
* Knowledge of Local SEO, e-commerce SEO, and programmatic SEO.
* Familiarity with Laravel, Next.js, or other JavaScript-based websites from a technical SEO perspective.
* Experience implementing and validating structured data.
* Basic knowledge of SEO automation and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrable improvements in organic visibility, relevant traffic, or conversions.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine keyword placement and backlink creation.

The candidate should be capable of
**thinking strategically, identifying growth opportunities, managing content execution, solving SEO challenges, and adapting to the changing search landscape driven by AI.**

**A proactive attitude, ownership of assigned projects, and a results-oriented mindset are essential.**

Why Join SAM Web Studio?

* Work on diverse Indian and international client projects.
* Gain hands-on exposure to SEO, GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search strategies.
* Collaborate with web developers, designers, and content teams.
* Opportunity to take ownership of SEO campaigns and contribute to measurable business growth.
* Professional working environment with opportunities for career advancement.

**Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**

and uses AI tools intelligently to work faster and smarter.

•   Analyse data to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into clear recommendations.

•   Present SEO and GEO performance, insights and strategy to clients and internal teams with confidence.

**﻿
What We're Looking For**

**Experience & Education**

•   Bachelor's or Master's degree with around
**3 years of hands-on SEO and analytics experience**

.

•   Working knowledge of GEO / AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) principles and how AI search platforms select and cite sources.

•   Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.

Send your CV and a short note on how you are approaching SEO in the age of AI search to:

**glen.ireland@eightytwenty.co.in**

description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for

  by identifying recurring questions, pain points and signals that can improve conversion and the overall experience.
* **Work closely across teams**
  with Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while keeping lead and interaction data accurate and up to date.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 1+ years of experience in pre-sales, sales, customer success or another customer-facing role.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance**
  covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning & development credits**
  to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support**
  to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Customer Support Associate
description:
**About Zoop**

Zoop sells fashion through live auctions. We own our supply: factory outlet stock and excess and liquidation inventory from brands and manufacturers. Our in-house studios and creators sell it live, every day. We are based in New Delhi and backed by Peak XV Partners (Surge) and Lumikai.

**The role**

You will be the person our buyers talk to. Every question about an order — where it is, what size it was, why it looked different, how to send it back — comes to you, and how you answer it decides whether that buyer bids again.

Live auctions move fast and buy decisions are made in seconds, so our customers reach out often and expect quick, clear answers. You will handle those conversations end to end on WhatsApp and in-app chat, and you will own the problem until it is actually solved, not until it is passed on.

You will work closely with the operations, warehouse and studio teams, and report to the founders.

**What you'll do**

* **Answer buyer queries.**

  Handle WhatsApp and in-app chat conversations on order status, sizing, product condition, payments, shipping timelines and anything else buyers ask.
* **Own post-purchase end to end.**

  Process returns and refunds, chase delivery escalations with courier partners, and stay on a case until the buyer has an outcome.
* **Resolve, don't route.**

  Dig into what actually went wrong — wrong item, missed pickup, stuck shipment — and fix it, pulling in ops or warehouse only when you need them.
* **Set expectations honestly.**

  Our stock is surplus and off-price, so condition and sizing vary. Explain that clearly before a buyer is disappointed, not after.
* **Close the loop on quality.**

  Flag recurring complaints — a lot that keeps coming back, a supplier with sizing issues, a courier that keeps failing — to the sourcing and ops teams with the data to back it up.
* **Keep response and resolution times tight.**

  Work to our first-response and resolution targets across every open conversation, including on live show days when volume spikes.
* **Build the playbook.**

  Write and improve canned responses, FAQs and escalation SOPs as we grow, so the next five people on this team start faster than you did.

**Who we're looking for**

* 1–3 years in customer support, customer success or post-purchase operations, ideally at a D2C brand, marketplace or e-commerce company.
* Writes clearly and calmly in Hindi and English, and can switch between them the way our buyers do.
* Patient with frustrated customers without becoming a pushover on policy.
* Comfortable owning a problem across teams and following up until it's closed.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and support tools: tracking tickets, response times, return reasons and repeat issues.
* Organised enough to run 40+ open conversations without losing track of any of them.

**Preferred**

* Experience on a WhatsApp-first support setup, and with tools like Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar.
* Has handled returns, refunds and courier escalations directly with logistics partners.
* Has worked in fashion or apparel and can speak credibly about fit, fabric and sizing.
* Experience supporting customers in a live commerce, quick commerce or high-volume sale environment.

**How we'll measure success**

* First-response and resolution time across WhatsApp and in-app chat.
* Percentage of cases resolved without escalation.
* Return and refund turnaround time.
* Customer satisfaction on resolved conversations.
* Repeat purchase rate among buyers who raised an issue.
* Recurring issues identified and fixed at source, not just handled case by case.

**Role details**

**Location:**

New Delhi, in-office

**Type:**

Full-time

**Reporting:**

Founders

**Compensation:**

Competitive salary + ESOPs

To apply, send your CV and a short note on the hardest customer situation you've handled: what the customer wanted, what you could actually offer, and how it ended.

title: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security
description:
**Designation: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security**

**Support level: L2 Operations**

**Domain: Network Security**

**Scope: Palo Alto Firewalls, Zscaler, SSE, ZTNA, Enterprise Browser, Internet Security (SWG and FWaaS), and Private Access**

**Job Location / Reporting Location: NCR - Gurugram**

**Process:**

• End-to-end incident management, from L1/L1.5 escalation to closure.

• Run firewall health checks (CPU and memory) and act on breaches.

• Collect logs and evidence for firewall alert events.

• Troubleshoot reported issues and check network connectivity.

• Enable new access per application needs, through the client's change process.

• Handle port and rule requests from other teams, including server teams.

• Apply firewall patches and OS upgrades under change control.

• Handle outage calls to restore connectivity.

• Support Zscaler and Palo Alto firewalls.

• Protect data in transit and at rest from unauthorised access.

• Report security issues promptly with recommended actions.

• Follow client security standards and guidelines.

• Keep ServiceNow tickets current, with clear resolution and closure notes.

• Join RCA reviews. Update SOPs and knowledge-base articles.

• Work with Connectivity, Hosting, IDAM, DLP and Malware Tools on cross-tower issues.

• Trace policy evaluation in SSE (Zscaler Internet Access, Prisma Access and similar) – URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DLP, CASB – and in Prisma Access (security, decryption, URL filtering rules) to find unexpected allows or blocks.

• Diagnose Private Access failures across application segments, segment groups, server groups, access policies and Private Service Edge.

• Troubleshoot forwarding profiles, PAC files, trusted network detection and bypass configuration.

• Diagnose GRE and IPsec tunnel failures to Zscaler, and Remote Network and Service Connection tunnels in Prisma Access, including IKE/IPsec phase issues.

• Resolve DNS issues for private apps, including split DNS, conditional forwarding and DNS search domains.

• Troubleshoot SAML assertion and attribute problems, SCIM provisioning failures and group sync issues with Entra ID, Okta or Ping.

• Resolve device posture and trusted network check failures.

• Take and analyse packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump, connector-side captures).

• Correlate logs across the SSE platform, SIEM, IdP and endpoint tools.

• Use ZDX and ADEM data to diagnose latency, edge selection and path problems.

**Tools:**

• Palo Alto firewalls (Cloud Firewalls)

• Zscaler

• Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Strata Logging Service, Prisma Access

• Splunk SIEM

• Datadog

• Enterprise monitoring tools

• ServiceNow

• Okta (secondary skill)

**Technologies:**

• Subject-matter expertise (8+ years) in NGFWs, WAFs, multi-cloud networking and security controls, core networking protocols, and security architecture – primarily Palo Alto, AWS and Azure, with GCP and Alibaba Cloud as a plus.

• Deploying security policies with IPS, URL filtering, DNS security and SSL inspection.

• Firewall security policy tuning with tools such as AlgoSec.

• Quickly identifying and remediating root cause.

• ITaaS, ITIL, monitoring and metrics.

• Multi-cloud networking.

• Firewall administration.

• Secure web gateway.

• Access and rule management.

• Network segmentation.

• Firewall log analysis.

• TCP/IP and routing basics.

• Python or Ansible scripting.

• IaC tooling: GitHub, Octopus, Terraform.

• DNS expertise.

**Experience:**

• 12 years of experience in L2 network security operations

• 24x7 support environment

• Palo Alto firewall administration

• Zscaler administration (scope to be confirmed)

• Enterprise networking expertise

• Firewall rule and port request handling

• Log and evidence collection

• ITSM incident, problem and change processes

• Clear written and spoken English

**Certifications:**

• Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE

• Zscaler administrator certification

• CCNA

• A Proxy / SSE industry certification (Zscaler or Palo Alto)

title: GIS Subject Matter Expert
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**GIS Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
with 7+ years of professional experience to support Environmental, Social, Health & Safety (ESHS), Sustainability, ESG, and Impact Assessment projects across infrastructure, renewable energy, industrial, urban development, transportation, water, and manufacturing sectors. The role will focus on geospatial analysis, map development, web GIS applications, spatial databases, and GIS-based decision support for environmental and social assessments. GIS capabilities are an integral part of Ramboll's impact assessment, environmental review, site evaluation, due diligence, and sustainability services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop high-quality GIS maps, figures, dashboards, StoryMaps, and spatial products using ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online in accordance with Ramboll cartographic and quality standards.
* Conduct spatial analyses including environmental constraints mapping, land-use assessment, accessibility studies, socio-economic profiling, cumulative impact assessment, climate risk screening, and site suitability analysis.
* Integrate environmental, social, infrastructure, demographic, regulatory, and satellite datasets to support project planning and decision-making.
* Support project teams in site selection, alternatives assessment, permitting, due diligence, stakeholder engagement, and impact assessment studies.
* Develop and maintain web GIS applications, ArcGIS Online solutions, dashboards, and interactive mapping tools.
* Manage geospatial datasets, metadata, quality assurance, and GIS standards.
* Support biodiversity screening, critical habitat assessments, social baseline studies, climate risk assessments, and ESG due diligence through geospatial analysis.
* Prepare maps and geospatial deliverables for technical reports, client presentations, lender reviews, and regulatory submissions.
* Collaborate with environmental, social, biodiversity, health & safety, climate, and sustainability specialists in multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to proposal preparation, methodology development, innovation initiatives, and business development activities.
* Mentor junior GIS analysts and support the development of GIS best practices and workflows.
* Ensure all GIS deliverables adhere to organisational GIS standards, data governance requirements, cartographic guidelines, metadata standards, and quality assurance processes. Promote consistent use of approved ArcGIS workflows, templates, symbology standards, and enterprise geospatial services across projects.
* Support the development and maintenance of the organisation's enterprise geospatial ecosystem, including ArcGIS Online content, shared data services, map templates, and reusable GIS workflows.
* Review GIS outputs produced by other team members to ensure compliance with organizational standards, project requirements, and client expectations.
* Act as the geospatial subject matter expert for Environment & Health projects, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and best-practice recommendations to project teams and junior GIS professionals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in GIS, Geography, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Geology, or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of relevant GIS and geospatial analysis experience.
* Strong proficiency in ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Enterprise GIS, Web GIS, spatial databases, and geospatial data management. Experience with other GIS platforms is beneficial; however, GIS production workflows, map authoring, cartography, and client deliverables should be developed using the organisations standard ArcGIS platform.
* Experience in environmental and social impact assessments, sustainability, infrastructure planning, renewable energy, or related sectors.
* Experience working with satellite imagery, remote sensing data, and geospatial modelling techniques.

title: Performance makreting
description:
We are looking for a data-driven and creative Performance Marketing Manager to lead our paid acquisition channels and scale our online store growth. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns that drive traffic, customer acquisition, and high Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  
The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of e-commerce metrics, an analytical mindset, and a sharp eye for what makes creative fashion ad content convert.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
• Campaign Management: Strategy, setup, and day-to-day management of paid acquisition channels, primarily focusing on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, and marketplaces.
  
• ROAS & Budget Optimization: Track, allocate, and optimize daily/monthly budgets to hit monthly revenue targets while maintaining healthy Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC)
  
• A/B Testing: Continuously run split tests on ad copy, visuals, landing pages, and audience targeting to maximize conversion rates.
  
• Data & Analytics: Monitor and analyze e-commerce KPIs (Conversion Rate, AOV, LTV, Click-Through Rate) using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Shopify analytics, and ad platforms.
  
• Reporting: Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting key insights, wins, losses, and strategic next steps for leadership.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
• Experience: 3+ years of proven experience managing performance marketing campaigns specifically for an e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand (fashion/apparel experience is a huge plus).
  
• Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (including Performance Max), and marketplaces ads
  
• E-commerce Stack: Proficiency with Shopify (or similar e-commerce platforms) and Google Analytics (GA4).
  
• Analytical Skills: Strong ability to manipulate data, interpret trends, and turn complex numbers into actionable growth strategies.
  
• Creative Instincts: Understanding of what hooks a customer visually in the fashion space and how to guide content creators to produce high-converting assets.
  
• Mindset: Highly organized, detail-oriented, agile, and comfortable working in a fast-paced retail environment.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
• performance-based Commission on sales upto 10%
  
• Generous employee discount on all products
  
• Flexible working hours and hybrid options.
  
• Clear paths for career growth in a rapidly expanding business.

description:

title: Industrial Trainee - Internal Audit
description:
**Role Purpose**

To support the Internal Audit function in conducting risk-based audits, Internal Financial

Controls (IFC) testing, process reviews, compliance audits, and ensuring timely closure

of audit observations across business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Internal Audit Execution

• Conduct process audits across business functions (Sourcing, Finance, Stores,

Production, HR, etc.).

• Perform risk assessment and identify control gaps.

• Execute audit programs and document working papers.

• Evaluate adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls.

• Draft audit observations with root cause analysis and risk rating.

• Discuss findings with process owners and obtain management responses.

2. Internal Financial Controls (IFC) Testing

• Perform design and operating effectiveness testing of IFC controls.

• Assist in preparation and updating of Risk Control Matrix (RCM).

• Identify control deficiencies and suggest remediation measures.

• Support management in strengthening financial reporting controls.

• Track remediation of IFC gaps.

3. Risk & Governance

• Assist in enterprise risk identification and documentation.

• Monitor key financial and operational risks.

• Evaluate compliance with policies, SOPs, and statutory requirements.

• Support governance framework improvements.

4. Compliance & Regulatory Review

• Review compliance with Companies Act, GST, Income Tax, Labour Laws, MSME

Act, etc.

• Ensure proper documentation and record retention as per statutory

requirements.

• Identify non-compliance areas and recommend corrective actions.

5. Audit Reporting & Follow-up

• Prepare draft audit reports with actionable recommendations.

• Maintain audit tracker and monitor closure of findings within agreed timelines.

• Conduct follow-up audits to ensure effective implementation.

• Maintain documentation repository for audit evidence.

6. Data Analysis & Controls Monitoring

• Perform data analytics for exception identification.

• Review transactional data for anomalies, fraud indicators, or control breaches.

• Assist in automation of audit processes where feasible.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

• Completion of audits as per audit plan.

• Timely closure of audit findings.

• Effective IFC testing with minimal repeat observations.

• Improvement in control environment maturity.

• Proactive identification of financial and operational risks.

**Qualifications & Experience**

• CA Inter / CMA / MBA (Finance) / Semi-qualified professional.

• 1–4 years of experience in Internal Audit / Risk Advisory / IFC.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and internal controls.

• Knowledge of ERP systems.

• Good drafting and communication skills

* Maintain proper documentation for GST, TDS, statutory audits, and tax assessments.
* Ensure timely closure of accounts payable at month-end.
* Review outstanding expenses, unbilled liabilities, vendor advances, and other payable balances.
* Prepare ageing reports, overdue payment reports, vendor outstanding statements, and payment forecasts.
* Reconcile accounts payable balances with the general ledger and assist in balance sheet reviews.
* Support monthly financial reporting and audit schedules.
* Coordinate with procurement, operations, HR, warehouse, and other departments for invoice approvals and supporting documents.
* Ensure compliance with the company's financial policies, approval matrix, and internal controls.
* Identify opportunities to improve invoice processing, payment tracking, and reconciliation processes.
* Guide and review the work of the accounts payable team, wherever applicable.
* Support internal, statutory, GST, and tax audits by providing the required records and explanations.

**Skills & Qualifications**
****Must-Have****

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
* 4–7 years of relevant experience in accounts payable, vendor accounting, team handling, and statutory compliance.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, vendor reconciliations, and month-end closing.
* Hands-on experience with Tally ERP/Tally Prime and advanced Excel.
* Strong accounting and reconciliation skills.
* Good understanding of GST and TDS provisions.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors and payment deadlines.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage a team and work independently.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a multi-location or multi-branch organisation.
* Knowledge of ERP systems and invoice processing workflows.

The Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment & Learning (RMEAL) function at CSF serves as the organization's central evidence and learning spine. You will work in close partnership with the EdTech vertical to ensure evaluations are methodologically robust, decision-relevant, and embedded into program and ecosystem strategy.

Evidence Design & Methodological Execution:
  
  

* Design and review rigorous evaluation approaches (RCTs, quasi-experimental, mixed-methods).

* Guide end-to-end evaluation processes.

* Translate findings into actionable insights and learning products.

**Stakeholder & Partner Engagement**

* Strong collaboration and influencing skills.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and multiple workstreams.

Compensation will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks.

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!

title: Lead - Leasing & Warehousing
description:
Lead – Leasing & Warehousing

Purpose of the Role

The Lead – Leasing & Warehousing will be responsible for driving leasing growth, optimizing warehouse occupancy, and supporting investment decisions across existing and prospective warehousing assets. The role focuses on end-to-end leasing management, commercial evaluation, client onboarding, contract execution, warehouse readiness, and customer relationship management. The incumbent will play a critical role in maximizing asset utilization, enhancing customer experience, and aligning warehousing operations with business growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Leasing & Business Development

Drive end-to-end leasing transactions, including lead generation, negotiations, LOI finalization, term sheet preparation, and execution of lease agreements. Collaborate with legal, finance, and operational teams to ensure timely closure of leasing opportunities. Support occupancy enhancement initiatives and maximize revenue realization across warehousing assets. Identify and develop relationships with prospective clients across diversified industry segments.

Investment Analysis & Commercial Evaluation

Evaluate new warehousing and leasing opportunities through financial modeling, IRR calculations, feasibility assessments, and business case preparation. Support investment decision-making by conducting techno-commercial evaluations and market viability studies. Monitor and analyze project financial performance against planned investment objectives.

Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

Ensure seamless transition of customers from the leasing phase to warehouse operations through structured onboarding and handover processes. Act as a key point of contact for customers to address operational and commercial concerns. Drive superior customer experience through proactive engagement, issue resolution, and service excellence.

Market Intelligence & Business Insights

Track market trends, warehousing demand-supply dynamics, rental benchmarks, and competitor activities. Generate actionable market intelligence to support pricing strategies, leasing decisions, and business expansion initiatives. Strengthen direct customer engagement to understand evolving market requirements and identify growth opportunities.

Budgeting & Cost Management

Support annual budgeting exercises, leasing forecasts, and capital expenditure planning. Monitor leasing-related expenditures and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Contribute to cost optimization initiatives while maintaining operational effectiveness.

Contract & Compliance Management

Coordinate preparation, review, and execution of lease-related documentation. Ensure compliance with approved commercial terms, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements. Maintain contract records and monitor key lease obligations and milestones.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards to track leasing pipeline, occupancy levels, warehouse utilization, revenue performance, and turnaround timelines. Generate periodic management reports and present insights to business leadership for decision-making. Leverage CRM systems and digital tools to improve pipeline visibility and reporting accuracy.

Digital Transformation & Innovation

Drive adoption of digital platforms and automation tools across leasing and warehousing processes. Stay updated on emerging technologies, digital solutions, and AI-driven capabilities to improve business efficiency and competitiveness. Identify opportunities for process improvements through data analytics and technology enablement.

People Leadership

Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Mentor and guide team members to enhance capabilities and professional growth. Build high-performing teams focused on achieving business and customer-centric objectives.

Key Stakeholders

Internal Stakeholders: Business Head – Agri Logistics & Warehousing, Head – Warehousing, Functional Heads and Cross-Functional Teams, Operations, Finance, Legal, Projects, and Commercial Teams, Direct and Indirect Reportees. External Stakeholders: Customers across diverse industry sectors, Government and Regulatory Authorities, Industry Associations, Trade Bodies, and Federations, Consultants, Channel Partners, and Service Providers, Market Competitors and Industry Networks.

Educational Qualifications

Full-time Graduate from a recognized institution. MBA / PGDM in Business Administration, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline preferred.

Experience

10–15 years of relevant experience in Leasing, Warehousing, Industrial/Logistics Real Estate, Business Development, and Investment Analysis. Proven track record in leasing closures, commercial negotiations, client relationship management, and warehousing

Experience working with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 9001, STQC, SOC2, etc.) is a plus.

description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Senior Vulnerability Remediation Engineer

P R O D U C T S E C U R I T Y · A N A P L A N

**Reports to:**
Senior Manager, Platform Security
  
**Working model:**
Gurugram (Hybrid)

Why this role matters

This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan! In this role, you will be at the forefront of scaling security through automation and self-service. You’ll be the driving force behind transforming security intent into enforced, self-service controls across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines. Think dependency policy, secrets handling, least-privilege access, and the guardrails that allow engineering teams to innovate rapidly without compromising security.

When done right, this is some of the most high-leverage work in our function. Every control you implement will run continuously for every team, seamlessly integrated into their workflows!

Why Anaplan

Anaplan is not just another SaaS application; it’s a powerful platform that performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modeling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. Our technical landscape is rich and varied, featuring the legacy Hyperblock engine, the innovative Polaris engine, and an expanding suite of AI-powered products like CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational, analyst-style planning support.

With AI revolutionizing software development, we are embracing more generated code and autonomous changes, making the need for encoded, verifiable guardrails more critical than ever. Security is woven into the fabric of how our platform evolves, rather than treated as an afterthought. Join our small, dynamic team where your contributions to automation will set the gold standard!

What you'll do

* Automate across the pipeline: build security automation into CI/CD and the broader SDLC so that controls run as code.
* Leverage AI to scale security automation: harness AI and LLM-assisted tools to speed up control development, triage, and remediation, extending automated coverage beyond what traditional scripts can achieve.
* Implement policy-as-code: encode guardrails for dependency and package policies, secrets, and configurations so they enforce themselves effortlessly.
* Build the controlled-repository model: automate the restriction of external dependencies and provide safe, approved package paths for our engineers.
* Automate secrets management and detection: ensure mishandled or leaked secrets are automatically caught and managed without the need for manual sweeps.
* Reduce standing privilege: develop automation for least privilege and just-in-time access, making persistent access the exception rather than the rule.
* Tame scanner output: integrate detection into low-noise, actionable workflows that feed remediation, preventing overwhelming flood of alerts.
* Automate attack-surface hardening: drive the creation of hardened, golden images and enforce baselines through code.
* Make controls self-service: default to providing engineers with a paved path wherever it’s safe to do so, rather than imposing unnecessary gates.

What we're looking for

* Strong automation and engineering skills, particularly in languages such as Python or Go, along with expertise in infrastructure-as-code and pipeline work.
* In-depth knowledge of DevSecOps: CI/CD security and hands-on experience with policy-as-code using tools like OPA, Conftest, or Kyverno.
* Foundational understanding of cloud-native security, particularly in Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider, along with knowledge of secrets management and identity basics.
* A builder's instinct: you create tools that engineers love because they simplify their work.
* Genuine care for developer experience, always striving to reduce friction rather than adding unnecessary barriers.
* The discernment to identify which controls are truly worth encoding and which can be set aside.

Nice to have

* Experience with supply-chain security: understanding of provenance and signing, as well as software or model bills of materials.
* Familiarity with zero-trust and least-privilege automation, including just-in-time access.
* Experience working in a regulated, enterprise environment.
* Contributions to open-source security tooling or relevant certifications.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
