title: Founders’ Office
description:
**Founder's Office \| Growth Valley Community** 




 Gurugram (in\-office) \| Full\-time \| 1\-5 years experience \| Reports directly to the Founder
 



  





 Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.
 



  





 Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A
 **consistent** 
 growth story will be awarded.
 



  





**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.** 




  





**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.** 




  





**About GVC.** 




  





 Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000\+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.
 



  





 Product\-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.
 



  





**The role.** 




  





 You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.
 



  





 This is the highest\-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.
 



  





**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:** 




  




* **Enrollment engine.** 
 Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.



  




* **Admissions product.** 
 We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.



  




* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1\.** 
 A new one\-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.



  




* **Partnerships.** 
 Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.



  




* **The numbers.** 
 Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.



  





**How we will measure you.** 




 Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.
 



  





**Who fits.** 



* Tier\-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1\-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.



  





**Who should not apply.** 




  





 If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.
 



  





**Compensation.** 




  





 fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG\-level.
 



  





**Growth path.** 




  





 This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.
 



  





**How to apply.** 




  





 Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com
 


1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.



 Subject line: FO \| Your Name \| College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

title: Independent Director
description:
**Enterprise context** 




  





 The company owns or controls reusable transport assets that circulate among producers, logistics nodes, distributors and other supply\-chain participants. Its value proposition depends on asset availability, standardisation, durability, hygiene, recovery and repeated use. The assets leave direct company custody for much of their life, making identification, location, condition and contractual accountability central to the model.
 



  





 Growth in movements can conceal value destruction when assets are lost, dwell too long, return damaged, require excessive repositioning or fail hygiene standards. Revenue may be recorded per trip, period, service or managed pool, while the company continues to carry replacement, repair, cleaning and recovery obligations. The Board seeks an Independent Director who can connect physical asset truth with revenue quality, customer economics and credible circularity.
 



  





**Board mandate** 




  





 The Director will oversee pool sizing, asset custody, cycle\-time economics, cleaning and inspection, repair, customer contracts, tracking data, loss provisions, capital allocation, reverse logistics and sustainability claims. The appointee will help the company scale without using new asset purchases to conceal weak recovery or customer\-level economics.
 



  





 The role requires a disciplined view of network effects. A larger pool is valuable only when asset turns, interoperability, availability and recovery improve. Complexity from bespoke assets, fragmented standards or one\-way lanes can reduce returns even while revenue and deployed units rise.
 



  





**Strategic and governance responsibilities** 




  




1. Establish asset\-register integrity.
 
 Govern unique identification, commissioning, ownership, customer assignment, movement, repair, retirement and physical verification. Duplicate or missing identities require investigation.
2. Make custody explicit.
 
 Define responsibility at each handoff, proof of transfer, permitted use, sub\-transfer, storage, damage, loss and dispute resolution. Contract language and operating practice must agree.
3. Measure complete cycle time.
 
 Track customer dwell, transport, cleaning, inspection, repair, depot waiting and repositioning. Revenue trips alone do not reveal asset productivity.
4. Govern hygiene and contamination.
 
 Establish prior\-use restrictions, cleaning method, water and chemical parameters, inspection, release, segregation and response to suspected contamination.
5. Strengthen repair and fitness standards.
 
 Define damage classification, repair methods, parts, inspection, load integrity and retirement. Commercial pressure must not return an unsafe or unsuitable asset to service.
6. Improve pool\-sizing decisions.
 
 Use demand variability, cycle time, loss, peak buffer, lane imbalance, customer growth and recovery capability. Purchases should not automatically follow billed movement.
7. Make customer economics visible.
 
 Include asset capital, dwell, loss, cleaning, repair, repositioning, data support, service levels, receivables and end\-of\-contract recovery.
8. Control loss and provisioning.
 
 Separate confirmed loss, disputed custody, overdue return, damage beyond repair and unverified location. Provisions should reflect recoverability evidence and ageing.
9. Govern tracking technology.
 
 Review tag or sensor coverage, read reliability, battery or device life, tamper risk, data ownership, access, integration and reconciliation to physical counts.
10. Manage network concentration.
 
 Assess dependence by customer, lane, depot, carrier, asset format and cleaning facility. A large contract should not make the pool operationally captive.
11. Protect capital discipline.
 
 Compare new assets, depot automation, tracking, repair capability and acquisitions using collected return, asset turns, loss reduction and downside residual value.
12. Prepare for disruptions.
 
 Test customer failure, asset detention, contamination, border or route closure, depot outage, tracking failure, recall, transport interruption and sudden volume decline.
13. Substantiate circularity.
 
 Measure verified cycles, useful life, repair, material composition, retirement and recovery. Avoid claiming avoided single\-use packaging without a defensible comparison boundary.
14. Build institutional governance.
 
 Strengthen financial close, internal audit, related\-party controls, whistle\-blower independence, leadership succession, risk reporting and readiness for future capital or listing scrutiny.



  





**Decisions expected at Board level** 




  





 The Director will contribute to major pool investments, bespoke asset formats, long\-duration customer agreements, tracking platforms, depot and wash capacity, acquisitions, asset\-backed finance, regional expansion and strategic transaction readiness.
 



  





 Every material proposal should identify custody, target turns, dwell assumptions, recovery rights, loss and damage, cleaning, repositioning, working capital, service liability and residual value. Bespoke pools should include enforceable customer commitments and an exit route if forecast movements do not occur.

description:
**Essential Services : Role \& Location fungibility** 




 At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360\-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
 **One Bank, One Team** 
 . To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
 **role and location\-fungible** 
 with the understanding that
 **Banking is an essential service** 
 . The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.
 



  





**About the program** 




 The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals to pursue a career in banking, with a strong focus on learning, capability building, and cultural grounding. The program prepares participants to join the Bank as Relationship Managers in a sales role, guided by the Bank’s culture of “seva bhav”\- serving customers with integrity, empathy, and responsibility. In this sales role, you will engage closely with customers to understand their needs, build long\-term relationships, and responsibly offer appropriate banking solutions, in line with the Bank’s values of truth, trust, and transparency, and the principle of being fair to the customer and fair to the Bank. The role involves continuous customer interactions and may require travel within and around the assigned location or city.
 



 The program includes 2 months of structured classroom training at a residential campus, the cost of which is borne by ICICI Bank. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be placed in Relationship Management (sales) roles at various locations across the country
 



**Read more about the program below!** 




  





**Eligibility** 



* **Education:** 
 Graduates, Engineers, Post Graduates
* **Qualification:** 
 60% and above in 10th and Graduation
* **Role and Location Fungibility:** 
 Applicant should be locationally mobile and willing to do Relationship \& Sales roles
* **Experience:** 
 0 to 2 Years.



  





**Program Structure** 



* **Program Duration:** 
 2 Months Classroom Training



  





**Remuneration** 



* **Stipend during the program: ₹18,000** 
 per month.
* **Starting Salary (CTC): ₹5\.00** 
 Lakh
 
 to
 **₹5\.50** 
 Lakh (Based on location).



  





**Selection Process** 



* **Online Aptitude Test:** 
 Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
* **Interview (Face\-to\-Face):** 
 Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in\-person interview. Interview Details will be shared on your registered email ID.



  





**Role of a Relationship Manager** 




 After completing the Probationary Officer Program you would take up the role of a Relationship Manager. Please find below the role description of a Relationship Manager.
 



 A
 **Relationship Manager** 
 is a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers. This involves a 360\-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs. The core philosophy is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer\-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. Relationship Managers collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like saving solutions, loan products, overdraft solutions, Insta loans, investment solutions, care products, trade solutions, business loans, or wealth management solutions while upholding our fundamental value of being
 **Fair to the Bank** 
 and
 **Fair to the Customer** 
 .
 



  





**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from diverse educational background!** 




 We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome .Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. You are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Customer Service:** 
 Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.
* **Business Development:** 
 Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360\-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.
* **Champion 360\-degree banking:** 
 Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.
* **Enhance the portfolio quality:** 
 Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of
 **Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer**
* **Customized solutions:** 
 As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.
* **Behold our values:** 
 Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.



  





**We are currently inviting applications from applicants across India**

description:
**Position:** 
 Software Development Engineer (SDE)
 



**Team:** 
 Solutioning \& Integration
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years
 



**Working Model:** 
 In\-office
 



**Role Type:** 
 Software Engineering \| Integrations \| Automation \| Solutioning
 



  





 QuickReply.ai is a cutting\-edge WhatsApp Marketing Automation platform built for e\-commerce businesses. In just 18 months, we’ve onboarded 700\+ global customers and achieved 15x revenue growth. As businesses rapidly shift from email and SMS to WhatsApp, we are building a category\-defining product in this space.
 



 Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, we raised seed funding in April 2023 and are now scaling our team.
 



 We help brands automate customer journeys across the buyer lifecycle — lead capture, abandoned cart recovery, customer support, order updates, retention, upsell, feedback, and more.
 



 Our platform works closely with systems like Shopify, CRMs, ERPs, payment gateways, logistics tools, custom backends, and WhatsApp Business APIs. As customers grow, their workflows become more complex. This is where our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 comes in.
 



  





**Role overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Software Development Engineer (SDE)** 
 to join our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 .
 



 This is a software engineering role focused on building technical solutions that connect QuickReply with customer systems and business workflows. You will work across APIs, webhooks, integrations, automation workflows, data transformation, technical debugging, and custom engineering solutions.
 



 You will work closely with customers, CSMs, Product, and Engineering teams to understand technical requirements, design solutions, build integrations, troubleshoot issues, and take solutions from requirement to production.
 



 It is an engineering role with significant exposure to real\-world customer problems.
 



 The right person should be comfortable reading API documentation, working with JSON and webhooks, writing scripts, debugging technical issues, understanding data flows, and building pragmatic solutions quickly.
 



 You will act as the engineering layer between
 **customer requirements and working technical solutions** 
 , while also contributing learnings back to the product team.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Understand Customer Workflows** 




 You will work with customers and internal CSMs to understand how their business works and translate business requirements into technical flows.
 



 Examples:
 


* How do they capture leads?
* Where does customer data live?
* How do orders, checkouts, payments, shipments, or appointments get created?
* Which events should trigger WhatsApp messages?
* What data is needed to personalize a message?
* When should a bot hand over to a human?
* What should happen after a customer replies?



 Your job is to convert these business flows into clear, scalable technical flows.
   





**Design WhatsApp Automation Solutions** 




 You will help design end\-to\-end automation journeys using QuickReply.
 



 Examples:
 


* Abandoned cart recovery flow
* Order confirmation and payment collection flow
* COD confirmation and RTO reduction flow
* Lead qualification bot
* Appointment reminder flow
* Feedback/NPS collection flow
* Support triage bot
* CRM lead handover flow
* Shopify or custom cart automation flow



 You should be able to think through edge cases, fallbacks, customer replies, data requirements, and handover logic.
 



  





**Work on Integrations and APIs** 




 A major part of this role will involve building and configuring integrations between QuickReply and customer systems.
 

 You may work with:
 


* Shopify
* Custom e\-commerce websites
* CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, LeadSquared, Zoho, etc.
* ERPs or internal systems
* Payment gateways
* Logistics platforms
* Webhooks
* REST APIs
* Google Sheets / Airtable / internal tools
* Customer databases or custom backends



 You should be able to read API documentation, understand request/response formats, test APIs, map payloads, and coordinate with customer technical teams.
 



  





**Debug Customer Issues** 




 You will investigate and resolve technical issues across integrations and automation workflows.
 



 Examples:
 


* Webhook not received
* Wrong customer data coming in
* WhatsApp template not triggering
* Bot flow breaking at a specific step
* CRM lead not getting created
* Shopify event missing data
* API authentication failing
* Duplicate contact being created
* Incorrect order status being passed
* Customer replies not mapping correctly



 You should be comfortable using logs, payloads, Postman, browser tools, and internal dashboards to identify root causes and implement fixes.
 



  





**Build Small Scripts, Tools, and Custom Solutions** 




 Sometimes a customer may need something small but important that is not yet available directly on the platform.
 



 You may build:
 


* Data transformation scripts
* Webhook middleware
* Small internal tools
* API connectors
* Google Apps Script automations
* One\-time migration scripts
* Custom payload mappers
* Utility scripts for testing or monitoring
* Creating mini web apps for customers



 This is not about building large products from scratch. It is about solving technical problems quickly, cleanly, and reliably.
 



  





**Own Technical Go\-Lives** 





 You will be responsible for making sure customers go live smoothly from a technical perspective.
 




 This includes:
 


* Understanding requirements
* Preparing technical solution notes
* Coordinating with CSMs, Product, Engineering, and customer teams
* Testing flows before launch
* Monitoring initial go\-live
* Debugging issues quickly
* Documenting what was implemented
* Creating reusable learnings for future customers



 Success in this role means customers go live faster, with fewer technical escalations and better automation outcomes.
 



  





**Share Product and Engineering Feedback** 





 Because you will work closely with real customer workflows, you will identify repeated technical gaps and opportunities.
 




 You should actively share:
 


* Which integrations are repeatedly needed
* Which product flows are confusing
* Where customers get stuck
* Which manual work should be automated
* Which features can reduce implementation effort
* Which use cases can become reusable templates
* Which technical capabilities can make future integrations faster



 You will bring these learnings back to the Product and Engineering teams to help improve the platform.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Must Have** 



* 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, integration engineering, solution engineering, or a similar technical role
* Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP methods, authentication, and basic system design
* Ability to write scripts or small applications using
 **JavaScript/Node.js or Python**
* Ability to debug technical issues logically and systematically
* Ability to understand business workflows and convert them into technical flows
* Comfortable working directly with customers and customer technical teams
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* High ownership and willingness to solve ambiguous problems
* Fast learner with a bias for action
* Excellent communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts clearly
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership startup environment
* Exposure to AI tools / LLM\-based workflows is preferred



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with Shopify or e\-commerce platforms
* Experience with CRM tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or LeadSquared
* Experience with Postman, API testing, logs, and webhook debugging
* Basic understanding of WhatsApp Business API, messaging templates, bots, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience with Google Apps Script, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools
* Familiarity with databases and SQL
* Exposure to AI tools for faster coding, debugging, documentation, or solutioning



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Strong Software Engineering Mindset** 




 Someone who enjoys building, debugging, testing, and shipping technical solutions rather than simply coordinating them.
 



  





**Builder Mindset** 





 Someone who can take a problem from
 
**understanding the requirement → designing the solution → writing code → testing → debugging → deploying** 

 .
 




  





**AI\-Native Approach** 





 A developer who actively leverages AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, research, and solutioning while maintaining engineering quality and ownership.
 




  





**High Ownership** 





 Someone who takes responsibility for solving problems end\-to\-end instead of waiting for detailed instructions.
 




  





**Comfort With Ambiguity** 





 Real customer problems rarely come with perfectly defined requirements. You should be comfortable figuring things out, asking the right questions, and creating practical solutions.
 




  





**Strong Curiosity** 





 You should enjoy learning new APIs, systems, technologies, tools, and business workflows quickly.
 




  





**Customer Empathy** 





 While this is an engineering role, you will work directly with customers. You should be able to understand their problems, communicate clearly, and translate their requirements into technical solutions.
 




  





**Why This Role Is Different** 





 As a Software Development Engineer in the
 
**Solutioning \& Integration team** 

 , you will work on problems that sit at the intersection of:
 




**Software Engineering \+ APIs \+ Integrations \+ Automation \+ Customer Problems** 




 You will not be limited to writing code against predefined requirements.
 



 You will have the opportunity to:
 


* Work with real\-world technical problems
* Build integrations with different systems
* Design automation workflows
* Debug APIs and data flows
* Write custom scripts and tools
* Work directly with customer technical teams
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering
* Use AI to accelerate development
* See the solutions you build go directly into production



 If you enjoy building things, solving ambiguous technical problems, and working close to the real\-world use of software, this role is for you.
 



  





**Working Model** 




**5\-day work week with alternate Saturdays mandatory** 




  





**Location** 





 Our office is located in Gurgaon, and we are building an in\-office team.
 




**Office Address:** 
 Plot 23, Sector 18, Maruti Industrial Development Area, Gurugram, Haryana 122015

EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

Strong capability in BRD development, ensuring clear documentation of requirements, workflows, and control enhancements. Able to support tool enhancement initiatives aligned with business requirements and risk process objectives. Demonstrated proficiency in managing client and stakeholder interactions to drive requirement clarity and solution alignment.

**Qualification**

**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. **Description**
 Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
   

  

 NOC Overview
   

  

 NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
   

  

 Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
   

  

**Purview Of a Trans Ops Representative**
 A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
   

  

 Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked\-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick\-up to delivery.
   

  

 Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
   

  

 A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real\-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

 Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.

* Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)

* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.


 Providing real\-time customer experience by working in 24\*7 operating environment.

**About the role**
 Cricket With Forza is our premium flagship page — built to go deeper on global T20 leagues than anyone else, while still covering Test and ODI cricket with real quality. We're looking for a creator who can be both the on\-camera face of the page and the producer behind it: someone who scripts their own long\-form content, knows how to guide a shoot, briefs editors on exactly how a piece should come together, and can hold their own in a podcast\-style discussion on cricket well beyond the IPL and Indian cricket. This is a hands\-on, on\-site role for someone who wants to build a recognisable presence as the voice of a premium cricket page.
   

  

**Key Responsibilties**
 • Host and appear on camera across the page's flagship formats — short and long\-form videos, opinion pieces, and podcast\-style discussions.
   

 • Script and structure long\-form video content (8–10 minutes) that breaks down tactics, storylines, or global cricket topics in depth.
   

 • Plan and guide the shoot process, working with videographers to translate a script into a visual plan.
   

 • Brief and guide editors on structure, pacing and tone so the final cut matches the page's premium positioning — without needing multiple rounds of revision.
   

 • Lead or participate in podcast\-style discussion formats, holding an informed point of view on cricket topics beyond the IPL and Indian cricket.
   

 • Deliver content fluently in both Hindi and English, switching naturally depending on the format and audience.
   

 • Stay on top of global T20 leagues alongside Test and ODI cricket, so coverage never defaults to India\-only storylines.
   

 • Work closely with the wider content team to keep the flagship page's voice and quality bar consistent across formats.
   

  

**What we're looking for**
 • Open to any gender, 25 years or older, with strong, demonstrable knowledge of cricket beyond the IPL and Indian cricket — global T20 leagues, and Test and ODI cricket.
   

 • Prior on\-camera experience — hosting, presenting, or creating video content as the face on screen.
   

 • Comfortable scripting and structuring long\-form video content (8–10 minutes), not just short\-form.
   

 • Experience guiding or directing video edits — able to clearly brief editors on structure, pacing and tone.
   

 • Confident holding a point of view in podcast\-style or panel discussion formats.
   

 • Fluent in both Hindi and English, with the ability to switch naturally between the two depending on content.
   

 • Willing and able to work on\-site, five days a week.
   

  

**Nice to have**
 • Experience producing or hosting a podcast or long\-form video series, personal instagram account dealing with cricket news and updates.
   

 • Deep personal interest in franchise T20 leagues outside India — SA20, BBL, ILT20, MLC, The Hundred, and others.
   

 • Prior experience with a cricket or sports media brand.
   

 • Working familiarity with editing software or post\-production workflows, even without hands\-on editing experience.
   

  

**This is a host\-producer role — the creator shapes both what's said on camera and how it comes together in the edit.**

description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Descriptor:**

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **International Corridor** team.

  



**Job Introduction**


The role holder will be responsible for the Banking proposition management initiatives, with a primary focus on performance management.

  

The NRI business seeks to enhance the Group’s share of wallet from the Non\-Resident Indian (NRI) community.


The key focus of this role is to enhance the customer experience ensuring International Service standards are high, and by joining up with overseas entities in key markets to make HSBC more relevant to the NRI community.  



The key focus of this role is to develop, grow and establish the NRI Proposition, by significantly increasing the International Customer base (NRI/PIO) in INM through varied activities such as identifying new geographies to implement the NRI business model, introducing new models for customer acquisition overseas.

  



* To manage cross border proposition and process
* To own client life cycle management and client communication to increase client experience
* To drive business metrics and delivery through branches, contact center and RMs.
* To work closely with overseas HSBC entities, teams and branches to enhance the International proposition.
* To work closely with control, compliance, operations etc., teams to create/enhance customer journeys, processes, product offering in adherence to cross border framework and local regulatory guidelines.
* Manage BAU activities, reporting’s, control checks etc.
* To conduct portfolio analytics to drive business objectives and efficacy across channels
* Stakeholder management is a key to the role requirement both global as well as local. Strict adherence with Group strategy/policies, managing approvals/changes \& maintain operational control.
* To be open, connected, and dependable and act with courageous integrity at all times. Full compliance with internal policies, procedures and compliance requirements

 **Role Context**

  

HSBC is one of the largest foreign Banks in India with a strong personal banking franchise and considerable brand equity. Our main competition is from other foreign Banks like Citibank, Standard Chartered and also strong competition from Private Indian Banks like ICICI Bank. NRI customers are a very attractive target for deposits, home loans and investment products. To leverage on this, the Group seeks to facilitate the easy delivery of NRI banking services from country to country for our valued HSBC Premier, existing and prospective customers, against a backdrop of increasing competition for this customer segment. The jobholder is expected to demonstrate the following characteristics:

* Enhancing customer experience by ensuring that International Service standards are high, and by joining up with overseas entities in key markets to make HSBC more relevant to the NRI community.
* Initiating and overseeing various business development initiatives targeting new customer acquisition,
* Responsible for driving initiatives for improvement in processes and operations with the aim of strengthening operational controls and carrying out process improvements.
* Ability to interact with relevant functional departments (Compliance, Legal, Marketing and Product areas)


Insightful understanding of local competitor strategies. Ability to position and differentiate the NRI Proposition from competitors.

  

The jobholder has to liaise with various departments and functions to identify the service gaps and set timeframes for addressing the issues, in order to deliver better service and to optimize results for maximum benefit to the customer. The jobholder has to coordinate with various NRCs overseas to ensure that each one of them operates as per the prescribed operations/service standards.


The job holder has to ensure quick resolution of the escalated complaint cases from NRI customers by coordinating with multiple units.


Another crucial challenge is to leverage the Group network and significantly increase the NRI footprint in a highly competitive and dynamic environment with established players.


The jobholder is expected to proactively take steps to ensure that productivity is kept high, costs are kept low and customers are satisfied with the service delivery and product offering.

 **Skills as pre\-requisites:**

  

Ensure timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators


Identify and implement relevant compliance guidelines, foster a compliance culture.

  

Revising the account opening forms and other marketing collaterals to ensure compliance with existing group guidelines / regulatory requirements


Understand cross border compliance issues and ensure compliance.

  

Mandatory requirements for Cross Border guidelines to be reiterated to the frontline, to ensure adherence at all times. Conducting sample checks and necessary quality checks for call recording and monitoring. Share learnings/feedbacks with frontline.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

 **Control**

  

The jobholder will adhere to, and be able to demonstrate adherence to, internal controls and will implement the Group compliance policy by adhering to all relevant processes/procedures.


The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.


The following statement is only for roles with managerial or specific Compliance responsibilities


The jobholder will implement measures to contain compliance risk across the business area. This will be achieved by liaising with Compliance department about business initiatives at the earliest opportunity. Also and when applicable, by ensuring adequate resources are in place and training is provided, fostering a compliance culture and optimising relations with regulators.

  

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.
* Maintain and observe HSBC internal control standards, implement and observe Group Compliance Policy, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal/external auditors and external regulators. Foster a compliance culture and implement Group Compliance Policy by managing compliance risk in liaison with the Head of Group Compliance, Regional Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer, ensuring adequate compliance resources are in place and training is provided, and optimising relations.

**Conduct**

  

Management of conduct is a critical component of all our business activities including, for example, the Group’s strategy and business models, our culture and behaviors, our interaction with customers, our financial markets operations, and our governance and oversight processes. HSBC's approach to conduct is designed to ensure we deliver fair outcomes for our customers and do not disrupt the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.

  

Focus on conduct is integral to HSBC’s values and principles, and supports the Group’s strategy for sustainable growth and streamlining of business processes and procedures.  



**Operational Effectiveness \& Control**

  

Ensure timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators


Identify and implement relevant compliance guidelines, foster a compliance culture.

  

Revising the account opening forms and other marketing collaterals to ensure compliance with existing group guidelines / regulatory requirements


Understand cross border compliance issues and ensure compliance.

  

Mandatory requirements for Cross Border guidelines to be reiterated to the frontline, to ensure adherence at all times. Conducting sample checks and necessary quality checks for call recording and monitoring. Share learnings/feedbacks with frontline.

 **Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements :**

  

* Minimum University (BA) or (BS) with 1\-3 Years of Experience in Banking.

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

 \- Assist in operational incident investigations as required.

 \- Monitor staff activities and escalate unsafe behaviors for corrective action.
 



 \- Support audits, inspections, toolbox talks, and safety campaigns.
 



 \- Assist in SMS documentation, record\-keeping, and compliance reporting.
 



 \- Support delivery of safety trainings and awareness communication.

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Proactively work with claimants to recover overpayments in full or negotiate monthly instalments according to established protocol

title: Senior Administrative Executive
description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation works with 96,000\+ girls annually across Delhi’s slum communities, building pathways out of poverty through education, mental health support, and livelihoods training. As the organisation scales into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, the Executive Director’s office requires dedicated, high\-calibre support to manage a wide and demanding portfolio of administrative, regulatory, and coordination responsibilities.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Administrative Executive will directly support the Executive Director in managing time\-sensitive administrative, regulatory, and coordination tasks that fall within the ED’s direct responsibility but do not require the ED’s personal judgement or presence to execute. This is a role for someone who takes ownership of tasks end\-to\-end, tracks details precisely, and follows through without repeated reminders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and track all statutory, regulatory, and administrative filings, licenses, registrations, and renewals that fall under the ED’s direct responsibility, maintaining a live compliance and renewals calendar with no missed deadlines.
* Coordinate with government departments, vendors, consultants, and external agencies on behalf of the ED, following up, collecting documentation, and driving pending applications to closure.
* Manage the ED’s calendar, correspondence, and meeting preparation, including compiling briefing notes and background material ahead of key meetings.
* Draft, proofread, and format correspondence, documents, and presentations on behalf of the ED.
* Maintain organised, accessible records of all documentation handled, physical and digital, so that nothing is dependent on institutional memory alone.
* Support the ED in tracking action items arising from meetings, board interactions, and donor conversations, and follow up proactively until closure.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information relating to governance, compliance, and personnel matters.
* Take on other administrative work sitting under the ED’s purview as required.


**Candidate Requirements**
**Non\-negotiables**
* Impeccable attention to detail. This is the single most important requirement for this role. The ideal candidate double\-checks their own work as a habit, catches errors before anyone else does, and treats documentation accuracy as professional pride, not obligation.
* Process discipline. Follows documented processes precisely, without shortcutting steps or improvising on filings, checklists, or approval flows. Deviations are flagged and discussed, not decided unilaterally.
* 24\-hour turnaround on assigned tasks. Every task gets a status update within one working day, even if the update is that the task is blocked.
* Absolute discretion. Handles confidential documents and conversations without exception.


**Essential**
* Graduate degree in any discipline. Additional certification in office administration or business support is welcome but not required.
* At least 5 years of experience in an executive assistant, administrative coordination, or similar support role, ideally involving statutory or regulatory filings.
* Prior direct experience supporting a Founder, CEO, or ED.
* Demonstrated experience navigating government departments or regulatory processes (fire department, municipal bodies, FCRA, or statutory filings).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.


**Preferred**
* Prior experience working with or for a non\-profit, foundation, or mission\-driven organisation.
* Familiarity with FCRA compliance requirements, or willingness to learn quickly.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Regulatory and statutory filings under the ED’s purview are tracked, followed up, and closed on time, with no last\-minute surprises.
* Correspondence and documents prepared for the ED are accurate and ready to use without correction.
* Routine administrative and procedural work is handled end\-to\-end, freeing the ED to focus on judgement\-heavy work only ED can do.

title: Quality analyst and Trainer
description:
The QA \& Training Analyst is a senior individual contributor who owns two connected charters for DentalKart's CX function: quality assurance and agent capability building. This role audits chat and email interactions against SLA/CX standards, runs structured root\-cause analysis (ACPT — Agent / Customer / Process / Technology) on service failures, and closes the loop by designing and delivering the training interventions — onboarding, refreshers, and targeted coaching — needed to fix what the audits surface. The ideal candidate has enough tenure to independently run both QA and training charters, and to represent both in reviews with the CX Head.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 4–5 years of experience spanning QA, training, or both, ideally within e\-commerce/D2C customer support or a comparable high\-volume support environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently run a QA charter — scorecard design, audit execution, calibration — without close supervision.
* Hands\-on training/facilitation experience — designing content and delivering it to agents, not just consuming training material.
* Strong command of CX metrics and terminology — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA, CSAT, NPS, deflection.
* Working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking, scorecards, and reporting.
* Familiarity with helpdesk/chat platforms such as Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or equivalent (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom).
* Comfortable working with root\-cause frameworks (ACPT or equivalent) and translating audit findings into training content and process recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to deliver constructive feedback to agents and summarize findings for CX leadership.


**Benefits**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Own end\-to\-end QA audits of chat (Zoho SalesIQ) and email (Zoho Desk) interactions against defined scorecards, covering both accuracy and tone/handling.
* Track and report CX metrics — FRT, ART, AHT, TAT, SLA compliance, CSAT, NPS, bot containment/deflection — and publish audit reporting on a defined cadence.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on negative feedback and repeat contacts using the ACPT framework, separating agent\-level, process\-level, and technology\-level failures.
* Run calibration sessions across auditors/TLs to keep QA scoring consistent; own the QA scorecard and update it as processes evolve.
* Convert recurring QA findings into SOP updates and process/technical fix recommendations, in partnership with the CX Head and Ops.
* Design and deliver onboarding/induction training for new CX hires, covering product, process, tools, and communication standards.
* Build refresher and upskilling modules based on recurring QA gaps — e.g., scripted/no\-resolution responses, misjudged escalations, tool usage errors. Design SOP of the processes and do weekly training with the team.
* Run targeted, evidence\-based coaching for individual agents or teams flagged through QA audits or performance scorecards (KRA/KPI).
* Maintain a training calendar, content library (SOPs, playbooks, scenario guides), and track training effectiveness against post\-training QA scores and CSAT movement.
* Certify agents on new processes, tools, or product launches before they go live on the floor.

title: Formal Verification Engineer
description:
We are currently seeking an experienced Formal Verification Engineer with strong CPU/GPU and verification fundamentals to work in NVIDIA's Central Formal team based in Bangalore. NVIDIA builds CPUs and GPUs that powering up the next generation AI and HPC workloads. This position will have you crafting and optimizing formal verification flows across CPU/GPU projects and resolving tool issues for design teams with tool vendors. Additionally, you'll verify the micro\-architecture using formal verification tools to employ the latest model checking and equivalence checking techniques. You will be expected to understand the design \& implementation, define the verification scope, and ensure design correctness. You will use advanced formal techniques to obtain full proofs, or sufficient bounded proofs, of the design while working with architects, designers, pre\- and post\-silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* The specification, implementation, and maintenance of an integrated end\-to\-end formal verification flow for the formal verification team.
* Developing scripts to automate the verification process.
* Review formal setups and proofs with design and verification teams.
* Maintain and extend assertion libraries, including support for both simulation and FV.
* Identifying key behaviours for verification of DUT and creating a verification plan.
* Developing verification environment including environment assumptions, assertions and cover properties in context of the verification plan.
* Applying various FV techniques to prove correctness of digital designs.

 We are looking for a

 As the company enters its next phase of growth, talent quality will become one of its most important competitive advantages. The People \& Talent Head will play a critical role in determining

description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 CashKaro is India's largest cashback app, helping users earn real cashback on purchases

 top of all existing discounts and can be transferred directly to a bank account, making
 



 CashKaro the smartest way to shop online.
 



  





 We are the \#1 performance marketing partner for e\-commerce in India, driving ₹10,000 Cr in
 



 annual GMV for our brand partners. Founded in 2013 by Rohan and Swati Bhargava,
 



 CashKaro has raised over ₹250 Cr in funding from marquee investors including the late Mr.
 



 Ratan Tata, and has scaled to ₹600 Cr in revenues — growing over 70% in FY26\.
 



  





 Our sister platform, EarnKaro, is India's \#1 affiliate marketing platform. It empowers content
 



 creators, homemakers, students, and micro\-influencers to monetise their reach by sharing

 The group also operates BankKaro, enabling users to compare and apply for credit cards,
 



 loans, and other financial products — making smarter financial decisions accessible to all.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Tele Caller you will be responsible for reaching out to customers and leads to promote
 



 BankKaro’s partnered credit card offerings, including SBI, Axis, HSBC, and other leading card providers. You will educate customers about card benefits, eligibility, offers, and application processes while managing follow\-ups and ensuring a smooth customer journey from initial outreach to application submission.
 



 The role requires strong communication, persuasion, follow\-up discipline, and atarget\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced sales environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Customer Outreach \& Product Promotion
 


* Make outbound calls to prospective customers and leads for credit card offerings.
* Pitch credit cards clearly by explaining benefits, eligibility criteria, rewards, and applicable offers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend relevant card options.
* Handle customer queries and objections professionally.



 2\. Lead Follow\-up \& Conversion
 


* Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads to drive application submissions.
* Maintain regular communication with interested customers throughout the application journey.
* Identify customer intent and maximise lead\-to\-application conversion.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups and closure of assigned leads.



 3\. Application \& Documentation Support
 


* Guide customers through the credit card application process.
* Explain required documentation and assist customers with the submission process.
* Ensure customer and application details are captured accurately.

 4\. Application Tracking \& Customer Updates
 


* Track application progress and keep customers informed about the status and next steps.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, customer interactions, and application stages.
* Follow up on pending applications and required documentation.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for customers.



 5\. Target \& Performance Management
 


* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets.
* Maintain strong call quality and closure rates.
* Monitor individual performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Adhere to defined sales, quality, and compliance processes.



  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 0–3 years of experience in telesales, telecalling, credit card sales, BFSI sales, or customer\-facing calling roles.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with fluency in English and Hindi.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection\-handling skills.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and customer\-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, CRM, or lead\-tracking systems.
* Good attention to detail while handling customer information and application details.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Previous experience selling or handling credit cards, particularly SBI, Axis, HDFC, or HSBC products.
* Understanding of basic credit card eligibility criteria such as salary, age, and CIBIL score.
* Familiarity with cashback, rewards, and credit card comparison products.
* Experience working in a BFSI, fintech, or financial services environment.



  





**Why Join CashKaro?** 



* Real Ownership, Real Impact — You're not a cog in a machine. You work directly on products and decisions that move the needle for a platform used by millions of Indians every day.
* Innovative Culture — No unnecessary layers, no committee lags. We move fast, back good ideas, and give people the space to build, experiment, and grow.
* Learning \& Development — Structured L\&D programs, cross\-functional exposure, and a team that believes your growth is the company's growth.
* Wealth Creation — ESOPs awarded to many team members, because when CashKaro wins, the people who built it should win too.
* Food, Sorted — Daily lunch and snacks in office. One less thing to worry about.
* Benefits That Actually Matter — Comprehensive medical insurance, Flexible Benefits Plan with tax benefits, wellness initiatives, and a workplace designed tosupport you.
* We Celebrate Everything — Festivals, birthdays, work anniversaries, life milestones. If it matters to you, it matters to us.
* Community, Not Just Colleagues — Team events, outings, dinner meetups, and the kind of in\-office culture where people actually like showing up.
* Diverse by Design — We believe the best ideas come from the most varied rooms.
* Different backgrounds, different perspectives — that's not a policy, it's how we operate.

title: Growth Associate - Dental
description:
**Looking for a Growth Associate to join Orvica Labs to help scale the Dental vertical.
 



  





 Orvica Labs develops Health One, an AI platform for clinics to run their day to day work on\- covering appointments, WhatsApp\-based patient communication, billing and clinical charting and much more. Our first clinical specialty is Dental, before we add other specialties in healthcare.
 



  





 The platform is currently deployed with a multi\-branch dental group in Delhi NCR.
 



  





 Why this might suit you
 



  





 If your future is in the business side of dentistry rather than at the clinical chair, this is a direct route in. You’ll build a working relationship with practice owners across Delhi NCR, learn what makes a clinic function in real life, and understand how dental businesses are actually run — knowledge that stays with you whatever you do next.
 



  





 How we work
 



  





 Field\-based, no fixed office; we do regular team meets, but you set your own days around meetings. You’ll learn something new most days, and the work is genuinely enjoyable. We work hard, but we also have lives — we don’t expect you to work weekends.
 



  





 What the job actually involves
 



  





 This is early\-stage work, and the brief is simple: put your best foot forward to bring good clinics onto the platform. Some days that’s a scheduled demo with a practice owner. Others it’s representing Orvica at an IDA branch meeting or a dental conference, sharing our work on the channels dentists actually read, following up on an enquiry, speaking to your own batchmates and seniors, or trying an approach nobody has tried before. Building relationships with dental supply reps and lab technicians is part of it too — they visit every clinic in NCR each week and know which practices are growing before anyone else does. If it brings in the right clinics, it’s in scope. And it goes without saying, we’re here to support you through it.
 



  





 You should also know that selling to clinics takes time. A doctor who likes the product on day one might still sign much later, after follow\-ups and demos for their partners and staff — that’s normal, and it isn’t a bad sign. Trust is what closes these conversations, and trust takes time to build; you can’t fake it. Not every conversation converts, and the ones that do often land long after you’d stopped expecting them to. The people who do well at this treat a “not right now” as a task for next month rather than a rejection, and they enjoy the long game: every conversation teaches you something about how these practices run, and that knowledge compounds whether or not that particular clinic gets onboarded.
 



  





 Compensation: Competitive Salary \+ Performance Incentive. All work travel fully reimbursed. Laptop provided.
 



  





 Requirements: BDS, 0–2 years’ experience. Based in Gurugram or Delhi NCR. Willing to travel across NCR.
 



  





 No clinical duties, no chairside hours. You’ll report directly to the founder.
 



  





 Send applications to divij@orvica.in \- and if you want to stand out, write briefly about your greatest wins and accomplishments, and why you will be a good fit for this role.**

title: 🚀 AUMChip is Building a 20-Member Elite Experience in Semiconductor | Quantum | Ai | Robotics | Space Team
description:
We are looking for 20 exceptional engineers, researchers, PhD scholars and top IIT students who want to work on something far beyond a conventional internship.
   

  

 What is AUMChip?
   

  

 AUMChip is building a deterministic compute architecture spanning:
   

 Quantum Computing × AI × Robotics × Space × Semiconductors
   

  

 Our work has progressed substantially beyond an idea stage. The current architecture has gone through extensive RTL verification and pre\-silicon implementation work, including RTL\-to\-GDS physical implementation, formal verification, gate\-level verification, FPGA emulation and multi\-platform validation.
   

  

 The next objective is to take this architecture through Indian semiconductor technology toward prototype silicon.
   

 India's SCL operates an 8\-inch, 180 nm CMOS fab and provides capabilities spanning synthesis, physical design, DRC/LVS, PEX, physical STA and GDSII release.
   

 SCL \+1
   

  

 🌐 Why AUMChip different ?
   

  

 AUMChip is not only a chip architecture.
   

 It is being developed around “.aum”, an AUMChip\-associated computing/data format and language ecosystem, with an IANA media\-type registration associated with the project. IANA maintains the global media\-type registration system.
   

 Iana
   

  

 One core. Multiple domains🚀
   

  

 The AUMChip architecture is designed to provide a common deterministic compute foundation for:
   

 AI • Robotics • Space • Quantum
   

  

 Rather than building four disconnected accelerators, our approach is to develop one verified core architecture that can be adapted across these workloads and hardware substrates.
   

  

 The architecture has already undergone extensive RTL verification, FPGA emulation and cross\-substrate validation across multiple implementation platforms. The next step is to take that verified architecture toward Indian semiconductor fabrication and physical silicon validation.
   

  

 Our ambition is to build an Indian sovereign compute stack — architecture → compiler → format/language → hardware → silicon.
   

  

 🇮🇳 The India opportunity
   

  

 We intend to work closely with India's emerging semiconductor ecosystem and explore opportunities with Indian government, semiconductor laboratories, research institutions and manufacturing partners.
   

 The objective is simple:
   

 Design in India → verify in India → fabricate in India → build IP from India.
   

  

 🏭 Physical infrastructure
   

  

 AUMChip's team also has access to an 18,000 sq. ft. industrial facility in Masuri Industrial Area, Phase 1, where we are preparing to establish a dedicated semiconductor/advanced hardware laboratory.
   

 This gives selected team members the opportunity to work not only on software simulations, but toward real hardware, laboratory validation and eventually silicon.
   

  

 💰 Equity / ESOP opportunity
   

  

 We are currently raising $18M Pre\-Series A to accelerate AUMChip's semiconductor, compute and R\&D roadmap.
   

  

 We intend to create an ESOP pool of up to 5% for the selected 20\-member technical team, subject to formal ESOP documentation, vesting and company approvals.
   

  

 Early contributors who join at this stage can potentially participate in the value created as AUMChip progresses from pre\-silicon architecture → prototype silicon → commercial deployment.
   

  

 🔬 Who are we looking for?
   

  

 Only 20 positions.
   

 Quantum Engineers
   

 Quantum Computing Researchers
   

 PhD Scholars / Research Scholars
   

 VLSI / ASIC Engineers
   

 RTL / Verilog / SystemVerilog Engineers
   

 Computer Architecture Researchers
   

 Quantum Error Correction Researchers
   

 FPGA Engineers
   

 Physical Design / RTL\-to\-GDS Engineers
   

 EDA / Verification Engineers
   

 AI Hardware Researchers
   

 Semiconductor Algorithm Researchers
   

 C/C\+\+ / Python Engineers
   

 IITs and other top engineering/research institutions preferred.
   

  

 Exceptional candidates from outside IITs are absolutely welcome if their technical ability is outstanding.
   

  

 Why join at this stage?
   

  

 Because early in a deep\-tech company is when the biggest technical impact is possible.
   

 You won't be joining to maintain someone else's product.
   

  

 You'll be joining to help build the architecture, tools, verification, hardware and silicon of an ambitious Indian semiconductor company from the ground up.
   

 20 people. One mission. Build something India can own.
   

  

 Early\-stage founding opportunity: Selected contributors will participate in the initial development phase with an ESOP opportunity of up to 5% collectively for the 20\-member team. Paid positions and fixed salaries will commence from January 1, 2027, based on role and formal employment/engagement terms.
