**Job Req ID:**
**Posting Date:**
**Function:**
**Location:**
**Salary:**
**About The Role**
 To manage and administer SD\-WAN technologies for BT and its global customers. The role is responsible for implementing, operating and supporting SD\-WAN services across customer environments while ensuring compliance with change management, SLA commitments and security standards. The position is part of the 24x7 Global Operations team and requires strong technical expertise in VMware SD\-WAN (VeloCloud), Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), Fortinet SD\-WAN, Meraki and Prisma SD\-WAN solutions, along with solid routing and switching fundamentals.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Implement and review simple to complex SD\-WAN service requests for global customers.
* Configure and troubleshoot VMware SD\-WAN (VeloCloud), Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), Fortinet SD\-WAN, Meraki and Prisma SD\-WAN solutions.
* Perform pre\-implementation validation, peer review, implementation and post\-validation checks.
* Manage routing technologies including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, Static Routing, MPLS and VPN.
* Delivering implementation requests directly under Owning queue and implementing simple to complex changes for Cisco switches, routers, WLCs and Firewall.
* Configure IPSec tunnels, QoS, segmentation, NAT/PAT, ACLs, DHCP and policy\-based routing.
* Support LAN/WAN/WLAN/Meraki/IPAM devices including Cisco, Wireless Controllers.
* Support customer migrations, project implementations and out\-of\-hours changes.
* Investigate implementation risks and coordinate with TDAs, Service Desk and stakeholders.
* Resolve technically escalated cases and mentor Request Fulfilment Engineers.
* Maintain implementation documentation and identify service improvement opportunities.


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in Network Operations, Request Fulfilment and SD\-WAN implementations.
* Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, WLAN, MPLS, VPN, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, DMVPN and IPsec technologies.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of Cisco Routing and Switching technologies.
* Working knowledge of VMware SD\-WAN (VeloCloud), Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), Fortinet SD\-WAN, Meraki and Prisma SD\-WAN solutions.
* Experience in implementing network changes through change management processes, including validation, peer review and post\-implementation checks.
* Understanding of QoS, ACLs, NAT/PAT, DHCP, Network Segmentation and Policy\-Based Routing.
* Experience working in a customer\-facing global operations environment.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation\-related issues within agreed SLA timelines.


**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Qualifications:**
* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge – Mandatory.
* CCNP Enterprise or SD\-WAN certification – Preferred.
* ITIL Foundation Certification – Preferred


**Our Package**
 At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Senior Travel Counselor
description:
**Company Description** 
 SkyHi Global Travels Pvt Ltd is a New Delhi–based travel management company with over 20 years of experience delivering premium global adventures at optimized costs. The company offers end\-to\-end services, including flights, hotels, visas, travel insurance, tours, car rentals, and specialized MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) travel solutions. Its unified platform combines intuitive self\-booking tools with real\-time expense tracking and policy compliance for transparent and controlled travel budgets. Long\-standing vendor relationships enable significant savings through negotiated rates, while flexible refund processes, 24/7 tech support, and curated local insights enhance every journey. SkyHi Global Travels is recognized for its reliability and innovation in the global travel management industry.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Travel Counselor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurgaon(Travel Desk), responsible for managing complex domestic and international travel arrangements for individual and corporate clients. Day\-to\-day activities include consulting with clients to understand their travel needs, proposing itineraries, booking flights, hotels, ground transport, and ancillary services, and ensuring all bookings comply with client policies and budget requirements. The role involves handling visa and travel insurance coordination, monitoring bookings for changes or disruptions, and providing timely support and solutions. The Senior Travel Counselor will maintain strong relationships with vendors, leverage negotiated rates, and use internal tools to track expenses and maintain accurate documentation. The position also involves delivering high levels of customer service, resolving issues, and contributing to process improvements to enhance the overall client experience.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong customer\-facing skills, including Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction capabilities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, to interact effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Travel Arrangements, including itinerary planning, booking, and coordination of end\-to\-end travel services.
* Candidates should possess experience working in a Travel Agency or similar travel management environment, preferably in corporate travel.
* Relevant experience as a travel consultant or counselor, with proficiency in GDS/online booking tools and familiarity with visa and insurance processes.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple bookings and client requests under time constraints.
* Comfort with technology, including travel booking platforms and MS Office tools, and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* A diploma or degree in Travel and Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field is preferred.

A high\-growth business operating in the Real Estate and PropTech sector, focused on residential and commercial property advisory and transaction services across India. We deliver end\-to\-end on\-site property consulting—market analysis, valuation, client advisory, and deal execution—for buyers, sellers, and investors. The role is customer\-facing and field\-driven, suited to commercial real estate professionals who thrive in target\-led sales environments.
   

  

**Primary Title:** 
 Real Estate Sales Consultant
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Prospect and qualify leads through cold outreach, referrals, walk\-ins, and developer partnerships to build a high\-converting pipeline.
* Conduct on\-site property visits and deliver accurate property valuations and contextual market insights to clients.
* Advise buyers and sellers on pricing strategy, investment potential, and market trends to align expectations and drive transactions.
* Negotiate offers, structure deal terms, and manage end\-to\-end transaction coordination until closure.
* Maintain up\-to\-date records in CRM, prepare and verify documentation, and coordinate with legal/finance teams for compliance and disbursal.
* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to local market intelligence by reporting competitor activity and demand signals.


**Skills \& Qualifications Must\-Have**
* Property valuation
* Market research
* Sales negotiation
* Lead generation
* CRM software
* RERA regulations


**Preferred**
* Experience with Zoho CRM or LeadSquared
* Familiarity with residential and/or commercial leasing transactions
* Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in real estate


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Competitive on\-target earnings with performance\-linked incentives and locality\-based allowances.
* Field\-first culture with structured sales enablement, regular training, and clear career progression into senior advisory roles.
* Supportive operations team for legal, documentation, and post\-sales coordination to let you focus on closing deals.


 Skills: market research,real estate investment consulting,sales \& marketing,lead generation,sales,crm software,real estate

title: Renewal officer
company: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited (ABHICL) is a health insurance provider established in 2015 as part of the Aditya Birla Group, in partnership with MMI Holdings. Since commencing operations in 2016, ABHICL has focused on innovative health insurance products, including chronic care solutions and incentivized wellness programs. The company positions itself not only as a payer of healthcare expenses but also as an enabler of informed health and wellness choices for customers. Its product philosophy centers on rewarding healthy behavior, supporting management of chronic lifestyle conditions, protecting health needs with dignity, and providing access to a holistic, digital\-first health and wellness ecosystem. ABHICL aims to shape and expand the health insurance landscape in India through customer\-centric innovation and a strong emphasis on preventive care.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Renewal Officer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram, responsible for managing and driving timely renewals of health insurance policies. This role involves tracking upcoming renewals, contacting customers through calls, emails, and messages, and explaining policy benefits, renewal options, and any changes in coverage or pricing. The Renewal Officer will handle customer queries, resolve issues related to lapses or payment delays, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure accurate documentation and smooth policy continuation. Daily tasks include updating renewal records, preparing basic reports and dashboards on renewal performance, and supporting targeted retention campaigns. The role requires maintaining high service standards, adhering to regulatory and company compliance guidelines, and contributing to overall customer satisfaction and retention.
 



  





 Budget:\- 4\.5 Lacs
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 







* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with diverse customers.
* Proficiency in verbal and written communication in English and local languages; confident telephone and email etiquette.
* Basic sales and negotiation abilities to promote renewals, address objections, and support retention goals.
* Comfort with data entry, MS Office tools (especially Excel), and CRM or policy administration systems.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills for managing multiple renewal cases, documentation, and timelines.
* Understanding of insurance or financial services concepts; prior experience in health or general insurance renewals, customer service, or telesales is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment while adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards.
* Graduate degree in any discipline; additional certifications in insurance or customer service will be beneficial.

**The Team**
 Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
   

  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programme

* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance


**How will you contribute?**
 Logistics Network Design\-
   

  

* Conduct as\-is logistics network diagnostics including transport lanes, DC locations, lead times, and costs
* Possess strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in modelling different network configurations and developing optimization algorithms based on defined objective functions
* Evaluate optimization opportunities for network redesign (hub\-and\-spoke, consolidation, cross\-docking, etc.)

 Transportation Planning \& Execution\-
   

  

* Assess current transportation/logistics operations to identify gaps and provide recommendations

* Execute transportation performance analysis (On\-Time In\-Full, Freight Cost per Unit, Utilization)

 Warehouse Operations\-

* Lead initiatives for layout redesign, slotting, and automation feasibility
* Develop SOPs and KPIs to improve inbound, put\-away, order picking, and dispatch processes
* Design and implement Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)


 Order Management \& Fulfillment\-
   

  

* Design and implement end\-to\-end order\-to\-ship processes with visibility and traceability
* Diagnose root causes of order delays, backorders, and fulfilment issues
* Define and track metrics like service level, Perfect Order Rate, Fill Rate, and Order Cycle Time


 Logistics Analytics \& Reporting
   

  

* Develop MIS dashboards on logistics cost, delivery performance, service level adherence, and transit lead times
* Implement RCA frameworks to identify recurring fulfilment bottlenecks
* Conduct benchmarking of logistics KPIs across regions/sites and propose improvement actions


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 6–10 years of experience in logistics, transportation, distribution strategy, or downstream supply chain execution roles
* Previous advisory experience from a top\-tier strategy firm, niche logistics consulting firm, or Big\-4 consultancy preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain, or a related field
* MBA / Master’s degree in supply chain \& Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or similar discipline
* Strong storyboarding skills to translate operational insights into impactful client presentations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with high motivation to drive logistics transformation
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills in dynamic, operationally complex environments
* Hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end logistics operations – transportation planning, routing, order fulfillment, warehouse layout/design, 3PL management, etc.
* Experience in KPI tracking (On\-Time Delivery, Fill Rate, Freight Cost per Unit, Perfect Order Rate) and performance dashboards
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement experience (supply, customer service, 3PLs)
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and root\-cause problem\-solving skills related to logistics data
* Hands on experience with WMS / TMS tools, logistics optimization tools (e.g., Coupa Supply Chain Guru, AIMMS, Starboard etc.) is preferred
* Tools knowledge on Alteryx, Power BI, python, Linear programming platforms, etc. would be a big plus
* APICS CLTD, CSCP, or Six Sigma certification would be an added advantage


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

description:
**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we’re on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust.
   

  

 Working with over 30,000 global brands, retailers, manufacturers and food growers, we are on the ground wherever products are made. We help businesses secure every step of their supply chain with quality inspections, supplier audits, certifications, and lab testing, all powered by our intelligent digital platform.

title: University Talent Partner
description:
**University Talent Partner** 




  





**About Graviton** 
 : Graviton Research Capital is a global quantitative trading and investment firm driven by technology, mathematics and rigorous problem\-solving. We bring together exceptional talent across quantitative research, software engineering and technology to solve some of the most challenging problems in the industry.
 



 Our university talent ecosystem is one of the most important engines for building Graviton's future — and one of the most operationally demanding to run well.
 



  





**The Role** 
 : We are looking for a campus talent professional who can both
 **think in systems and execute in detail** 
 — someone who can shape how Graviton identifies, engages, assesses and converts exceptional early\-career talent, and who is equally comfortable owning the on\-the\-ground execution that makes a hiring cycle run without friction.
 



 Depending on experience, this role can be scoped as a hands\-on execution owner running the campus hiring engine end\-to\-end, or as a strategic owner architecting the assessment frameworks, university strategy and program design that the engine runs on — in both cases, you will partner closely with Quant and Tech leaders and be accountable for the full lifecycle: university outreach, assessments, internships, PPO conversion and onboarding.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**Campus Talent Strategy \& Ecosystem Building** 



* Build and maintain relationships with priority institutions (IITs, IIITs, BITS and relevant global universities), placement offices, faculty and student communities.
* Drive year\-round engagement \- events, technical talks and competitions — to strengthen Graviton's employer brand outside peak hiring windows.



**Assessment \& Selection** 



* Coordinate (or design and standardize, at senior levels) rigorous selection frameworks in partnership with Tech and Quant teams — scheduling assessments, allocating panels, driving timely feedback, and building interviewer calibration mechanisms to keep evaluation objective and consistent.



  





**Internships \& PPO Conversion** 



* Own the operational lifecycle of internship programs: onboarding, logistics, engagement tracking and performance milestones.
* Manage the transition from internship to PPO/FTE with clear communication, decision timelines and (at senior levels) program design that maximizes conversion of high\-performing interns.


- 


**Operations \& Candidate Experience** 



* Be the primary point of contact for candidates, delivering a high\-touch experience with transparent timelines from first contact through onboarding.
* Own budget tracking, vendor relationships, venue booking, travel and infrastructure for on\-ground and virtual events.
* Build and maintain robust SOPs and checklists for scalable, repeatable execution.



  





**Data, Reporting \& Leadership** 



* Maintain real\-time hiring metrics, trackers and dashboards (funnel conversions, offer acceptance, joining rates) and use them to guide decisions and inform leadership.
* At senior levels: act as a strategic partner to executive leadership and mentor the broader campus talent team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Campus hiring cycles run predictably, with zero operational friction and complete data transparency.
* Candidates, interviewers and university stakeholders receive an exceptional, high\-touch experience.
* Selection frameworks consistently identify top\-tier quantitative and technical talent.
* Internship and PPO programs serve as Graviton's primary pipeline for high\-performing full\-time hires.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6–12 years of experience in campus recruitment, university relations, early\-career programs, or program management, ideally within a highly selective technical or quantitative talent environment
* Proven experience managing (or architecting) end\-to\-end campus hiring campaigns across multiple universities simultaneously.
* Strong project management skills, high attention to detail and operational discipline; at senior levels, demonstrated experience in assessment design, interview calibration and multi\-year strategy building.
* Proficiency with recruitment data, tracking systems and reporting dashboards, with an analytical, decision\-driven mindset.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to build trusted relationships with candidates, faculty, university placement teams and internal leadership.
* Ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly and take complete ownership of outcomes.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 
 Great campus hiring is won in the details and built on strategy. From the first student touchpoint to assessment design, internship execution and final conversion, every interaction shapes how top talent views Graviton. You will help build — and run — a world\-class university hiring engine that operates with speed, precision and rigor.

description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest \& most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable the global technology for BCG’s entire HR \& People Function including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility, \& Career Development); L\&D and Teaming; and Core HR (including Workday \& Compensation). Over the past two years, the HR Product Portfolio has more than doubled in size, and there is more growth to come.
   

  

 With this growth comes amazing new leadership opportunities, including the Product Owner for a new squad focused on delivering Data \& Analytics for Learning@BCG. This product owner role will be responsible for a new data product, consolidating Learning completions and other HR data about Learners to support both reporting, analytics and agentic personalization.
   

  

 Initially, this role will be part of a larger Learning Transformation project. Long\-term this role will be part of a growing suite of data products and analytics, focused on enabling our HR functions.
   

  

 As the Product Owner, you will represent the voice of the customer, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the squad's backlog to deliver impactful results. You will also collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and high data quality.

* Oversee what is delivered by the squad and when

* Support and enable the squad to get its work done
* Collaborate with the squad to remove impediments and clarify requirements.
* Partner with Chapter Leads for resourcing and technical expertise.
* Provide performance feedback to squad members and cross\-functional team members.


 What You'll Bring

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with HR leadership.

description:
**Job Purpose**
 To direct \& administer the wealth management business in the designated zone \& devise strategies to achieve its customer, profit, growth \& customer service objectives. The product service portfolio includes portfolio \& wealth management advisory services for stocks, mutual funds, broking services, real estate advisory and other relevant financial services products.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 Job Context: Aditya Birla Money Mart Ltd. (ABMML) is primarily a distribution house of third party investment products through investment advisory and Wealth Management Services to it’s High net worth, Institution \& Retail clients. ABMM has also started its new vertical of Tele Sales in FY 12 for Insurance selling.
   

  

 ABM is the second largest Investment Advisory in the country with over 25,000 crores of AUA as of November 2012\. Its one of the leading securities trading companies and amongst the largest non\-bank promoted Wealth advisor in the country.
   

  

 ABM has a daily turnover of over 1,000 crores and has been rapidly improving its market shares in the various segments it operates in. In the otherwise fragmented equity broking business, ABM has doubled it market share to over 1\.6% of retail cash equity volumes in the last 18 months. The commodity market shares have also doubled during this period.
   

  

 ABM remains one of the largest distributor for BSLI and BSLAMC and the largest distributor for other manufacturing organisations within ABFSG.
   

  

 ABM brings value to other line of business within ABFSG and adds Rs \~ 25\-30 Crores to the bottom line of BSLI / BSLAMC / ABFL / ABPE etc…
   

  

 ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating it’s day to day operations.In addition to the regulator ABM is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX/ NSDL / CDSL etc..
   

  

 ABM also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local Broking outfits.
   

  

 ABMML competition is from Major Distribution Houses like NJ India Invest, Bajaj Capital Prudent, IIFL and a range of Banks (both Indian and MNC). ABMMU is a unique award winning innovative digital business in the financial services space that offers the functionality of automated aggregation of all financial services relationships of a customer in a single location and enabling advice and transaction handling on the aggregated data. ABMU is a category killer new business line that has been launched to service the ‘digitally savvy but financially uninformed’ client segment to thereby ensuring that the financial services products penetration in India improves significantly. The mission of MU is ‘To make India financially confident’. ABMMU recently crossed a customer base of over 100,000 within a very short time of launch and has over Rs. 3,300 crores money aggregated on the site till date.
   

  

 The Wealth management division is engaged in providing strong research backed financial services advisory to the HNI clients and managing their ongoing financial advisory and Portfolio Management needs. The product portfolio includes Mutual funds, Life insurance, Bonds, Structured products, Real estate advisory, Company fixed deposits \& Equity and commoditybroking services
   

  

 The Zonal head is responsible for directing the affairs of the wealth management business in his zone to achieve profit, growth \& customer service objectives.
   

  

 Job Challenges: The main challenges faced by this profile include increasing the market share amidst stiff competition, motivating the channel to promote high revenue yielding and research backed products, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, controlling all the operational requirements of the zone \& effective cost management. The critical skill sets that this profile requires are excellent analytical, communication \& presentation skills, a strong industry network and an ability to resource new business with a strategic vision to interpret market trends \& high target \& customer service orientation
   

  

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 To plan and drive new client acquisition \& growth ? To build marketing and business expansion strategies for the region and deploy resources \& timelines to achieve them
   

  

* To identify business potential in new cities through market sources \& penetrate them by setting branches in strategic locations \& sales activities.
* To create strong institutional and dealer networks for business expansion and review their performance periodically
* To forge newer tie ups for business expansion in the zone


 KRA2 To promote development of new products and analytical tools ? To liaise with the research and product teams to develop superior customer friendly tools for financial planning, analysis and portfolio management
   

  

* To add newer product offerings in the portfolio
* To actively review the existing portfolios \& market trends \& advise new investment plans to de\-risk against attrition \& achieve stability of book


 KRA3 To achieve targeted profitability \& fee income ? To strategize product\-customer mix for optimal revenue generation
   

  

* To initiate cross selling initiatives for generating additional revenues
* To regularly monitor achievement of branch \& regional targets


 KRA4 To drive customer satisfaction and retention initiatives ? To work with the customer servicing teams to continually develop new customer friendly initiatives
   

  

* Benchmarking the portfolio\-service offerings with the competition and highlight the critical modifications required
* To prioritize customer grievance addresal and take corrective action for avoiding similar issues in future


 KRA5 To ensure policy adherence and coordination ? To supervise and ensure compliance of all critical policies \& procedures \& ensure compliance with them
   

  

* To ensure adequate documentation of all transactions and coordinate with market intermediaries like banks for smooth operations


 KRA6 To present MIS Dashboards ? To send periodic business reports to HO for profit, new product launches, new clients \& new channel development \& changes/improvement in business plans

description:
**About the team:**
 Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network of 21,000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories \- from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
   

  

 Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save upto 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dineout feature on the Swiggy app Using the Dineout feature on the Swiggy app, users can discover and avail the best deals and discounts at restaurants, cafes, bars, and pubs in their city. Users can search for their favourite restaurants based on various parameters such as cuisine, location, price range, and availability.
   

  

 For customers, our vision is to become their default app for all their dining\-out occasions. We intend to do so by building a full stack solution for them to discover restaurants they might like, make a table reservation, make payment, and avail the best discounts/value across restaurants.For restaurants, our vision is to become their de facto platform of choice to grow their dine\-in business. We aspire to do so by becoming the most cost\-efficient marketing channel for them to build their brand, drive demand and acquire \& engage customers.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview:**
 The Senior Account Manager / Partner Success Manager will own the post\-sales relationship with restaurant partners, ensuring successful adoption, active usage, and measurable ROI. This role is critical in driving partner satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth by acting as a trusted growth advisor to restaurant partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Partner Onboarding \& Adoption:
* Own end\-to\-end post\-sales onboarding of our product suite for assigned restaurant partners, including Digital Menu, CRM tools, reservations, and QR\-based ordering.
* Coordinate product setup, POS integration, QR deployment, and account configuration (menu, floor plans, shifts, outlet details).
* Conduct structured product walkthroughs, demos, and staff training to ensure smooth go\-live within defined timelines.
* Partner Success \& Relationship Management:
* Act as the single point of contact for restaurant partners in the city.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with owners, decision\-makers, and outlet managers.
* Regularly engage partners through check\-ins, reviews, and on\-ground visits
* Driving ROI \& Business Growth:


 Help restaurant partners translate product feature usage into measurable business outcomes, including:
   

  

* Higher AOV / table value through upsell and cross\-sell
* Improved repeat visits using CRM and targeted campaigns
* Better table utilization and demand shaping
* Reduced operational friction via QR\-led ordering and billing
* Track and communicate ROI metrics such as adoption depth, repeat rate uplift, campaign performance, and menu\-led revenue impact.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reviews:
* Conduct monthly/quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with partners.
* Analyze partner performance data and recommend actionable improvements.
* Identify early warning signs of churn and proactively resolve issues
* Expansion \& Feature Adoption Support
* Identify opportunities to increase depth of usage across available product features.
* Train restaurant staff on new workflows and ensure adoption remains stable despite staff churn through repeat training and SOPs.
* Support expansion across multiple outlets by demonstrating value and best practices.
* Work closely with Sales and City teams to enable renewals and portfolio expansion through strong post\-sales outcomes.
* Product Support \& Issue Resolution
* Act as first\-level support for product\-related queries and issues.
* Coordinate with Product, Tech, Ops, and Support teams to resolve bugs, integrations, and workflow challenges.
* Ensure minimal downtime and a smooth partner experience.
* Partner Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Act as the voice of restaurant partners by sharing structured feedback on product usability, gaps, and enhancement needs.
* Contribute inputs to improve product features, onboarding journeys, and partner\-facing processes.


**Key Success Metrics (KPIs):**
* Product Features adoption \& activation rate
* Partner retention and churn reduction
* Usage frequency of the features
* Partner ROI metrics and satisfaction (NPS)
* Revenue expansion from existing partners


**Experience \& Qualifications:**
**Experience**
* Experience in: Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Success, B2B relationship management, Prior experience in F\&B, hospitality, SaaS, CRM, POS, or restaurant\-tech is highly preferred
* Experience managing city\-level or portfolio\-based accounts is a strong plus


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Good understanding of business metrics, ROI, and growth levers
* Comfortable with data, dashboards, and performance reports
* Ability to train and influence non\-tech restaurant owners and staff
* High ownership mindset with strong problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent communication skills (local language \+ English preferred)


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Marketing, or a related field.
* MBA or hospitality background is a plus but not mandatory.


**Additional Information**
**Why This Role is Important:**
* Directly impacts restaurant partner success and retention.
* Plays a key role in scaling Dineout ecosystem.

description:
Position: AR \& AP Executive
 



  





 Job description:
 



 Shift: US: 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM
 



 Must Have: International clients experience
 



 Proficient in Excel \& quick books
 



 AR Experience: 6 Months to 1 Years
 



 Location: Noida, Sector 2
 



  





 Core Responsibilities
 


1. **Accounts Receivable (AR) \& Collections Management**


* Credit Analysis: Evaluate new customer creditworthiness, analyze risk profiles, and recommend appropriate credit limits and payment terms.
* Aging Management: Actively monitor AR aging reports to identify overdue accounts, trends in delinquency, and potential bad debt risks.
* Collections Strategy: Execute proactive collection activities for high\-value or severely delinquent accounts via phone and formal written communication.
* Dispute Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex customer billing, pricing, or tax discrepancies by partnering with internal sales and operations teams.



  





**2\. Accounts Payable (AP) \& Compliance Management** 



* Invoice Verification: Execute rigorous 3\-way matching (Purchase Orders, Receiving Logs, and Vendor Invoices) for incoming vendor billings.
* Payment Optimization: Manage weekly payment runs via banking portals, balancing cash preservation with early\-payment discounts.
* Tax Compliance: Review and ensure compliance regarding local statutory requirements, including accurate withholding tax (TDS) deductions and GST reconciliation.
* Vendor Reconciliation: Perform monthly or quarterly reconciliations of vendor statements against internal sub\-ledgers to prevent duplicate or missed payments.



  





**3\. Month\-End \& Analytical Reporting** 



* Ledger Reconciliation: Reconcile AR and AP sub\-ledgers against the General Ledger (GL) to ensure complete data integrity.
* Accrual Management: Calculate and post monthly AP accruals for goods or services received but not yet invoiced.
* KPI Tracking: Generate and analyze operational cash flow metrics for leadership, including:
* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
* Days Payable Outstanding (DPO)
* Collection Effectiveness Index (CEI)
* Process Improvement: Identify system bottlenecks and assist in transitioning manual processes toward automated ERP workflows.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) DSO Reduction: Maintain Days Sales Outstanding within target corporate thresholds.
* Overdue Percentage: Keep accounts past 60/90 days below a defined percentage of total AR.
* AP Accuracy: Achieve greater than 98% accuracy in 3\-way matching and voucher creation.
* Reconciliation Timeliness: Complete monthly ledger reconciliations within the standard close timeline.



  





**Job Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* Technical \& Professional Skills Experience: 6 Months to 1 year of progressive experience in corporate accounting, specifically focusing on dual AR/AP workflows or general ledger management.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related business field.
* ERP Proficiency: Solid working experience with established ERP software (such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Tally Prime, or QuickBooks).
* Advanced Excel Capabilities: High proficiency in data manipulation using VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, logical formulas, and text/data parsing.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Sound operational knowledge of GST, TDS, corporate taxation, and fundamental accounting principles.



  





**Behavioral \& Interpersonal Competencies** 



* Assertive Diplomacy: Ability to negotiate firm payment timelines with delinquent clients while maintaining a professional business relationship.
* Detail Orientation: High visual and analytical precision to spot pricing discrepancies across high\-volume transaction files.
* Confidentiality: Demonstrated commitment to handling sensitive corporate cash positions and supplier contract pricing with strict data discretion.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Commuter assistance

description:

* Direct exposure to partners and to live client assignments from day one.

title: Research Analyst
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
   

  

 For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
   

  

 Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
   

  

 By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
   

  

 This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
   

  

 Wood Mackenzie
   

  

 Intelligence Connected
   

  

**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**
* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action


**The Opportunity**
 Global wind and solar capacity additions now exceed all other generation technologies combined, and the accuracy of weather\-driven production estimates has become a first\-order determinant of asset value, financing cost, and curtailment risk across every region Wood Mackenzie covers. As markets move toward hybrid, storage\-paired, and round\-the\-clock renewable structures and merchant price exposure rises, the gap between a well\-specified and a poorly\-specified production profile translates directly into basis points on project IRR and into real disputes between developers, lenders, and offtakers.
   

  

 Wood Mackenzie's Power \& Renewables research is the reference point utilities, IPPs, developers, investors, and financial institutions turn to for independent, defensible power market and asset\-level views worldwide. That standing rests on the credibility of the data underneath it, and weather\-to\-power modelling is one of the least commoditised, highest\-leverage parts of that data stack. The function is also evolving fast: machine learning and AI\-based approaches to weather nowcasting, satellite\-derived resource estimation, and calibration are moving from research curiosities to production tools, and there are relatively few analysts who combine meteorological data fluency, power market context, and modern ML tooling, making this a distinctive and fast\-growing skill set to build early in a research career.
   

  

 Joining this function gives you direct exposure to how resource assessment assumptions flow through into capacity expansion outlooks, price curves, and asset valuations used in live client transactions across multiple global markets, rather than working on production forecasting as an isolated technical exercise.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a technically strong Research Analyst to build and maintain the weather and production profile datasets that underpin Wood Mackenzie's global power market research. You will work closely with Senior Analysts and Principal Analysts across regional teams to translate raw meteorological, satellite, and asset\-level data into hourly generation profiles that feed directly into our capacity expansion models, price forecasts, and asset\-level revenue models.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, technically\-oriented role. You will spend the majority of your time working with weather and satellite datasets, asset characteristics data, calibration and validation workflows, and increasingly with machine learning and AI\-based methods, building and QAQCing hourly production profiles and validating model output against observed plant generation across multiple geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Weather data processing and quality control**
* Source, clean, and process gridded weather datasets, including reanalysis products (ERA5, MERRA\-2\), satellite\-derived irradiance (e.g. NSRDB, CAMS, SARAH), and numerical weather prediction (NWP) output, for use in production profile modelling
* Perform quality control on raw weather inputs, including gap\-filling, bias correction against ground\-station or satellite reference data, and consistency checks across data vintages
* Maintain structured weather databases across South Asia and APAC, ensuring version control and traceability of underlying data sources


**Wind and solar production profile modelling**
* Build and maintain hourly wind and solar production profiles at site and portfolio level, incorporating asset characteristics (turbine model and hub height, panel technology and tilt/azimuth, inverter specification, layout and spacing) alongside power curve modelling, wake loss adjustment, system losses, degradation, and curtailment assumptions
* Support long\-term resource assessment (P50/P90 exceedance analysis) for utility\-scale wind and solar assets globally, applying inter\-annual variability and measurement\-correlate\-predict (MCP) techniques where relevant
* Apply machine learning and statistical methods (e.g. gradient boosting, random forests, neural network\-based weather\-to\-power mapping) to improve production profile accuracy where they outperform physical or engineering\-based approaches, under the guidance of senior team members
* Translate site\-level weather, satellite, and asset data into generation profiles that feed into Wood Mackenzie's capacity expansion, dispatch, and asset revenue models


**Model validation and back\-testing**
* Calibrate production profile models against actual SCADA or grid\-metered generation data, and validate forecast accuracy by quantifying and documenting forecast error (MAPE, RMSE) by technology, geography, and time horizon
* Support back\-testing of forecast methodologies against realised generation, identifying systematic biases (e.g. wake modelling, soiling, curtailment under\-estimation) and feeding corrections back into the calibration workflow
* Assist in evaluating and piloting AI/LLM\-assisted tools for data processing, documentation, and anomaly detection within the production forecasting workflow


**Research and data support**
* Track and interpret weather\-driven trends relevant to renewable output across global markets, including seasonal and inter\-annual variability, and their implications for capacity factors and revenue forecasts
* Support Senior and Principal Analysts with data preparation, chart production, and analysis for client deliverables, research notes, and bespoke advisory projects
* Maintain thorough documentation of modelling assumptions, data sources, and methodology to ensure model outputs are transparent, defensible, and repeatable across markets


**Requirements**
**Qualification and experience**
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in renewable energy resource assessment, meteorology, wind/solar production forecasting, or power system data analysis; experience at a renewable energy developer, IPP, technical advisory firm, or meteorological services provider is an advantage
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Renewable Energy Engineering, Environmental Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline
* Working knowledge of wind and/or solar resource assessment methodologies, including power curve application, wake modelling concepts, and irradiance\-to\-power conversion (e.g. PVsyst, System Advisor Model, WAsP, or equivalent)
* Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, xarray) and/or SQL for processing large, gridded, time\-series weather datasets; familiarity with NetCDF and geospatial data formats is an advantage
* Exposure to reanalysis or satellite weather datasets (ERA5, MERRA\-2, NSRDB, CAMS) and NWP model output is highly desirable


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Foundational understanding of wind and solar generation technology, plant\-level losses, and the drivers of capacity factor variability across seasons and geographies
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large, imperfect, multi\-source datasets
* Ability to clearly document methodology and communicate technical findings to non\-technical audiences


**Communication Skills**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Fluency in additional European/ Asian languages is an advantage


**Equal Opportunities**
 We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: Associate Manager | Digital Strategy & Delivery
description:
ABOUT ENKI
 
 Enki Studio is a B2B brand strategy and creative agency for companies that refuse to be boring in categories that usually are. We work across telecom, SaaS, real estate and enterprise technology, bringing strategy, content, design, video and digital delivery together.
 



  




 THE ROLE
 
 We are looking for a smart, hands\-on project manager who can lead SEO and AIO accounts with confidence, understand what makes social media work, and see how every digital channel contributes to the larger marketing objective.
 



  





 You will own delivery, but you will also be expected to exercise judgment. That means reading an SEO audit and spotting the weak logic, questioning a content recommendation that has no search intent behind it, recognising when a social calendar is busy but strategically empty, and explaining the way forward to a client without hiding behind the specialist team.
 



  





**This is project management with a digital brain.** 




  




 YOUR PRIORITIES
 1. **SEO AND AIO :** 

 Lead organic\-search accounts from diagnosis to execution. Connect technical SEO, content, authority and AI\-led discovery into one coherent plan.
2. **SOCIAL MEDIA :** 

 Oversee strategy, calendars, campaigns and reporting with a sharp eye on audience, platform behaviour, brand voice and performance.
3. **DIGITAL MARKETING :** 

 Understand the wider ecosystem (websites, content, analytics, paid media, email and conversion journeys) well enough to manage integrated work and ask the questions that matter.



  




 WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO
 
**Own SEO and AIO delivery end to end.** 
 Turn business goals into roadmaps, sprint plans, clear responsibilities and measurable outcomes across technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, content, authority building, local search and visibility in AI\-generated answers.
 



  





**Interrogate the strategy.** 
 Review keyword and intent mapping, audits, content briefs, internal\-linking plans, schema recommendations, reporting and AIO experiments before they reach the client. You do not need to execute every task, but you must know when the work is shallow, disconnected or simply wrong.
 



  





**Run social media workstreams with context.** 
 Guide channel strategy, campaign planning, content calendars, community considerations and performance reviews. Ensure that ideas are platform\-aware, brand\-right and tied to a purpose beyond filling the grid.
 



  





**Manage integrated digital projects.** 
 Scope work, build timelines, allocate resources, track dependencies, control change requests and keep budgets and delivery health visible across SEO, social, content, website and campaign assignments.
 



  





**Lead the client conversation.** 
 Own meetings, reviews and difficult conversations on active accounts. Translate specialist thinking into plain language, defend sound recommendations and bring decisions to closure.
 



  





**Connect the specialists.** 
 Keep strategists, writers, designers, developers and analysts aligned so that the hand\-offs do not quietly murder the idea—or the deadline.
 



  





**Report what matters.** 
 Move reporting beyond rankings and vanity metrics. Connect visibility, qualified traffic, engagement, conversions and business signals; surface risks, insights and next actions clearly.
 



  





**Stay ahead of the shift.** 
 Track changes in search engines, AI discovery, content formats and social platforms, and turn relevant developments into practical recommendations for clients and the studio.
 



  




 WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
 
**SEO deeply enough to lead it.** 
 You understand technical, on\-page, off\-page and content\-led SEO; search intent; keyword strategy; crawling and indexing; site architecture; internal linking; structured data; page experience; authority; and the logic behind an organic growth plan.
 



  





**AIO beyond the acronym.** 
 You understand how answer engines and generative search are changing discovery, and how strong content structure, entity clarity, authority, citations, schema and measurement can improve a brand’s chances of being found and referenced. You can distinguish responsible experimentation from fashionable guesswork.
 



  





**Social media beyond posting.** 
 You understand audience behaviour, content pillars, formats, platform nuances, community, campaign thinking, social listening and the relationship between organic and paid distribution.
 



  





**The broader digital landscape.** 
 You can hold a credible conversation about websites and CMS platforms, analytics, conversion journeys, email, paid campaigns and content marketing—and know when a specialist needs to enter the room.
 



  




 THE EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
**4–7 years of relevant experience,** 
 with meaningful responsibility across digital marketing projects or client delivery.
 



  





**Agency experience is strongly preferred,** 
 because priorities move, feedback arrives late and calm judgment matters more than a pristine tracker.
 



  





**Demonstrable ownership of SEO accounts,** 
 including strategy, execution governance and performance reviews. Exposure to AIO, answer\-engine optimisation, generative search or AI\-search visibility is highly valuable.
 



  





**Working experience with social media accounts,** 
 from strategy and calendar governance to campaign delivery and reporting.
 



  





**Comfort with common tools,** 
 such as Google Search Console, GA4, keyword and crawling platforms, Looker Studio or equivalent reporting tools, social scheduling and analytics platforms, and project\-management systems.
 



  





**Excellent written and verbal communication,** 
 with the ability to make complex work clear without making it simplistic.
 



  




 WHAT WILL MAKE YOU RIGHT FOR ENKI
 
 You are organised, but not bureaucratic. Curious enough to challenge a recommendation, commercially aware enough to protect scope, and calm enough to handle an awkward client call without turning it into a five\-person escalation. You care about the quality of the work as much as the neatness of the tracker.
 



  





 We would rather meet someone who has led real accounts, learned from a few uncomfortable dashboards and can explain why a strategy will work than someone who knows every digital acronym but has never owned the outcome.
 



  





 If you think you are the right fit, drop an email with the subject :

title: Outreach Coordinator - 2 to 4 Years
description:
**Company Description** 
 Valion is India’s first Private Real Estate Family Office (P.R.E.F.O) with over a decade of experience and offices in Gurugram, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Singapore. The group is a trusted partner to more than 2,000 HNI and super HNI families, managing real estate investments and assets worth over INR 4,000 crores. Valion expanded its services with PropCare, a dedicated property management brand supporting property owners with multiple or out\-of\-city assets. It also launched myfollo, a real estate portfolio management portal that offers property advisory for investors and end users. Together, these platforms provide comprehensive real estate and property management solutions across domestic and international markets.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Outreach Coordinator role is a contract, on\-site position based in Gurugram for professionals with 2 to 4 years of relevant experience. The role involves planning and executing outreach initiatives to engage clients, partners, and local communities, including organizing events, meetings, and information sessions. The coordinator will handle day\-to\-day communication with stakeholders, respond to inquiries, and maintain strong relationships through high\-quality customer service. Responsibilities include conducting research on target audiences, tracking outreach performance, preparing reports, and sharing insights with internal teams. The role also supports training and onboarding activities for new partners or clients, ensuring consistent messaging and a positive brand experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written interaction with diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Community Outreach and Customer Service skills to build relationships, manage queries, and represent the organization professionally.
* Candidates should possess Research skills to identify outreach opportunities, analyze data, and provide actionable insights.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to support orientation sessions, workshops, and partner enablement activities.
* Relevant experience (2–4 years) in outreach, community engagement, client relations, or a similar role, preferably in real estate or services sectors.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Social Sciences, or a related field.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, manage multiple initiatives, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and basic data reporting; familiarity with CRM or outreach management systems is an advantage.
